The Bowman Mechbird Sculpture is a heady glass dab rig built for serious collectors who want their daily driver to double as a centerpiece. Hand-crafted in Spokane, WA, this mechanical bird form blends ultra-clean function with mind-bending detail, so you get a piece that absolutely rips but also lives on its own pedestal when you’re not seshing. Every Mechbird is unique, with American-made craftsmanship and full functionality wrapped into one wild, future‑aviary design.

This is the kind of rig you keep for years, not seasons. It’s designed for dabbers who care as much about line work, balance, and presence as they do about smooth pulls and tight function.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Gallery-level centerpiece — The mech-inspired bird form, with its sculpted body and detailed line work, looks like it belongs in a glass show, not just on a coffee table.
  • True heady, not mass-produced — Each Mechbird is individually hand-made in Spokane, WA, so no two pieces are exactly alike.
  • Built to be used, not just stared at — Under all the sculpture is a functional rig layout with clean diffusion and airflow designed for real-world dabbing.
  • Stable footprint — The balanced, sculpted base keeps the piece planted so you’re not stressing about tip-overs mid-sesh.
  • Feels like a forever piece — At this level, you’re not buying a rig to replace in a year; you’re adding a long-term anchor to your heady collection.

Best For

This Mechbird is made for heady hunters and art-forward dabbers who already have the basics covered and are ready for a true centerpiece rig. It’s perfect if you’ve got a dialed-in station with a favorite dab pad or mat and want one showpiece that instantly upgrades the whole vibe.

If you’re the type to go to glass shows, follow artists, and care who actually made your rig, this fits right into that world.

How to Use It

Day to day, the Mechbird runs like a high-end rig should. Attach your preferred nail or banger, add water to your usual level for smooth diffusion, and you’re ready for your concentrates. The internal pathways are designed for clean, controlled airflow, so it feels as refined as it looks.

To keep everything safe and steady, park it on a quality dab station or nonstick setup so you’re not sliding glass around on bare wood or glass tables. Treat it like the art piece it is—move it with two hands, and give it its own dedicated spot when not in use.

Pair it with your favorite carb cap and banger style, and it easily shifts from “showpiece for friends” to “personal daily driver” depending on how hard you like to run your seshes.

Category Heady glass dab rig / sculpture
Height Varies by individual piece
Material Borosilicate glass
Artist / Origin Hand-crafted in Spokane, WA, USA
Type Made in USA, heady glass

Because each Bowman Mechbird is hand-sculpted, exact height, volume, and shape will vary slightly from piece to piece. That’s part of the appeal—you’re not getting a factory clone.

Care & Cleaning

Think of this like cleaning a high-end sports car, not hosing down a beater. Let the piece cool completely after use, then gently wipe or rinse out any residue you can reach. For deeper cleans, soak the functional areas in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry fully before you go back to dabbing.

To keep it looking fresh between washes, try to dump old water regularly and avoid letting reclaim build up in those tight sculpted sections. When you’re not using it, consider displaying it near your other top-shelf glass or next to your nicer concentrate jars and stash containers so everything feels like part of one intentional setup.

Heady Glass Context

The Mechbird sits in that rare zone where sculpture and function actually meet in the middle. You’re not just paying for wild shaping—you’re getting an American-made rig from a serious glass worker with time in the game. For collectors already into American heady work, it’s the kind of piece that holds its own next to collabs, worked tubes, and other high-end rigs.

If you’re stepping up from simpler rigs or entry-level imports, this is a big leap into that “lifetime piece” category. It’s the kind of rig that deserves a clean workspace, maybe some padded surfaces, and dedicated tools that never leave your main dab tool and dabber setup.

Display & Protection Tips

With this much work in the shaping and form, display matters. A sturdy shelf or enclosed case is ideal, with enough room to avoid bumping it when you’re grabbing other gear. Keeping it away from high-traffic zones or wobbly tables is a simple way to extend its life.

If you’re moving or traveling, pack it like real glass art—padded, supported on the base, and not tossed into a bag next to random accessories. When it’s in your regular rotation, pairing it with durable smoke shop accessories that won’t scratch or chip glass is a small but real upgrade.

FAQ

  • Is the Bowman Mechbird Sculpture actually functional as a rig?
    Yes. Under the wild sculpted bird design, it’s built as a fully functional dab rig. You get real diffusion and proper airflow—it’s made to be used, not just stared at on a shelf.
  • Does this come with a banger or nail?
    The listing is for the sculpted rig itself. You can pair it with your preferred banger, nail, or other attachments, or upgrade to something special from your existing collection of rigs and silicone-compatible accessories.
  • What kind of concentrates can I use with this?
    Any standard dab-friendly concentrates (like rosin, live resin, etc.) will work, as long as you’re using an appropriate banger or nail. The rig doesn’t care what you load—it just handles the vapor and cools it down.
  • How fragile is it compared to a simple beaker or silicone rig?
    It’s still glass, so it won’t shrug off drops the way a silicone piece might, and the sculpted details deserve extra respect. That said, the base and structure are designed to stand stable, so as long as you don’t knock it over or mishandle it, it’s perfectly fine as a regular-use rig. If you want something totally worry-free for camping or travel, a dedicated piece from our nectar collectors and travel straws lineup might be better for on-the-go seshes.
  • Is every Mechbird identical?
    No. Each one is handmade in Spokane, WA, so shapes, proportions, and tiny details will vary. You’re getting a one-of-a-kind piece, not a stamped copy.
  • How should I clean around the more intricate sculpted areas?
    Let the rig cool, then gently rinse or soak the functional sections with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry. For tight angles or detailed spots, patience and lighter cleans more often are better than aggressive scrubbing.
  • Is this worth it if I mostly want a daily driver?
    If you just want something simple and indestructible, there are plenty of budget pieces for that. The Mechbird is for dabbers who want their daily driver to feel like art—something you’re proud to leave out when friends come over, and something that stands out in any serious collection.

Full CFL Serum with Haterade accents means this rig doesn’t just sit there—it shifts from champagne to rosy tones as your lighting changes, turning every sesh into a moving light show.

Why You’ll Love This Rig

  • True centerpiece energy — The Mech Burd silhouette and layered colorwork are built to live on the top shelf, not in the cabinet.
  • Color that actually moves — CFL Serum glass shifts from champagne to soft rose depending on your light source, so the rig feels different at night than it does in the sun.
  • Collector-level collab — Joint work from Kerby and Bowman means you’re getting a one-off piece with its own personality, not something that looks like every other rig online.
  • Ready for serious dabs — 14mm male, 45° joint is made for modern bangers and accessories, so it’s not just pretty—it’s built to be used.
  • Balanced and comfortable — Around 10 inches (254mm) is that sweet spot: big enough for function and flavor, small enough to handle comfortably on the couch or at the desk.
  • Heady flex without compromise — You’re getting sculpture-level detail while still keeping a layout that’s actually cleanable and sesh-friendly.

Best For

This rig is made for serious heady glass people—the ones who know artists by name and can spot CFL work from across the room. It’s ideal if you already have a daily driver and want the piece you pull out when friends are over, or when you’re staging a new drop on the table next to your favorite concentrate jars.

If you’re the type who takes time dialing in your setup, photographing your rigs, or rearranging shelves just to show off the right angles, Mech Burd #2 will fit right into that ritual.

The Artists & The Build

Kerby and Bowman don’t really do “simple.” This collab leans into that mechanical bird aesthetic—layered forms, sculpted lines, and clean welds that look like they’re in motion even when the rig’s just sitting there. It’s the kind of piece you keep finding new details on months later.

The full CFL Serum body is where the magic really lives. Under cooler indoor light it leans champagne and soft gold, then under different sources or sunlight that same glass wakes up with rosy, pinkish tones. The Haterade accents cut through all that warmth with sharp, electric hits of color, so the whole piece reads like a stylized mech out of a future cartoon.

How to Use It

Think of this like any other high-end 14mm rig—just with way better aesthetics. Pair it with your favorite 14mm female banger, directional cap, and a comfortable torch or e-rig setup, then let the shape and volume of the piece handle the rest. The 45° joint makes it really natural to use at a coffee table height without wrestling your angle.

Set it down on a quality dab mat or pad when you’re in use mode, so any stray drips or reclaim hit silicone instead of your shelves or desk.

Cleaning is about respect with heady pieces. Let everything cool off, then rinse and gently swish; for deeper cleans you can soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry fully before putting it back under the lights. Treat it like the functional sculpture it is and it’ll stay in rotation for years.

Joint Angle 45°

Fit & Compatibility

With a 14mm male, 45° joint, this rig is built to play nice with standard 14mm female bangers, dropdowns, and reclaim catchers. That 45° cut is especially friendly for people who like to run slightly larger nail setups without feeling crowded by the can.

If you’re running a full setup—directional carb cap, pearls, etc.—this rig gives them room to shine. Pair it with your favorite cap or explore new airflow options in our selection of carb caps to really fine-tune your function.

Care Tips

Heady glass deserves a little routine. Try to empty water between seshes or at least daily if it’s staying on display, so you don’t get that stale line inside the can. Let the banger and joint cool fully before you move or clean anything.

For deeper cleaning, a simple soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry is usually all you need. Avoid harsh tools or scrubbing anything near the artwork—let the alcohol do the work so you don’t risk scratches or micro-abrasions on those color sections. When it’s not in use, a padded shelf next to your other premium smoke shop pieces is the safest home base.

FAQ

  1. Will this rig fit my current banger setup?

    The Mech Burd #2 has a 14mm male, 45° joint, so it fits any standard 14mm female banger or nail. If your current pieces are 14mm female, you’re set—just drop one in and you’re ready.
  2. Is this meant to be used or just displayed?

    Both. It’s absolutely a collector-level piece, but it’s also fully functional heady glass. Many people use rigs like this as their “special occasion” or weekend setup and keep a different daily driver in rotation alongside more rugged silicone rigs for travel and rougher use.
  3. How hard is it to keep clean without damaging the artwork?

    As long as you stick to isopropyl alcohol, gentle rinsing, and patience, it’s straightforward. Let everything cool, soak if needed, rinse with clean water, and air dry. Avoid abrasive brushes or anything that could scratch the glass.
  4. What makes CFL Serum special compared to regular glass colors?

    CFL Serum reacts to certain light wavelengths, so it shifts in tone depending on the light in your space. You’ll notice more champagne or golden vibes in some lighting, and softer rose tones in others, which keeps the rig feeling “alive” on the shelf. It’s a favorite among heady collectors who like pieces that change throughout the day.
  5. Is this rig good as a first “nice” piece?

    If you’re jumping straight into high-end heady glass, this is one of those forever pieces you build a collection around. Just know you’re in serious territory here—many people start with more affordable setups, then upgrade to something like this once they’ve dialed in their preferences and storage game with proper storage and packaging for their concentrates.
  6. Does it come with any accessories?

    The listing is for the rig itself. You’ll need to supply your own 14mm female banger, cap, and tools. If you’re curating a full heady setup around it, you can match it with unique tools from our rotating accessories collections to keep the whole station on theme.
  7. What’s the advantage of the 10" height?

    About 10 inches (254mm) is a great balance: enough internal volume for smooth, flavorful pulls and visible function, but not so tall that it feels awkward to handle or harder to store. It’s a comfortable size for both solo seshes and passing around the room without feeling like you’re juggling a sculpture.

The Cowboy Holy Waters Sherlock Pipe is a high-end, American-made art glass hand pipe built for serious collectors who want a true centerpiece, not just another spoon. Made by Chris Kerner (Cowboy) in Eugene, Oregon, it blends elite function with gallery-level aesthetics. The Fire and Ice color work and plate stack construction turn every sesh into a flex.

Why It Hits Different

  • Display piece that absolutely rips — Signature Cowboy shaping and plate stack radness give you something that looks museum-ready but still works as a legit daily driver.
  • Wild color contrast — Fire and Ice palette throws hot and cold tones against each other, so the pipe shifts personality depending on the light.
  • Refined airflow, smooth pulls — The Sherlock profile and hollow disk wigwag mouthpiece help deliver comfortable, controlled hits instead of harsh, straight-shot draws.
  • Loaded with details — Faceted bowl, millies, and layered construction reward close-ups when you're passing it around or just staring at it on the coffee table.
  • Heirloom-level craftsmanship — Handbuilt in Eugene, OR by a named artist whose work is featured in This Is A Pipe, so the value is in the art as much as the function.
  • Built for real use — Even at collectible status and price, this is still a thoughtfully designed hand pipe meant to be used, not just locked in a case.

Best For

This piece is made for glass heads who are already deep into the scene—people who know artist names, follow drops, and treat pipes like sculpture. If you’ve outgrown throwaway glass and want one signature Sherlock that defines your setup, this belongs in that conversation. It also pairs well with durable, on-the-go gear like our silicone pipes so you can keep this Cowboy safe at home and travel with something more bombproof.

How to Use & Live With It

The basics are simple: it’s a Sherlock hand pipe—pack the bowl, use the carb, and enjoy the smoother, angled draw that keeps the heat away from your face. The elongated neck also helps cool things a bit compared to a stubby spoon, so your hits feel more refined.

Treat it like a functional art piece. When you’re loading up, set it on a soft, stable surface like a dab mat or padded tray so you’re not risking a drop on a hard table. Avoid tapping it out on rough edges; use a tool or a soft surface instead.

For upkeep, let it fully cool before cleaning. Tap or blow out loose ash, then wipe exposed areas with a soft cloth or cotton swab. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before the next sesh.

Specifications

Category High-end Sherlock hand pipe
Artist Chris Kerner (AKA Cowboy)
Design Cowboy Holy Waters Sherlock with plate stack construction
Colorway Fire and Ice
Key Features Faceted bowl, signature millies, hollow disk wigwag mouthpiece
Origin Eugene, Oregon, USA
Type Made in USA, artisanal glass

Fit, Feel & Function

That Sherlock curve isn’t just for looks—it brings the bowl down and away while the mouthpiece comes up toward you, so you get a relaxed, ergonomic hand position. The faceted bowl adds grip and sparkle under light, and the mouthpiece disk gives your lips a natural landing point.

This isn’t a pocket beater. It’s ideal as a home piece where you can control the environment, keep it clean, and enjoy the details. For safe storage between sessions, many collectors pair high-end glass with padded cases and stash their flower separately in proper glass jars & packaging to keep everything organized and protected.

Collectible Value

What pushes this beyond “nice pipe” territory is the name and the execution. Cowboy is a recognized glass artist, and having work tied to projects like This Is A Pipe adds extra credibility for collectors tracking provenance and long-term value.

At this price, you’re investing in studio time, concept, and reputation as much as the physical glass. If you’re already curating a shelf of American functional art—or planning to start—this Sherlock sits comfortably in that top-tier lane alongside other Made in USA heavy hitters and can live right next to more rugged daily gear from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

FAQ

  • Is each Cowboy Holy Waters Sherlock Pipe truly one of a kind?
    Yes. Because Cowboy hand-crafts these pieces, each pipe will have its own subtle variations in linework, color balance, and details. The Fire and Ice theme and core design repeat, but no two are exactly the same.
  • Can I actually use this as a daily driver, or is it just for display?
    You can absolutely use it as a daily driver if you’re careful with your glass. Many collectors rotate a piece like this for “special occasion” seshes and keep a tougher backup pipe or even a silicone bong or rig for rougher use or clumsy friends.
  • How should I clean it without risking damage?
    Let the pipe cool first so there’s no thermal shock. Tap or blow out loose ash gently, then use isopropyl alcohol for deeper cleans—either a soak or a rinse—followed by a thorough warm water rinse and full air-dry. Avoid harsh abrasives or metal tools against the glass.
  • Does the Sherlock shape really change the way it hits?
    Yes. The curved neck and length between bowl and mouthpiece can make hits feel smoother compared to very short, straight pipes. It also keeps your face a bit farther from the bowl, which a lot of people find more comfortable over longer seshes.
  • What makes Cowboy’s work a “collector’s item” instead of regular glass?
    It comes down to recognized artist status, consistent style, and execution. Cowboy’s name, the Holy Waters theme, the plate stack building, and being featured in projects like This Is A Pipe all contribute to this being a piece you can identify, talk about, and potentially see hold or increase value in a serious glass collection.
  • How should I store it when I’m not using it?
    Ideally, keep it on a padded stand, in a display case, or in a cushioned box where it won’t get knocked over. Many people keep their flower or concentrates in separate storage & packaging solutions and only bring this piece out once everything else is set up, then put it away right after the sesh.
  • Is this pipe covered under any kind of warranty if I break it?
    In almost all cases, glass is considered fragile art—if it’s dropped, knocked, or smashed, that’s not covered. The craftsmanship is top-tier, but it’s still glass, so treat it with respect and handle it like the premium piece it is.

This is that “forever piece” you buy once and then build your whole concentrate routine around.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Showpiece-level art — Hand-crafted glasswork turns your rig into a centerpiece, not just another tool in the rotation.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The internal design helps cool vapor as it moves, so the hit stays potent without feeling harsh.
  • Confident, sturdy stance — A wide 5 inch (127mm) base keeps things stable when you’re passing it around or running larger dabs.
  • Made in the USA glasswork — Built by an American artist with the kind of attention to detail you only get from small-batch, handmade rigs.
  • 14mm ready — Standard 14mm joint size keeps it easy to pair with your favorite bangers and accessories.
  • Collector-grade build — The craftsmanship and price tag put this squarely in grail-piece territory, while still being functional enough to use every day.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who are past the “starter setup” phase and want something they can proudly keep on the coffee table. If you rotate multiple strains, store your sauces and rosin in proper concentrate jars, and actually notice the difference between average and great function, you’re the person this piece was built for. It’s also a strong fit for collectors who like owning named, recognizable work that holds its value over time.

How to Use It

Functionally, the Darby Ray Run Rig runs like a well-designed daily driver: attach a 14mm banger, add water to your preferred level, and you’re ready to go. The internal geometry is designed to cool and condition vapor quickly, so even when you’re taking heavier dabs, you’re not getting cooked on the inhale.

For the cleanest setup, park this rig on a quality dab mat so you’re not risking sticky tables or accidental tip-overs when you set the banger down. Treat it like the art piece it is—give it a stable, padded home base and it’ll stay looking fresh.

Between seshes, let the rig cool and then pour out old water regularly. If you dab often, a quick rinse every day or two keeps flavor clean and lets you actually taste those terps you paid for. Think of it like maintaining a favorite car: a little routine attention goes a long way.

Height 9 inches (229mm)

For anyone building out a full silicone-friendly station, it also pairs well with our selection of silicone bongs & rigs as backup pieces when you don’t feel like putting the art glass at risk.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig fully cool before you do anything with it—especially if you’ve just finished a heavy dab. For light maintenance, empty the water and give the piece a warm rinse. For deeper cleaning, you can soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before the next sesh. Keeping it clean not only makes it look better, it keeps flavor sharp and lets the craftsmanship really shine.

FAQ

  • What joint size does the Darby Ray Run Rig use?
    This rig is built with a 14mm joint, so you’ll want to pair it with 14mm bangers, dropdowns, and other attachments. If your favorite banger is already 14mm, it should drop right in with no issues.
  • Is this rig good for daily use, or should I treat it as a display piece?
    It’s absolutely functional enough to be a daily driver, and the design is made with real-world dabbing in mind. That said, the price and craftsmanship put it into collector territory, so a lot of people use it for their “nice” seshes while keeping a backup from our broader smoke shop products lineup for more chaotic situations.
  • How should I clean this rig without damaging it?
    Let it cool first, then empty the water and rinse with warm water. For built-up residue, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it air dry before using again. Avoid big temperature shocks—no super hot water right after a torch sesh.
  • Does it come with a banger or other accessories?
    No, this listing is for the rig itself. You’ll need to supply your own 14mm banger, carb cap, and dab tools. If you’re dialing in a full setup, it pairs well with our curated dab tools so you always have the right tool for different consistencies.
  • Is each Darby Ray Run Rig exactly the same?
    No. These are hand-made in the USA, so each piece has its own subtle variations in line work and details. The overall shape, size, and function stay consistent, but you’re getting a one-of-a-kind rig, not stamped factory glass.

  • How should I store or display it when I’m not dabbing?
    Keep it on a stable, flat surface away from edges or high-traffic zones. A padded surface or a thick pad helps protect the base and prevents accidental chips. If you’re also storing your concentrates nearby, keeping them sealed up in proper storage & packaging will keep your whole station dialed and ready whenever you want to fire up the rig.

If you’re ready to step up from “nice rig” to “grail piece,” the Darby Ray Run Rig delivers that leap. Made in the USA, engineered for real-world function, and finished with the kind of hand-worked detail you only see in serious glass, this is the rig you buy once and keep in the collection for good.

  • Collector-level statement piece — Custom, hand-blown glass with a futuristic "space bot" aesthetic that instantly becomes the centerpiece of your rig lineup.

How to Use It

The KERBY SPACE BOT works like a refined version of your favorite dab rig: water in the bottom chamber, banger in the 14mm female joint, and you’re ready to go. The key difference is how the multi-chamber system routes vapor — as you draw, it pulls through multiple sections of the rig to diffuse and cool before it ever hits your lungs.

Keep the water line just above the perc openings in the lower chamber. Too much water and you’ll feel drag; too little and you’ll miss out on the fully smoothed hit this rig is built for. Once you’ve got your level dialed, you’ll feel the function lock in — that balanced resistance when you pull that tells you the diffusion is working properly.

Pair it with one of your go-to flat-top bangers, and don’t be afraid to swap in different cap styles from your favorite carb caps to see how airflow plays through the chambers. This rig really shows you the difference between lazy airflow and tuned function.

Where the SPACE BOT really shines is the way its chambers and reclaim catcher are laid out. Instead of letting excess oil and residue pool in awkward corners, the internal pathways help guide reclaim away from your main airflow, so the flavor stays cleaner for longer. That means fewer deep cleans and more time actually dabbing.

The futuristic “bot” profile isn’t just for looks — the shape gives you multiple solid grip points, so you can steady the rig easily when you’re three dabs in and trying to hit your banger without tapping the glass. It’s the kind of thoughtful, made-by-dabbers design you don’t notice until you’ve lived with it for a few weeks.

A budget import will get you vapor; the KERBY SPACE BOT is for when you actually want to taste what your grower or extractor did.

    The product listing is for the rig itself. That keeps things simple if you already have a favorite 14mm male banger. If not, grab a solid quartz banger and you’ll be fully set up.

    It’s easier than it looks. Let the rig cool, drain the water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, and gently shake. Rinse well with warm water afterward and let it dry completely. Regular light cleans will keep it from ever becoming a big project.

Pair it with clean storage like nonstick-lined options from our storage & packaging collection to keep your material tasting fresh before it even hits the banger.

    Yes, the design, joint size, and function are all tuned for dabs and other concentrates. If you’re looking for something that can pull double duty with flower, you’re usually better off with a different layout or a dedicated flower piece plus a separate dab rig.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Showpiece-level art you’ll actually use — The sculpted purple hands and custom shaping make this rig stand out instantly, but it’s built to be hit, not just stared at.

  • Complete set, ready to go — Comes with a matching banger, so you’re dialed in for concentrates straight out of the box.

The Cove Glass Purple Hands Recycler Set is made for dabbers who already have a basic rig and are ready to step into high-end glass without sacrificing function. If you’re the friend hosting seshes and like having a centerpiece on the coffee table, this is the flex piece that still rips like a workhorse. It also slots in perfectly alongside other premium pieces in your collection of smoke shop products when you want one rig that always gets a reaction.

How to Use It

Start by adding a bit of water to the main chamber and recycler section. You’re aiming for enough water to cover the perc while still leaving room for the recycler to cycle — you’ll see the water drain and return as you pull when it’s dialed right. Give it a couple of test pulls (no heat) to feel and hear the function.

Once the water level feels right, load your concentrates into the included banger and heat using your preferred torch technique. As you draw, the recycler pulls water up and then drops it back down, constantly refreshing the filtration so your hits stay smooth and flavorful. Setting the rig on a quality dab mat keeps your table safe from heat, drips, and accidental bumps when you’re a few dabs in.

Between hits, let the piece rest upright so all the water settles back into the base. That recycler loop is designed to work with a steady, comfortable draw — no need to over-pull. When you’re done, let the banger fully cool before cleaning or putting anything away, so you’re not shocking hot glass or leaving crusty buildup for “future you” to deal with.

Cleaning & Care

For quick maintenance, let everything cool after your sesh, drain the water, and rinse the rig with warm water to keep reclaim from building up in the recycler pathways. Keeping the banger clean with regular wipes means better flavor and less scrubbing later — especially if you’re working with terpy concentrates stored in proper concentrate jars.

The Basics: Recycler Function

Recycler rigs like this one are all about movement and cooling. As you pull, water is pulled up through the internal channels, filtered with your vapor, then “recycled” back into the base. The silver fume and color work give it that evolving, lived-in look that just gets better with every sesh.

Why It Hits Different

  • Super smooth, zero-chug function — The incycler design constantly recycles water through the internal chambers, cutting harshness and keeping your hits cool and clean.
  • Massive rips with real control — The 18-inch (457mm) height and big internal volume let you stack fat clouds without it feeling like a lung workout.

Best For

It also plays perfectly as the centerpiece to a bigger station with trays, tools, and a dedicated dab mat underneath to keep everything clean and cushioned.

The Basics: What an Incycler Does

An incycler is a style of recycler where the return drain is tucked inside the main chamber instead of running around the outside. That enclosed drain means a tighter, more contained water path, which usually translates into less splash, more consistent water level, and smoother pulls.

On this 18" Monark, as you pull, water is drawn up into the upper chamber and then continuously sucked back down through the internal drain. That constant motion helps break up the smoke with more contact time in the water, which takes some of the bite out without killing flavor.

Because it’s so tall, you get that fun visual of water and smoke moving through separate sections. It’s the kind of piece you end up staring at mid-rip because the function looks almost mechanical when everything is dialed in.

How to Use It

Start by adding water through the mouthpiece or joint until the lower chamber and percs are properly covered and you get a nice, active recycle when you pull. Take a few test pulls with no bowl in to check for splash and adjust the water level until it cycles smoothly without kissing your lips.

From there, just treat it like your main bong: pack your bowl, pull at a pace that keeps the water spinning, and let the incycler do the heavy lifting of cooling and smoothing. For concentrates, you can swap in a banger or use a compatible adapter so this thing can double as a monster dab rig alongside your smaller silicone bongs and rigs.

Cleaning is simple: let the piece cool if you’ve been running hot bowls or dabs, empty the water, then give it a rinse. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh.

  • Can I use it for both flower and dabs?

If you’re switching back and forth, give it a good rinse in between, just like you would with smaller smoke shop products in your rotation.

    Splash control on tall recyclers mostly comes down to water level and pull speed. Start with less water, test pull, then slowly add more until you see strong recycle without splash. If you’re ripping it super hard and getting a little mist, back off the pull slightly or reduce the water a bit.
  • What’s the best way to clean all those internal chambers?
    Empty the water, add isopropyl alcohol, gently plug the openings, and swirl to let the solution work its way through the inner paths. Rinse well with warm water afterward and let it dry. For day-to-day use, frequent quick rinses will keep buildup under control so you don’t have to deep clean as often, similar to how you’d treat your other high-end accessories.

The 8″ COOKIES DOUBLE CYCLER is a premium glass recycler rig built for dabbers who want that clean, cooled-down hit without giving up on style. At 8 inches (203mm) tall with a 14mm, 90° joint, it’s sized perfectly as a daily driver that still feels special every time you pull it out. The double uptake recycler and top cut puck perc team up to keep your vapor moving, filtering, and cooling so your hits stay smooth and flavorful.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Rig

  • Chiller, smoother pulls — Double uptake recycler keeps your vapor and water cycling, stretching contact time for cooler, less harsh hits.
  • Clean-tasting function — The top cut puck perc breaks everything into fine bubbles so you taste your concentrates, not hot, dense vapor.
  • Locked-in alignment — Fixed downstem and 90° 14mm joint keep your banger or bowl stable and easy to aim into.
  • Real Cookies flex — Authentic Cookies branding, etched details, and packaging so you know you’re holding the real thing, not a knockoff.
  • Comfortable size for real use — At 8 inches (203mm), it’s tall enough for legit function but still easy to pass, stash, and clean.
  • All-in-one experience — Comes with a Cookies etched bowl and Santa Cruz Shredder, so you’re dialed in right out of the box.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a recycler that actually functions, not just something that looks cool on a shelf. If you’re the type running a few seshes a day and you care about flavor, cooling, and legit brand collabs, this is your lane. It also doubles as a fancy flower piece when you don’t feel like breaking out a big tube, especially if you’ve already got a solid stash of accessories from our broader smoke shop products collection.

How to Use It

Set up the COOKIES DOUBLE CYCLER with your favorite 14mm banger or the included bowl. The 90° joint makes it easy to keep everything level on a flat surface, so you’re not fighting for the right angle mid-sesh.

When you pull, vapor and water are drawn through the top cut puck perc first, where the bubbles are broken up for initial diffusion. From there, the double uptake arms pull water up and around, sending it on a loop through the upper chamber before it drains back down. That recycler motion is what takes the edge off your hits and keeps things tasting cleaner. Parking it on a nonstick dab mat is a smart move so any sticky drips or splashback stay off your table.

The continuous circulation also helps keep your water fresher a little longer, so hits don’t go stale as fast when you’re running multiple pulls back-to-back. Just remember to keep your water level in a comfortable range so you’re getting that recycle effect without drinking your rig.

Fit & Compatibility

The 8″ COOKIES DOUBLE CYCLER uses a standard 14mm joint at a 90° angle, which means it plays nice with most common bangers, dropdowns, and accessories in that size. If you’re upgrading your setup, pairing it with a good carb cap from our curated carb caps lineup will help you really dial in airflow and function on this recycler.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig cool down before you do anything to it. Once it’s at room temp, dump the water and rinse. For a deeper clean, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry before you put it back into rotation. Keeping the recycler pathways clean will help maintain that fast, satisfying drain and crisp function.

FAQs

  • Will this fit my existing 14mm banger or nail?
    Yes. The rig has a 14mm joint at a 90° angle, so most standard 14mm bangers, nails, and dropdowns will fit right in. If you’re switching from a 45° piece, you’ll probably like how naturally a 90° joint sits over a flat accessory setup on your table.
  • Is this only for dabs, or can I use flower too?
    You can absolutely use it for flower. It comes with a Cookies etched bowl, so you’re ready for flower right out of the box. Swap that out for a 14mm banger and you’ve got a serious dab rig with recycler function.
  • How hard is it to clean a double recycler like this?
    It’s pretty straightforward. Rinse regularly so residue doesn’t build in the arms, and when it needs a reset, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry. Keeping reclaim under control also makes it easier to keep your paired dab tools clean and ready.
  • What’s the advantage of the double uptake recycler design?
    The double uptake arms pull water up and around more efficiently, which gives you smoother, cooler hits and helps reduce splashback. You get that looping, “drain and spin” recycler feel that a lot of dabbers love because it keeps vapor moving instead of just bubbling in one spot.
  • Is 8 inches big enough for daily dabbing?
    Yes. 8 inches (203mm) is a sweet spot for dab rigs — compact enough to handle easily but tall enough to give the vapor some path and let the perc and recycler do their job. It’s a solid daily driver size, especially if you’re already running small or mid-size rigs in your lineup of silicone bongs & rigs and glass pieces.
  • Does this come with everything shown, or do I need to buy extras?
    You get the rig, a Cookies etched bowl, a Cookies logo Santa Cruz Shredder, a seal of authenticity, and branded packaging. You’ll want to add your own banger if you’re dabbing, and storing your concentrates in quality concentrate jars will help you actually taste what this rig can do.
  • Is this an authentic Cookies piece or a replica?
    It’s an authentic COOKIES DOUBLE CYCLER collab with Wyn Brands, complete with official logos, etched details, and a seal of authenticity in the box, so you’re getting the real thing and not a random copy.

At 14 inches (355mm) tall with a 14mm joint, it’s a perfect daily driver size—big enough for milky pulls, but not a chore to handle or stash. The clear glass shows off the function, while the Cookies etching keeps it looking clean, modern, and instantly recognizable.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Built-in ice pinch lets you stack cubes in the neck so each rip comes in chilled.
  • Solid, stable base — Beaker bottom spreads out the weight so it’s way less likely to get knocked over mid-sesh.
  • Easy to customize — Standard 14mm joint size plays nice with tons of bowls, ash catchers, and other glass add-ons.
  • Clean, iconic look — Clear glass with Cookies branding gives you that subtle flex without being loud or cartoony.
  • Great daily driver size — 14 inches (355mm) is tall enough for real function, but still easy to pass around or keep on a shelf.
  • Ready to use out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm bowl so you’re not rummaging for random glass just to try it.

Best For

This beaker is made for people who want a reliable, good-looking bong they can actually use every day—not just stare at on a shelf. If you’re the friend who always has the “house piece” ready for movie nights or pre-roll warmups, this is right in your lane. It also fits well into a more complete setup if you’re building out a full smoke shop products station at home.

How to Use It

Start by adding water into the beaker base until the downstem area (if present) would be properly covered—enough to filter, not so much that it splashes into your mouth when you clear it. Drop a few ice cubes in through the mouthpiece so they rest on the ice pinch for extra cooling power.

Pack your dry herb into the included 14mm bowl, seat it snugly in the joint, and you’re ready to go. The beaker design gives you a big volume of water and space for smoke to stack, which is why these shapes hit so smooth when you dial in your water level. If you like to keep your table clean, setting this on a dedicated dab mat helps catch any drips, ash, or stray herb as you load and pass it.

After your sesh, dump the water and give the piece a quick rinse so resin and smell don’t build up too hard. Keeping up with that simple routine makes every rip taste way fresher.

If you’re also working with concentrates, you can keep your flower in this and use a separate rig or nectar collector for dabs so each setup stays clean and tuned for what it does best.

Care & Cleaning

Let the glass cool down before cleaning, especially if you’ve been running hot bowls back-to-back. Rinse with warm water, then for deeper cleans, soak the bong in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry completely before using again. A quick wipe of the bowl and joint area after a few uses keeps it from getting crusty and hard to pull.

FAQ

  • Does this bong come with everything I need to use it?
    Yes. You get the 14″ Cookies V Beaker Clear bong and a 14mm bowl piece in the box, so if you already have flower and a lighter, you’re good to go. If you like to prep your material ahead of time, pairing it with a good grinder and some airtight glass jars keeps your stash ready and fresh.
  • Will a 14mm banger or other accessory fit this?
    As long as your accessory is 14mm and the correct gender to match the joint on the bong, it should fit. Most standard 14mm bowls and attachments made for bongs will play nice with this Cookies beaker.
  • How much water should I put in the beaker?
    Fill the base so the bottom of the downstem area (if present) would be well covered in water, but not so high that it splashes into your mouth when you clear a hit. You can experiment a little to find your sweet spot—too little and it’s harsher, too much and it drags.
  • Is this a good piece for everyday use?
    Absolutely. The 14-inch height, beaker base, and 14mm joint combo make it a solid daily driver for most smokers. If you like to keep your setup dialed in and organized, consider storing your flower or small accessories in dedicated storage & packaging so everything’s in one spot when it’s time to sesh.
  • How do I keep the glass looking clear and not cloudy?
    Change the water regularly, give it a quick rinse after use, and do an isopropyl alcohol soak when you notice buildup. Don’t let dirty water sit for days—that’s what stains and smell up the glass. A little upkeep goes a long way with clear pieces, especially branded ones like this.
  • Is this more for collectors or for actual heavy use?
    It works for both. The Cookies branding gives it that collectible vibe, but the design is fully functional and made to be used. If you want to keep your dabbing gear separate, you can run flower through this and use your more heat-focused glass with dedicated dab tools so nothing crosses over.
  • Can I travel with this bong?
    You can move it between spots or bring it to a friend’s place, just be smart about padding it in the box or a padded bag so the glass isn’t clanking around. For on-the-go or rougher environments, some people prefer unbreakable pieces like silicone bongs & rigs and keep the Cookies beaker at home as the main setup.

The 8" Cookies Incycler is a premium glass dab rig built for Cookies fans and flavor chasers who want smooth function and legit branding in one piece. At 8 inches (203mm) tall with a 14mm, 90° joint, it’s sized perfectly as a daily driver that still feels special every time you pull it off the shelf. The incycler design keeps water cycling inside the rig for extra-smooth, well-controlled function without splashes.

Made in collaboration with Wyn Brands, this rig blends clean scientific lines with that unmistakable Cookies aesthetic, from the cookie-cut perc to the etched logos and branded accessories. If you’re the type who actually uses your glass but still wants it to look like a centerpiece, this is right in your lane.

Why this piece hits different

  • Smoother pulls with less effort — The incycler continuously recycles water inside the rig, helping cool and condition vapor so your hits feel softer on the throat.
  • Less splash, more control — Internal recycling keeps the water moving without sending it up the neck, so you can pull harder without getting a mouthful.
  • Ready for real use — A fixed downstem and bridged joint add durability where rigs usually fail, so it can handle being a true daily driver.
  • Dialed-in 14mm, 90° joint — Works seamlessly with standard 14mm bangers and accessories, so you can swap in your favorite setup without hunting for adapters.
  • Signature Cookie Cut Perc — The custom perc breaks up vapor into smaller bubbles for better diffusion and also adds that recognizable Cookies look inside the can.
  • Legit Cookies branding — Etched Cookies logos, a seal of authenticity, and branded accessories make this feel like a complete, collectible setup instead of just another clear rig.
  • Table-friendly size — At 8 inches (203mm), it’s compact enough to keep on a desk or coffee table but tall enough to clear comfortably without hunching over.

Best for

This 8" Cookies Incycler is made for dabbers who want more than a basic beaker—people who care about function, brand authenticity, and how their rig actually looks on the shelf. It’s especially solid for anyone running a dedicated dab station with a dab mat and a couple of favorite tools always within reach.

If you’re into flavorful dabs, moderate to heavy daily seshes, and you like rigs that feel both collectible and practical, this one hits that sweet spot. It’s not a giant showpiece you’re scared to touch, but it definitely doesn’t feel cheap or disposable.

How to use it (and actually enjoy it)

Using the Cookies Incycler feels like any solid rig, just with smoother water movement going on behind the scenes. Fill the water through the mouthpiece or joint until the cookie-cut perc is properly covered but not flooded. The magic here is the incycler section: as you pull, water gets drawn up and then drains back down, continuously recycling to cool vapor and reduce harshness.

The 14mm, 90° joint plays nice with most standard bangers, so you can pair it with your go-to nail and set it on a dab tool stand or holder between pulls to keep your station organized. Once you dial in your preferred water level, you’ll notice the function feels tight and controlled—no wild chugging, just a smooth, cycling pull.

After your sesh, give the rig a quick rinse while everything’s still fresh; it’ll keep reclaim from building up in the tight incycler pathways. When you want to stash your concentrates until next round, parking them in proper concentrate jars will help keep your flavor on point and your rig from getting gunked up too fast.

Cleaning is simple: let everything cool, empty the water, rinse, and when it needs a deeper refresh, soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry before you bring it back into rotation. No special tools required.

What's included

  • 8" Cookies Incycler glass rig
  • Cookies etched bowl — perfect if you ever want to run flower through it instead of concentrates
  • Santa Cruz Shredder — a high-quality grinder to round out the setup
  • Official Cookies sticker — for your case, tray, or wherever you rep your gear
  • Designer box — adds to the collectible vibe and keeps everything safe if you store or gift it

Fit & pairing notes

The 14mm, 90° female joint is pretty much the standard sweet spot for dab rigs, so it plays well with most 14mm male bangers and dropdowns you already own. If you’re building a full Cookies-inspired setup, you can round it out with silicone or glass gear from our wider smoke shop products collection to keep everything feeling cohesive.

Because it’s an incycler, it shines with consistent, controlled pulls rather than super aggressive chugging. If you prefer tiny, ultra-micro rigs or huge party-table pieces, this lands right in the middle as a balanced, daily driver size.

FAQs

Will this work with my existing 14mm banger?

Yes. The rig has a 14mm female joint set at 90 degrees, which is standard for most 14mm male bangers and quartz nails. As long as your banger is 14mm male, it should drop right in without needing an adapter.

Can I use this rig for flower too?

You can. It comes with a Cookies etched bowl, so if you want to swap from dabs to flower, just trade out your banger for the bowl. If you’re mostly a flower person and like to keep everything fresh and organized, pairing this with proper storage and packaging for your herb will help lock in flavor between seshes.

Is the incycler harder to clean than a regular rig?

Not really. There are more internal paths for water, but cleaning is still straightforward: empty the water, rinse, and when it needs it, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse again, and air dry. Regular quick rinses will keep the inner recycling section from building up heavy reclaim.

Does this come with everything I need to start dabbing?

It includes the rig, a Cookies etched bowl, a Santa Cruz Shredder, and branding extras, but it does not list a banger by default—so you’ll want to pair it with a 14mm male quartz banger or nail. If you’re building out a full dab kit, you can grab tools, caps, and more from our accessories lineup to round things out.

What’s the advantage of an incycler over a regular rig?

Incyclers keep the water moving in a loop inside the rig, which helps with smoother, more consistent function and usually less splashback. Many dabbers feel they get better flavor and a more controlled pull because the water is constantly recycling around the vapor instead of just bubbling once and sitting there.

How much water should I put in it?

Fill until the perc is covered and the recycling section has enough water to circulate, but not so much that it wants to climb into the neck. You can fine-tune by adding or removing small amounts until you find the balance of function and drag that feels right for you. Keeping it on a stable base like a silicone bong or rig station can help avoid spills while you’re adjusting.

Is this more of a collector piece or a daily driver?

Honestly, both. It’s got the look and branded presentation of a collector piece, thanks to the Cookies logos, Santa Cruz Shredder, and designer box. But the fixed downstem, bridged joint, and 8" incycler design make it fully capable as a daily driver for regular dabbers who actually put their glass to work.

The ZIG ZAG ROSE CONES – CARTON – 3-Pack is a premium pre-rolled cone setup for folks who want their smoke to feel like an event, not an errand. Each 109mm King Size cone is wrapped in real rose petals for a smooth, tobacco-free burn with a plush floral aroma. Built-in humidity control and included packing tools make these just as practical as they are pretty, whether you're rolling for date night, special occasions, or just treating yourself.

What You Get

  • Luxury feel without the hassle — Pre-rolled 109mm King Size cones made from genuine rose petals, so you skip the rolling and go straight to the flex.
  • Stays fresh, smells incredible — Each unit includes an Integra 1g 62% humidity control pack to keep the petals soft, aromatic, and ready when you are.
  • Eye-candy in every tube — Assorted rose petal colors mean every cone looks a little different, and every sesh feels like a little celebration.
  • No tobacco, no weird additives — Just rose petals around an unbleached cone for a clean, flower-forward experience.
  • Easy to pack, even when you’re faded — Each tube comes with a packing tool that lets you load your blend evenly from tip to filter.
  • Perfect for sharing — With 3 cones per tube and multiple tubes per carton, you’re set for parties, weekends, or gifting to your favorite heads.

Best For

This carton is made for people who want their smoke to double as decor — think birthdays, anniversaries, picnic seshes, or just those nights when a basic paper isn’t cutting it. If you already keep your setup dialed in with a clean rig or reliable daily driver from our broader smoke shop products, these cones are the upgrade you break out when you want something special without learning any new tricks.

How to Use These Cones

Using the ZIG ZAG ROSE CONES is straightforward. Gently remove a cone from its tube, then use the included packing tool to guide your ground herb into the open end, tapping the filter side lightly on the table to help everything settle. A firm but not overly tight pack helps the rose petals burn nice and even.

These burn a touch slower than a standard paper thanks to the petal structure, which gives you more time to pass it around and actually enjoy the flavor. Keeping your prep area organized with a nonstick dab mat or similar work surface makes loading cleaner and less messy, especially when you’re working with stickier blends.

When you’re done, slide any unused cones back into their tubes, make sure the Integra pack stays inside, and pop the cap to protect the petals until your next sesh.

Feature Details

Material Genuine rose petals around unbleached cone
Cones per Tube 3 cones
Cones per Pack 8 tubes (carton)
Humidity Control Integra – 1g 62% pack included

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the cones in their original tubes with the Integra pack to maintain softness and aroma. Store them in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight so the petals don’t get brittle. If you’re stocking up for events, you can organize the tubes alongside your other wraps, cones, and gear in your main storage & packaging setup to keep everything easy to grab.

FAQ

Are these cones completely tobacco-free?
Yes. The ZIG ZAG ROSE CONES use genuine rose petals around an unbleached King Size cone and are designed for a tobacco-free experience. If you’re trying to keep things cleaner but still want something special, these are a solid upgrade over basic papers.

Do the rose petals affect the flavor of my herb?
They add a light floral note and aroma, but they don’t overpower your strain. You’ll still taste your flower first, with a little rosiness around the edges. For people who love terp flavor and want it to shine, pairing these with good curing and proper storage in quality glass jars helps keep everything tasting fresh.

How fragile are the cones when I’m packing them?
The petals are softer than standard paper but still sturdy enough for normal handling. Just avoid crushing the tip or over-packing — use the included packing tool and work in small layers rather than trying to cram everything in at once. If you’re working at a crowded table, a dedicated spot or tray helps keep them safe.

Can I remove the Integra pack and still store the cones?
You can, but you’ll get the best experience leaving the humidity control pack inside the carton or tube. It helps keep the petals from drying out or getting crispy. If you live in a dry climate or stash your gear near fans or AC, that little pack makes a big difference over time.

Are the colors in each tube the same every time?
No, the petals are assorted, so you get a mix of colors and patterns. That randomness is part of the fun — every tube feels like a tiny surprise. If you like building a whole themed setup, pairing these with colorful pieces like some of our silicone bongs & rigs can make your whole sesh look as good as it hits.

What grind works best with these cones?
A medium grind usually works best — too fine and it can pack too tight, too chunky and it won’t burn as evenly. You don’t need anything special; whatever you normally get from your everyday grinder will do fine as long as you tap down gently and keep airflow in mind.

How should I travel with these without crushing them?
Keep them in their plastic tubes with the caps snapped on, and tuck the tubes into a padded pocket or a small pouch. If you’re traveling with a whole sesh kit, sliding the tubes next to more durable gear like nectar collectors or other accessories in a padded bag helps prevent accidental squishing.

Each tube packs 5 cones plus a humidity control pack, so they stay fresh until you’re ready to spark one up.

Why You’ll Love These

  • Standout vibes — Made from naturally grown rosebuds, every cone has its own unique color and petal pattern, so no two rolls look exactly the same.
  • Short and sweet sessions — 70mm length hits that perfect quick-sesh size for solo smoke breaks or sampling different strains.
  • Less cracking, more stacking — Included humidity control pack helps keep the petals from drying out, so your cones stay ready instead of brittle.
  • No rolling skills required — Pre-rolled with a built-in tip so you just fill, pack, and go — ideal if rolling rose petals by hand sounds like too much work.
  • Smoother, slower burn — Designed to burn at a relaxed pace so you can actually enjoy the flavor instead of watching it disappear in a few pulls.
  • Great for sharing (or flexing online) — The rose look is an instant conversation-starter and low-effort way to make your sesh feel extra “occasion worthy.”

Best For

Mini Rose Cones are made for people who care about the experience, not just getting through the bag. If you’re the friend who brings the pretty papers, curates the playlist, or loves rolling up something camera-worthy, these are for you. They also make a solid upgrade for small celebrations, pair nicely with a favorite piece from our broader lineup of smoke shop products, and are clutch for anyone who hates hand-rolling but still wants something special.

How to Use Them

These work like any other pre-rolled cone, just with rose petals instead of plain paper. Gently grind your herb, pinch the cone near the filter, and feed in small amounts while lightly packing as you go so you don’t crush the rose shell.

Use the included packing tool to firm up the fill — you want it evenly packed from filter to tip, but not so tight that airflow gets choked. Once you’re happy with the shape, twist the end and you’re ready for your sesh. If you’re loading a few at once, staging them on a clean surface like a dab mat keeps stray flower and ash from going everywhere.

When you’re done, let everything cool and tap out the cone gently. Any leftover herb or crumbs on your tray can be brushed back into your stash or jarred up for later in one of your go-to storage and packaging options to keep things organized.

At 70mm, these minis are smaller than a standard king-size cone, so they’re ideal for single-person seshes, quick breaks, or sampling multiple strains without overdoing it. They’re also a good match for lighter smokers who don’t always finish a full-size joint. If you’re pairing them with glass, they sit nicely in most standard cone holders, joint tips, or compact smoking accessories that are set up for pre-rolls.

Care & Storage

Keep the cones in their original tube with the humidity pack until you’re ready to use them. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight so the petals don’t fade or dry out too much. If a cone feels a little extra delicate, handle it from the filter end and avoid squeezing the petal area harder than you need to when packing.

FAQ

  • Are these actually made from real rose petals?

    Yes. Zig Zag Mini Rose Cones are crafted from naturally grown rosebuds, which is why the color and petal pattern can vary slightly from cone to cone. That’s part of what makes each one look unique compared to regular papers or plain pre-rolls you’d stash next to your other parchment papers and gear.

  • How big are the 70mm mini cones compared to regular cones?

    At 70mm, these are on the smaller side — think “personal joint” or quick-sesh size. They’re shorter than standard king-size or 1 1/4 pre-rolled cones, which makes them great for fresher-tasting hits and less half-smoked leftovers sitting in your ashtray or stash jars.

  • Do the rose petals change the flavor a lot?

    You’ll notice a light floral note and a different aroma compared to plain papers, but your strain still does most of the talking. It’s more of a vibe and subtle accent than a full flavored wrap situation, especially if you’re packing in loud flower.

  • How do I keep them from cracking or drying out?

    The easiest move is to leave them in the original tube with the included humidity control pack until you’re ready to fill them. Don’t store them open on a shelf or dashboard. If you’re grabbing multiple tubes for events or retail, keep the case somewhere cool and dry alongside the rest of your glass jars and packaging so everything stays dialed in.

  • Can I use these with any herb or mix?

    They’re designed for legal smoking blends and work best with a medium grind so you can pack evenly without tearing the petals. Super sticky or extra chunky material can be harder to load, so breaking things up a bit first goes a long way. If you’re rolling different blends back-to-back, a proper grinder and a few dedicated joint tubes help keep everything organized.

  • What’s the best way to pack them without ripping?

The 20" Monark Half Color Recycler Beaker is a premium glass bong built for heavy hitters who want recycler-level smoothness in a familiar beaker shape. It’s made for people who actually use their glass every day, not just stare at it on a shelf. At 20 inches (508mm) tall with a single-uptake recycler and wide beaker base, it’s all about cool, controlled pulls and rock-solid stability.

The half-color design and sandblasted Monark logo give it that heady-showpiece vibe, but the function is what really sells it: consistent recycling action with a standard 14mm joint so it’s easy to plug into the rest of your setup.

Why it works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The single-uptake recycler pulls water and smoke up and back down, constantly moving and cooling your hit before it reaches you.
  • Less harshness at bigger rips — That 20" (508mm) height plus recycling gives smoke more time and distance to mellow out, so you can clear bigger bowls without feeling cooked.
  • Stable base that won’t stress you out — Beaker bottom means more surface area on the table, so it’s way harder to tip over when you bump the coffee table or pass it around.
  • Collection-piece looks, daily-driver function — Half-color glass with a clean sandblasted logo keeps it looking custom without any over-the-top gimmicks that mess with function.
  • Ready to rip out of the box — Comes with a 14mm flower bowl so you’re not hunting for spare glass just to try it out.
  • Recycler feel without a weird learning curve — If you’re used to classic beakers, this keeps that familiar feel and adds recycling on top of it.

Best for

This piece shines for daily smokers who want their main bong to feel like a heady upgrade, not just another clear tube. If you’re the friend hosting movie nights and seshes, this is the kind of water pipe that becomes part of the ritual and pairs nicely with a clean dab pad or mat to protect your table.

It’s especially good for people who like big water capacity, smoother pulls, and the look of a tall beaker, but still want the extra cooling and motion you usually only see on recyclers.

How to use it

Using the Monark Half Color Recycler Beaker is as straightforward as any beaker-style bong, with the recycler doing the extra work behind the scenes. Fill the beaker base with enough water to cover the perc area and give the recycler chamber room to cycle without splashing into the mouthpiece.

As you pull, smoke and water get pulled up through the single uptake into the upper chamber, then drop back into the base. That constant movement helps cool things down and break up the smoke, so each hit feels smoother than what you’d get from a basic straight-tube or non-recycler beaker. If you like to keep your setup dialed in, stash your bowl or extras in one of our heavy-bottom concentrate jars so they’re not rolling off the table between rips.

The 14mm joint plays nice with a ton of accessories. You can swap in different bowls, a 14mm ash catcher, or even a 14mm banger if you want this to moonlight as a big dab rig. Just keep in mind it’s a tall piece, so a sturdy surface and maybe a small accessory stand or tray will make your station feel way more organized.

Specifications

Height 20 inches (508mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Material Glass
Type Beaker Base Recycler

Fit & compatibility

The 14mm joint means this bong works with most standard 14mm male bowls, ash catchers, and bangers. If you’re already running 14mm glass on your other smoke shop pieces, it should slot right into your rotation with no weird adapters.

Because it’s a recycler beaker, it likes a bit more water than a tiny straight tube, but you still don’t need to overfill it. If you do, you’ll just end up with extra drag and the recycler chamber might start to spit. Dial it in once and you’re good.

Care & cleaning

Let the piece cool completely before cleaning. Rinse with warm water to loosen residue, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol for deeper cleans, followed by a thorough rinse and full air-dry before using again.

Regular light cleanings will keep the recycler pathway clear, the logo crisp, and the half-color glass looking sharp. If you’re cleaning multiple pieces at once, it can help to set them on a silicone bong or rig station so any drips don’t wreck your counter.

FAQ

  • Does this come with everything I need to start?
    Yes. The 20" Monark Half Color Recycler Beaker includes a 14mm flower bowl, so as long as you’ve got herb and water, you’re ready to go. If you want to keep your flower fresher between seshes, pair it with proper storage and packaging instead of a plastic baggie.
  • Can I use this for dabs too?
    You can. Just swap the included 14mm flower bowl for a 14mm banger or similar dab attachment. Keep in mind it’s a tall piece, so it’ll feel more like a big, cooled-out dab experience than a tiny micro-rig. For people who mainly dab, you might want a dedicated setup and use this as more of a crossover piece.
  • How do I keep the recycler function working well?
    Don’t overfill the water, and clean it regularly so reclaim doesn’t build up in the uptake and recycler chamber. Rinse with warm water after use when you can, and do a deeper isopropyl alcohol soak when you notice drag increasing or the recycler action slowing down.
  • Is this too big for smaller spaces?
    At 20 inches (508mm), it’s definitely on the tall side, but the beaker base and recycler design make it a solid "main piece" for a coffee table or desk. If your space is super tight, you might want something more compact or a portable option like one of our silicone pipes for on-the-go use, and keep this as your home base piece.
  • What’s the advantage of a recycler beaker over a regular beaker?
    A regular beaker diffuses smoke once through the water and sends it up. This recycler beaker moves the water and smoke repeatedly through the system, giving you smoother, cooler, and often tastier hits with less harshness. If you love the feel of big beakers but want a little more refinement, this hits that sweet spot.
  • Will it work with my 14mm accessories?
    If your accessory is a standard 14mm male piece, it should fit the 14mm joint on this bong. That includes most bowls, ash catchers, and even some nectar collector-style adapters if they’re built for 14mm connections. Just handle with care when stacking extra glass.
  • How fragile is it?
    It’s still glass, so drops and hard hits are not its friend. The beaker base helps with stability and day-to-day safety, but treat it like a nice piece. Set it down gently, avoid tight, cluttered shelves, and maybe don’t leave it where your clumsiest friend is likely to knock it over.

The 12″ Monark Half Color Fume Dewar Zongcycler is a heady 12-inch (305mm) glass dab rig built for dabbers who want elite function and serious style in one piece. With its half-color fume work and Zong-shaped recycler body, it’s made for people who like long, smooth pulls and love watching their rig drain and churn. The 14mm 90° Dewar joint and included banger keep the setup simple but dialed-in for daily use.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Ultra-smooth, cooled vapor — The Zongcycler recycler function keeps water moving, cycling your vapor for cooler, gentler hits on every pull.
  • Heady showpiece for the table — The half-color fume design and Z-shaped neck give it that “what rig is that?” factor when friends come through.
  • Stable, comfortable setup — 90° Dewar joint keeps the banger centered and balanced so you’re not fighting weird angles while you dab.
  • Plug-and-play out of the box — Ships with a 14mm 90° banger already matched to the joint, so you’re ready to go without hunting for extra glass.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Thick, high-quality glass is designed for regular seshes, not just sitting on a shelf.
  • Cleaner flavor, less splash — Recycler design helps control water movement and reduce splashback, so you taste your concentrates, not bong water.

Best For

This Monark Zongcycler is made for dabbers who already know they like recyclers and want something with a little more personality than a plain straight tube. If you’re running multiple dabs in a row and care about smoother, cooler pulls, this checks that box easily. It also fits right into a more serious setup with proper staging on a solid dab mat so your table doesn’t get sticky.

How to Use It (The Basics)

Fill the rig so the bottom chamber has enough water to cover the perc openings, but not so much that it’s splashing into the neck when you pull. The recycler loop is designed to pull water up and cycle it back down, so a little movement is normal — that’s the whole point.

Drop the included 14mm 90° banger into the Dewar joint, load your concentrates, and let the recycler do the work while you pull. You’ll see the water climb and drain through the Zongcycler section, which helps cool the vapor while keeping the flavor crisp. If you like swapping between bangers and other styles, the 14mm joint plays nice with most standard dab tools and accessories you probably already own.

When you’re done, empty the water and let the rig fully cool before cleaning. Because of the recycler design, giving it a quick rinse after heavy seshes helps keep reclaim from building up in the recycling pathways.

Design & Function

The “Zongcycler” name is literal: it combines that classic Zong-style bent neck and body with recycler plumbing. The bends help add a bit of natural cooling and keep your face farther from the banger, while the recycler section keeps water circulating for smoother pulls.

The Dewar joint is reinforced, meaning the joint is welded to the body with extra glass instead of just hanging off the side. That’s clutch for a rig in this price range — it helps protect against accidental knocks when you’re moving it around or swapping out the 14mm banger.

The half-color fume work gives it a unique, almost shifting look depending on lighting and angle. It’s the kind of glass that looks different in the daylight vs. under LEDs, so it doesn’t get boring on the shelf. If you like to match your glass with storage or display, it pairs nicely with heavyweight glass concentrate jars that show off your extracts next to your rig.

Specifications

Height 12 inches (305mm)
Type Glass dab rig / recycler
Joint Size & Style 14mm Dewar joint at 90°
Material High-quality glass
Included Banger 14mm 90° banger

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm 90° Dewar joint is the standard setup for most modern dab rigs, so you can easily swap in other 14mm male bangers, terp slurpers, and similar nails if you already have a lineup. Just stick with 90° options so they hang correctly and don’t sit at an awkward angle.

Because it’s a recycler, it shines with concentrates over flower. If you’re building a full dab station around it, you can round things out with other smoke shop products like iso storage, q-tip holders, and stands to keep everything clean and organized.

Cleaning & Maintenance

Let the rig and banger fully cool before you do anything. Dump the old water, then rinse the rig with warm water to loosen up any light residue. For a deeper reset, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

If you’re reclaim-conscious, you can pour out rinse alcohol into a separate container and let it evaporate. For people who keep a whole rotation of pieces, it’s worth storing this Monark alongside your other rigs and pipes with some dedicated storage & packaging solutions to keep everything dust-free between uses.

FAQ

  • Does the Monark Zongcycler come with a banger?

    Yes. It includes a 14mm 90° banger that’s ready to drop into the Dewar joint right out of the box. You can upgrade to specialty bangers later if you want, but you don’t need to buy anything extra to start using it.

  • Will this fit my other 14mm dab accessories?

    As long as they’re 14mm and designed for a 90° rig, they should fit just fine. That includes most common quartz bangers, terp slurpers, and similar nails. If you’re already running other 14mm silicone bongs & rigs, you’ll be familiar with this joint style.

  • Is it hard to clean since it’s a recycler?

    It’s a little more involved than a straight tube, but not bad. A good soak in isopropyl alcohol and a warm rinse usually clears out the recycling pathways. If you clean it regularly instead of waiting until it’s fully gunked up, it stays much easier to maintain.

  • Can I choose the exact color or fume pattern?

    The rig comes in multiple half-color fume options, but the exact pattern and shade can vary because each one is worked by hand. Check the product photos and options on the page for what’s currently in stock; each one has its own personality.

  • Is this better for big dabs or smaller flavorful hits?

    It handles both well. The recycler action shines when you’re pushing a little more vapor and want extra cooling, but the smaller internal pathways still preserve flavor when you’re taking more conservative, terp-forward dabs. If you’re really chasing flavor, pairing it with clean quartz and fresh product from proper glass jars & extract packaging makes a big difference.

  • Can I use this with flower instead of concentrates?

    Technically, you could swap in a 14mm bowl, but this piece is designed as a dab rig. The recycler function, included banger, and overall size are tuned specifically for concentrates. If flower is your main thing, you might prefer a dedicated bong or a more straightforward tube-style piece.

  • Is the glass thick enough to be a true daily driver?

    Yes. It’s built from high-quality glass meant for regular use, not just occasional display. Of course, it’s still glass, so treat it with some respect — setting it down on a cushioned surface like a mat or even near your clearance accessories is a smart way to protect your investment.

If you like rigs that hit smooth, look wild, and hold up to daily rotation, the 12″ Monark Half Color Fume Dewar Zongcycler earns its spot on the shelf and in the sesh.

If you’re building out a full smoking station, these grinders pair well with heat-proof dab pads and mats to keep your table protected from stray herb and sticky tools.

How to Use It

Each Classic Zinc Grinder breaks down into multiple layers: the magnetic lid with teeth, the grinding chamber, a storage layer, and a kief catch with a removable screen and scoop. Load your herbs between the teeth, reattach the lid, and twist until everything moves freely and you feel the material has broken down to your preferred consistency.

Ground material collects in the center chamber, while the finest particles fall through the screen into the bottom kief catcher. Over time, you’ll build up a layer of potent kief you can scoop out with the included tool and sprinkle where you want a little extra kick. For people who like to keep strains separated and organized, pairing these grinders with clear, heavy-bottom concentrate jars is an easy way to keep flavors and textures in check.

Does this display really come with 12 grinders?

How do I keep the kief screen from clogging?

Eventually, any fine screen will start to clog up as oils and small particles stick to the mesh. When you notice kief isn’t falling through like it used to, gently tap the screen over a surface to shake loose material. For a deeper refresh, remove the section and give it a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry completely before putting it back.

How to use it
