The 11″ Monark Color Fume Taurus Bong is a high-end glass incycler built for people who actually care about function as much as looks. At 11 inches (280mm), it’s compact enough for the coffee table but stacked with serious diffusion thanks to a slit puck perc and Taurus recycler design. If you’re the friend who always brings the “good glass” to the sesh, this is that piece.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The slit puck perc stacks bubbles hard, taking the edge off hot smoke before it climbs the incycler path.
  • Less splashback, more flavor — Taurus incycler design keeps water moving in a loop without sending it up to your lips.
  • Built to survive real-life use — A bridged joint reinforces the weakest point on most bongs, so one bad bump doesn’t end your favorite piece.
  • Dialed-in size for daily use — 11 inches (280mm) gives you good volume and function without turning into a clumsy tower.
  • Heady look without going full art-piece — Color fume work and a clean sandblast logo give it that custom vibe without getting too wild to pass around.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm flower bowl, so you’re not hunting for spare parts before the first sesh.

Best For

This Taurus Bong is made for daily smokers and glass heads who want recycler-level function without a super complex, hard-to-clean piece. If you like your flower rips milky but not harsh, and you want something nice enough to leave out as your main daily driver, this fits the bill. It also suits people who baby their glass but still live in houses where things occasionally get knocked over — that bridged joint is clutch.

How to Use It

Fill the base with enough water to cover the slit puck perc, but not so high that it rushes up the drain tube when you pull. The puck perc is doing the first round of work here, chopping your inhale into a ton of tiny bubbles for smoother, cooler hits.

As you draw, smoke and water travel up into the Taurus incycler section, then drain back down into the base in a loop. That constant circulation gives you extra cooling and diffusion without beating up your flavor. Set it on a solid surface or a soft dab mat so you’re not stressing the base every time you set it down.

For cleaning, let the piece cool off completely, empty the water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, give it a gentle shake, then rinse well with warm water and let it dry before the next use.

The Basics & Build

The Taurus layout is a style of incycler where the uptakes and drain are built into the inner chamber, so water stays moving in a controlled loop as you clear the piece. That means smoother function, less chug, and better control when you clear the chamber. It’s a smart choice if you like recycler function but don’t want multiple exposed arms and tubes waiting to get snapped.

The color fume work on this Monark piece gives you that shifting, layered look that changes under different lighting. Over time, as the glass gets a bit of use, the fume tones usually deepen, so it actually looks better after it’s been part of your rotation for a while. If you’re already building a little lineup of favorites, this sits nicely next to more rugged gear like silicone bongs and rigs as your “nice glass” option.

Specifications

Height 11 inches (280mm)
Joint Size 14mm female
Included Bowl 14mm male flower bowl
Perc Type Slit puck perc
Function Style Taurus incycler (recycling-style bong)
Material Borosilicate glass
Design Color fume accents with sandblast logo

Fit & Compatibility

The Monark Taurus Bong runs a standard 14mm female joint, so it plays nice with most 14mm male bowls, ash catchers, and dry herb attachments. If you like to keep your water pipes spotless, you can add a 14mm male ash catcher or pre-cooler between your bowl and the joint to catch resin before it hits the main chamber. Just keep in mind: extra glass means extra weight on the joint, so that bridged reinforcement is doing real work here, not just looking cool.

Stick to 14mm male accessories and you’re good. If you eventually want to dab on it, you can swap the bowl for a 14mm male banger and run it as a crossover piece, though a dedicated rig plus this as your flower champ is usually the move. For on-the-go or throw-in-a-bag setups, consider backing this up with something from our more rugged smoke shop products so you’re not hauling your nice Monark everywhere.

FAQ

  • Q: What size bowl or accessory will fit this bong?

    A: This piece has a 14mm female joint, so any 14mm male bowl, banger, or ash catcher will fit. If you’re upgrading the bowl later, just make sure you’re grabbing 14mm, not 10mm or 18mm.

  • Q: Is the 11" size big enough for group seshes?

    A: Yes, 11 inches (280mm) is a sweet spot for passing around — plenty of volume and diffusion without being so tall that it’s awkward to corner on a couch. For bigger circles or party nights, you can always keep a second piece or some backup silicone pipes in the mix.

  • Q: How do I clean the incycler section?

    A: Treat it like any quality glass piece: let it cool, dump the old water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, a bit of isopropyl alcohol and a gentle shake will help break down residue in the perc and incycler path. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before using again.

  • Q: Will the color fume fade or change?

    A: Fume work doesn’t really “fade” under normal use — if anything, it tends to develop more character over time as the piece gets some mileage. Regular cleaning keeps the colors looking sharp instead of muted by residue. If you’re keeping a whole display of glass, pairing this with some clean glass jars and packaging on the shelf makes everything look extra dialed.

  • Q: Is this better for flower or concentrates?

    A: Out of the box, it’s set up for flower with the included 14mm bowl. You can absolutely throw a 14mm banger on there for dabs, but most people prefer this as their main flower bong and run a smaller rig for concentrates. If you’re a heavy dabber, look at dedicated rigs or nectar collectors for more dialed-in concentrate sessions.

  • Q: Is the bridged joint really that important?

    A: On recycler-style and incycler pieces, the joint area takes a lot of stress, especially if you’re running heavier bowls or attachments. The bridged joint on this Monark reinforces that spot, so a small bump is less likely to turn into a crack or full snap. It’s one of those details you really appreciate the first time your piece survives a clumsy set-down.

  • Q: How should I store it when I’m not using it?

This rig is made for dabbers running a few solid seshes a day who want recycler function without going into giant, overly complex lab-glass territory. If you like to sit at a clean, dialed-in station with a solid dab mat and a couple of favorite tools instead of a cluttered spread of random pieces, this Monark fits right in. How to Use It

Fill the recycler so the 3-hole puck perc and the bottom of the barrel are just covered in water; you want enough for active chug without sending it up the neck. Because of the double uptake design, a modest water level is usually all it takes to get that satisfying whirl in the upper chamber.

Drop your concentrates into the included 14mm banger, start your pull, and watch the recycler do its thing: water and vapor move up the dual uptakes, roll through the barrel section, then drain smoothly back down the return. Running it on a stable surface or next to a padded surface like a silicone bong or rig helps protect it when you’re passing it around or setting it down between dabs.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Super smooth pulls — Inline perc starts the diffusion and the ratchet perc finishes the job, so your smoke takes a long, bubbly path before it hits your lungs.
  • Flavor that actually shows up — The stacked percs cool and filter without turning your bowl into harsh, stale-tasting smoke too fast.
  • Color accents that pop — Matched color on the base, mouthpiece, and bowl gives the piece a custom, heady look right out of the box.
  • Comfortable in the hand — The 12" height hits a nice middle ground: tall enough for function, short enough to pass around the circle without feeling clumsy.
  • Ready-to-rip setup — Comes with a matching 14mm flower bowl, so you’re not digging through a drawer for something that fits.

Best For

This bong is made for flower lovers who want legit diffusion without going full science-project. If you’re the person who actually notices the difference between a single downstem and a multi-perc piece, this will feel like an upgrade. It’s also a great pick if you already have smaller daily drivers or basic smoke shop pieces and you’re finally ready to step into “nice glass” territory.

How to Use It

Start by adding water to the base so the inline perc is fully covered; you want it bubbling along its whole length when you pull. Then make sure there’s just enough water above the ratchet perc to fire all the slits without sending splash up the neck.

Load your 14mm flower bowl with your favorite herb, set the piece down on a solid surface (a non-slip dab mat works great here), and take a slow pull so both percs can do their thing. You’ll feel the inline start the diffusion and the ratchet kick in higher up, stacking dense, cooled smoke in the tube.

After your sesh, let the piece cool. For quick upkeep, rinse with warm water and a little isopropyl when needed; for deeper cleans, soak in iso, rinse thoroughly, and dry before your next use.

The Basics of the Inline to Ratchet Setup

Think of the inline perc as your first filter: it stretches horizontally across the base, with multiple slits that break your pull into tons of small bubbles instead of big, chunky ones. More bubbles means more surface area, which means better cooling and filtration.

From there, the smoke rises into the ratchet perc. That’s the second stage — a circular ring of slits higher in the chamber that further chops and cools the smoke. It’s like running your hit through two filters in one pull, without adding a ton of drag when the water level is dialed in.

This combo is especially nice if you’re coming from a simple beaker or straight tube and want something that feels smoother but still rips. If you’re already deep into diffusion land with recyclers or percy-style rigs, this offers a familiar, powerful hit with more classic bong vibes.

  • Can I use this for concentrates too?

Just keep in mind it’s sized and designed as a flower bong, so the volume and diffusion are more in line with big rips than tiny terp sips.   • How much water should I use?
    Enough to fully cover the inline perc and lightly cover the ratchet perc slits. If you’re getting water in your mouth or heavy splashback, you’ve gone too high; if only part of the perc is firing, add a little more. Tiny adjustments matter a lot with multi-perc pieces.
  • Is this hard to clean with the extra perc?
    It’s a bit more involved than a plain beaker, but not bad. A soak in isopropyl alcohol plus a warm water rinse usually clears both the inline and ratchet sections. If you like to keep your glass spotless, pairing it with proper storage and packaging for your flower helps cut down on ash and reclaim buildup.
  • Does it tip over easily?
    The 12" height and weighted base make it stable for normal table use. As always with glass, don’t park it on the edge of a cluttered desk or somewhere it can get bumped — especially when people are passing it around during a long sesh.
  • Will the airflow feel restricted with two percs?
    When you’ve got the water levels right, the pull feels surprisingly open. The inline perc spreads your hit out, and the ratchet adds more diffusion without turning it into a workout. If it feels like too much drag, try lowering the water just a bit.
  • What’s the best way to keep the color accents looking fresh?
    Rinse regularly so resin doesn’t stain, avoid abrasive scrubbers, and let it dry fully between deep cleans. Keeping your flower in clean, sealed glass containers also helps your piece stay cleaner longer by cutting down on dusty, dry herb that burns messy.

column3:
The ZIG ZAG KING SIZE BULK UNBLEACHED CONES (800 cone carton) are pre-rolled king-size papers for smokers who want reliable, natural cones on deck at all times. They’re built for people running constant group seshes or stocking a shop, with unbleached paper that keeps the taste clean and simple. One carton packs 800 cones, so you can stop stressing about running out mid-weekend.

What You Get

  • Skip the hand-roll struggle — Pre-rolled king cones mean you just fill, pack, and you’re ready to go.
  • Cleaner taste from your flower — Unbleached natural fibers keep it simple so you’re not fighting a paper flavor.
  • Party-proof quantity — 800 cones per carton easily covers big weekends, events, or heavy daily use.
  • King-size burns — Extra length is perfect when you’re passing it around and don’t want it gone in two minutes.
  • Consistent rolls every time — Factory-shaped cones all pack the same so burns stay predictable from cone to cone.
  • Time saver for busy hands — Ideal if you’re rolling back-to-back and don’t want to sit there shaping papers all night.

Best For

This 800-pack is made for heavy smokers, party hosts, and shops who want to keep a reliable stash of king-sized cones without constant reordering. It’s also clutch for anyone who prefers consistency over experimenting with hand rolls every time. If you’re already running a full toolkit of grinders, rigs, and other smoke shop products, this is the bulk paper move that just makes life easier.

How to Use It

Using these cones is straightforward: prep your herb, load the cone, gently pack, and you’re good. The pre-formed shape handles the hard part, so you get an even, stable cone without wrestling thin paper. Take your time packing evenly from tip to top to help it burn smooth instead of canoeing.

For cleaner prep, break your flower down with a good grinder and stage everything on a nonstick dab mat or tray so you’re not chasing crumbs around the table. Once filled, a light tap or gentle tamp at the open end helps settle everything without overpacking.

Specifications

Brand Zig Zag
Type Pre-rolled cones
Size King size
Material Unbleached natural fibers
Carton Count 800 cones per carton

Fit & Compatibility

These Zig Zag king cones work with most standard cone loaders, filling machines, and packing tools built for king-size cones. If you’re pre-packing for events or for your crew, pair them with whatever cone filler you already like using, as long as it’s made for king size. For shops or brands, they also play nice with standard retail storage like bulk jars or storage & packaging options if you’re pre-filling in a legal market.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the cones in their carton or a dry, closed container so they don’t get crushed or warped. Store them away from moisture and big temperature swings so the paper stays crisp and easy to pack. If you’re pre-filling cones ahead of time, stash them in sealed containers, such as heavy glass or glass jars & packaging, to help keep everything fresh until it’s time to burn.

FAQ

  • Are these cones actually king size?
    Yes, these are king-size pre-rolled cones, ideal when you want a longer, slower burn that can handle passing around the circle.
  • How many cones do I get in one order?
    Each carton includes 800 individual unbleached Zig Zag king cones. That’s more than enough for daily smokers, parties, or stocking a small lounge or shop.
  • Do these cones come with tips already built in?
    Yes, as standard pre-rolled cones, they come formed and ready to fill with a built-in tip area, so you’re not messing with separate rolling tips for every cone.
  • What’s the difference between these and regular Zig Zag papers?
    Functionally, they’re the same quality Zig Zag paper, but here it’s unbleached and already rolled into king-size cones. You skip the roll and just focus on packing, which is a big plus if you usually struggle with hand rolling or you’re prepping a lot at once. If you prefer traditional papers to roll yourself, you might also look at other gear in our general accessories lineup.
  • Will these work with my cone filler or machine?
    If your loader or machine is designed for king-size cones, these should fit and function well. Always double-check your device’s size spec before you buy a big carton, especially if you’re running automated filling.
  • How should I store a big carton so the cones don’t get ruined?
    Keep the carton upright in a cool, dry spot, away from anything that could crush it. For pre-filled cones, consider moving them into more protective packaging like mylar bags or jars, especially if they’re being transported or displayed.
  • Are these good for mixing with concentrates?
    King-size cones are a solid choice if you like to mix in concentrates with your flower because you’ve got more room to work with and a longer burn window. If you’re working with sticky extracts, handle them on parchment or parchment papers first so you’re not wasting material or gumming up the cone.

With 900 cones in one box, this is a true stock-up move so you’re not stuck hand-rolling when everyone’s ready to spark.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Way faster than hand-rolling — Pre-rolled with filter tips already in place, so you just fill, pack, and you’re done.
  • Slow, even burns — Zig Zag’s ultra-thin paper keeps the burn consistent so you’re not babysitting runs the whole sesh.
  • Bulk box that actually lasts — 900 cones per carton means you’re set for parties, regular shop traffic, or months of personal use.
  • Less mess while packing — Built-in tips help keep material from spilling out the end, so more stays in the cone and not on the table.

  • Consistent size every time — Same 1 1/4 cone length in every piece, so your fills and burn times are predictable.

Best For

This 900-count Zig Zag cone carton is ideal for smoke shops, delivery services, and events where you’re going through stacks of pre-rolls every week. It also makes sense for heavy smokers who want a ready-to-pack stash on hand and never feel like hand-rolling again. If you’re already stocking up on bulk storage and packaging for flower, this is the natural add-on for efficient pre-roll prep.

How to Use Them

Using these cones is straightforward: hold the cone by the filter, gently load your ground material into the open end, and tap or lightly pack it down to your preferred firmness. Twist or tuck the tip at the open end when you’re done filling to lock everything in place.

For big fill sessions—like prepping a lineup of pre-rolls—set up over a nonstick dab mat or tray so any spills are easy to scoop back up. Because everything is pre-rolled and filtered, you get a consistent cone every time without worrying about paper technique or filter rolling.

If you’re cranking out cones for the crew, line a few up, fill each loosely, then go back and pack them to the same level so they all burn similarly. The 4 inch (102mm) length gives you enough room for a solid fill without being oversized or awkward.

FAQ

  • How should I store the unused cones?
    Keep them in the original carton or a clean, dry container, away from direct sunlight and moisture. If you’ve got a more organized backroom setup with other smoke shop products, treating these like any other paper stock works well—cool, dry, and out of the way.
  • Will these papers change the flavor of my flower?

column3:
The 16″ Wrap and Rake Fume Beaker is a tall, heavy-duty glass bong made in the USA for smokers who care as much about function as they do about glass art. At 16 inches (406mm) with a 14mm joint, it’s built for people who want dense, cooled hits and a centerpiece for the table, not just another clear tube. The wrap and rake fuming throws shifting colors and depth under different light, so it looks as good empty on the shelf as it does in the middle of a sesh.

Why You’ll Actually Love This Beaker

  • Bigger, smoother rips — The tall neck and wide beaker base give your smoke more time and water to cool down before it ever reaches your lungs.
  • Serious table presence — The wrap and rake fume work gives you layered color and shine that changes with angle and lighting, so it never looks flat or boring.
  • Easy to upgrade — Standard 14mm joint means you can drop in different bowls, dropdowns, or ash catchers without hunting for weird sizes.
  • Made in the USA glass — You’re getting solid craftsmanship and reliable welds instead of mystery import glass.
  • Stable, low-tipping base — Classic beaker footprint helps keep it planted when someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Feels like a real “daily driver” — Big enough for party nights, smooth enough that you’ll still reach for it when you’re solo on the couch.

Best For

This piece is made for smokers who want one main bong that does it all: daily use, group seshes, and looking good on the shelf in between. If you’re upgrading from a small straight tube or something cheap and thin, this 16″ beaker will feel like a real step up in both function and presence. It also slots in nicely if you’re building out a full smoke shop products style home setup and want a solid glass anchor piece.

How to Use It

Using this beaker is straightforward: add enough water to cover the downstream slits and give the base a quick swirl so everything settles evenly. Pack your 14mm bowl with ground flower, set your pace, and clear the chamber in a way that matches the size of this piece—big hits are easy here, so you can take it slow if you want.

For comfort, use your off hand to stabilize the beaker by the base or neck, especially when you’re passing it around. Setting it on a cushioned surface like a dab mat or pad adds a little extra protection for the base and keeps sticky water rings off your table.

Cleaning is simple: let the glass cool if it’s been used heavily, then rinse out the old water. For light maintenance, a quick rinse and shake with fresh water keeps things from building up. When it needs a real reset, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before you put it back into rotation.

Specifications

Height 16 inches (406mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Type Female
Material Glass
Style Beaker base bong
Design Wrap and rake fume
Origin Made in USA

Fit & Compatibility

The 16″ Wrap and Rake Fume Beaker uses a 14mm female joint, which plays nice with most modern bowls and attachments. If you already own 14mm bowls, dropdowns, or ash catchers, they should plug right in without adapters. When you’re rotating between different strains, pairing this piece with a couple of dedicated 14mm bowls stored in separate storage and packaging containers can help keep flavors from getting muddled.

Care Tips

To keep the fume work looking sharp, avoid super abrasive scrubbers directly on the colored sections. Let it cool before cleaning, dump old water regularly, and wipe or rinse after heavier use so buildup doesn’t have a chance to bake on. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it air dry completely before you pack the bowl again.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my existing bowl or slide?

    As long as your bowl is a 14mm male, it will fit this beaker’s 14mm female joint. If your current stuff is 18mm, you’ll need either a new bowl or a simple adapter—handy if you also keep smaller silicone bongs and rigs around and want everything to share the same parts.

  • Is a 16″ beaker too big for everyday use?

    Not at all—16 inches is a sweet spot for people who like full, cooled hits. It’s tall enough to stack smoke and keep it comfortable, but still manageable to pick up, clear, and stash on a shelf or in a cabinet when you’re done.

  • How do I keep the fume colors from fading or looking dull?

    The color itself doesn’t really “fade,” but buildup can make it look muted. Regular rinses and occasional alcohol soaks keep the fume work bright. Avoid harsh physical scrubbing on the design and let the soaking do most of the work instead.

  • Can I use this with concentrates?

    You can, as long as you swap the bowl for a 14mm male banger or nail. If you go that route, you’ll probably want a carb cap and a solid dabber—both easy upgrades you can grab from our dab tools and accessories lineup to round out your setup.

  • Is it travel friendly?

    It’s more of a stay-at-home tank than a travel piece. You can move it with a padded bag or hard case, but for tossing in a backpack or quick trips, most people prefer something smaller or a compact option like one of our silicone pipes that won’t stress you out if it takes a knock.

  • How much water should I use?

    Fill just enough to cover the diffusion at the end of the downstem—too little and it won’t function right, too much and you risk splash. You can fine-tune the level in small pours until it feels perfect for your pull style.

  • What should I pair this with to build a full setup?

    Most people like to add a dedicated grinder, a couple of 14mm bowls, and something to store their flower or concentrates—heavy-bottom concentrate jars or glass containers keep your material fresh and look clean next to this beaker on the shelf.

The 9.5" Color Fume Maria Drain Incycler is a compact, high-function glass incycler for people who want recycler-level smoothness without a huge, fragile tower on the table. It’s built for flower and concentrates alike, with a 14mm joint and a color-matching horn flower bowl that makes it ready to rip right out of the box. Fumed glass, the Maria Drain design, and that internal recycle path give you a piece that looks wild on the shelf and delivers super-washed, flavorful hits when it’s in your hand.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Washed, smoother hits — Incycler design constantly recycles the water around your hit, knocking down harshness before it reaches your lungs.
  • Trippy fume work — Color-fumed glass catches light and slowly shifts character over time as it breaks in, so your piece develops its own look.
  • No splash to the mouth — The internal drain keeps the water moving down where it belongs instead of climbing up the neck when you pull hard.
  • Daily-driver size — At 9.5 inches (241mm), it’s tall enough for solid function but still easy to handle, pass, and stash.
  • Ready-to-pack bowl — Includes a 14mm color-matching horn flower bowl so you don’t have to dig through a drawer for something that fits.
  • Solid glass build — Thick, quality glass made to handle regular seshes instead of feeling like you’re holding a museum piece.

Best For

This incycler is made for people who love smooth, flavor-forward hits and actually pay attention to function, not just hype glass. If you’re the friend who always notices how a piece stacks bubbles and drains, this is your lane. It’s also an awesome upgrade if you’re moving from a basic straight tube into your first recycler-style piece, but don’t want something huge or complicated.

If you like to keep your setup dialed in, park this on a nonstick dab mat so the base and your table both stay clean between rips.

The Basics: How It Hits

An incycler is basically a recycler that keeps the recycling chamber tucked inside the outer body instead of hanging off the side. On this Maria Drain incycler, your hit pulls water up through the perc, circulates it around the inner chamber, and then sends it back down through the drain in the center. That constant loop breaks your hit into lots of tiny bubbles and cools everything down before it gets to you.

Because of the Maria Drain design, water drains quickly and predictably, so you get that "cyclone" function without the annoying chug or random splashback. You’ll notice the hit feels dense and flavorful, but a lot less aggressive on the throat, which is why recycler-style pieces are so popular with both heavy flower smokers and dabbers.

Day to day, you just fill the base so the perc is properly covered, pop in the 14mm bowl or a compatible banger, and let the incycler do the hard work of cooling and filtering the hit for you. Set it next to your favorite dab tools so everything you need is within reach when you’re mid-sesh.

Specifications

Height 9.5 inches (241mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Type 14mm female joint
Included Bowl 14mm color-matching horn flower bowl
Material Fumed glass
Style Maria Drain incycler (bong / water pipe)

Fit, Function & Compatibility

The 14mm female joint plays nice with most standard 14mm male accessories, so it’s easy to swap the included flower bowl for a banger if you want to turn this into a dab rig. That makes it a legit all-in-one: flower on the couch, concentrate sesh on the weekend, same piece, just a quick accessory change.

If you’re already sitting on a stack of 14mm attachments or want to organize them better, pairing this with dedicated storage and packaging for your glass and small parts keeps everything protected and easy to grab.

How to Use It

Using this piece is straightforward. Add water through the mouthpiece or joint until the main perc is covered and the recycler path starts to engage when you pull. Too much water and you’ll feel extra drag; too little and you won’t get that nice recycle action. Once it’s dialed in, you really don’t have to think about it again unless you dump it to clean.

For flower, use the included horn bowl. For concentrates, swap to a 14mm banger or compatible nail. The incycler function shines with both — the constant movement of water helps keep hits flavorful while still being gentle, especially if you’re taking multiple pulls in a row. Between seshes, empty the water and let the piece air dry so it doesn’t get that stale-res water funk.

If you’re the type who keeps multiple strains or batches around, stash them in heavy-bottom glass jars so your flower or concentrates stay fresh and you’re not loading a premium incycler with dried-out product.

Cleaning & Care

Fumed glass rewards good cleaning habits because clear, clean glass really shows off the color changes over time. Let the piece cool before you clean it, then empty the water and rinse out loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before you use it again. Avoid banging it on hard sinks or counters — it’s built tough for glass, but it’s still glass.

FAQ

  • Is this better for flower or dabs?
    It genuinely does well with both. Out of the box, it’s set up for flower with the included 14mm horn bowl. If you prefer concentrates, just add a 14mm male banger and you’ve essentially got a compact dab rig with recycler-style function. A lot of people use it as their main "do-everything" piece.
  • Will my existing 14mm accessories fit?
    Yes, if you have 14mm male accessories — bowls, bangers, or nails — they should fit right into the 14mm female joint on this incycler. Just make sure you’re matching male to female and sticking with 14mm only; 10mm or 18mm parts won’t work without adapters.
  • How hard is it to clean an incycler compared to a regular bong?
    It’s slightly more involved than a straight tube because there are internal paths, but still very manageable. The key is not letting resin build up forever. Rinse regularly, and when it needs a reset, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and let it dry. You don’t need special tools or complicated steps.
  • Does the incycler design actually make hits smoother, or is it just for looks?
    It’s definitely not just for looks. The recycle action keeps water moving around your hit, which increases contact with the bubbles and helps pull out heat and some harshness. It also tends to keep flavor more consistent over longer pulls, which is why dabbers especially like recycler-style pieces.
  • Is 9.5 inches big enough to be a main daily driver?
    Absolutely. 9.5 inches (241mm) is a sweet spot for function and control. It’s tall enough for good cooling and recycling but compact enough that you won’t feel like you’re handling something fragile every time you pass it around. Many people prefer this size over huge towers as their everyday piece.
  • Can I travel with this piece?
    You can move it around or take it to a friend’s place, but treat it like any nice glass — wrap it, pad it, and keep it in a safe spot in the car. For more rugged on-the-go options, a lot of people grab unbreakable pieces from our silicone bongs and rigs collection and leave the fumed glass at home.
  • What else do I need to get the most out of this incycler?
    For flower, you’re basically set with just the incycler and a lighter. For concentrates, add a quality 14mm banger and a carb cap. You might also want a few basic accessories like cleaning plugs, cotton swabs, or travel-safe storage to keep the piece and your gear in good shape over time.

If you’re building out a full sesh station, you can also explore our broader lineup of smoke shop products to round out grinders, papers, and other daily-driver essentials that pair well with a piece like this.

The 10" Highway Quad Uptake Dome Recycler is a glass dab rig built for concentrate fans who care about function as much as flavor. It’s made for dabbers who want ultra-smooth, splash-free pulls and love watching their rig cycle water like a mini science project. Standing at 10 inches (254mm) with a 14mm, 90° joint and included banger, it’s a ready-to-go recycler that earns its spot as a serious daily driver.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler vapor — The quad uptake recycler pulls water up and around the dome, cooling and conditioning vapor before it reaches you.
  • Way less splashback — The dome recycler design keeps the water where it belongs, so you’re not tasting your rig on every pull.
  • Watch the function — Multiple uptakes and a central dome create that mesmerizing "tornado" style circulation every time you hit it.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a 14mm, 90° banger so you don’t have to dig through drawers to get your first sesh going.
  • Dialed-in size for daily use — At 10 inches (254mm), it’s big enough for real cooling but still compact enough for a small desk or coffee table setup.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who run more than a quick one-and-done sesh and actually care how their rig functions. If you love recyclers, watch your water line like a hawk, and want smoother, longer pulls from a mid-sized setup, this one fits right in. It also pairs nicely with unbreakable setups like our silicone bongs and rigs if you like to mix glass and silicone in your rotation.

How to Use It

Drop your concentrate into the included banger and draw steadily through the mouthpiece. As you pull, vapor and water are pulled through the lower chamber and up the four uptake tubes into the dome, where everything spins, cools, and drains back down to repeat the cycle. That constant recycling is what gives rigs like this their signature smooth, flavorful function.

To keep your table clean and your base from sticking, set the rig on a nonstick dab pad or mat while you’re working. Between hits, let the rig rest upright so water can fully drain back into the lower chamber and your recycler is ready to go again next time you pull.

If you rotate multiple rigs or switch between flower and concentrates, consider staging this one near your main station with your favorite dab tools handy, so you’re not chasing hot tools and bangers around the room mid-sesh.

The 10" Highway Quad Uptake Dome Recycler uses a 14mm male joint at a 90° angle, which means it plays nice with most 14mm female accessories in your stash. Directional and bubble caps, terp-pearls, and standard 14mm bangers are all fair game as long as they match that 90° angle. If you like to swap caps depending on the type of concentrate you’re running, check out our selection of carb caps to really dial in airflow and control.

Cleaning & Care

Let the rig cool fully before any cleaning. For light maintenance, rinse with warm water and give the recycler a quick shake to move old water and residue out of the uptake tubes and dome. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

To keep your concentrates tasting fresh and your banger from getting torched-looking too fast, store your extracts in proper concentrate jars instead of leaving them out on the table or in plastic.

FAQ

    It includes the main recycler rig and a matching 14mm, 90° banger, so you’re set on the glass side. You’ll still want your usual tools like a dabber, carb cap, and a good surface like a sheet of parchment or dab mat to stage your concentrates.

  • Will this fit my other 14mm bangers and accessories?

    Yes, as long as they’re 14mm and designed for a 90° male joint, they should fit. If your current gear is 45° or a different size, it won’t sit right or seal properly, so double-check those specs before swapping pieces around.

  • How tall is it exactly, and is it stable?

    The rig stands at 10 inches (254mm). That’s a sweet spot for recyclers: tall enough for real cooling and visible function, but still with a sturdy footprint so it doesn’t feel tippy when you’re capping or adjusting your torch. The colored foot adds both style and visual awareness on cluttered tables.

  • What’s the benefit of a quad uptake recycler over a simple rig?

    The four uptakes move more water and vapor at once, which boosts cooling and gives you that rolling, continuous circulation recyclers are known for. Compared to a basic single-chamber rig, you’ll usually notice smoother hits, better flavor retention, and less chance of water jumping up the neck.

  • Is this better as a daily driver or a “special occasion” piece?

    It’s absolutely built to be a daily driver if you want it to be. The size, joint angle, and included banger make it super practical for regular seshes, while the dome recycler design gives it that "showpiece" vibe when friends are over. If you already have a more rugged travel setup like a silicone pipe from our silicone pipes collection, this recycler is perfect to keep at home on the main station.

  • How do I keep the recycler from clogging in the uptakes?

    Change your water regularly and avoid overfilling; keep the level just high enough to cover the perc and allow the uptakes to draw. If buildup starts in the tubes, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a warm water rinse usually clears things out without any special tools.

  • Is this rig good for low-temp flavor dabs?

    Yes, that’s where recyclers like this really shine. The quad uptake and dome recycler move water constantly around the vapor path, which helps keep things cool and lets terp flavor come through clearly. Pair it with clean concentrates stored in proper storage and packaging and a clean banger, and you’ll really notice the difference.

If you’re looking to level up your concentrate station with one rig that looks good and actually functions the way you want when you’re a few dabs deep, the 10" Highway Quad Uptake Dome Recycler earns its spot on the shelf.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Stays put during clumsy moments — The bulbous beaker base gives you a low center of gravity and more contact with your surface, so it’s way less likely to tip if someone bumps the table.

If you like stacking hits, running longer seshes, or sharing with a group, the 16″ height and beaker volume give you the space you need without getting cartoonishly huge.

How to Use It

Day to day, this bong is straightforward. Add water to the beaker base until it comfortably covers the end of your downstem and gives you a nice responsive bubble through the ratchet perc. You want enough water for good diffusion, but not so much that it splashes up into the neck when you clear it.

If you’re into cooler, smoother pulls, use the ice pinch: tilt the bong slightly and slide in a couple of ice cubes so they rest above the perc area. That way, the smoke is diffused in the water, then dragged past the ice for a final chill before you clear the chamber. Setting the beaker on a nonstick dab mat is a nice touch to catch any stray water or ash and keep your table clean.

The 14mm joint means you can swap bowls, add an ash catcher, or convert to a dab setup with a compatible banger if you ever want to run concentrates. Just stick to 14mm gear so everything seals up properly.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cleaner hits — Inline perc plus ratchet perc break your smoke into tons of tiny bubbles for serious diffusion before it ever reaches the neck.
  • Stays cool on heavy pulls — 16-inch (406mm) height and an ice pinch give your smoke plenty of travel and contact with ice so you can rip harder without getting cooked.
  • Stable on the table — Footed straight-tube base gives you a wide, grounded footprint so it’s less likely to tip when someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Built to last — Bridged joint reinforces the stress point where most bongs crack, so this piece can actually keep up with daily seshes.
  • Dialed-in aesthetics — Color accents, matching decals, and a coordinated flower bowl make it look like a custom setup right out of the box.
  • Easy airflow, big clouds — The straight design and open percs keep drag low, so big rips don’t feel like you’re trying to sip a milkshake through a coffee straw.

Best For

This bong is made for people who like a real sit-down sesh — think living room, coffee table, and a couple of friends passing it around. If you’re the person in the crew who owns the “good glass,” this is absolutely that piece. It’s also ideal if you’ve outgrown tiny travel pipes and want something with legit cooling and filtration, but still want to keep everything in one clean, vertical footprint instead of some wild, hard-to-clean sculptural rig.

If you’re pairing this with other gear, it plays especially well as the centerpiece in a bigger setup alongside your favorite smoke shop accessories like ashtrays, lighters, and storage.

How to Use It

Using the 16″ Black Sheep Inline Ratchet Straight is straightforward once you’ve got your water level dialed. Fill the tube slowly so that the inline perc is just submerged and the ratchet perc is getting consistent bubble action when you pull — too little water and you lose diffusion, too much and you’ll get splashback.

Drop your flower into the matching color bowl, seat it in the joint, and pull steadily so the percs can do their thing. If you like your clouds extra cold, feed a couple of ice cubes down through the mouthpiece until they sit on the ice pinch; they’ll stay suspended high in the neck so they cool the smoke without messing with your water level. Setting this piece on a reliable dab mat is a smart move so you’re not worrying about water marks or resin on the table when things get laid back.

When you’re done, let any remaining water cool, then carefully pour it out and give the tube a quick rinse so it’s not building up grime between seshes. Keeping on top of that light maintenance makes your deeper cleans way easier later.

Let the piece cool down first, then empty the water and wipe or rinse out any loose residue. A quick rinse after each sesh keeps your perc stack from getting gunked up and makes those deeper cleans a lot less work.

This is a tall piece, so check your storage spot or cabinet height — at 16 inches (406mm) it wants a bit of vertical space. The straight-tube profile makes it easier to slide into a corner or onto a shelf than wide, beaker-style bases, and that footed base still keeps it stable when it’s on the table.

  • Q: How much water should I put in it?
    A: Add water until the inline perc is fully submerged and the ratchet perc is getting good bubble action when you pull. You don’t need to flood the tube — just enough to keep both percs working without splashing into the mouthpiece.
  • Q: Can I use this bong with concentrates if I swap the bowl?
    A: Yes, if you grab a compatible banger or nail that matches the joint, you can absolutely use this as a dab rig. When you do that, it pairs nicely with proper dab tools so you’re not improvising every time you want a dab.

    A: For routine cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol and a good rinse will get into the perc slits and holes just fine. Because it’s a straight tube, you don’t have a lot of weird bends or chambers, which keeps cleaning simple compared to more complex recycler-style rigs.
  • Q: Will it feel draggy with two percs?
    A: The inline and ratchet percs on this piece are designed to diffuse without turning your pull into a workout. With the right water level, you get smooth resistance and dense clouds instead of that suffocating, plugged-up feeling.
  • Q: What should I store it with when it’s not in use?
    A: A padded spot away from edges is your best friend, especially if you’re sharing space with roommates or pets. Keeping your flower or concentrates in proper concentrate jars and glass containers nearby also helps keep your whole station organized.
  • Q: How does this compare to smaller or single-perc bongs?
    A: Smaller or single-perc pieces are more compact, but you’ll notice hotter, harsher hits when you pack them the same way. The 16″ Black Sheep gives you dual percs plus ice capability, so it’s noticeably smoother and better for longer seshes where you’re taking multiple rips back-to-back. If you like that “big tube” feel with real function, this is the upgrade.

If you’ve been wanting a bong that rips hard while still going easy on your lungs, this one’s made to be the centerpiece of your lineup, not just background glass on the shelf.

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Double stereo matrix percs create tons of tiny bubbles, giving smoke maximum contact with the water before it reaches you.

  • Stays upright when things get clumsy — The sturdy, footed base keeps it planted so you’re not babysitting it every time someone passes it back.

Pair it with a solid non-slip dab mat or bong mat if you want extra security on glass tables, cluttered desks, or “party mode” coffee tables.

Function on this piece is all about those double stereo matrix percs. As you pull, smoke travels down into the lower chamber and hits the first matrix, instantly breaking into a cloud of micro-bubbles. It then moves up into the second matrix perc, repeating the process and cooling even more before it stacks in the can and moves up the neck.

Fill the base so the matrix percs are properly covered, but not flooded; you want those slits and holes to fire freely, not fight water resistance. Start with a conservative water level and adjust until you feel the pull get nice and chuggy without splashing.

Let the bong cool down before you mess with it. Empty the water, then rinse with warm water to knock loose ash and light buildup. For deeper cleans, soak the inside with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before you put it back in rotation.

  • Is 13.5 inches too big for a daily driver?
    For most people, 13.5 inches (343mm) is that sweet spot: tall enough to stack bubbles, small enough to handle on the couch or at a desk. It’s not a mini travel piece, but it’s very comfortable for everyday use.
  • How fragile is the joint and perc area?
    The bridged joint gives extra support to the area that typically takes the most stress, and the matrix percs are tucked safely inside the can. It’s still glass, so don’t treat it like a football, but it’s absolutely meant to be used, not just stared at.
  • What kind of water level works best?
    You’ll want both stereo matrix percs covered, but not buried. Add water slowly, take a test pull, and stop when it stacks bubbles without splashing into the neck. If you hear it struggling or feel too much drag, you’ve probably overfilled it and should pour a little out.
  • What’s the advantage of a double stereo matrix over a basic downstem bong?
    A basic downstem gives you a few large bubbles; a stereo matrix gives you tons of small ones. More bubbles means more surface area, more cooling, and smoother hits. The double stack just doubles down on that effect, which you’ll notice right away on bigger clears.
  • How should I store it when I’m not using it?
    Empty the water, give it a quick rinse, and let it dry before putting it away. If you’re packing it up with other gear or travel cases, keeping spare bowls, papers, or accessories organized in proper storage & packaging helps protect both the bong and your stash.

If you’re ready to move beyond basic glass and actually feel what good diffusion does for flavor and comfort, the 13.5″ MONARK Double Stereo Matrix Bong is that upgrade piece you’ll keep in rotation for years.

  • Art that evolves — Fume coloring deepens and shifts over time as it meets heat and residue, so your rig slowly “seasons” into something uniquely yours.
  • Great size for daily use — 8 inches (203mm) is big enough for real function, but small enough to live on your coffee table or desk without taking over.

Best For

This recycler is made for dabbers who want legit function and a clean recycler pull without going to a giant showpiece rig. If you’re running a few dabs a day and care more about flavor, recycling, and aesthetics than giant clouds, this is a sweet daily driver. Park it on a nonstick dab mat so any sticky drips or hot banger moments don’t end up on your table.

How to Use It

The 8" Color Fume Double Uptake Wheel Recycler works like any classic recycler: vapor and water move in a loop so your hit gets repeatedly filtered and cooled before it hits your lungs. The double uptake arms pull water up and around the wheel, while the double drain sends it back down to the base, keeping the cycle going as long as you’re pulling.

Add a small amount of water to the base so it just engages the internal function when you pull — you’ll see and hear it cycling when you’re in the sweet spot. Drop your concentrate into the included 14mm banger with your favorite dab tool, cap it, and let the recycler do the work while you watch the water spin around the wheel.

Because this rig has a 45° 14mm joint, it plays especially nice with angled bangers and directionals, so you can pair it with different carb caps to tweak airflow and get your puddles moving just how you like.

Specifications

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm male, 45° joint is pretty much standard for modern oil rigs, so most 14mm accessories you already own should slide right into rotation. Just stick to 14mm female bangers or attachments and you’re set.

Cleaning & Care

Let everything cool down before you start cleaning — especially the banger. For light maintenance, a quick rinse with warm water and a shake will knock loose fresh reclaim and keep the recycler pathways from clogging. For a deeper clean, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

To keep the fume looking its best, avoid abrasive brushes on the outside of the rig. Gentle wipes and regular rinses are all you really need. When you’re not using it, you can stash your rig and accessories together in a padded case alongside your favorite non-glass silicone bongs & rigs so they’re all ready for the next sesh.

FAQ

  • Does this come with everything I need to start dabbing?

    It comes with the glass recycler itself and a 14mm male 45° banger, so you’re most of the way there. You’ll still want a torch, a dab tool, and optionally a carb cap to really dial in your hits. If you want to keep your concentrates fresh between rips, pair it with some airtight concentrate jars.

  • Will this fit my current bangers and accessories?

    If your current setup uses 14mm female bangers or attachments that sit on a 14mm male joint, you’re good. Just make sure they’re built for a 45° angle, since extremely flat, 90°-style pieces may sit a little off. Most common quartz buckets, slurpers, and blenders in 14mm will work just fine.

  • How much water should I put in the rig?

    Use just enough water to engage the function so you see the recycler cycling without heavy splashback. Too much water can choke airflow and send water up the neck; too little won’t recycle properly. You’ll find the sweet spot by adding small amounts and test-pulling until the wheel and drains are moving smoothly.

  • Is the wheel recycler hard to clean?

    Despite the intricate look, it’s pretty straightforward. Regular rinses help keep reclaim from building in the uptakes and drains. When it needs a reset, soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol, give it a few gentle shakes, then rinse thoroughly and let it dry. If you’re already cleaning other smoke shop products, just add this rig to the same routine.

  • Will the fume color really change over time?

    Yes. Fume glass reacts with heat, light, and a bit of residue over time, so the tones tend to deepen and shift slightly as you use it. Think of it like seasoning a pan — the more you sesh, the more character it picks up, without changing the function.

  • Is this a good rig for big, heavy globs?

    It can absolutely handle solid rips, but its sweet spot is flavorful, controlled dabs where you want to enjoy the recycler function and taste your terps. If your style is nonstop back-to-back heavy hits, you might want to rotate it with a beefier backup rig and keep this one as your flavor-focused recycler.

  • Can I use this rig for flower with a bowl piece?

    Technically, if you have a 14mm female bowl that fits a 14mm male joint, it will work, but this piece is really tuned for concentrates. The recycler design and banger setup shine with oil. If you mainly smoke flower, you’ll probably be happier with a dedicated piece from our broader accessories and glass lineup.

Why You’ll Love It

Pop open a tube, slide the rose cone out gently, and keep track of the included packing tool. The Basics

These ZIG ZAG SINGLE RED KING ROSE CONES are all about taking that classic cone shape and wrapping it in something way more eye-catching than standard paper. The rose petals are formed into a consistent king-size cone (109mm), so you still get the familiar feel of a cone-style smoke—just with a floral twist in aroma and aesthetics.

For people who want to keep pre-packed cones safe before a party, consider a stash jar from our concentrate jars and repurpose it for flower cones to keep everything protected in a bag or backpack.

Care & Storage

Keep unused cones in their original tubes with the Integra humidity pack until you’re ready to pack them. Store the carton in a cool, dry place out of direct sunlight so the petals don’t fade or over-dry. If a cone ever feels too crisp, leave it sealed with the humidity pack for a bit before packing so it can re-balance.

Frequently Asked Questions

    Each carton contains 12 individual tubes. Every tube includes one king-size (109mm) rose petal cone, a packing tool, and a 1g Integra 62% humidity pack.

  • Will these fit in my usual cone loader or rolling tray?

    A little more gentle than with standard paper cones. Use the included packing tool, add your flower a bit at a time, and tamp lightly instead of jamming it down hard. A good, even grind helps the petals hold shape and burn smoother.
  • Can I store pre-packed cones for later?
    Yes—if you pack a cone and want to save it, let it dry a bit so it’s not overly moist from fresh flower, then store it somewhere protected so it doesn’t get crushed. A hard case, jar, or even a spare tube from other products in your stash works well. Why It Works

  • Smoother, cleaner pulls — The one-hole perc feeds directly into the incycler chamber, giving you controlled diffusion without over-chopping your terps.
  • Less splash, more flavor — Incycler design keeps water moving inside the pillar instead of your mouth, so you can pull harder without tasting the pool.
  • Dialed for concentrates — The included 14mm 90° banger lines up perfectly with the rig’s geometry, so airflow feels natural and easy when you’re mid-sesh.
  • Stable on the table — The pillar body and heavy glass give it a solid footprint, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Eye candy that actually rips — Color accents and the sculpted recycler column make it look like a showpiece, but it’s still built to be a true daily driver.
  • Easy draw control — That single perc hole keeps the pull from feeling restricted, which you’ll notice when you’re stacking bubbles with minimal effort.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who run regular seshes and want something more interesting than a plain beaker, but still need reliable function every single time. It’s a great upgrade if you’re moving from a simple rig into the world of recyclers and incyclers and want something that won’t be a pain to clean or use daily. If you already have a lineup of smaller travel pieces or silicone rigs, this makes a perfect “stay-at-home” centerpiece that delivers your best-tasting dabs.

How to Use It

Fill the rig so the bottom chamber just covers the one-hole perc and the recycler pillar starts to engage when you pull. Too much water and you’ll choke the function; too little and you won’t get that satisfying internal spin.

Drop your concentrate into the included 14mm banger, cap it, and watch the incycler go to work as the water cycles up and back down through the pillar. The internal motion helps cool the vapor and keep it moving, so your hits feel lighter on the lungs even when you’re taking bigger dabs. Parking it on a non-slip dab mat is a nice move to keep your table clean and your glass safe.

When you’re done, let everything cool, empty the water, and give it a quick rinse so reclaim doesn’t build up inside the recycling pathways. For heavier use, deeper cleans with isopropyl alcohol will keep that glass shining and the function crisp.

  • What kind of concentrates can I use with this incycler?

    Anything you’d normally run through a banger will work — wax, shatter, rosin, live resin, diamonds in sauce, etc. The incycler doesn’t care what texture you prefer; its job is to cool and smooth out whatever vapor you send through it. Just use a tool instead of trying to drop sticky product straight in.

  • How much water should I put in it?

    Fill just enough to cover the one-hole perc in the bottom chamber, then test pull and adjust until you see water cycling up through the pillar without splashing into your mouth. You don’t need to overfill it; recyclers and incyclers work best with a moderate water line that lets the water move freely.

  • Is an incycler better than a regular rig?

    “Better” depends on what you like. Incyclers like this shine if you enjoy smoother, cooled hits and like watching water motion while you dab. If you’re coming from a basic pipe or one-chamber rig in our broader smoke shop products line, this will feel like a noticeable upgrade.

  • How do I keep the recycling pathways from clogging?

    The easiest way is to not let reclaim sit in there for weeks. Empty the water after use, give it a quick rinse, and do a light alcohol clean when you start to see buildup. If any reclaim collects near the recycler tunnels, a little isopropyl soak and a good rinse usually clears it right up. Storing your concentrates in clean, sealed concentrate jars also helps keep dust and debris from finding their way into the rig.

  • Can I travel with this rig?

    You can move it around or take it to a friend’s place, but treat it like the high-end glass it is. Empty all water before packing it, wrap it in something padded, and keep the banger separate so it doesn’t knock around. If you need something truly toss-in-a-bag friendly, it’s worth grabbing a tougher option from our storage and packaging lineup to protect it when it’s not on display.

  • Is this rig overkill for someone new to dabbing?

    Not at all. If you know you’re going to be dabbing regularly, starting with a solid incycler just means you won’t feel the need to upgrade in a month. It’s easy to use, not overly complicated, and forgiving on the lungs. You can always start simple and grow into it, instead of buying a cheaper piece you’ll quickly outgrow and end up tossing in the clearance pile of your own collection.

The 12″ Highway Color Accent Twin Turbo Stemline Recycler is a seriously dialed-in glass dab rig built for people who care about function as much as they care about looks. At 12 inches (304.8mm) tall with a twin turbo stemline and full recycler cycle, it’s made for dabbers who want cool, smooth vapor and zero splashback, even on heavier pulls. With the included 14mm 90° banger, it’s ready to drop right into your daily rotation as soon as it lands on your doorstep.

This piece blends thick glass, color accents, and smart internal design, so you’re not just buying something pretty—you’re getting a rig that actually rips the way it should.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Twin turbo stemline perc breaks your vapor into tons of tiny bubbles for better diffusion and less throat bite.
  • No more surprise splashback — The cone-shaped splash guard and recycler arms keep water circling where it belongs, not in your mouth.
  • Long, flavorful hits — Recycler action constantly moves water and vapor, helping preserve terps and keeping your hits from going stale mid-dab.
  • Ready to use out of the box — Comes with a 14mm male joint and matching 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to dig through a drawer of random glass to get started.
  • Stands tall & stable — At 12 inches (304.8mm), it gives your vapor time to cool while still feeling solid and balanced on the table.
  • Looks as good as it hits — Color accents on the mouthpiece and base add some personality without turning it into a toy-looking piece.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who are past the starter-pen phase and want a real piece of glass with legit function. If you’re running multiple dabs a day and want consistent, recycler-level smoothness, this checks that box. It’s also a strong choice if you already have a dedicated dab pad or mat and want a centerpiece rig that actually deserves the space.

If you like tasting your concentrates more than just surviving them, the extra diffusion and recycler function will make a noticeable difference when you swap over from a basic straight tube or mini rig.

How to Use It

Day to day, this rig is straightforward. Add enough water to cover the stemline perc slits and give it a few test pulls (no heat) to find your preferred water level—too low and you lose diffusion, too high and you’ll feel it creep toward the splash guard. Once you’ve got it set, that water line tends to stay pretty consistent unless you’re really going hard.

The included 14mm 90° banger drops right into the joint, so you can set your concentrates up with your usual routine and focus more on the hit than the hardware. If you like a cleaner workspace, park the rig on a non-slip accessory mat so you’re not worrying about bumping the base mid-sesh.

After things cool down, you can wipe the banger and rig joint area to keep reclaim from building up. For deeper cleaning, let everything cool, remove the banger, and soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and let it dry before your next use.

The Basics of the Design

The twin turbo stemline lives in the lower chamber, where your vapor first hits the water. Those multiple slits increase surface area, which means more contact between vapor and water for smoother pulls. From there, the recycler arms pull water and vapor up into the upper chamber, then drain it back down in a loop.

That constant circulation helps keep your water fresher during a sesh and keeps the hit from feeling harsh halfway through a pull. The cone splash guard on top of the main chamber acts like a shield, stopping water from jumping up as you clear the rig, which is huge if you like to clear big rips without sipping gently.

Pairing that design with a quality banger and proper storage—like keeping your extracts in solid concentrate jars instead of random silicone scraps—helps you get the most out of your material.

It also vibes well with other gear you might already have—things like carb caps, pearls, and dabbers from your current lineup. If you’re building out a matched setup, it fits nicely alongside both glass and silicone rigs and bongs without looking out of place.

Care & Maintenance

Rinse the rig with warm water after heavier seshes to keep the recycler pathways from getting clogged. When it starts to look foggy or you notice drag increasing, it’s time for an alcohol soak and rinse. Keep the banger wiped down after use so you don’t have to fight burnt-on residue later.

For people in tighter spaces or shared homes, you can store your clean rig in a safe spot and keep your concentrates tucked away in smell-conscious storage and packaging, so everything stays low-key between uses.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    It includes the main rig and a 14mm 90° banger, so you’re good on the glass side. You’ll still want your own carb cap, dab tool, and a surface like a parchment sheet or mat for handling concentrates.
  • Will this fit my current carb caps and dab tools?
    Most standard caps that work on typical 14mm-sized bucket bangers will work here too, since the included banger is a standard style. Any regular dabber from our dab tools collection will also pair just fine with this setup.
  • Is 12 inches too tall for a recycler rig?
    Not at all—12 inches (304.8mm) is actually a sweet spot for recyclers. It’s tall enough to cool vapor effectively and show off the function, but not so tall that it feels unwieldy or clumsy on a coffee table.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    There isn’t a precise line etched on the glass, but a good rule of thumb is to fill just above the slits in the stemline and then test pull. Add or remove a little until you get strong bubbles without splashing into the splash guard. Once you find your preferred level, you’ll dial it in quickly every time.
  • Is this more of a “special occasion” piece or a daily driver?
    Functionally, it’s built to be a daily driver. The diffusion and recycler action handle back-to-back dabs easily, and the design is robust enough for regular use if you treat it like good glass. If you want something ultra rugged for travel, you might still grab one of our portable pieces or nectar collectors instead.
  • How hard is it to clean the recycler sections?
    It’s easier than it looks. A bit of isopropyl alcohol and warm water will reach all the internal passages. Give it a soak, shake gently, rinse well, and let it dry fully before using it again.
  • Can I use this with flower instead of concentrates?
    This rig is really dialed for concentrates with the included banger, and that’s where it shines. If you want a dedicated flower setup, it’s usually better to grab a piece designed around bowls from our broader smoke shop products lineup and keep this one as your go-to oil rig.

The 12″ Monark Grid Perc Incycler is a tall, premium glass dab rig built for dabbers who care about flavor, smoothness, and showpiece-level function. At 12 inches (305mm) with a grid perc and incycler cooling, it’s made for people running real seshes, not just “test hits.” The footed can base and bent neck keep it comfortable and stable while you push big, milky pulls.

Why it hits different

  • Smoother, cooler rips — The incycler design constantly recirculates water around the grid perc, knocking down harshness before it ever hits your throat.
  • Flavor stays on point — Grid perc diffusion breaks vapor into tiny bubbles without over-chopping it, so you keep terps instead of washing them out.
  • Stays put on the table — Footed can base gives you way more stability than skinny-tube rigs, so one clumsy elbow is less likely to end in heartbreak.
  • Comfortable angle, less neck strain — The bent neck brings the mouthpiece to you, so you’re not hovering over the table or craning your back mid-sesh.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Comes with a 14mm male 90° banger, so you can toss it in rotation with your other 14mm gear right away.
  • Great daily driver size — At 12 inches (305mm), it’s big enough for heavy hitters but still manageable to clean, move, and stash.

Best for

This rig is made for dabbers who have outgrown tiny starter rigs and want legit function they can feel in every pull. If you’re doing multiple dabs per sesh or sharing with the group, the incycler design helps keep things smoother hit after hit. It also fits right into a serious glass lineup as your main recycler-style daily driver or as the “show me something nice” piece you pull out next to your other premium smoke shop products.

How to use it

Function-wise, the 12″ Monark Grid Perc Incycler is all about recirculating water for consistent cooling. When you pull, vapor and water are drawn through the grid perc at the bottom of the can. That grid chops the vapor into tons of small bubbles, increasing surface contact with the water for smoother hits.

From there, the incycler kicks in: water gets pulled up and around the internal pathways, then drops back into the main chamber in a loop. You’ll see that classic incycler “chug and swirl” as the water drains back down while you’re still clearing the hit. It looks cool, but more importantly, it keeps fresh, moving water around the vapor so you’re not just recycling hot, stale water.

Set the rig on a flat surface (a dedicated dab pad or mat works great) with enough room to move your torch or e-nail around comfortably. Use the included 14mm male 90° banger or swap in your preferred 14mm 90° setup, and you’re ready to dial in your ritual.

For cleaning, let everything cool down completely, then wipe off residue around the joint and banger. When it’s time for a deeper reset, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh.

That means it plays nice with most 14mm 90° bangers, terp slurpers, and compatible e-nail heaters you might already own. If you’re upgrading from a smaller rig, this can easily step in as your main piece without needing to replace all your accessories.

Because it’s an incycler with a grid perc, you’ll get best results using a banger with decent thermal mass and pairing it with a proper cap. Directional or bubble caps can help you really spin your puddle and make the most of the diffusion coming off that grid perc, just like you would on our dedicated carb caps and airflow-focused accessories.

FAQ

  • Will this work with my current banger?
    If your banger is 14mm and designed for a 90° joint, it should fit right in. This rig ships with a 14mm male 90° banger, so if you’re used to running that size and angle, you’re good to go.
  • Can I use an e-nail with this rig?
    Yes, as long as your e-nail coil and nail are made for a 14mm 90° setup, they’ll pair nicely with this piece. Just make sure the coil sits securely and that the rig is on a stable surface, like a non-slip accessory mat or stand, so you’re not bumping hot hardware.
  • Is a 12″ incycler too big for daily use?
    Not at all. 12 inches (305mm) is a sweet spot for a daily driver if you want smoother hits without going into giant tower territory. It’s tall enough to cool things down and show off the incycler function but still easy to move from desk to coffee table.
  • How hard is this to clean compared to a simple rig?
    The incycler has more internal pathways than a basic beaker or straight tube, but it’s still very manageable. Let everything cool, rinse, and when it needs a refresh, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry. Keeping your concentrates stored cleanly in proper concentrate jars can also help reduce funk buildup over time.
  • Can I travel with it or is it more of a stay-at-home piece?
    It’s definitely more of a home-base rig, but you can bring it to a friend’s place if you’ve got good padding and a safe spot to set it down. For true throw-in-the-backpack situations, you might want to add a smaller piece from our durable silicone bongs & rigs lineup and keep this Monark incycler as your at-home flex.
  • What kind of dabbing style is this best for?
    This rig shines for people who like steady, flavorful dabs—whether you’re into lower-temp, terp-focused hits or stacking a few back-to-back. The incycler function helps keep water moving and cooling, so it keeps up when the sesh goes from “a quick dab” to “everyone’s taking another round.” Pair it with quality rosin tools and handling gear from our rosin extraction collection for a full, dialed-in setup.
  • Is the grid perc really that different from a regular perc?
    Yeah, you’ll notice the difference. A grid perc has multiple small openings that break vapor into fine bubbles, which increases contact with the water without making the pull super draggy. Compared to basic downstems or single-slit percs, it’s smoother, more controlled, and way more satisfying to watch—especially combined with the incycler’s drain.

VIBES Blanco Fatty papers are all about balancing size with control. The 53mm double-wide format gives you more surface area than a regular paper, but not so much that your roll turns into a blimp. Once you get used to the width, it’s easy to shape clean cylinders or those old-school baseball bat joints without wasting flower or paper.

Best For

This Encore recycler is made for dabbers who take flavor seriously but still want something tough enough to be a daily driver. If you’re running multiple dabs in a sesh, sharing with friends, or upgrading from a basic straight-tube rig, this checks the boxes without getting overly complicated. Airflow starts in the lower chamber, where the double disc percs go to work. Set the Encore Cone Drain Recycler on a flat, stable surface and fill the base until the showerhead perc is just covered. From there, the cone drain brings water back down to the base in a clean central stream. That constant cycling is what makes recyclers feel so smooth: the water never just sits and gets stale, and the airflow stays steadier, so your hit feels easier to control. Why It Works

  • Smoother, tastier pulls — The fixed downstem with a two-hole perc breaks your hit into smaller bubbles, helping cool and preserve flavor.
  • Less waste, more reclaim — Reclaim-style body is shaped to collect excess oil instead of sending it down the neck or into your sink.

Glass rigs always perform best when they’re clean. Let everything cool down, then wipe off any visible residue from the banger and joint. Fill the beaker base with water until the bottom of the tire perc is comfortably submerged, but not so high that water splashes toward the mouthpiece when you clear the tube. The tire perc is designed to work best with moderate water levels so it can fire all those slits without adding drag.

Let the bong cool down after use, then empty the water. For regular upkeep, a quick rinse with warm water goes a long way. Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger fully cool before cleaning. For the glass body, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse with warm water and complete dry time will keep the recycler pathways clear. The banger can be wiped or soaked the same way to remove stubborn residue.

If you’re someone who likes spotless glass all the time, changing the water regularly and giving it quick rinses will keep buildup from forming in the uptakes and perc, so you don’t have to do deep cleans as often.

  • What’s the advantage of a double uptake recycler vs a regular rig?

The 15.5″ ENCORE Thick Base Tree Beaker is a tall, heavy-duty glass bong built for everyday smokers who actually put their glass to work. At 15.5 inches (394mm), it gives you big, cooled hits while the thick base keeps everything planted on the table. With a tree perc for extra diffusion and a 14mm flower bowl included, this is the kind of piece you stash in the “do not touch” zone because it instantly becomes the house favorite.

Why You’ll Reach For This One

  • Smoother, cooler rips — The tree percolator breaks your pull into multiple small bubbles, so each hit feels less harsh and more flavorful.
  • Stays put on the table — Thick, heavy base adds stability so it’s less likely to get knocked over when people are passing it around.
  • Big beaker volume — The classic beaker bottom gives more water and smoke capacity, which means bigger, denser clouds when you want them.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a 14mm flower bowl, so you’re set to sesh as soon as it lands.
  • Dialed-in function — Tree perc + beaker design hits the sweet spot between smoothness and airflow, without feeling like you’re trying to sip a milkshake.
  • Looks as good as it rips — Colored lips and perc add some personality without screaming for attention on the shelf.

Best For

This beaker is made for flower lovers running real daily-driver routines, not just taking a novelty hit once a month. If you’re the friend who always has a clean, working piece ready to go, this slots perfectly into that role. It also pairs nicely with a solid dab pad or mat under it if you want to protect your table and keep drips at bay.

How to Use It

Fill the beaker base with enough water so the tree perc is just covered over its slits. That’s where most of the diffusion happens, so you want those cuts under water without flooding the whole neck. Drop in your 14mm bowl, pack it the way you like, and you’re good to go.

As you pull, smoke travels down through the downstem, up through the tree perc, and then into the neck for a long, cool path to your lungs. You’ll feel the difference compared to a straight-tube with no perc — smoother, less throat bite, and more flavor from your flower. If you ever decide to swap the bowl for a banger, it’ll still function great as a dab setup, especially if you keep your concentrates cold and tidy in proper concentrate jars.

When you’re done, dump the old water and give it a quick rinse. Keeping the water fresh is the easiest way to make this thing taste good every time, especially if it’s your main piece sitting next to your other go-to smoke shop gear.

Let the piece cool before you deal with it, especially if you’ve been using a torch and banger on it. For quick turns, rinse with warm water and shake gently to knock loose debris.   • How much water should I put in it?

  • Is the base really that thick, or is it just marketing?

Fill the beaker with enough water to cover the end of the downstem, then adjust to your preferred level once you’ve tried a couple of pulls. When you want extra-cool hits, drop a few ice cubes down the mouthpiece so they catch on the ice pinch. That extra cooling in the neck makes a big difference on bigger rips, especially if you’re pairing this with potent flower you keep tucked away in proper storage and packaging.

After your sesh, let the glass cool, dump the water, and rinse. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and let it dry before you bring it back into rotation.   • Does the ice pinch really make a difference?
    If you like colder, smoother hits, absolutely. Being able to hold ice right in the neck cools the smoke as it travels up, which takes the harshness down—especially on those big, lung-buster pulls this 16" beaker is great at.
  • How hard is it to clean a 16" beaker like this?
