The double ratchet perc and fixed downstem combo give you serious diffusion in a clean, modern Black Sheep aesthetic.

Why You’ll Actually Love This Rig

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The double ratchet perc stacks bubbles in layers, so your vapor has more contact with water before it ever hits your lungs.
  • Less splash, more comfort — The bent neck keeps water away from your mouth while giving you a relaxed, natural angle when you’re posted up mid-sesh.
  • Stays put on the table — Footed can-style base spreads the weight out, so it’s less likely to get tipped when someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Dialed for modern bangers — 14mm, 90-degree joint works perfectly with most flat-top quartz bangers and common accessory setups.
  • Great function without being huge — At 9 inches (228.6mm), you get legit percolation and flavor without hauling around a tall, fragile showpiece.
  • Clear accents show the action — The transparent sections let you watch the double ratchet perc shred and stack bubbles every time you rip it.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers running regular seshes who want a high-functioning piece that can still be a daily driver, not just a shelf trophy. If you already have a favorite quartz banger and a decent dab mat, this is the upgrade that levels up your function without making your setup overly complicated.

It’s especially solid for people who like flavorful, terp-forward hits and want more diffusion than a basic single perc rig, but don’t want to step into bulky recyclers or multi-chamber glass that’s a pain to clean.

How to Use It

Set up the 9" Black Sheep Double Ratchet Rig on a flat, stable surface and add enough water to cover the slits on the double ratchet perc while still keeping the pull comfortable. The can-style base keeps it steady, so once it’s filled, it’s basically ready to live on your coffee table or desk.

Attach your preferred 14mm quartz banger or nail to the 90-degree joint. As you pull, vapor is drawn down through the fixed downstem and into the double ratchet perc, where it’s broken into tons of small bubbles for extra cooling and filtration. From there it travels up the bent neck, which is angled to keep water in the can and away from your mouth, even on more aggressive pulls.

For clean, organized sessions, pair it with a solid set of dab tools so you’re not juggling sticky utensils while you’re trying to enjoy the rig’s function.

Cleaning is straightforward: let everything cool, then empty the water. Add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, cover the openings, give it a shake, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh. Because the perc is fixed and internal, regular quick cleans will keep it from building up and getting harder to maintain.

If you like to swap between rigs and silicone bongs & rigs, staying in the 14mm ecosystem keeps your banger collection simple and interchangeable.

The Basics of the Double Ratchet Perc

A ratchet perc uses a ring of slits or holes that force vapor through multiple small paths instead of one big opening. This rig doubles that system, so vapor is broken up more aggressively before it gets to you. More bubbles = more surface area touching the water = cooler, smoother pulls.

In normal use, you’ll feel a bit of resistance on the draw — not choked, just nicely restricted — which helps stack bubbles and makes for that satisfying, controlled pull. It’s a great middle ground between super-open chug rigs and overly tight, multi-chamber glass.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Quad uptakes and a single drain keep water moving so your vapor has more time to cool before it hits your lungs.
  • Big flavor, less harshness — The up-fire showerhead perc breaks your pull into tons of tiny bubbles, letting terps shine without cooking your throat.
  • Recycles like a champ — True recycler function keeps the water looping instead of splashing, so you get that chug and whirl without getting a mouthful of water.
  • Comfortable seshes — The bent neck keeps the rig at a natural angle and helps prevent splashback when you pull a little too hard.
  • Dialed-in size for daily use — At 8 inches (203mm), it’s big enough to stack function but small enough to live on your desk or nightstand.
  • Two-tone style that isn’t boring — Contrasting colors on the accents give it that “nice piece” vibe instead of “random glass from the gas station.”

Best For

This recycler is made for dabbers who like running multiple seshes a day and want smoother pulls without upgrading to some massive table piece. If you’re into watching water and vapor cycle through intricate glass, this gives you that visual show without being fragile art-glass level overkill. It’s also a great upgrade if you’re coming from a basic rig and want real recycler function that pairs nicely with a solid dab mat to keep your table clean.

How to Use It

Fill the rig from the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is just covered and the uptakes start to function when you pull—too much water and you’ll flood it, too little and the recycler action won’t really kick in. You’re aiming for enough water that it cycles up the tubes and drains back smoothly without splashing into the neck.

Drop the included 14mm 90° banger into the Dewar joint, load your concentrates, and let the rig’s design do the heavy lifting. As you pull, vapor moves down into the showerhead perc, gets broken into bubbles, and then is pulled up through the four uptakes into the upper chamber before dropping back down through the single drain. That loop is what makes recyclers feel smoother and taste cleaner, especially if you’re pairing them with good-quality material stored in proper concentrate jars.

When you’re done, let the glass cool off before handling or cleaning. A simple rinse after a sesh goes a long way toward keeping that two-tone glass looking fresh instead of foggy.

The included 14mm 90° banger gets you started, and you can always upgrade later to something thicker or specialized from your stash of smoke shop products if you want to customize your setup.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you do anything. For everyday maintenance, a hot water rinse helps keep the recycler paths clear so you’re not fighting built-up reclaim.     Any accessory with a 14mm female joint and a 90° angle will fit this rig. If you’ve got a drawer full of old bangers and dab tools, this piece should drop right into your existing lineup as long as they’re 14mm female.
  • What’s the advantage of a recycler over a regular rig?
    Recyclers keep water (and vapor) moving in a loop through the uptakes and drain instead of just bubbling in one spot. That extra motion helps cool and condition your vapor, which can feel smoother on the throat and lungs—especially if you tend to take longer pulls or back-to-back dabs.
  • Is 8 inches big enough for serious dabs?
    Definitely. 8 inches (203mm) is a sweet spot for dab rigs—compact enough to keep flavor tight, but with enough room for the recycler and showerhead perc to really function. If you like your rigs on the smaller side but still want real diffusion, this size works well.
  • How do I keep the recycler tubes from clogging?
    Try not to let reclaim build up for weeks. A quick rinse after heavy use and an occasional alcohol soak will keep the uptakes and drain clear. Setting your rig on a clean dab station or accessory setup between seshes also helps keep dust and grime out.

Why You’ll Want This on the Table

  • Smoother, cooler hits — 15 inches (381mm) of travel plus a square ice pinch means your smoke has time to cool down before it ever reaches you.
  • Classic beaker stability — Wide beaker base helps keep it planted, so you’re not holding your breath every time someone bumps the coffee table.

The 9" Black Sheep Color Accent Double Ratchet Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for flavor chasers who want smooth, controlled hits without dragging around a giant piece. At 9 inches (229mm) tall with a 14mm, 90-degree joint, it’s a perfect daily driver size that still has room for serious diffusion. The star of the show is the double ratchet perc, stacking stacks of tiny bubbles so your vapor comes through cool, dense, and clean.

Designed by Wyn Brands (What You Need), this rig mixes clean lines with subtle color accents and Black Sheep logos that actually look good on the table, not just in product photos. The footed can-style body keeps it stable, while the bent neck keeps water out of your mouth—even when you’re ripping it a little harder than planned.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Everyday

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The double ratchet perc breaks vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, giving it more time in the water so each hit feels softer on the throat.
  • Less splash, more flavor — The can-shaped body and bent neck work together to keep water down and terps up, so you’re tasting your concentrate, not your rig water.
  • Dab-ready joint setup — 14mm, 90-degree joint is the standard dab rig sweet spot, so swapping in your favorite banger or nail is plug-and-play.
  • Built to survive real-life seshes — Fixed downstem and bridged joint mean fewer weak points, which is clutch when someone bumps the table or passes it a little too hard.
  • Compact but not cramped — At 9 inches (229mm), it’s tall enough for good function and easy clearing but small enough to stash on a shelf or in a cabinet without drama.
  • Art piece energy — Color accents and Black Sheep branding give it just enough personality to stand out without looking loud or cheap.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want real function in a mid-size piece—people doing a few seshes a day who care about smoothness and taste, not just getting cooked. It’s also a great fit if you already have a lineup of bangers and carb caps and just need a clean, reliable rig to tie the setup together.

If you’ve been running a big bong with a banger and you’re ready for a dedicated dab rig that doesn’t chug or splash, this is a solid upgrade path.

How to Use It

Fill the rig so the double ratchet perc is just covered—enough water to fully stack bubbles, but not so much that it climbs the neck when you pull. The perc is designed to do the heavy lifting, so you don’t need to overfill to get smooth hits.

Drop in your favorite 14mm banger or nail, set the rig flat on a stable surface (a good dab mat helps keep things clean and grippy), and you’re ready to go. The bent neck angle lets you sit comfortably without having to hover over the table, and it helps keep any stray splash away from your mouth.

Between seshes, a quick warm rinse and occasional alcohol soak will keep the perc from clogging so you’re not fighting stale flavor or restricted airflow when you’re three dabs deep and just want things to work.

The 14mm, 90-degree joint is the go-to spec for modern dab rigs, so this will play nice with most 14mm quartz bangers, nails, and dropdowns you already own. If you’re building a fresh setup, pair it with a solid banger and a directional cap, and stash your extracts in proper concentrate jars so you’re not wasting terps between seshes.

Because it’s a 90-degree joint on a can-style body, this rig works best with flat-bottom or slightly angled bangers, not steep slanted ones that want to tip or sit weird.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig cool fully before cleaning—especially if you’ve just heated a banger on it. For quick freshening, rinse with warm water and gently shake to loosen any reclaim. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

If you’re someone who hates cleaning day, keeping it on a clean surface and pouring old water out after each use will stretch out the time between full deep cleans. Using clean tools from our broader dab tools selection also helps keep the inside of your rig from getting gunked up too fast.

FAQ

  • Q: Does this rig come with a banger or nail?

    No, this listing is for the rig itself. That’s actually nice if you’re picky about your quartz—you can choose the exact 14mm banger style you like best from your favorite shop or current stash of smoke shop products.
  • Q: Will this fit my existing 14mm accessories?

    If your gear is 14mm male and meant for a 90-degree joint, it should fit just fine. That includes most standard quartz bangers, reclaim catchers, and dropdowns that are made for dab rigs, not big flower bongs.
  • Q: Is 9 inches too small or too big for a dab rig?

    9 inches (229mm) is a sweet-spot size—big enough for real diffusion and comfortable pulls, but not so tall that it feels clunky or hard to store. If you’ve been using tiny micro rigs, this will feel like an upgrade in smoothness; if you’ve only used tall bongs, this will feel more compact and efficient.
  • Q: What’s the benefit of the double ratchet perc versus a simple downstem?

    A plain downstem just pulls smoke through a few slits or holes, so you get bigger bubbles and less contact with water. The double ratchet perc stacks multiple layers of diffusion, breaking vapor into smaller bubbles and giving you smoother pulls and better flavor. You’ll notice the difference right away compared to a basic beaker or straight tube.
  • Q: How do I keep the perc from clogging?

    Avoid letting reclaim build up for weeks. Empty the water regularly, give it a warm rinse here and there, and do a deeper isopropyl soak when you see residue collecting in the perc slits. Let everything dry fully before using again. Keeping your workspace clean with things like nonstick parchment papers can also help cut down on random gunk making its way into the rig.
  • Q: Can I use this for flower too?

    Technically yes—if you put a 14mm bowl on it, it will function as a small water pipe. Just know that flower tends to leave more residue, so if you care about dab flavor, it’s better to keep your flower and concentrate pieces separate or be ready to clean more often. For dedicated flower setups, a lot of people like to pair a flower bong with unbreakable gear like our silicone pipes.
  • Q: Is this portable or more of a stay-at-home piece?

    It’s small enough to travel with if you’ve got a padded bag or case, but it really shines as a stay-at-home daily driver. If you’re constantly on the move, you might want to back it up with something more rugged or silicone-based from our storage & packaging lineup to keep everything protected and organized.

The ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classic Papers 300s (20/box) are ultra-thin rice rolling papers built for heavy rollers, shops, and anyone who cares more about flavor than paper. Pure rice with that classic Elements Criss-Cross watermark means clean, slow, almost ash-free burns. At 1 1/4 size (about 76mm x 40mm), they hit the sweet spot for everyday personals without wasting flower.

Why These Papers Hit Different

  • Clean flavor, almost no ash — Pure pressed rice paper burns down to a faint white line so you taste your flower, not the paper.
  • Fewer runs, less babysitting — Elements' Criss-Cross watermark helps the paper burn evenly, so you’re not chasing runs mid-sesh.
  • Perfect everyday size — 1 1/4 format at 76mm x 40mm gives you a comfortable personal roll without turning it into a marathon.
  • Bulk-friendly for real smokers — 300 leaves per pack and 20 packs per box keep frequent rollers and busy shops stocked for a while.
  • Minimal ingredient list — No pulp, no hemp, no chalky nonsense—just rice paper and a thin natural gum line.
  • Rolls tight or fluffy — Thin paper is flexible enough for cone-style, straight, or anything in between without fighting you.

Best For

These ELEMENTS 1 1/4 Classics are made for people who roll a lot and actually care how their joints burn. If you’re running through multiple rolls a day, stocking a crew, or grabbing a box for your shop counter, this 300-count format keeps you from constantly re-upping. They’re also solid for anyone switching from thicker papers and wanting a smoother, cleaner-tasting upgrade to pair with their favorite smoke shop products.

The Basics: How These Papers Work

Each sheet is an ultra-thin strip of rice paper with a light Criss-Cross watermark printed across the surface. That pattern isn’t just for looks—it controls how the paper burns so your joint stays even instead of canoing down one side. The gum line is a narrow strip along one edge designed to seal with just a quick lick and press.

The 1 1/4 size gives you enough room to roll a proper joint without needing origami skills. You can go with a looser, fluffier cone or a tighter cylinder—these papers are thin and pliable, so they wrap around your grind easily. Set your pack on a small dab mat or tray to keep your rolling area clean and organized.

How to Use Them (Without Overthinking It)

Pull a sheet from the 300-pack stack and decide if you want a crease or a straight sheet—these come flat so you can choose. Add your ground flower and shape it the way you like; the thin rice paper hugs the material as you tuck and roll. Once everything feels tight and even, seal along the gum line and you’re good to go.

If you’re rolling for a group or doing a bunch back-to-back, it helps to keep your material prepped and staged in something cleaner than a baggie—think small glass concentrate jars or similar containers so your flower stays fresh while you roll through the box.

Specifications

Paper Type Classic Elements rice rolling paper
Size 1 1/4 – 76mm x 40mm (approx. 3.0 x 1.6 inches)
Leaf Count (per pack) 300 leaves
Pack Count (per box) 20 packs
Case Count 30 boxes per case (wholesale level)

Fit, Feel & Rolling Style

Because these are ultra-thin rice papers, they feel lighter and a bit more delicate than thick wood-pulp papers—but that’s what gives you the clean smoke. Once you get used to them, you’ll notice you need less paper overlap and your joints feel smoother and more streamlined in the hand.

They work great with hand rolling or basic rollers; if you’re using any kind of roller, just make sure it’s sized for 1 1/4 papers and you’re set. For folks who like to tuck in a cardboard tip or filter, there’s enough width to add one without making things bulky—especially if you keep your material evenly ground, which you can dial in with your go-to grinder or other rolling accessories.

Care & Storage

Even though they’re just papers, how you store them matters. Keep the box somewhere dry and cool so humidity doesn’t warp or curl the leaves. Try not to leave packs stuffed in sweaty pockets or in direct sun—rice papers can pick up moisture or get too crisp if they’re abused.

If you’re only cracking one pack at a time, leave the others sealed in the display box or stash them with your other long-term storage and packaging so they stay fresh for months.

FAQ

  • Are these papers bleached or flavored?
    No flavors, no dyes, no pulp. These are classic unflavored rice papers designed to stay as neutral as possible so your flower does the talking.
  • Will these fit in my 1 1/4 rolling machine?
    Yes. Any rolling machine made for standard 1 1/4 papers will play nice with these, as long as it’s in decent shape and not gummed up with old resin or crumbs.
  • Do they come with tips or filters?
    No, this box is strictly papers. If you like using crutches, you can rip your own from card or grab separate tips along with other smoke shop staples to round out your kit.
  • Are rice papers harder to roll than regular papers?
    They can feel different at first because they’re thinner and smoother, but most people adjust quickly. Once you get the hang of them, they actually make it easier to roll clean, tight joints that don’t feel bulky.
  • Do these burn slower than thicker papers?
    The combo of rice paper and the Criss-Cross watermark helps them burn slow and even without a ton of ash. Your grind, pack, and roll all play a part, but these are definitely on the “slow burn” side of the spectrum.
  • Can I use these with mixes or herbal blends?
    Yes. Whether you’re rolling straight flower or mixing in other legal herbs, the neutral rice paper won’t overpower the flavor of what you’re packing.
  • What’s the benefit of getting the 300s instead of regular packs?
    You get way more sheets per pack, which is perfect if you roll daily or run through papers fast. It also cuts down on how often you’re buying more, which is nice when you’d rather be stocking up on rigs, silicone bongs, and the fun stuff instead of constantly hunting for another pack of papers.

The 6" Monark Clear Mini Floating Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want top-tier function in a tiny footprint. It's made for dabbers who like clean, smooth pulls without dragging a huge piece around. Standing just 6 inches (152mm) tall with a 10mm joint and included quartz banger, it's a true grab-and-go recycler that still rips like a full-size rig.

The floating recycler design keeps your hits cool and flavorful while recycling water through the piece so every pull feels consistent from first dab to last. If you want a small, efficient daily driver that doesn't waste concentrates or table space, this little Monark checks the boxes.

Why it works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The floating recycler continuously pulls and returns water, cooling vapor before it reaches your mouth.
  • Flavor-focused design — Short vapor path and included quartz banger mean you taste your terps instead of stale, over-traveled vapor.
  • Tiny rig, big function — At 6 inches (152mm), it's compact enough for tight spaces but still has real diffusion and recycler action.
  • Ready out of the box — 10mm quartz banger included, so you don't have to hunt for a matching nail before your first sesh.
  • Easy to control — Small chamber makes it simple to dial in comfortable-sized hits, especially for newer dabbers or folks who don't want lung-buster rips.
  • Solid glass build — All-glass construction gives you a clean look and sturdy feel without random plastic bits or gimmicks.

Best for

This mini floating rig is made for dabbers who want recycler function without committing to a massive, delicate showpiece. It's ideal if you:

  • Run a couple dabs a day and want an easy-to-clean daily driver, not a chore.
  • Live in a smaller space, share a coffee table, or travel between spots and need something compact.
  • Prefer rigs that pair cleanly with a small dab mat instead of taking over your whole desk.
  • Like the smoother, cooler feel of recyclers but don't want extra percs that make cleaning a nightmare.

How to use it

Using the 6" Monark Clear Mini Floating Rig is straightforward, even if this is your first recycler. Fill the rig with just enough water to cover the bottom of the percs and let the recycler sections do the rest while you draw — you'll see the water cycle through the upper chamber and back down as you pull.

Drop the included 10mm quartz banger into the joint, heat it with your torch, then let it settle before introducing your concentrate. The compact size and recycler design help keep the vapor dense but comfortable, so you're not getting cooked by harsh, dry hits. For best results, keep it on a stable surface like a small tray or smoking accessory station so you're not balancing it on your knee mid-sesh.

When you're done, let everything cool down before you move or clean it. Quartz and glass don't love sudden temperature changes, and a quick cool-off keeps your rig safer in the long run.

Fit & compatibility

This rig runs a 10mm joint and comes with a matching quartz banger, so you're covered right away. If you swap hardware, stick to 10mm accessories to keep the seal tight and function on point. It plays especially well with small, low-profile bangers and compact carb caps that don't overpower the tiny rig.

The smaller joint and recycler design also make it a great match for more flavorful, terp-heavy concentrates where you care more about taste than monstrous clouds. Pair your extracts with durable concentrate jars to keep everything fresh between seshes and you've got a tight, efficient setup.

Cleaning & care

Let the rig and banger fully cool before cleaning. Empty out the water, then rinse with warm water to loosen anything loose. For deeper cleans, soak the glass and quartz in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let everything dry before your next use.

If you're someone who dabs often, make a quick rinse part of your routine so reclaim and buildup don't clog the recycler paths. For the banger, wiping out residue after each use helps it stay clear instead of cloudy and crusted.

FAQs

  • Is 6 inches big enough to function like a "real" rig?
    Yes. Even though it's compact, the floating recycler setup gives this piece solid function. You still get water diffusion and recycling, just in a tighter, more efficient package instead of a tall, bulky rig.
  • What size accessories can I use with this rig?
    This rig uses a 10mm joint, so you'll want 10mm bangers, nails, or adapters. If you like using specific tools or caps, you can pair them with this piece as long as they're sized for 10mm setups. For better control when loading your banger, a dedicated dab tool is a nice upgrade.
  • Can I use this as my main daily driver?
    Absolutely. It's built as a small but capable daily rig, especially for dabbers who run a few seshes a day and want something easy to grab, rip, and clean. If you're doing huge, back-to-back party clouds, you might still keep a bigger rig on hand, but most people will be happy using this as their main piece.
  • How hard is this to clean compared to a bigger recycler?
    Because it's smaller and has fewer complex chambers than some giant recyclers, it's actually easier to keep clean. Regular rinses and occasional iso soaks will keep the glass looking sharp. If you're already using parchment paper or liners to handle sticky concentrates, you'll end up with less mess in the banger in the first place.
  • Does the floating recycler really make the hit smoother?
    Yes — the recycler action moves water and vapor in a loop, giving the vapor more contact time with water before it reaches you. That extra cooling can take the edge off hotter dabs and make the hit feel softer while still staying flavorful.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    The 6" height and compact body make it much easier to pack or stash than a tall tube. Just make sure you travel dry, wrap it or store it safely, and keep your concentrates in sealed storage containers so nothing leaks or smells up your bag.
  • What else do I need to get started with this piece?
    The rig and a 10mm quartz banger are included, so you're most of the way there. You may want a carb cap that fits your banger, a reliable torch, and a small smoke shop accessory like a tray or mat to keep your area tidy. After that, it's just concentrates and your preferred tools.

The 10" Color Accent Barrel Body Incycler is a glass dab rig built for concentrate fans who want ultra-smooth, splash-free function without lugging around a giant piece. At 10 inches (254mm) tall with a 14mm male, 90° joint, it hits that sweet spot between tabletop stability and easy handling. The barrel body design, internal recycling, and color-accented showerhead perc are all about clean flavor, controlled chug, and looking good while you’re at it.

What You Get

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The showerhead perc and incycler water path diffuse and recycle the vapor for mellow, flavorful pulls.
  • Way less splashback — Internal circulation keeps the water moving inside the rig instead of in your mouth.
  • Stable on the table — The solid, wide foot keeps the rig planted so you’re not babying it every time you grab your carb cap.
  • Ready to sesh out of the box — Comes with a 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt for glass just to get started.
  • Plays nice with your kit — Standard 14mm male joint works with most of the bangers and accessories you probably already own.
  • Compact but not cramped — At 10 inches (254mm), there’s enough room for proper diffusion without feeling like you’re hitting a tiny travel rig.
  • Eye-catching color work — Color accents on the barrel and perc give it that "nice piece" vibe when it’s sitting on the coffee table.

Best For

This incycler is made for dabbers who run regular at-home seshes and want a true daily driver: reliable function, easy water levels, and no drama. If you’re into terp flavor and smoother, medium-temp rips over giant, hot-lung blasts, this rig fits that style. It also pairs well with people who already keep their workspace dialed in with a solid dab mat under everything.

How it Hits (and Why it Feels So Smooth)

The barrel body incycler is all about controlled water movement. When you pull, the showerhead perc at the bottom breaks your vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, spreading the heat out so the hit cools down before it reaches your mouth. At the same time, the incycler’s internal pathways pull water up and cycle it back down, keeping it moving in a loop instead of just sloshing in the base.

That recycling effect means less harshness and better flavor, especially if you like longer pulls. It also helps the rig resist splashback since the water has a designated path to travel rather than rocketing straight up the neck. The 90° 14mm joint lines up cleanly with the included banger, so your concentrates vaporize right over the perc without awkward angles or weird drips.

How to Use It

Fill the rig from the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is fully covered and you get a comfortable chug when you pull through. You don’t need to overfill it — the incycler will keep that water circulating as you hit it. Set it down on a flat spot or on a non-slip accessory like a tray or pad so you’ve got room for your tools and carb cap.

Load your concentrate into the included banger with a dab tool, cap it, and pull steadily through the mouthpiece to let the showerhead perc and incycler do their thing. You’ll feel the barrel body fill, the water climb, and then roll back down into the base as you clear it. Once you’re done, let everything cool before you move or clean it so you’re not handling hot glass.

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you clean anything. For everyday upkeep, empty the water and rinse with warm water after your sesh. When things start to look cloudy, give the piece a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before using again. Do the same with the banger to keep your flavor on point.

Fit & Compatibility Notes

The 14mm male, 90° joint means this rig will work with most standard 14mm female bangers and accessories on the market. If you ever want to swap the included banger for something thicker or more specialized, you won’t have trouble finding options. If you like to keep multiple strains ready to go, stash them in dedicated concentrate jars so you’re not scooping out of parchment on the fly.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?

    It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm 90° banger, so you’re covered on the glass side. You’ll still want a carb cap and dab tool to use it comfortably; you can find plenty of options in our dab tools lineup.

  • Will this work with my existing 14mm accessories?

    Yes. The rig has a 14mm male joint, so any 14mm female banger, dropdown, or reclaim attachment should fit as long as it’s also set up for a 90° joint. Just match 14mm to 14mm and you’re good.

  • How much water should I put in an incycler like this?

    Use just enough to cover the showerhead perc and give you a smooth, consistent chug when you pull through. If you hear it struggling or getting too airy, add a little more; if you’re getting splash, pour a bit out. Once you dial it in, you’ll know your sweet spot.

  • Is a 10" rig good for daily use, or is it more of a travel piece?

    At 10 inches, this is very much a daily driver size — it’s big enough for solid function but not so tall that it dominates your whole table. If you want a true throw-in-the-bag option, you might pair this with something smaller from our silicone pipes collection for on-the-go.

  • What’s the benefit of an incycler over a regular straight tube rig?

    Incyclers recycle water internally as you pull, which helps keep hits smoother and reduces splashback. A straight tube can still hit hard, but an incycler like this is better if you care about flavor, smoother diffusion, and a more controlled pull.

  • How do I keep the banger from getting cloudy or chazzed?

    Let the banger cool a bit between uses, avoid overheating it, and clean it regularly with isopropyl alcohol once it’s cooled down. Keeping your concentrates stored cleanly in proper storage containers also helps cut down on mystery residue.

  • Can I use this with flower, or is it only for concentrates?

    This setup is designed as a dab rig, but if you grab a 14mm female bowl built for flower, it’ll function just fine for that too. Just remember it’s tuned for concentrates out of the box, thanks to the included banger and the style of diffusion.

Why You'll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Inline perc runs the vapor through multiple slits, increasing diffusion so each pull feels easier on the throat.
  • Flavor-forward function — The compact cube body and straight inline path keep the hit tight and tasty, so you get more terps and less harshness.
  • Comfortable angle — Bent neck and 90° joint keep the banger away from your face and make it easy to see what you're doing while you work.
  • Stays put on the table — Wide, heavy base helps prevent accidental tips when you're a few dabs in or someone bumps the coffee table.

This rig is made for dabbers who run regular seshes and want one solid piece that can hang with anything you throw at it. If you like clean function, inline diffusion, and a rig that looks good on the shelf without screaming for attention, this checks the boxes. If you're already building a full dab station with a dab pad or mat under everything, this cube rig fits right in as the centerpiece.

The Wormhole Cube Inline Rig works like a classic concentrate rig: water in the base, banger in the joint, and you're off. Keep the water level just over the inline perc so all the slits are covered—too low and you lose diffusion, too high and you're flirting with splashback.

The bent neck makes it easy to line up your face naturally with the mouthpiece while still keeping your eyes on the banger. The inline perc sits horizontally along the bottom, so as you pull, vapor is forced through multiple small slits, breaking it up into bubbles. That extra contact with the water cools things down and takes the edge off bigger dabs.

Between rips, you can park the rig on your station and keep your concentrates sealed up in proper concentrate jars so they're not drying out or collecting dust between seshes.

Cleaning is simple: let everything cool completely, dump the old water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry before using again.

  • How much water should I put in?

    Fill until the inline perc is fully submerged and the slits are covered when the rig is upright. Too much water and you risk splashback; too little and you won't get the smoothing effect from the perc.

The VIBES Ultra Thin Cones Box – 1.25" is a bulk box of pre-rolled cones made for smokers who care about flavor and consistency but don’t want to sit there hand-rolling every time. These ultra-thin papers are all about tasting your herb, not the paper, and the 1.25" size is dialed for personal joints and quick seshes. With 180 cones in one box, you’re basically set for a long stretch of hassle-free rolls.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Less paper, more flavor — Ultra-thin paper keeps the paper taste way in the background so your strain’s terps can do their thing.
  • Perfect for solo joints — 1.25" (31.75mm) size is ideal when you don’t want to roll a whole party joint but still want a proper smoke.
  • No rolling skills required — Pre-rolled and ready to pack so even your “I can’t roll” friend can get a clean, even cone.
  • Consistent every time — Same shape, same thickness, same airflow, so you’re not guessing if this one will canoe on you.
  • Bulk box = always stocked — 180 cones means you’re not running to the corner store mid-week because you burned through your last pack.
  • Cleaner burn — Designed for an even, slow burn so you’re not babysitting runs or fighting with constant relights.

Best for

These are made for people who already grind their flower properly and just want to skip the rolling lesson. If you’re the designated joint roller in your friend group and you’re tired of doing that job every single sesh, this box quietly becomes your new favorite coworker. They’re also clutch for anyone building out a stash of smoke shop essentials at home or in a lounge space.

How to use it

Take a cone from the box, hold it by the filter tip, and gently load it with evenly ground material. Light tamping with a packer or the flat end of a dab tool keeps airflow smooth without cramming it so tight it won’t pull. A quick final twist at the tip (if you like to close it off) and it’s ready to ride.

If you’re loading a few cones at once, keep them upright on a dab mat or work surface so you’re not chasing them as they roll off the table. Once they’re packed, store any extras somewhere cool and dry so the papers stay crisp, not soft.

For cleanup, it’s simple: when you’re done and the cone is completely out and cool, dispose of the tip. No extra parts to maintain, nothing to scrub, just swap in a fresh cone next time.

Specifications

Specification Details
Product type Pre-rolled cones (rolling papers)
Brand VIBES
Size 1.25 inches (31.75mm)
Quantity per box 180 pre-rolled cones

Fit & compatibility

These 1.25" cones play best with smaller personal-size fills and standard rolling accessories like packing tools and cone loaders. If you keep your flower in glass or smell-proof bags, they’ll stay ready-to-pack as long as you keep the box closed and away from moisture. Pair them with your favorite storage from our storage & packaging lineup to keep everything organized and fresh.

FAQ

  • How many cones do I actually get in this box?
    You get 180 total 1.25" cones in one box, which is a serious stash for daily smokers or anyone stocking up for parties, events, or the homie who never has papers.
  • Are these good for beginners who can’t roll?
    Yes. The whole point of pre-rolled cones is to remove rolling from the equation. If you can grind and pack, you can use these. They’re a nice upgrade from basic papers if you’re just getting into rolling and want a cleaner, more consistent experience than crumpled hand-rolls.
  • What kind of material works best in these?
    Any evenly ground, dry-but-not-dusty herb works well. Avoid big stems or chunky pieces that can poke through the paper or block airflow. If you’re also working with concentrates, you can keep those separate in proper concentrate jars and add them in carefully if that’s your style.
  • Do these burn slower than regular papers?
    They’re designed for an even, controlled burn, but your grind, pack, and how you hit it all play a role. Ultra-thin paper helps keep combustion smooth so you’re not burning a thick layer of paper along with your flower every time.
  • How should I store the box so the cones don’t get crushed?
    Keep the box closed, stored flat in a drawer, backpack, or cabinet where it won’t get sat on or tossed around. If you’ve got a bigger kit with grinders, trays, and other tools, you can tuck the box alongside your smoking accessories to build a clean, all-in-one station.
  • Are these 1.25" cones the same as king size?
    No. 1.25" cones are a smaller, more personal size compared to king size. They’re great when you want a quicker sesh or you’re not passing to a huge group. Think “personal joint” instead of “party log.”
  • How do I keep them from running or canoing?
    Use a consistent, medium grind and pack the cone evenly from tip to top without overstuffing one side. A gentle tamp every few pinches of flower helps. Keeping your rolling area tidy on a tray or pad (like you would with parchment and other prep gear) makes it easier to load them cleanly and avoid lopsided fills.

The VIBES Rice Cones Box – 1.25" is a bulk pack of ultra-thin rice pre-roll cones built for smokers who like long, chill burns without constantly re-rolling. Perfect for seshes where the joint does a few laps around the room, this box gives you 180 cones total so you’re stocked for a good while. The slow-burning rice paper and consistent airflow keep things even from spark to last pull.

Why You’ll Actually Like These

  • Stretch your seshes — Rice paper burns slower than standard wood pulp, so each cone lasts longer between passes.
  • Smoother, more consistent pulls — The cone shape and airflow design help your herbs burn evenly instead of canoeing halfway through.
  • Bulk box = less re-upping — 30 packs with 6 cones each (180 total) means you can prep party joints, personal cones, and still have backup.
  • Easy on the flavors — Thin rice paper adds minimal taste, so you’re mostly getting your flower’s terps, not paper.
  • Great for personal or shared use — 1.25" standard size hits the sweet spot between a quick solo cone and a small group joint.
  • No rolling skills required — Pre-rolled with built-in tips, so you just load, pack, twist, and you’re ready.

Best For

The VIBES Rice Cones 1.25" are made for people who:

  • Like slower-burning papers and don’t want to rush their smoke.
  • Host group seshes and hate stopping to roll every time someone new shows up.
  • Prefer consistent, pre-rolled cones over hand-rolling every joint.
  • Run through a lot of cones and want a box that actually lasts instead of a tiny booklet.

If you’re already dialing in your sesh space with a solid rig or bong, these cones are a nice switch-up for days when you don’t feel like glass and just want something simple that works. They also play well with a clean dab pad or mat if you like keeping your prep area organized and crumb-free.

How to Use These Cones

These are pre-rolled, so there’s no learning curve. You load them from the open end, gently pack your herbs down toward the filter, then close the tip so everything stays put in your pocket or tray. The rice paper handles the rest with a slow, even burn as long as your pack is consistent.

For smoother packing, a small tool, pen, or dedicated poker makes it easier to tap the material down without over-compressing it. Once filled, keeping your cones staged on a tray or nonstick surface helps avoid spills and wasted material; a lot of folks like pairing their cones with sturdy storage and packaging so pre-rolls stay protected until it’s sesh time.

Since rice paper is thin, treat the cones with a little care when loading so you don’t crumple the tip or sidewall. If you’re filling a bunch at once for events, stash the finished cones in a box or tube so they don’t get bent while you move around the room.

Specifications

Brand VIBES
Paper type Rice paper
Cone size 1.25" (standard 1¼ size)
Total quantity 180 cones
Packaging 30 individual packs ("coffins"), 6 cones per pack

Fit & Compatibility

The 1.25" VIBES Rice Cones are a standard small/medium cone size, so they work with most common cone loaders, filling devices, and pre-roll loaders that are built for 1¼ cones. If you already use other name-brand 1¼ cones, these should fit in the same gear without an issue.

They’re built for ground botanical material—just make sure your grind is even so the airflow stays smooth from start to finish. If you’re stocking up for a shop or brand, these pair nicely with glass stash options like heavy-bottom glass jars and packaging so your flower and cones both feel premium on the shelf.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the box closed and store it somewhere dry, cool, and out of direct sunlight so the rice paper doesn’t warp or get brittle. If you’ve pre-filled cones, stand them upright in a jar or tube so they don’t bend at the filter or crush at the tip.

For on-the-go, tossing a few packs into a smell-proof bag or case helps keep paper fresh and the cones from getting pocket-flattened. A good setup is flower in one of your airtight jars and cones in their coffins so everything stays clean and ready.

FAQ

  • Are these cones actually made from rice paper?
    Yes, these VIBES cones are made from rice paper, which is known for a slower burn and a lighter taste compared to standard wood pulp rolling papers.
  • How big is a 1.25" cone in real-world terms?
    1.25" (1¼) is a classic small-to-mid-size cone—big enough for a solid personal smoke or a light pass-around with one or two friends, without feeling oversized.
  • Will these work with my cone-filling device?
    If your loader or filling machine is designed for standard 1¼ size cones, these should fit and function the same as other 1.25" pre-rolls.
  • Do they come with filters already installed?
    Yes, each cone has a built-in tip, so you don’t need to roll or insert separate filters—just fill, pack, and close the end.
  • Do rice papers burn slower than regular papers?
    Rice papers like these are typically thinner and designed to burn slower and more evenly than many standard pulp papers, which is why they’re popular for longer, more relaxed seshes.
  • How should I store the box so the cones don’t go bad?
    Keep the coffins in the main box, flap closed, in a cool, dry place. Avoid humidity, heat, or pockets where they can get crushed; some people like to keep their box alongside their other smoke shop gear so everything’s ready in one spot.
  • Can I pre-pack a bunch of cones ahead of time?
    Absolutely. Just don’t pack them so tight that airflow is restricted, and store them upright in a jar or container so the tips don’t flatten. If you’re doing bulk prep, consider pairing them with dedicated joint tubes to protect individual pre-rolls on the go.

The 14" Highway Color Accent Twin Turbo Straight is a tall, heavy-hitting glass bong built for flower lovers who want super-smooth pulls without giving up punch. It stacks two inline percs in a straight-tube body, so your hits get serious diffusion before they touch your lungs. With color accents on the lip, base, joint, and matching 14mm flower bowl, it’s a statement piece that actually rips, not just something pretty on the shelf.

Why it works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Dual inline percolators break your pull into tons of tiny bubbles, taking the edge off harsh smoke.
  • Extra chill factor — Built-in ice pinch lets you stack cubes down the neck for frosty rips on demand.
  • Stays upright, even on cluttered tables — Straight-tube design with a solid base keeps the piece stable when the sesh gets busy.
  • Less stress on your glass — Bridged joint adds reinforcement so you’re not babying the connection every time you set it down.
  • Cohesive look out of the box — Matching 14mm color-accented bowl ties the whole setup together, no mismatched hardware.
  • Showpiece energy — Color pops on the lip, foot, and joint give it that “what piece is that?” presence on your coffee table.

Best for

This bong is made for flower fans who want legit diffusion and cooling in a clean straight-tube profile, not a giant science project of percs. It’s a great pick if you’re running regular evening seshes, sharing with friends, or upgrading from a basic beaker and finally want something that hits smoother without getting overly complicated. If you already have a favorite spoon or smaller daily piece, this works perfectly as your “let’s really taste the strain” home base alongside your other smoke shop gear.

How to use it

Start by adding water through the mouthpiece or joint until both inline percs are just covered — enough to fire, but not so much that you’re drinking it. Then load the matching 14mm flower bowl with your favorite strain and you’re ready to go.

For colder pulls, drop a few ice cubes into the neck so they catch at the ice pinch; that extra cooling layer is clutch when you’re snapping bigger bowls. Setting it on a non-slip surface like a dab mat is an easy way to keep the base from sliding around when you’re passing it back and forth.

After your sesh, let the glass cool, dump the water, and rinse out the chamber. For deeper cleans, soak the bong and bowl in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let everything dry before the next round.

Specifications

Height 14 inches (355.6mm)
Joint Size 14mm female
Material Borosilicate glass
Percolation Double inline percolators
Mouthpiece Style Straight tube with color-accented lip
Special Features Ice pinch, bridged joint, color accents, matching 14mm flower bowl

Fit & compatibility

The Twin Turbo Straight uses a standard 14mm female joint, so it plays nicely with most 14mm male bowls, ash catchers, and adapters you already own. If you’re the type who likes to swap bowls or add a little pre-cooler, you’ll have tons of options to experiment with. For storage between rips, you can keep your flower sealed up in proper jars from our glass jars & packaging collection so every bowl tastes as clean as the first.

What you get

  • 1 × 14" Highway Color Accent Twin Turbo Straight glass bong
  • 1 × Matching 14mm color-accented flower bowl

FAQ

  • Does this bong really hit that much smoother than a basic straight tube?

    Yes. The double inline percs give you way more diffusion than a simple downstem setup. Each pull gets broken into smaller bubbles twice before it reaches your mouth, which helps cool things down and makes bigger rips feel less harsh. If you’re upgrading from a plain beaker or straight tube, you’ll notice the difference fast.

  • Will this fit my other 14mm accessories?

    It uses a standard 14mm female joint, so most 14mm male bowls, dropdowns, and ash catchers will fit right in. Just match the joint size and you’re good. If you’re building out a full dab setup too, this pairs well with silicone and glass pieces from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup so you’ve got options for both flower and concentrates.

  • Is it hard to clean with the double inline percs?

    It’s actually pretty straightforward. Rinse out the bong after use, then when it needs a reset, fill with isopropyl alcohol, let it soak, and rinse with warm water. The straight-tube design makes it easier to drain and dry than some multi-chamber pieces with tight corners.

  • Is 14 inches too big for a daily driver?

    For most people, 14 inches (355.6mm) is that sweet spot: tall enough for real cooling and ice, but not so huge that it feels like a special-occasion piece only. If you like solid, flavorful hits at home and don’t mind a little extra diffusion, this is a strong daily driver candidate. For on-the-go or travel, you might want a smaller hand pipe or something from our silicone pipes which are lighter and more portable.

  • Can I use this with concentrates?

    You can, as long as you swap the flower bowl for a 14mm male banger or similar attachment. Just keep in mind this piece is built with flower in mind, so it’s not as compact as a dedicated dab rig. If you’re mostly into dabs, check out rigs, bangers, and dab tools designed specifically for concentrates.

  • How fragile is the joint and base?

    The bridged joint adds extra glass support where joints usually take the most abuse, which helps cut down on accidental snaps when you’re changing bowls or bumping the table. The base is wide and flat for stability, but it’s still glass — treat it with the usual care, and maybe don’t pass it over concrete floors if you’re three bowls deep.

  • What do I need besides the bong to get started?

    Out of the box you’ll have the bong and matching 14mm bowl. All you really need on top of that is your flower, a lighter, and a safe place to set it down. If you like to stay organized, you can stash your herb, tools, and extras together using smell-resistant options from our storage & packaging collection so everything for your sesh lives in one place.

column2: 9.5″ BLACK SHEEP CLEAR DOUBLE RATCHET RIG
column3:
The 9.5″ Black Sheep Clear Double Ratchet Rig is a mid-size glass dab rig built for flavor chasers who still want solid diffusion. The double ratchet perc stacks bubbles for cool, smooth pulls, while the bent neck keeps splashback out of your mouth. With a 14mm 90° joint and included banger, it’s genuinely ready to hit as soon as you unbox it.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Double ratchet perc breaks your vapor into tons of tiny bubbles for better cooling and less throat bite.
  • Watch every ripple — Fully clear glass lets you see the percs working and spot when it’s time for a quick clean.
  • Stable on the table — Footed can base keeps the rig planted, so one clumsy elbow doesn’t end the sesh.
  • Comfortable angle — Bent neck keeps the heat away from your face and helps stop accidental splashback.
  • Dialed for dabs — 14mm 90° joint with included banger means you don’t have to hunt for extra parts before you can use it.
  • Great daily driver size — At 9.5 inches (241mm), it’s big enough for solid function without being a pain to stash or clean.

Best For

This Black Sheep rig is made for dabbers who are past their first cheap setup and want something that actually rips clean but still feels simple and reliable. It’s a strong pick for anyone running a couple of dabs a day and wanting a go-to piece that looks clean on the shelf without being fragile or overly complicated. If you’ve already got a basic rig and you’re ready to upgrade your function without jumping into huge recyclers, this hits the sweet spot.

How to use it

Start by adding just enough water to the can so both ratchet percs are properly engaged when you pull; you want active bubbling but not water climbing toward the neck. Set it on a solid surface — dropping it onto a cushy dab mat is a good move if you’re the “oops” type.

Drop your 14mm banger into the 90° joint, heat it up, and once it’s ready, use a dab tool to place your concentrate in the bucket and cap it. Pull through the bent neck and let the double ratchet do its thing, stacking bubbles and cooling everything down before it hits your lungs. When you’re done and the glass is cool, empty the water and give it a quick rinse so residue doesn’t build up.

For deeper cleans, let the rig cool, then soak the glass portions in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it preserves flavor so your terps aren’t fighting through old reclaim.

Type Glass dab rig
Height 9.5 inches (241mm)
Material Glass (clear)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90 degrees
Perc Style Double ratchet perc
Neck Bent neck
Included 14mm banger (male), ready to dab out of the box

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm 90° female joint plays nice with most standard 14mm male bangers, terp slurpers, and similar quartz upgrades. If you like to swap between different nails, you’ll have an easy time building a little lineup that all fits this rig. Keep your extra nails and small accessories together with other essentials from our smoke shop accessories so you’re not digging through drawers mid-sesh.

What You Get

  • 1 × 9.5″ Black Sheep Clear Double Ratchet Rig (glass)
  • 1 × 14mm 90° banger (male)

FAQ

  • Will this fit my other bangers?
    Yes. Any 14mm male banger with a 90° neck should drop right into this rig. That includes most standard quartz bangers, terp slurpers, and specialty nails sold as 14mm male. If you’re building out a full dab station, it pairs well with tools from our dedicated dab tools collection.
  • Is this more for flavor or huge clouds?
    It leans slightly toward flavor with the double ratchet perc giving you a lot of cooling and diffusion without turning the piece into a chuggy monster. You can still push big rips through it, but the design really shines when you’re trying to taste your concentrates instead of just getting blasted.
  • How much water should I use?
    Use enough to submerge and activate the ratchet percs, but not so much that water splashes up into the neck when you pull. Start low, test your pull, and add a bit at a time until you find your sweet spot. If you like to swap strains and keep things tasting fresh, storing your extracts in proper concentrate jars will help your flavor match the rig’s smooth function.
  • Is it hard to clean the double ratchet perc?
    Not really. Because it’s clear glass and not insanely tall, a simple isopropyl alcohol soak and warm water rinse usually does the trick. Let the rig cool before cleaning, and don’t forget to change your water regularly so buildup doesn’t get ahead of you. If you’re already keeping your flower gear organized with proper glass jars and packaging, treating your rig the same way will keep your setup looking sharp.
  • Can I use this for flower too?
    Technically, yes — if you add a 14mm bowl piece, it will work. But it’s really tuned for dabs in terms of volume and perc style, so that’s where it shines. If you want a flower-only setup, you might be happier grabbing a dedicated piece from our broader smoke shop products lineup.
  • Is the Black Sheep logo durable?
    The rig uses a clean silver/black decal logo that pops against the clear glass. As long as you’re not scraping at it with abrasive tools or harsh cleaners, it should hold up well through regular use and normal cleaning.
  • Is this rig better as a daily driver or a special-occasion piece?
    It’s built to be a daily driver — stable base, simple design, solid diffusion, and easy cleaning. But it also looks nice enough that it doesn’t feel boring on the table, especially when it’s sitting clean on your favorite mat with the percs ready to stack bubbles for the next dab.

The 14” Fume Straight is a classic straight-tube glass bong made in the USA for flower lovers who just want clean, powerful rips without any gimmicks. At 14 inches (356mm) tall with a 14mm bowl, it hits that sweet spot between “big enough to rip” and “still easy to handle,” and the built-in ice pinch gives you naturally cooler, smoother pulls. If you’re into simple, sturdy glass that feels like a real daily driver, this is that piece.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Cooler, smoother pulls — The ice pinch lets you stack a layer of cubes in the neck so your smoke has to travel through cold air before it hits your lungs.
  • No-fuss function — Straight-tube design means fast, direct airflow with no weird drag or complicated percs to clog.
  • Built to last — Thick fume glass and a solid base give it that “set it down anywhere” confidence for daily use.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a 14mm flower bowl so you’re not hunting for spare parts before your first sesh.
  • Made in the USA — You’re supporting American glassblowers and getting the kind of craftsmanship that feels right in your hands.
  • Looks better over time — Fume glass develops character as it breaks in, so the more you use it, the more unique the piece becomes.

Best For

This bong is made for people who want a reliable home base piece they can hit all day, not something fragile or overcomplicated. If you’re the friend everyone comes to for a big, clear rip on movie night, this straight tube has the punch and volume to keep up. It also pairs nicely with a nonstick dab mat under it if you’re trying to keep your table or desk from getting wet or sticky between water changes.

How to Use It (The Simple Version)

Think of the 14” Fume Straight as your “fill it and chill” piece. Add enough water to cover the bottom of the downstem so you get good percolation without splash-back. Pack your bowl, drop a few ice cubes past the ice pinch if you want extra-cool hits, and you’re set for a mellow, no-drama sesh.

The straight-tube profile means your draw is direct: smoke travels from bowl to base to neck with minimal resistance, so you get fast, milky clears without feeling like you’re fighting the piece. If you like to move around your space while you sesh, parking it on a sturdy tray with some smoking accessories nearby keeps everything in one easy-to-grab spot.

Cleaning stays straightforward too. Let everything cool, empty the water, then rinse. For heavier build-up, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry will keep it looking and tasting fresh.

Specifications

Height 14 inches (356mm)
Joint Size 14mm (female)
Material Glass (fume)
Style Straight tube bong
Country of Origin Made in USA

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm joint size plays nice with most standard 14mm bowls, ash catchers, and basic attachments, so you can swap in a different slide or add-on down the line without hunting for weird sizes. If you like to keep your flower and concentrates dialed in, storing them in dedicated concentrate jars or glass containers makes it easier to reload the bowl without drying things out.

Since it’s a straight tube with a single joint, you don’t have to worry about complex perc stacks or special fittings. Just stick with 14mm-compatible glass and you’re good to go.

FAQ

  • Does this bong come with everything I need to start?
    Yes. The 14” Fume Straight includes a 14mm flower bowl, so as long as you’ve got water and herb, you’re ready to go. If you like to keep things organized, tossing your lighter, grinder, and bowl on a nearby smoke shop tray or accessory keeps your sesh area tidy.
  • Is 14 inches too big if I’m newer to bongs?
    Not at all. 14 inches (356mm) is a really comfortable size for most people — big enough to stack a nice hit, but not so huge that it feels awkward to clear. If you’re stepping up from smaller pieces, this is a very natural upgrade.
  • Will this fit my existing 14mm accessories?
    If your pieces are 14mm male (bowls, ash catchers, etc.), they should fit this bong’s 14mm female joint. Just match 14mm to 14mm and you’re set. For travel or backup bowls, some people like to keep extras in their general storage and packaging setup so they’re not scrambling when one goes missing.
  • How do I keep the glass looking good over time?
    Change your water regularly and give it a quick rinse after heavy use to cut down on stain and smell. When it needs more love, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before using again. The fume will keep developing character as you use it, which is part of the charm.
  • Is this piece okay to travel with?
    It’s best treated as a home-base bong because of the 14-inch height. You can move it between rooms or take it to a friend’s place with some padding, but for true on-the-go use, most people lean toward smaller glass or unbreakable silicone bongs and rigs.
  • What’s the advantage of a straight tube over a beaker?
    Straight tubes usually clear a little faster and feel more direct, which a lot of people love for snappy, to-the-point hits. Beakers can have more volume and stability, but if you like quick clears and simple function, a straight tube like this one is tough to beat.

How to Use It

The basics are straightforward: add enough water so the showerhead perc is comfortably submerged, but not so much that you’re catching splashback in the neck. For deeper maintenance, plug the openings, add isopropyl alcohol and a bit of coarse salt if you like, shake gently, soak if needed, then rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before the next use. Change it at least daily if you’re using it regularly, and more often if you’re running a lot of bowls through it in one night. Fresh water keeps flavor better and helps the perc function properly instead of fighting through murky, stale water. A clean piece and fresh water make your good flower or concentrates — and your favorite concentrate jars — feel worth the money.

Definitely. It’s tall enough to feel like an upgrade, has legit diffusion without being a nightmare to clean, and uses the super-common 14mm joint size. If your first bong was something small, acrylic, or cheap glass, this is a big step up in both function and feel.

It’s made from glass, so you still need to treat it like glass, but the straight design and sturdy base help a lot with stability. Avoid setting it on hard, uneven surfaces and try to keep it on something padded like a smoke shop mat or tray if you’re clumsy or have chaotic roommates.

Out of the box, you’re covered for flower with the included 14mm bowl. Beyond that, most people like to add a lighter, grinder, and maybe an ash catcher or banger if they want to cross over into dabs. Best For

How to Use It

The 9″ Color Lip/Foot Double Uptake Matrix Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who care about flavor, function, and looks in one piece. At 9 inches (229mm) tall with a 14mm, 90-degree joint, it’s an easy upgrade for anyone already running modern bangers. The double uptake recycler and matrix perc combo keeps your hits smooth, splash-free, and tasty while the colored lip and foot give it that “favorite rig” energy on the shelf.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The internal matrix perc breaks up vapor into tons of tiny bubbles so the water can actually cool things down before it hits your lungs.
  • Splash-free recycling — Double uptake arms constantly pull and return water, so the rig churns without sending water up the mouthpiece.
  • Flavor over drag — Matrix diffusion is balanced, giving you clean function without turning each hit into a lung workout.
  • Stable, low-tipping design — The footed base keeps this recycler planted, even when you’re passing it around or swapping hot glass.
  • Easy to pair — Standard 14mm, 90-degree joint plays nice with most modern bangers and dropdowns you already own.
  • Compact but capable — 9 inches (229mm) is tall enough for real diffusion, but still small enough for a desk, tray, or bedside sesh station.
  • Color that actually pops — The color lip and matching foot frame the clear glass so you can watch the recycler function while it still looks intentional on display.

Best For

This double uptake matrix recycler is made for dabbers who want more function than a basic straight tube but don’t want some giant, over-complicated science project. It shines as a daily driver for people who hit concentrates regularly and care about flavor, stability, and easy pairing with 14mm bangers. If you already have a solid dab mat and like to keep a clean, dialed-in sesh station, this rig slots in perfectly.

How to Use It

Set the rig on a flat surface and fill from the mouthpiece or joint until the matrix perc is just covered and the recycler arms have enough water to cycle without spitting. Too much water and you’ll get gurgle and drag; too little and the recycler won’t really “spin” during your pull.

Attach your favorite 14mm banger to the 90-degree joint and heat as you normally would. Once things have cooled to your preferred temp, load your dab and pull steadily — you’ll see the matrix perc fire first, then water and vapor will travel up through the double uptake arms and drain back down as you hit it. For flavor-heavy dabs, pair it with a good carb cap from our carb caps collection so you can control airflow and keep vapor moving through the matrix instead of just straight up the neck.

When you’re done, let the rig and banger cool before you move anything. For day-to-day upkeep, swap the water regularly and give the rig a quick rinse so reclaim doesn’t build up in the perc and recycler arms. If you like running multiple flavors, keeping a clean recycler like this helps you actually taste the difference instead of just “hot and harsh.” Stash your concentrates in proper concentrate jars between seshes to keep that terp profile fresh.

The Function Breakdown

The heart of this rig is the matrix perc: a cylindrical grid of slits/holes that takes incoming vapor and smashes it through tons of tiny openings. That turbulence is what creates those stacks of small bubbles you see, which means more surface contact with water and smoother pulls for you.

From there, the double uptake recycler takes over. As you pull, water is drawn up through twin arms, carrying vapor with it in a looping path before it returns back down into the main chamber. That constant motion keeps everything cooler, reduces hot spots, and helps trap any little splash so it doesn’t tag you in the mouth mid-hit. It’s a noticeable difference from a basic beaker or straight tube — especially when you’re a few dabs deep and just want everything to hit clean and predictable.

With its 14mm, 90-degree joint, this recycler is basically made for standard quartz bangers, dropdowns, and reclaim catchers. If you’re running smaller, low-temp dabs, a simple flat-top bucket and directional cap is perfect. For bigger hits, you can step up to thicker quartz or specialty inserts without throwing off the balance.

The stable footed base gives you a good landing zone for hot accessories, but if you’re the type to spread tools, pearls, and caps everywhere, a small tray or some extra accessories like tool stands and holders will help keep chaos to a minimum.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig cool completely before you do anything with it. Dump the old water, give it a warm rinse, and for deeper cleans, add isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, shake gently, then rinse with clean water and let it dry before reuse. Keeping the matrix perc and recycler arms clear makes a big difference in both function and flavor.

If you’re in heavy rotation and cleaning often, pairing this rig with durable, easy-wash pieces like our silicone bongs & rigs as backups can help you rotate gear instead of rushing a deep clean right before a sesh.

FAQ

  • Q: Will this rig fit my current banger?

    Most likely, yes. This piece has a 14mm, 90-degree joint, which is the standard for most modern dab bangers. As long as your banger is 14mm male and meant for a 90-degree joint, it should drop right in and line up cleanly.
  • Q: Is 9 inches big enough for smooth dabs?

    Absolutely. The height plus the matrix perc and recycler action gives you plenty of cooling without making the piece bulky. You get the function of a larger rig in a tighter, more manageable package that’s easy to handle and store with your other smoke shop products.
  • Q: How much water should I put in the recycler?

    Fill until the matrix perc is covered and you see water cycling through the double uptake arms when you pull, but not so high that it runs up into the neck. You can fine-tune by adding or removing a little water until it feels right for your pull strength.
  • Q: What’s the advantage of a double uptake recycler vs a regular rig?

    The double uptake keeps water and vapor moving in a loop instead of just bubbling in place. That extra circulation helps with cooling, reduces splash, and can make hits feel smoother and more consistent across back-to-back dabs compared to a simple perc-only piece.
  • Q: How do I clean the matrix perc and recycler arms?

    Empty the rig, add isopropyl alcohol (and a bit of coarse salt if you like), plug the openings, and gently shake so the solution can move through the perc and arms. Rinse well with warm water afterward and let it dry completely before using it again.
  • Q: What accessories do you recommend with this rig?

    A good 14mm quartz banger, a carb cap, and a reliable dab tool are the basics. If you’re handling a lot of different strains or textures, keeping everything organized in proper storage & packaging helps keep your rig clean and your flavors separate.
  • Q: Can I use this with flower or is it only for dabs?

    It’s designed as a dab rig, but if you grab a compatible 14mm bowl, you can technically run flower through it. Just know that heavy flower use will gunk up the perc faster and can mute flavor for concentrates, so most people keep a recycler like this dedicated to oils and use another piece or even silicone pipes for dry herb.

The 8" Color Klein Recycler is a compact glass dab rig built for flavor chasers who want ultra-smooth function in a small footprint. At 8 inches (203mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint, it’s that sweet spot size where you get serious recycling without a giant table-hogging piece. The included 14mm male banger and dual recycling chambers are all about cooler vapor, less splash, and more terps.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Dual recycling paths keep water moving so vapor has more time to cool before it hits your lungs.
  • Flavor stays front and center — Continuous circulation helps keep the hit fresh instead of tasting stale or harsh.
  • Less splashback, more control — Klein-style routing keeps water away from the mouthpiece, even when you pull hard.
  • Perfect daily-driver size — At 8 inches (203mm), it’s big enough for real function but small enough to stash or travel with.
  • Ready to sesh out of the box — Comes with a 14mm male 90-degree banger that matches the rig’s joint angle and size.
  • Color that actually pops — Multiple color options so your recycler looks as good as it rips.

Best For

This 8" Color Klein Recycler is made for dabbers who hit concentrates regularly and want a noticeable jump in smoothness from a basic straight-tube or mini rig. If you like running small to medium dabs and care more about flavor and function than just having the biggest piece, this checks the box. It also pairs nicely with a clean dab pad or mat if you’re trying to keep your sesh station neat and protected.

How to Use It

Fill the recycler just enough to cover the perc at the bottom; the recycling design will pull and drain water through the upper chamber as you draw. You don’t need to overfill—too much water can choke airflow and bump up the chance of splashback.

Drop the included 14mm male banger into the 90-degree joint, heat it with your preferred torch, and let it come down to your ideal temp before introducing your concentrate. As you pull, watch the water cycle between the lower and upper chambers—that circulating motion is what cools the vapor and keeps things smooth when you’re a few dabs deep.

Between hits, set the rig down on a stable surface or a nonstick rig accessory setup to avoid accidental tips and keep your table from catching stray reclaim or water.

The Basics of Klein Recycling

A Klein recycler is a specific recycler style where the drain and uptake paths are looped in a way that keeps water constantly moving and separated from the main airflow. On this piece, vapor and water enter the main chamber together, but gravity and design take over, sending water back down while vapor keeps heading up the neck.

That constant circulation means less stagnant water, better cooling, and more consistent hits from the first pull to the last of the sesh. It’s especially noticeable if you’re coming from a simple single-perc rig where you might be used to harsher pulls at higher temps.

Specifications

Product Type Dab rig / oil rig
Height 8 inches (203mm)
Material Glass
Joint Angle 90 degrees
Joint Size 14mm (accepts 14mm male banger)
Included Banger 14mm male, 90-degree
Style Color Klein recycler, dual recycling chambers

Fit & Compatibility

This rig has a 14mm female joint set at 90 degrees, so it plays best with 14mm male 90° bangers and accessories. If you already have a stack of 45-degree bangers from a beaker bong, those won’t sit right here—stick to 90° hardware for proper function and less mess.

It’s dialed for concentrates, but if you ever want to swap for a flower bowl, just make sure it’s a 14mm male piece so it seats correctly. For storing what you’re running through it, consider keeping your extracts in sturdy glass concentrate jars to protect terps between seshes.

Care & Cleaning

Routine cleaning keeps a recycler hitting like new. Let everything cool completely, then empty the water and rinse with warm water to knock out loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak or shake with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry before you use it again.

To avoid buildup, try not to let old water sit in the rig for days—fresh water means fresher-tasting dabs. If you’re running a lot of rosin or live resin, doing a quick rinse at the end of the night goes a long way.

  • 1 × 8" Color Klein Recycler glass dab rig
  • 1 × 14mm male 90-degree glass banger

FAQ

Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm male 90-degree banger, so you’ve got the core setup covered. You’ll still want a torch, some concentrates, and ideally a decent dab tool to make loading cleaner and easier. If you don’t have one yet, check out dedicated dab tools for a proper setup.

How much water should I put in the recycler?
Fill just enough to cover the perc or the bottom of the internal downstem. When you pull, you should see water travel up and recycle back down smoothly without hitting your mouth. If you’re getting splashback, you likely have a bit too much water in there.

Will this fit my other bangers and accessories?
As long as your bangers are 14mm male and designed for a 90-degree joint, you’re good. Anything 10mm, 18mm, or 45-degree will either not fit or won’t function properly. If you want a separate flower setup so you’re not swapping hardware constantly, you might grab a simple piece from our general smoke shop products and keep this one locked in as your dedicated dab rig.

With a finely-cut honeycomb perc and a 14mm female joint, it balances size, filtration, and portability so it can be your home base rig or your trusty travel piece.

Why It Hits So Well

  • Smoother pulls, less harshness — The honeycomb percolator breaks vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, increasing surface area and cooling each hit before it reaches your lungs.
  • Flavor stays front and center — Efficient diffusion without feeling over-chuggy means you taste your terps instead of just hot air.
  • Comfortable daily driver size — At 10 inches (254mm), it’s tall enough for good function but compact enough for desks, coffee tables, and travel bags.
