  • Plays nice with standard gear — 14mm female joint means it works with most 14mm male bangers, nails, and dropdowns you already own.
  • Built from borosilicate glass — Heat-resistant and less fragile than soft glass, so it can actually survive life as a real daily driver.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who are past the novelty stage and just want something that rips right every time. If you’re running a few seshes a day, care about flavor, and want a piece that can live on your coffee table without looking like basic glass, this hits the sweet spot. It’s also a great upgrade if you’re coming from a tiny travel rig and want stronger function without going full oversized tower.

How to Use It

Set the Sandblast Honeycomb Rig on a stable surface and add water through the mouthpiece until the honeycomb perc is just covered. You want the slits or holes submerged, but not so full that water splashes up into the neck when you pull. A quick test pull (no heat, no banger) will tell you if the chug feels right.

Attach your favorite 14mm male banger or nail and you’re good to go. Many dabbers like to park this on a dab mat so any stray drips and tools land on something easy to clean instead of the table.

Between dabs, let the rig cool down a bit before moving it, especially if you’re the type to swap bangers or pass it around. For longer seshes, keep your extracts close in proper storage — using good concentrate jars helps keep your flavor on point and your station organized.

If you’re already running a drawer full of 14mm accessories, this will slide right into your setup. For heavy-handed dabbers or those who travel a lot, you might also want to add a simple dropdown or reclaim catcher from your favorite dab tools and accessories lineup to keep the joint cleaner and protect against heat stress.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig cool before you touch the banger or pour anything out. Empty any old water, then rinse with warm water after use to keep buildup from getting ahead of you. For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry will bring the glass and honeycomb perc back to clear. Try not to let reclaim sit too long in the perc — the more often you give it a quick rinse, the easier it is to keep it looking fresh.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my current banger?
    If your banger is 14mm male, it will fit this rig. The Sandblast Honeycomb Rig has a 14mm female joint, which is the standard size for a ton of quartz bangers and nails on the market.
  • Is this better for flavor or big clouds?
    The honeycomb perc gives you a really nice balance. It cools and diffuses your hit enough to stay smooth, but doesn’t feel like you’re pulling through a huge, draggy water pipe. If you like a flavorful, medium-density hit, this is right in that lane. For ultra-terp chasing, pair it with a good carb cap from our carb cap selection to really dial airflow.
  • Can I use this for flower too?
    You technically can if you use a 14mm male herb bowl, but this piece is really designed as a dab rig. The honeycomb perc and size are tuned for concentrate vapor. If you primarily smoke flower, check out broader options in our smoke shop products where you’ll find pipes and dedicated flower bongs.
  • How often should I change the water?
    Ideally, swap the water daily if you’re dabbing regularly. Fresh water keeps flavor crisp and makes it easier to rinse out light residue before it turns into stubborn reclaim. A quick dump-and-rinse routine goes a long way.
  • Is the sandblasted design just for looks?
    It definitely adds style, but it’s also practical. The frosted honeycomb sections give you a bit more grip, which is clutch when your hands are a little sticky or you’re passing it across a crowded coffee table. If you like durable, easy-grip gear, you might also vibe with some of our flexible pieces in silicone bongs & rigs.
  • How do I clean the honeycomb perc if it clogs?
    If you notice the holes starting to gunk up, empty the rig, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, and plug the openings with your hands or stoppers. Gently shake to loosen buildup, then rinse thoroughly with warm water until it runs clear. Let it dry completely before your next sesh.
  • Is this a good choice for travel?
    At 10 inches (254mm), it’s compact enough for a backpack or padded case and light enough to bring to a friend’s place without stress. Just make sure it’s fully cool and empty before packing it, and consider keeping it in a soft case or wrapping it in something cushy along with any accessories you’re bringing so nothing knocks around.

Fill the rig with just enough water to cover the showerhead perc and lightly touch the recycler pathways. You want the pillars to cycle water without splashing your mouth — a quick test pull without heating anything will tell you if the level is right.

Recyclers like this one are all about movement. As you pull, water rushes through the showerhead perc, then gets lifted up through the quad pillars and drains back down into the base in a loop. That loop gives your vapor extra contact time with water without adding a ton of drag or volume.

The result is a hit that feels lighter and cooler, but still delivers all the potency and terps from your concentrate. Pair it with quality extracts stored in proper concentrate jars and you'll really notice the flavor this rig can deliver.

The VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is a bulk box of wide rolling tips built for people who roll all the time and hate running out of filter material. These are for daily rollers and crew seshes where consistency matters more than improvising with torn-up business cards. With 50 booklets in the box and a sturdy kraft feel, you get clean, stable rolls for the long haul.

Each sheet is cut wide to give your joints more support and smoother airflow, so the end stays open and your herbs stay out of your mouth. If you like your rolls to look and hit the same every time, this box turns “Do I have tips?” into a non-issue for months.

Why It Works

  • Smoother pulls every time — Wide tips keep the end of your roll open and shaped, so airflow stays consistent all the way down.
  • No more herb in your teeth — The tip acts as a barrier, keeping loose bits of flower from making it to your mouth.
  • — The extra width gives more structure at the base, which helps your joint pack evenly and burn more predictably.
  • Bulk box for real smokers — 50 booklets in one box means you’re stocked for parties, road trips, and those “one more?” nights.
  • Easy to fold and shape — The kraft sheets are firm enough to hold form but still flexible enough for W’s, spirals, or whatever style you like.
  • Less waste, more function — Purpose-made tips beat tearing cardboard, so your rolls look cleaner and feel better in hand.

Best For

The VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is made for people who roll multiple times a day and want their joints to feel like they came from someone who knows what they’re doing. It’s also clutch for anyone keeping a stash spot or travel kit dialed in alongside other everyday smoke shop essentials.

If you’re the one rolling for the group, this box keeps you prepared without needing to grab another pack every week. Toss a booklet in your bag, leave a few at home, and keep the rest in your main setup for backup.

How to Use It

Pop open a booklet, tear off a single sheet, and fold it into the tip style you like—simple accordion folds, a tight spiral, or a combo of both. Then you drop that tip at the end of your paper before you start forming your roll, so it becomes the base everything packs around.

Building off a good tip makes the rest of the roll a lot easier, especially when you’re working over a dab mat or tray and don’t want crumbs everywhere. Because the tips are wide, you get more control over how open or tight the mouthpiece feels.

After you’re done, you’ll notice the tip keeps your joint from collapsing at the end and gives you something solid to hold, which is especially nice during longer seshes when things usually get soft and messy.

Fit & Compatibility

These wide tips are designed to play nice with most standard rolling papers and wraps, from shorter personal rolls to longer, party-sized creations. If you keep a rotation of papers around, they’ll sit right next to your favorite storage and packaging gear without needing any special sizes.

The wider format gives you some flexibility—roll them tight for smaller papers or leave them a bit looser and open if you like bigger rolls. Either way, they’re meant to work with what you already smoke.

Care & Storage

Since these are kraft paper tips, there’s no real “cleaning” needed—just keep the box dry and away from spills. Store it somewhere cool and out of direct sunlight, the same way you’d treat your glass jars and packaging so everything stays crisp and ready to roll.

FAQ

  • Are these tips pre-rolled or flat sheets?
    They’re flat sheets in booklet form. You tear off a sheet and fold or roll it into the tip shape you like, which gives you more control over how open or tight the mouthpiece feels.
  • Will these work with king size or just standard papers?
    These wide tips work with both standard and king size papers. For bigger rolls, just leave the tip a bit more open; for smaller papers, roll the tip tighter. They’re a good all-around choice if you switch paper sizes often.
  • Do they change the flavor of my herb?
    No, the kraft tips are just there for structure and airflow. They’re neutral, so your flavor comes from your flower and papers, not the filter. If you’re picky about taste, pair them with clean-burning papers and stash your herbs in proper glass jars to keep terps happy.
  • How many rolls can I realistically get from one box?
    You get 250 individual tip sheets. So, if you use one tip per joint, that’s 250 rolls. If you’re rolling multiple times a day or passing a lot with friends, this box still lasts way longer than single packs.
  • Can I use these with cones or just hand-rolled joints?
    They’re mainly meant for hand-rolled joints, but you can shape them and slide them into empty cones if you like a more solid mouthpiece. Just fold and roll them to a tighter size that fits the cone opening.
  • Are these better than tearing cardboard from a pack?
    Functionally, yes. These are cut to a consistent width and thickness, so your tips feel the same every time and don’t get soggy or collapse as easily. Plus, they look cleaner when you’re rolling on a proper surface like one of our rolling accessories.
  • What’s the difference between wide tips and regular tips?
    Wide tips give you more material to work with, which means more support at the end of your roll and a bigger range of sizes you can shape. Regular tips are narrower and can feel a bit flimsy on larger rolls, while wide tips hold up better on both small personals and longer party joints.

If you’re tired of scavenging for scraps to use as filters and want your rolls to feel dialed in every single time, the VIBES Wide Tips Box – Kraft is a simple upgrade that makes a big difference in day-to-day rolling. Keep a box on hand along with your favorite smoke shop deals, and you’re set for a lot of very easy, very consistent seshes.

The 7.5" Oregon Made Glass Hammer Bubbler is a USA-made glass hand pipe for people who want that classic hammer feel with the smoothness of water filtration. At 7.5 inches (190.5mm), it’s big enough to cool things down but still easy to pass around or park on a coffee table. This is the kind of piece you buy once and keep for years because it hits clean, feels solid in the hand, and actually looks good sitting out.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The bubbler chamber gives you water filtration, so hits are noticeably less harsh than a dry spoon.
  • Comfortable hammer grip — The hammer profile balances nicely in your hand or on a flat surface, so you’re not fighting to keep it from tipping over mid-sesh.
  • Made in the USA quality — Oregon-made glass means real craftsmanship, not flimsy mass-produced stuff that cracks if you look at it wrong.
  • Dialed-in size — 7.5 inches (190.5mm) is long enough to cool the smoke a bit before it reaches you, but still compact enough to travel.
  • Solid, satisfying weight — Thick glass gives that “real piece” feel when you pick it up, without being a brick in your bag.
  • Clean flavor — Glass keeps the taste of your flower true, unlike metal or mystery-material pipes.
  • Looks as good as it hits — Hammer bubblers have that functional, old-school vibe that still stands out on a shelf.

Best For

This hammer bubbler is made for flower smokers who like the simplicity of a hand pipe but want something easier on the throat than a dry bowl. If you love the grab-and-go feel of a spoon but wish it hit more like a tiny water pipe, this bridges that gap nicely. It’s also a solid upgrade if you’re tired of cheap imports and want a reliable, American-made piece that can be your main daily driver instead of a backup to your bigger glass or other smoke shop pieces.

How to Use It

Functionally, this works like a hand pipe with a bonus water chamber. You add a little water into the bubbler section, pack your bowl, and you’re good to go. The water does the heavy lifting: it cools things down and softens the draw so you can take more comfortable pulls without feeling roasted.

Start with just enough water to cover the lower part of the internal stem; from there you can tweak it over time until you find your sweet spot. Set it down on a flat surface and you’ll notice the hammer shape keeps it parked and stable, which is clutch when you’re mid-sesh and someone gets clumsy around the table or your dab pad.

For cleaning, let the piece cool completely, then empty the water. A simple soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a thorough rinse and dry, is usually all it takes to get the glass clear again. Keeping the water fresh and giving it a quick clean regularly will help it stay tasting and looking nice.

Specifications

Length 7.5 inches (190.5mm)
Material Glass
Design Hammer-style bubbler
Category Hand pipe / bubbler
Origin Made in USA (Oregon)

Fit, Feel & Function

The hammer shape isn’t just for looks — it changes how the piece behaves on the table. The front-heavy design keeps the mouthpiece up and bowl forward, so it sits comfortably without rolling, unlike some round-bottom dry pipes. That makes it a great couch, desk, or balcony piece: you can put it down for a second without gambling on it crashing to the floor and becoming a story instead of a bubbler.

Because it’s glass, it plays well with standard flower, grinders, and storage — no weird fit issues. If you like to prep bowls ahead of time, pair it with some solid glass jars and packaging so your herb stays fresh and ready when it’s time to break out the bubbler.

FAQ

  • Is this a dry pipe or does it actually use water?

    It’s a true bubbler, not just a hammer-shaped dry pipe. There’s a water chamber built into the front section, so when you add a bit of water, your hits get filtered and cooled before they reach you.

  • How much water should I put in it?

    Add just enough to cover the bottom of the internal stem in the bubbler chamber. Too little and you won’t get that bubbling action, too much and the airflow can feel restricted or you might get splashback. A tiny adjustment goes a long way, so tweak it until it feels right.

  • How do I clean this without ruining it?

    Let the glass cool, dump out the old water, then soak with isopropyl alcohol to loosen up the buildup. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before you use it again. Regular quick cleans will keep the function and flavor where they should be, just like you would with your favorite daily driver pipe.

  • Is the glass really made in the USA?

    Yes. This hammer bubbler is made in Oregon, USA. If you’re trying to support American glassblowers and avoid mystery import pieces, this fits that lane perfectly.

  • Can I travel with it, or is it too big?

    At 7.5 inches (190.5mm), it’s still very packable. It’s not a tiny pocket piece, but it fits easily into a padded pouch or small bag. Just make sure it’s clean and empty before you stash it, and consider pairing it with smell-proof options like storage and packaging if you’re moving around with it.

  • How does this compare to a small bong?

    Function-wise, it’s closer to a mini water pipe than a dry spoon, but with way less bulk and no separate downstem or bowl piece to worry about. You get smoother hits than a regular pipe without committing to a full-size bong setup and all the extra space and accessories that come with it.

  • What else should I grab with this?

    If you want a clean little setup, grab something to keep your flower fresh and easy to load, like dedicated storage jars (they work great for small amounts of ground flower too). A soft cloth or simple protective pouch is also a good idea if you plan to toss the bubbler into a backpack or travel bag.

The 7.5″ Oregon Made Glass Sherlock is a handcrafted glass bubbler built for people who want real-deal American-made glass with character, not mass-produced imports. At 7.5 inches (190mm), it’s long enough to cool things down while still being easy to pass, stash, and clean. The fumed glass slowly shifts color as you use it, so over time you end up with a one-of-a-kind piece that tells its own story.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Cooler, smoother pulls — Sherlock-style neck and bubbler chamber give smoke more distance and water contact before it hits you.
  • Comfortable angle — The Sherlock bend keeps the bowl away from your face and the mouthpiece right where it feels natural.
  • Real USA glasswork — Made in Oregon by Oregon Made Glass, so you’re getting legit craftsmanship and attention to detail.
  • Fumed glass that evolves — As resin builds and you keep cleaning it, the colors shift and deepen into a unique patina.
  • Solid in the hand — 7.5 inches (190mm) gives you a sturdy, grown‑up feel without being bulky or fragile-feeling.
  • Water filtration without a full bong — Bubbler function takes the edge off your hits without committing to a big tube on the table.

Best For

This Sherlock is made for smokers who want something nicer than a basic spoon, but don’t want to deal with a full-sized water pipe every time they sesh. If you like the idea of one trusty daily driver that looks good on the coffee table and still travels well, this hits the sweet spot. It also plays perfectly with low‑key setups built around durable smoke shop accessories instead of a giant glass collection.

How to Use It

Think of this as a mini water pipe with the feel of a hand pipe. Add a small amount of water to the bubbler chamber—just enough to cover the bottom of the downstem area so it can percolate without splashing into your mouth. Then you’re ready to pack the bowl and enjoy filtered, cooled hits in a compact form factor.

When you’re done, tap out the bowl, give it a rinse, and you’re good to go. If you like to keep your table clean, parking it on a nonstick dab mat or pad keeps water rings and ash off your surfaces.

For cleaning, let the glass cool, then wipe or rinse out loose residue. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry before using again. Regular cleanings also help you really see the color shifts in the fumed glass.

Type Glass Sherlock bubbler
Length 7.5 inches (190mm)
Material Fumed glass
Style Sherlock with bubbler function
Origin Made in USA (Oregon)

Fit, Feel & Function

The 7.5″ length gives you that nice in‑between zone: long enough for smoother, cooler pulls, short enough to handle with one hand without feeling like you’re swinging a cane. The Sherlock curve keeps the bowl slightly lower and forward, which a lot of people find more ergonomic than straight hand pipes during longer seshes.

As a bubbler, it’s great when you want water filtration but don’t want to drag out a big rig or bong every time. If you like to switch pieces depending on mood, it pairs well with unbreakable silicone bongs and rigs when you need something more travel‑proof.

About the Fumed Glass

Fumed glass is what gives this Sherlock its evolving look. Thin layers of metal fumes are worked into the glass during blowing, creating subtle tones that shift as the piece gets used and cleaned over time. The cleaner you keep it, the more clearly you’ll see those color changes show up against the clear and lightly tinted areas.

If you’re the kind of person who likes seeing your gear “break in” and get more character instead of just looking dirty, fumed glass is perfect. Store it carefully when not in use—setting it alongside your other glass and smoking accessories helps keep everything organized and safe.

FAQ

  • Is this Sherlock good as a daily driver?
    Yes, this is absolutely built to be a daily driver. The size, water filtration, and sturdy handfeel make it something you can reach for every day without babying it. If you want to keep your whole setup dialed in, pairing it with sturdy silicone pipes gives you options for more rugged situations.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    You only need enough water to cover the bottom of the internal downstem area so you get that gentle bubbling without splashback. Too much water and you’ll feel it creeping toward the mouthpiece, too little and you won’t get much filtration.
  • Is fumed glass harder to clean?
    No, fumed glass cleans just like regular glass. Let it cool, rinse or wipe out loose debris, and for deeper cleans soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry before reuse. The color you see is in the glass itself, not just resin, so it’ll still look great after a full clean.
  • Will this fit in a typical carrying case or bag?
    At 7.5 inches (190mm), it fits most standard padded pipe cases and many smell‑proof pouches, as long as they’re not strictly pocket-sized. If you travel with flower or want to keep everything together, stash your material in proper storage and packaging so nothing bounces around against the glass.
  • How is this different from a regular spoon pipe?
    Function‑wise, this Sherlock gives you water filtration plus a longer air path, so hits come through smoother and cooler. The Sherlock bend also keeps the bowl out in front of you instead of right under your face, which a lot of people find more comfortable—especially during longer seshes.
  • Does the color really change over time?
    Yes. As you use it, resin buildup and repeated cleanings make the fumed work pop more, and subtle blues, golds, or purples can become more visible. If you like seeing your glass evolve, this is one of those pieces that gets better-looking the longer you own it. Keeping your herb fresh in proper glass jars and packaging also keeps flavor on point so the piece doesn’t just look good—it hits good too.
  • Is this made from thick glass?
    It’s crafted by Oregon Made Glass in the USA, so it’s built with durability and real use in mind rather than ultra-thin show glass. That said, it’s still glass—treat it with respect, don’t drop it in the sink, and try not to knock it off the table when you’re a few bowls deep.

  • Big, direct hits — Tall 18.5 inch (47cm) straight tube gives you that strong, classic chug without extra percs slowing things down.
  • Cooler pulls on demand — Built-in ice pinch lets you drop cubes in the neck so your hit cools off before it gets to you.

  • Clean, see-through style — Clear glass with subtle decals lets you actually see your function and keep an eye on resin buildup.

The 6″ Cane Weave Color Accent Banger Hanger Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for dabbers who want real function with serious style. At just 6 inches (152mm) tall, it’s a perfect daily driver for tight spaces, desktops, or travel setups. The cane weave body and color accents make it look like heady art, while the two-hole perc and included 14mm 90° banger keep the hits smooth and easy.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smooth, controlled pulls — The two-hole perc breaks up the vapor just enough for smoother, cooler hits without feeling like you’re dragging forever.
  • Compact but stable — At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough for a cluttered desk but still has enough weight and balance not to tip over during a clumsy grab.
  • Ready to rip out of the box — Comes with a 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to dig through drawers or add extra pieces just to get started.
  • Standout cane weave design — That basket-weave look with cane swirl accents makes it feel like a custom piece, not another boring clear rig.
  • Great flavor rig — The smaller chamber keeps vapor dense and tasty, so your terps don’t get washed out by a huge water volume.
  • Easy to clean and maintain — Simple two-hole perc and straightforward shape mean less scrubbing and fewer spots for reclaim to hide.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a compact, good-looking piece that can hang as a main rig, not just a backup. If you’re running a few dabs a day and want something that looks like functional art without jumping into true heady pricing, this fits that lane. It also plays nicely in a small station setup with a quality dab mat when you’re trying to keep your table clean and organized.

How to Use It

Set the rig on a flat, stable surface and drop the included 14mm 90° banger into the 14mm female joint. The upright “banger hanger” joint design keeps the bucket comfortably out and away from the body, so you’ve got room to work with your dab tool and carb cap.

Once your banger is up to temp, introduce your concentrate and pull through the mouthpiece while the two-hole perc does its thing, breaking the bubbles into a smoother, cooler draw. For the cleanest experience, keep your concentrates staged in clean concentrate jars instead of scraping from random containers mid-sesh.

Between dabs, a quick dry pull clears extra vapor and helps keep reclaim from building up as fast. When you’re done, let everything cool down fully before moving or cleaning the rig so you’re not shocking hot glass or smearing hot residue all over your setup.

The Basics of Its Function

This is a classic banger hanger style rig: the joint comes straight out from the side, then the neck angles up so you’ve got a comfortable line of sight to your nail without leaning way over. The small internal volume means it doesn’t need a huge lungful of air to fully stack the chamber, which makes it a great match for smaller or medium-sized dabs.

The two-hole perc is simple on purpose. Instead of a super-complex multi-chamber setup, you get reliable function with very little drag and minimal spots for buildup. That makes it easier to keep clean and keeps the flavor tight instead of over-diffused.

Specifications

Height 6 inches (152mm)
Rig Type Glass dab rig / oil rig
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90°
Perc Style Two-hole perc
Material Glass
Included Accessory 14mm 90° banger

Fit & Compatibility

This rig has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, so it plays best with 14mm male 90° bangers. If you’ve already got a stack of quartz, just match those specs and you’re good. You can also pair it with directional caps or spinner caps from our carb caps collection if you like running pearls or really dialing in airflow.

Care and Cleaning

Let the banger and rig cool completely before cleaning. For light maintenance, a quick rinse with warm water after use helps cut down on buildup. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh. Avoid knocking it around sinks or hard counters—glass is tough, but not unbreakable, and nobody wants to explain a broken favorite piece to a roommate.

FAQ

  • What size banger does this rig use?
    It uses a 14mm male banger at a 90° angle. The rig already comes with a 14mm 90° banger, so you’re ready to go right away. If you swap it out later, just stick to 14mm male, 90° options and you’ll be set.
  • Can I use this as a mini bong for flower?
    You technically can if you grab a 14mm bowl instead of a banger, but this piece is really tuned for concentrates. The banger hanger layout, two-hole perc, and smaller chamber make it shine as a dab rig. If you want something more flower-focused, check out the broader pieces in our smoke shop products section.
  • How hard is it to clean the cane weave body?
    Even though it looks intricate from the outside, the interior is pretty straightforward: a simple can with a two-hole perc. That means iso soaks work well, and you’re not dealing with crazy internal recycling pathways. Just let it cool, soak in isopropyl alcohol when needed, rinse, and dry.
  • Will this rig tip over easily?
    For its 6 inch (152mm) height, it has a solid, stable footprint, especially when you keep it on a flat, grippy surface like a silicone bong or rig mat. As with any glass rig, don’t park it on the edge of a table or somewhere it can get bumped off.
  • Is this a good rig for small, flavorful dabs?
    Yes, that’s exactly its sweet spot. The smaller chamber and simple diffusion keep your vapor dense and flavorful without over-cooling or diluting things. Pair it with good quartz and a solid dab tool from our dab tools lineup and you’ve got a great little flavor rig.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    The 6″ size makes it bag-friendly, but it’s still glass, so treat it gently. Use some padding, stash the banger separately, and keep any material stored in sealed containers or proper storage packaging if you’re moving between spots in legal markets.
  • Does the two-hole perc create a lot of drag?
    No, that’s one of the perks of this setup. The two-hole perc gives you noticeable diffusion without turning your pull into a workout. You get smooth, cooled vapor while still keeping the draw nice and open.

The LOOKAH ANT 710 Battery Mod is a compact, adjustable-voltage battery built for dabbers who live on their wax pens and want real control, not guesswork. It’s made for people who want pocket-sized power with enough battery (950mAh) to last through long days and nights, plus simple voltage options (3.2V, 3.6V, 4.0V) to dial in flavor or thickness on the fly. If you’re tired of underpowered stick pens and want something that actually hits the way you like, this is that upgrade.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Real control over your hits — Three voltage settings (3.2V, 3.6V, 4.0V) let you switch from flavor-sipper to cloud-chaser without swapping gear.
  • Lasts way longer than basic pens — The 950mAh battery gives you plenty of seshes between charges, so you’re not hunting for an outlet halfway through the night.
  • Clean, tasty vapor — Two Type D quartz coils are designed to bring out flavor while still putting out satisfying vapor, especially for concentrates that deserve better than a cheap cart battery.
  • Charge and rip at the same time — USB Type-C charging with pass-through use means you can keep going even when the battery’s tapped, as long as you’re plugged in.
  • Pocket-friendly but tough — The metal body feels sturdy in the hand and can handle bouncing around in bags and pockets without babying it.
  • Easy to read, easy to use — A digital display keeps your battery level and settings clear, so you’re not guessing when it’s going to die.
  • Dialed for wax pen fans — Built for people who want more than a basic stick battery but still want something small, simple, and discreet.

Best For

The LOOKAH ANT 710 is made for dabbers who lean on their wax pens as a daily driver and want the feel of a “real” device without carrying a giant box mod. It’s a solid choice if you’re bouncing between flavors or consistencies and want quick voltage tweaks instead of fully locked-in settings. If you’ve already got a rig setup at home, this makes a perfect out-the-door companion to whatever’s sitting on your main dab mat.

How to Use It

The basics are simple: connect your compatible 710-style coil or wax attachment, power on the ANT 710, and choose from the 3.2V, 3.6V, or 4.0V settings depending on whether you’re chasing flavor or heavier clouds. Once you’ve got your voltage set, it’s just click-and-go — no menus to scroll through or confusing modes to remember when you’re already a few dabs deep.

Lower voltage is great when you want to taste every terp, while the higher end of the range leans into denser vapor and harder-hitting pulls. The digital display helps you keep track of your battery life so you’re not surprised by a dead device mid-sesh. When you’re back at the desk or couch, it pairs well with other electric tools and dab gear, especially if you’re already into portable rigs or nectar collectors for home use.

Charging is straight-forward: plug into the USB Type-C port. Thanks to pass-through capability, you can still use the ANT 710 while it’s plugged in, which is clutch when the battery is low and you don’t want to wait. Just avoid covering the airflow when holding it, and try not to run it totally dry constantly — your battery will thank you over time.

Cleaning & Care

Let the device and coil cool completely before cleaning. Once it’s cool, gently wipe off any visible residue on the exterior and around the connection points. For a deeper coil or attachment clean, remove the piece (if it’s designed to be removed), soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry fully before popping it back onto the device. For general protection and to keep sticky tools from wandering, it’s handy to park the mod next to your main stash spot or with your other core dab tools.

Color Options

You get a full lineup of colors so your battery doesn’t have to look like everyone else’s: Black, Blue, Gray, Green, Neon Green, Orange, Purple, and Red. Go low-key with Black or Gray, or pick something louder like Neon Green or Purple if you’re constantly misplacing your gear and want it to stand out in a bag or couch cushion.

Specifications

Specification Details
Battery Capacity 950mAh
Voltage Settings 3.2V, 3.6V, 4.0V
Coils Two Type D quartz coils
Charging Port USB Type-C

Fit & Compatibility Notes

The LOOKAH ANT 710 is designed specifically around LOOKAH’s 710-style wax coils and attachments, including the included Type D quartz coils. It’s best treated as a dedicated wax pen/battery mod, not a universal box for every random tank or cart you have laying around. If you’re building out a whole setup, it plays nicely as the “on-the-go” option next to your heavier glass or silicone bongs & rigs at home.

FAQ

  • Can I use the LOOKAH ANT 710 while it’s charging?

    Yes. The ANT 710 supports pass-through charging, so you can keep using it while it’s plugged into a USB Type-C cable. Just be mindful of cable strain so you’re not bending the port every time you hit it.

  • What’s the advantage of the adjustable voltage settings?

    The three voltage options let you tune your sesh to what you’re dabbing. Lower voltage is smoother and more terp-forward, while bumping it higher gives you thicker vapor and stronger hits. It’s easier than dealing with full temperature curves and still gives you a clear difference between modes.

  • What coils does this work with?

    The ANT 710 is built around LOOKAH’s 710-style quartz coils, including the two Type D quartz coils it comes with. Those coils are designed for concentrates and give you a solid mix of flavor and vapor density. If you’re swapping coils, stick to compatible LOOKAH 710 options for the best fit and function.

  • How do I clean the device safely?

    Let everything cool first, then wipe the exterior and connection points with a dry or slightly damp cloth. For attachments or coils that are meant to be cleaned, remove them and soak in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry before putting them back on. To keep the rest of your gear clean and organized, pair it with sturdy storage & packaging so you’re not tossing sticky parts in random drawers.

  • How long does the 950mAh battery last?

    Actual runtime depends on how often you hit it and which voltage level you prefer, but 950mAh is a noticeable upgrade from slim stick batteries. Most people can get multiple solid seshes in a day before needing a recharge, especially if they’re using the lower and middle voltage settings.

  • Is this a good option for beginners?

    Yes. The ANT 710 keeps things simple: three voltage settings, clear display, and straightforward controls. It’s friendly enough for someone just getting into wax pens, but still powerful and adjustable enough that more experienced dabbers won’t outgrow it right away. For those just getting started, pairing it with easy-to-load products in quality concentrate jars makes learning the ropes a lot smoother.

  • How does this compare to a full-size rig or e-rig?

    It won’t move as much air or water as a dedicated rig setup, but the ANT 710 wins on portability and convenience. Think of it as your pocket-friendly wax pen solution, while your big glass or tabletop gear stays home. If you’re trying to build a full kit, the ANT 710 makes a great travel or stealth option alongside your at-home pieces and general smoke shop products.

The 5" Sectional Wigwag Sherlock w/ Opal is a heady glass hand pipe for people who actually care what their daily driver looks like. Built for flower smokers who want function and art in the same piece, this Sherlock gives you that comfy, laid-back form factor with serious color work and an encased opal as the flex point. At 5 inches (127mm), it hits smoother than a tiny pocket spoon but still stays small enough to stash or travel with.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Comfortable couch-mode hits — Sherlock-style bend keeps the bowl out front and the mouthpiece up, so you’re not hunching or craning your neck mid-sesh.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — the 5-inch (127mm) path gives smoke more room to travel than a micro pipe, taking a bit of the edge off your hit.
  • Showpiece vibes — sectional wigwag work and the encased opal turn this into something you’ll actually want to leave out on the table.
  • Squish mouthpiece = no-slip seal — the flattened lip end feels natural against your mouth and helps you get a solid draw without trying.
  • Easy to handle — that Sherlock curve doubles as a handle, so you’re not palming a hot bowl when you pass it around.
  • Collector-worthy but still practical — built from quality glass that’s meant to be used, not just stare-at-it-in-a-case glass.

Best for

This is made for smokers who are over cheap, generic spoons and want a real showpiece they can still burn out of every day. If you like heady glass but need something smaller and more manageable than a full rig, this Sherlock slides right into that “nice enough to flex, simple enough to use all the time” lane. It also pairs nicely with more durable travel pieces like our silicone options in the silicone pipes collection if you want a full rotation.

How to use it

The layout is classic: bowl on the front, carb on the side, mouthpiece at the end of that curved Sherlock stem. Load your favorite flower into the bowl, use the carb to control airflow, and let the bend in the neck do its thing by keeping heat and ash away from your face. The curve also makes it easy to rest in your hand or lay across an ashtray between hits without it rolling off the table.

After your sesh, let the pipe cool completely before you even think about cleaning. Setting your Sherlock on a nonstick dab mat while you pack and ash keeps the table from turning into a sticky, dusty mess.

The squish mouthpiece is a subtle touch, but once you use it, round tips feel a little bland.

Because these are worked glass pieces, colorways and pattern layouts will vary — that’s part of the fun. You’re not getting a factory clone; you’re getting a unique piece that still keeps the same overall 5-inch Sherlock form factor and opal placement.

Fit & everyday use

If you’re the type to keep all your gear in one place, it lives nicely alongside your grinders, lighters, and other smoke shop accessories without taking over the drawer.

FAQ

  • Is this pipe super fragile?

If you’re accident-prone, consider pairing it with a more rugged daily driver from our smoke shop products lineup and keeping this one for home seshes.

    Let the pipe cool, then tap or wipe out loose ash from the bowl. For a deeper refresh, soak the pipe in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before using again. Avoid scraping the glass with metal tools so you don’t scratch the color work or the area around the opal.
  • Will this fit in a pocket or small bag?

  • Does the opal affect how it hits at all?
    No, the opal is fully encased in clear glass and is there purely for aesthetics. It won’t change airflow or how the pipe smokes; it just gives you that extra bit of heady flair that regular production pieces don’t have. For more strictly functional gear without the art-glass touches, browse our glass jars & packaging section for storage and lab-style accessories.
  • What’s the best way to ash it without making a mess?
    Let the bowl cool a little, then tap or gently scoop out the ash into an ashtray or trash. If you’re seshing at a desk or coffee table, putting the pipe down on a sheet of parchment paper or a mat keeps stray ash and herb crumbs from grinding into your surfaces.
  • Is this good as a first “nice” piece?
    Yes. It’s simple enough to use like any other hand pipe, but the wigwag sections and opal make it feel like a real upgrade from gas-station glass. If you think you’ll eventually move into concentrates, it also looks right at home next to rigs, nails, and dab tools on your tray.

The 2.5″ 14M 90° Assorted Etch Quartz Banger 9pc Display Box is a quartz banger set built for dabbers and shops running 14mm female rigs all day. Each 2.5 inch (63.5mm) long, 90° banger has a 25mm bucket, giving you real room to work with your concentrates without easy spillover. You get nine etched quartz bangers in one display box, so you’re covered whether you’re stocking a counter or just want backups for heavy rotation.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Dialed for 14mm rigs — 14mm male joint slides cleanly into any 14mm female piece, so no guessing games with fit.
  • Roomy 25mm bucket — Extra space means less chance of boiling over when you get generous with your dabs.
  • Reliable quartz heat — Solid quartz construction holds heat evenly, so you get more consistent flavor across the whole pull.
  • Clean 90° angle — Built to sit straight on most upright dab rigs and classic beaker bongs without feeling awkward or off-center.
  • Assorted etched designs — Each banger has its own etched look, so your setup doesn’t just hit well, it actually looks like you care.
  • Retail-ready 9pc display — Comes boxed and organized so shops can drop it right into the display case or keep it tidy in the back.
  • Backup-friendly — Crack one, clog one, or torch one too hard? You’ve still got eight more lined up and ready.

Best For

This 9-pack is made for dabbers and smoke shops that see a lot of action on 14mm female rigs. If your daily driver is a medium-sized rig or beaker and you hate being down a banger mid-sesh, having nine matching-spec pieces on deck just makes life easier. It’s also a smart add-on if you’re already building out a concentrate station with a solid dab mat and want a clean, uniform look.

How to use it

Pop one of these quartz bangers into the 14mm female joint on your rig, making sure the 90° joint sits level and the bucket is centered over your piece. Heat the bottom and lower walls of the 25mm bucket with your torch until it’s where you like it, then work your concentrates off your dabber into the bucket and cap it with your favorite carb cap. Between dabs, let the bucket cool a bit and swab it out so it stays clear instead of cloudy.

When you’re done for the sesh, let the banger cool completely, then give it a quick wipe or soak so it’s ready next time. If you like keeping your station tight, pair these with proper dab tools so you’re not scraping quartz with random metal objects from the junk drawer.

Specs

Total Length 2.5 inches (63.5mm)
Joint Size & Gender 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°
Bucket Diameter 25mm
Material Quartz
Pieces per Box 9 assorted etched bangers

Fit & setup notes

These bangers are sized specifically for 14mm female joints, which is the most common size on small and medium rigs. They play best with upright rigs and beakers where a 90° joint keeps the bucket level and not tilted toward the ground. For rigs with angled joints or different joint sizes, you’ll want to look at other options in your kit or add an adapter from your regular accessories stash.

Care & Cleaning

Let the banger cool before you touch it, then wipe out any leftover residue with a cotton swab. For a deeper clean, soak the cooled piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and dry completely before heating it again. Keeping quartz clean not only looks better, it helps preserve flavor so your terps aren’t fighting through burnt buildup.

FAQ

Will these fit my rig?
Each banger in this set is a 14mm male, 90° joint, so it’ll fit any rig or bong with a 14mm female joint at that angle. If your piece is 10mm or 18mm, or uses a 45° joint, these won’t be ideal without an adapter.

What’s the benefit of the 25mm bucket?
The 25mm diameter gives you more surface area and volume than smaller buckets, so your concentrates have room to move without instantly spilling over the edge. That extra space is especially nice if you’re loading bigger dabs or sharing during a group sesh on your main silicone bongs & rigs or glass setups.

Are the etched designs going to fade or rub off?
No. The etching is cut into the quartz itself, so it doesn’t wash off or peel with normal use and cleaning. As long as you’re not grinding metal tools against the artwork, the designs should stay sharp for the life of the banger.

Is quartz really better than glass for dabs?
Quartz is the standard for a reason: it handles heat better, warms up and cools down more predictably, and doesn’t get as stressed under repeated torching as standard glass. If you’re serious enough about flavor and function to be running proper concentrates out of real concentrate jars, quartz is what you want on your rig.

How should I clean these without ruining the etching?
Let the banger cool, then wipe out fresh residue with a cotton swab. For stuck-on buildup, soak the cooled quartz in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry before you heat it again. Avoid using abrasive pads or tools on the etched areas so they stay crisp and clear.

Can I use these with directional or spinner caps?

When you’re heating, focus your torch around the base and lower walls of the bucket so it warms evenly. Setting your rig on a quality dab mat helps keep that gold finish and your table both looking clean.

The Graphic Downstems by What You Need are decorative replacement downstems for glass bongs and water pipes, built for smokers who want real diffusion and a little art in the mix. They’re all borosilicate glass with printed graphics, so you’re not just upgrading function—you’re upgrading the whole look of your piece. Available in multiple lengths and joint sizes, they slide into a wide range of setups and turn harsh pulls into smoother, more controlled rips.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Level up your piece’s look — Printed graphics turn a plain bong into something that actually matches your style.
  • Smoother, less harsh hits — Precision-cut diffusion at the tip helps break up smoke for a cleaner pull.
  • Tune the way your piece hits — Different lengths let you dial in how much water your downstem sits in and how airy or chuggy your function feels.
  • Easy swap for broken stock stems — A simple way to bring a tired bong back to life without buying a whole new piece.
  • Borosilicate durability — Made from lab-style glass that handles daily use and routine cleans better than cheap soft glass.
  • Mix and match across your collection — Multiple size options mean one order can refresh more than one water pipe if they share the same joint spec.

Best For

Graphic Downstems are made for people who already have a favorite bong or tube, but want it to hit better and look less generic. If you’re the type who actually cares what’s on the coffee table during a sesh, this is an easy upgrade. They also make a great choice if you rotate between a couple of pieces and like keeping a spare stem ready instead of retiring a pipe when the stock downstem finally taps out. If you’re building out a full station, they pair nicely with a solid nonstick dab mat to keep any water drips and resin off your table.

How to Use It

Pick the correct joint size and effective length, slide the narrow end of the downstem into your bong’s joint, and seat it snugly — that’s it. The key detail is how far the tip of the downstem sits in the water: you want it submerged enough that all the slits or openings are under the surface so you get full diffusion. Too shallow and you’ll lose function; too deep and your piece may feel a little chuggier.

Once it’s in, you use your bong exactly how you normally would, but you’ll notice the difference in how the bubbles stack and how the pull feels. If you’re running a full concentrate setup with a banger on top, keep the joint and stem on a heat-safe accessory tray or pad when you’re not hitting it so you’re not setting hot glass down on random surfaces.

For cleaning, let everything cool down, pull the downstem out carefully, and soak it in isopropyl alcohol until the resin loosens. Rinse with warm water and let it dry completely before you drop it back into your piece.

Specs

Feature Details
Product type Replacement / upgrade glass downstem
Material Borosilicate glass
Design style Printed graphic artwork on the stem
Size options Multiple lengths and joint sizes (select from options)
Joint type Varies by option (match to your bong’s female joint)
Diffusion Precision-cut openings/slits at the tip

Fit & Compatibility

Downstems are all about two things: joint size and effective length. Joint size has to match your bong’s female joint (commonly 14mm or 18mm). Effective length is the measurement from the ground glass shoulder (where it stops at the joint) to the very tip that sits in the water. Matching those two numbers means your stem seats properly and diffuses right where it should.

These Graphic Downstems are designed to play nice with most standard glass water pipes that use removable downstems, as long as you choose the correct option. If you’re building out a kit from scratch, they work well alongside unbreakable setups like our silicone bongs and rigs for those times when glass isn’t ideal.

Tips for Getting the Right Size

If you’re replacing a broken stem, line it up against a ruler and measure from the ground glass shoulder to the tip — that’s the number you want to match. If you don’t have the original stem, gently feed a pencil or straw straight down the joint until it taps the bottom of the water chamber, mark where the shoulder would sit, and measure that distance. When in doubt, going just a bit shorter is usually safer than overshooting and slamming the tip into the base of your bong.

Once your stem is dialed in, you can focus on the rest of your setup — things like proper flower or concentrate storage in heavy-bottom glass jars and packaging will do more for flavor than any fancy logo on the neck of your piece.

FAQ

  • How do I know which joint size to order?
    Most glass bongs use either 14mm or 18mm joints. If you still have your bowl or banger, that can tell you the size: a 14mm male piece fits a 14mm female joint, and same with 18mm. If you’re unsure, you can compare the opening to another piece you know the size of, or ask your local shop to measure it for you before grabbing a downstem online.
  • What’s the “length” referring to on a downstem?
    Length refers to the effective length from the ground glass shoulder to the tip — not the total glass top-to-bottom. That’s the part that actually sits inside the bong and reaches into the water. Matching that measurement is what keeps the slits under the waterline and gives you proper diffusion.
  • Will this work in my beaker bong and my straight tube?
    As long as both pieces use the same joint size and need a similar effective length, you can swap the same Graphic Downstem between them. Just make sure the tip isn’t hitting the base of one or barely touching the water in the other. If you’ve got multiple pieces and want backup parts, it can be smart to standardize around one size.
  • Can I use this with a dab rig setup?
    Yes, if your rig uses a removable downstem and the joint size matches. Just remember you’re still responsible for the banger or nail on top; the downstem’s job is only to pull smoke or vapor through the water. Pair it with quality tools from our dab tools lineup to keep your concentrate side of the setup dialed in.
  • Is the graphic going to fade or peel?
    The art is printed onto borosilicate glass and designed for regular use, so it won’t just wipe off during normal cleaning. Avoid metal brushes or anything overly abrasive, and stick to isopropyl alcohol soaks and rinses. That keeps both the glass and the graphics looking good longer.
  • How should I clean it without breaking it?
    Let the piece cool, pull the downstem straight out while supporting the joint, and soak it in isopropyl alcohol until the resin loosens. Rinse with warm water and let it dry fully before putting it back. To avoid clinking glass-on-glass while drying or storing, keep spare stems in a padded case or even a spare storage container so they’re not rolling around in a drawer.
  • Do these work with silicone pieces?
    Many silicone bongs use glass downstems in standard sizes, so as long as your silicone piece has a glass or sized-downstem port that matches, you can absolutely run a Graphic Downstem in it. If your current silicone piece uses a fixed stem or a proprietary shape, you’ll want to stick with a model that accepts standard removable downstems or look at swap-friendly options in our broader smoke shop products lineup.

The inline perc runs horizontally along the base, stacking bubbles for cleaner, cooler pulls while the color accents keep it looking sharp on the table.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Rig

  • Comfortable daily driver size — 7.5 inches (190mm) is tall enough for solid function, short enough to stash or pass around easily.
  • Smoother, less harsh hits — the inline perc spreads smoke across multiple slits, sending it through more water for a softer pull.
  • Ready out of the box — comes with a 90° banger matched to the 14mm male joint, so there’s no guessing on sizing.
  • Stable and balanced — the horizontal inline section keeps the weight low, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the table.
  • Clean flavor — simple, direct path from banger to mouthpiece helps preserve terps instead of over-chilling or over-diffusing them.
  • Looks good on the shelf — bold Monark color accents give it that “nice piece” vibe instead of looking like lab glass.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a legit upgrade from cheap glass without going full art piece. If you’re running a few dabs a day and want something that stays comfortable, easy to clean, and consistent, this fits right in as your main rig. It also pairs nicely with unbreakable travel gear like our silicone bongs and rigs if you like keeping glass at home and silicone for on-the-go.

How to Use It (The Basics)

Fill the rig so the inline perc is just slightly covered with water — you want the slits fully submerged, but not drowning. When you pull, watch for tight, fast bubbles along the inline; that’s how you know it’s doing its job. Too much water and it’ll feel draggy, too little and you’ll lose the smoothness.

The 14mm male joint is already matched to the included 90° banger, so you’re set up for concentrates without having to hunt for compatible glass. Set the rig on a solid surface or a nonstick dab mat to catch any drips and keep your station clean while you work.

When you’re done, let everything cool before you touch the banger. For cleaning, a quick rinse after use keeps reclaim from building up; when it’s really time for a reset, a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry will bring the glass back to clear.

Why Inline Percs Hit Different

An inline perc is basically a horizontal tube with multiple slits or holes cut along the bottom. As you pull, vapor is forced through those cuts and broken into smaller bubbles. Smaller bubbles = more surface area touching the water, which means more cooling and a smoother pull without needing a giant chamber.

Compared to big tree percs or stacked chambers, an inline setup like this keeps drag lower and maintenance way simpler. You get that satisfying chug and diffusion, but you’re not scrubbing a forest of tiny arms every weekend. If you like rigs that feel responsive and easy to clear, this inline design hits that sweet spot.

Rinse the rig with warm water after heavier seshes to keep the inline perc from clogging with reclaim. Yes, if you already have 14mm female accessories designed for a 90° joint, they should fit the 14mm male joint on this rig. Just make sure they’re also sized for concentrates and not flower bowls if you’re planning to dab with it.

How hard is it to clean the inline perc?

Inline percs are easier to clean than a lot of multi-arm or multi-chamber designs. A soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a warm water rinse usually clears out built-up reclaim. For the banger, giving it regular quick cleanups helps keep flavor fresh, especially if you’re working with quality material you’re also storing in proper glass jars and extract packaging.

Is 7.5 inches too small for bigger dabs?

7.5 inches is a sweet spot for concentrate rigs — it’s compact but not tiny. The inline perc and water volume give you enough cooling for normal to heavier dabs, without the piece feeling oversized or awkward to pass around.

Can I use this for flower with a different bowl?

Technically, you can swap the banger for a 14mm female flower bowl and use it that way. If you’re a flower person first and foremost, you might want a separate piece or one of our more general smoke shop products built around bowls.

Does the color affect durability or function?

No, the color is purely aesthetic. It doesn’t change the way the inline perc functions or how thick the glass is — it just makes the rig look better on your desk, tray, or next to your carb caps.

Is this a good choice as my first “real” rig?

Yes, this is a solid starter-into-midrange rig: simple function, easy maintenance, standard 14mm sizing, and no weird custom joints. If you’re upgrading from a cheap mini rig or pen and want something that will stay in rotation for a long time, this Monark inline is a smart, no-drama pick.

This is the kind of rig you grab when you want daily-driver reliability plus a little color flex.

Why you’ll actually use this every day

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Incycler design continuously recycles water inside the rig, helping tame hot vapor before it ever reaches your throat.
  • Comfortable mid-size height — Around 10 inches (254mm) tall, it’s big enough for solid function but small enough that it isn’t a pain to store or clean.

  • Dialed for flavor — Compact chamber and recycler-style function help keep terps tasting fresh instead of harsh and dry.
  • Stable and sesh-friendly — The proportioned base and 90° joint angle make it easy to park on a table without your banger hanging at a weird angle.

Best for

This CALVO incycler is made for dabbers who want smoother hits than a basic mini rig but don’t feel like lugging around a giant tower. It’s a sweet spot for people running a few dabs a day, or that one friend whose place turns into the default dab spot. If you already have a decent setup with a dab mat and tools but your old rig feels basic or too harsh, this is a clean upgrade in both function and looks.

How to use it

Set up is simple: fill the rig until the main perc is covered and there’s enough water for the recycler to cycle without splashing into your mouth. You’ll see the water move up into the internal section and drain back down as you pull, which is how you know the incycler is doing its thing.

Drop the included 14mm male banger in the 90° joint, heat and cool it to your preference, then cap and pull as usual. The incycler will drag vapor through the water multiple times, which helps even out the hit and keep flavors more dialed-in. If you like to keep your station neat, park the rig on a nonstick accessory pad so any stray drops from the banger don’t end up stuck to your table.

When you’re done for the day, let the rig cool off before dumping the water. For deeper cleans, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol and a pinch of salt, shake gently, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh.

The basics of the incycler design

An incycler is like a recycler’s more compact cousin: instead of having an external recycling arm looping around the outside, most of the water and recycling paths are built into the body of the rig. That keeps the piece cleaner looking and a little less fragile while still giving you the same repeated water contact.

As you pull, vapor and water are drawn up through the perc and into the upper chambers. The water then drains back down while vapor continues up the neck. This back-and-forth movement helps knock down harshness, control splash, and keep the hit feeling dense without being too hot. It’s a noticeable upgrade if you’re moving from a basic straight tube or tiny rig.

To keep flavor and function on point, change the water frequently — ideally daily if you’re dabbing often. Old water kills taste and can stain the glass over time.

Is 10 inches too big for a daily dab rig?

Not at all. 10 inches (254mm) is that sweet middle ground — you get enough internal space for good recycling function and cooling, but it’s still compact enough to live on a desk, nightstand, or coffee table. If you’ve been using a tiny micro rig and want smoother hits without jumping to a huge tube, this size feels like a nice upgrade.

How do I keep reclaim and residue from building up too fast?

Use clean water, avoid overloading, and try to swab your banger after each dab so less residue makes its way into the rig. When things start looking cloudy inside, give it a quick soak and rinse with isopropyl alcohol. For people running a lot of dabs back-to-back, setting your piece on a nonstick smoke shop pad also keeps your surrounding area from getting sticky.

If you’re primarily a flower smoker, you might want a dedicated flower tube and keep this one dialed in as your concentrate rig, with your flower stored separately in smell-tight storage and packaging so everything stays fresh.

Yes. The incycler design helps keep vapor moving and cooled without feeling thin, which pairs nicely with lower-temp dabs where you want max flavor. Match it with a good quartz banger and a carb cap you like, and you’ll get clean, terp-forward hits that don’t cook your throat.

Think of this like a regular water bong that just happens to look like a handgun. Try not to grab it by any thin or decorative extensions when you’re moving it around the sink; treat it like functional art. If you store it in a cabinet or case, keep it upright and use the stand when possible, the same way you’d baby your nicer glass jars and packaging.

The VIBES Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones are oversized, pre-rolled cones built for smokers who like big joints without a ton of paper in the way. Designed for people who’d rather pack and spark than sit and roll, these cones use ultra-thin VIBES paper and a fat 18mm opening so you can load up fast and still get that smooth, clean-tasting burn VIBES is known for.

Each cone is finished with an 8mm tip that balances easy airflow with just enough resistance, so your fatty draws smooth instead of feeling like you’re pulling through a straw.

Why you’ll actually use these

  • Less rolling, more smoking — Pre-rolled design with a wide 18mm opening means you just grind, pack, and go instead of fighting with loose papers.
  • Big joints, less paper taste — Ultra-thin VIBES paper keeps the focus on your flower, not on that dry paper flavor halfway through the sesh.
  • Smooth, open draw — 8mm tip is wide enough to move serious airflow but still shaped to keep things comfortable to hold and hit.
  • Slow, even burn — Ultra-thin stock is engineered to burn consistently so your fatty doesn’t canoe on one side while the other barely lights.
  • Perfect for sharing — Fatty size makes these ideal for passing around at a kickback, festival, or any sesh where one little pinner just won’t do it.
  • Minimal mess — The stiff cone body helps keep ground herb from spilling everywhere while you’re packing.

Best for

These Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones are made for smokers who already know they like a heavy pour—bigger joints, longer burns, and full-flavor flower. They shine when you’re rolling up for a group sesh, or if you’re the type who would rather pack one solid fatty than roll three separate joints. If you’re building out a full kit, they pair nicely with a clean surface like a dab mat so your grind stays where you want it.

They’re also a smart pick for anyone who’s decent at grinding but still hates the actual rolling part. Cones are forgiving, and VIBES ultra-thin paper keeps the experience tasting way closer to glass than old-school thick papers.

How to use them

Using these cones is straightforward: fill from the wide 18mm opening, lightly tap or tamp to settle your herb, then twist the tip of the paper at the top to lock everything in. Because they’re ultra-thin, go gentle when you’re packing—firm, not aggressive—so you keep airflow and don’t crush the cone.

For a smoother prep routine, stage your ground flower on something nonstick or easy to clean, or keep it in proper glass jars so it doesn’t overdry before you even get to pack a cone. Once you’re finished with your smoke, just let the cone cool off and toss the ash and crutch responsibly.

Cleanup is basically nothing—no scraping, no wiping down gear—just make sure you’re not ashing on anything that melts or stains, the same way you’d treat any joint or cone.

Fit & Compatibility

Because of the 18mm opening, these cones work best with a medium to large amount of ground flower—think “fat joint,” not a tiny personal. They’re easy to pack by hand, but also play well with most generic cone loaders and packing tools. If you’re the type to keep multiple pieces in rotation—bowls, rigs, and cones—these live nicely alongside more durable silicone pipes for when you don’t feel like rolling at all.

They’re regular-paper sized at the tip, so they feel familiar in the hand even though they’re built to hold a lot more herb than a standard skinny cone.

This listing is for VIBES Ultra Thin Pre-Rolled Fatty Cones from What You Need, priced as a bulk pack at $75.99. Exact cone count and pack breakdown follow the vendor configuration, but you’re getting a full box built for people who burn through cones regularly—perfect for stocking a home stash, a busy smoke circle, or a shared spot where everyone always “forgets” to bring papers.

FAQ

  • How big are these compared to regular cones?
    These are “fatty” style cones with an 18mm opening, so they’re noticeably wider than your standard slim or 1 1/4 cone. They’re made for bigger joints and longer burns, not quick personals.
  • Will these fit in my cone loader or packing tool?
    Most universal cone loaders can handle fatty cones, but it depends on your specific tool. If your loader can take wider cones or king-size formats, it’ll usually play fine with this 18mm size. Otherwise, packing by hand works just as well.
  • Are the Ultra Thin papers going to rip while I pack?
    They’re thinner than average for taste and burn quality, but still sturdy enough for normal packing as long as you don’t overjam or stab at them with something sharp. Fill gradually and use something smooth (like a small packing tool) and you’ll be good.
  • Do these come with filters already installed?
    Yes, each cone has an 8mm tip already in place, so you don’t need to roll or insert your own crutch. Just pack the cone, twist the top, and you’re ready.
  • What’s the difference between these and regular VIBES papers?
    Regular papers are flat sheets you still have to roll yourself, while these are pre-formed cones that save you the effort and keep the shape consistent every time. If you like the VIBES paper feel and flavor but hate rolling, these are the easy-mode version.
  • How should I store the cones so they don’t get crushed?
    Keep them in their original box or slip a few into a hard-sided tube or case when you’re on the go. If you’re building out a full travel kit, you can toss them alongside other smoking accessories so everything stays organized.
  • Are these good for mixing concentrates with flower?
    If you like to blend in a little hash or rosin with your flower, the extra capacity on these fatties gives you more room to work. Just keep any stickier material staged on nonstick surfaces like PTFE or non-stick paper until you’re ready to load so you don’t waste anything.

  • How should I store unused cones?
    Leave them in their original packaging until you need them, and keep that pack somewhere dry and out of direct sunlight. If you pre-pack a few, you can stand them upright in small accessory jars or containers so they don’t get crushed before showtime.

These king size VIBES Ultra Thin Cones are made for smokers who care more about fresh flower flavor than paper and want an easy, repeatable setup. They’re ideal if you’re the friend who always brings the pre-rolls, if you host regular smoke nights, or if you just hate hand-rolling but still want that joint-style experience. Pair them with a solid grinder and a clean smoke shop accessory setup and you’re dialed.

How to use it

Using these cones is straightforward: gently load your ground flower into the open end, tap or shake the cone to settle it, then use a small tool to lightly pack as you go. Once it’s filled to your liking, twist the tip closed and you’re ready for a long, slow-burning joint.

For less mess, set your cones and flower over a dab mat or tray so any spills stay contained instead of rolling off the coffee table. Take your time with the pack — too loose and it’ll run, too tight and it won’t pull how you want.

This box is built around consistency and flavor. All 90 cones are the same king size format with an ultra thin paper that stays out of the way of your flower. Because they’re pre-rolled, the crutch/filter is already in place, the taper is uniform, and you get a reliable shape every time — you just bring the material.

FAQ

  • How much can each VIBES King Size rice cone hold?
    Each king size cone is designed to hold roughly 1 gram of ground flower comfortably. You can pack a little less if you want shorter seshes, but 1 gram is where they really feel balanced in terms of airflow and burn.

    Yes. Rice paper is thinner and tends to burn slower and cleaner than a lot of hemp papers, which is why people reach for these when they want to stretch a smoke and really taste their flower. If you’re used to standard cones, you’ll notice the difference in how long these hang around.
  • Are the cones already tipped, or do I need to add filters?
    They come pre-rolled with tips built in, so you don’t need separate filter papers or crutches. Just load them up. If you’re packing several at once, a small funnel or packing tool from your usual accessories setup can make the job even faster.

For rolled and filled cones, a small jar or tube works great; plenty of people repurpose empty glass jars for this.

    Rice papers are usually thinner, so you’ll want to treat them with a bit more care than thick, chalky papers. Handle from the tip end when loading, don’t over-cram the top, and they’ll hold up fine. The pre-rolled shape helps a lot — the tricky folding work is already done.
  • Will these work if my flower is a little sticky?
    Yes, as long as your grind is even. Very sticky flower can clump, which affects how evenly the cone burns, so a solid grind is key.   • How do I keep the burn even and avoid canoeing?
    Most of that comes down to packing. Aim for a firm but not rock-hard fill from tip to top so airflow stays consistent. Avoid big chunks or stems that can poke the paper. When you’re packing a bunch in a row for a session, using a clean loading area like you would when setting up nectar collectors and other gear helps you see and remove any odd pieces before they go into the cone.

Let the piece cool completely before cleaning. Dump out the old water, then wipe or rinse away loose residue. Regular quick rinses will keep the flavor fresher and the glass looking clear.

  • Is this a dry pipe or does it need water?

    Add just enough water to cover the diffusion openings inside the chamber, then test a pull without lighting anything. If you’re getting water near your mouth, pour a little out until the bubbling feels comfortable and controlled.

"Made in Oregon, USA" usually means better quality control, more consistent joints and welds, and the peace of mind that you’re supporting real artists instead of mass-produced mystery glass.
  • Is this better than a big bong for filtration?
    It’s different. Bigger bongs give you more volume and sometimes more percs, but they’re bulkier and not as easy to stash. This sidecar bubbler is about balance: smoother than a dry spoon, more compact than a big tube, and easier to clean than a multi-chamber setup. If you want something you can hand around without overthinking it, this fits that lane nicely.
  • What should I store it with when I’m not using it?
    Once it’s empty and dry, keep it in a safe spot away from edges and traffic. A lot of people like to keep all their glass, flower, and tools together with jars, bags, and other options from our storage & packaging collection so nothing gets lost or knocked over.

Designed and made in Oregon, this sidecar-style piece keeps heat away from your face while the 7-inch (178mm) length gives you a solid, balanced feel in hand. It’s the kind of dry piece you buy once and keep in rotation for years.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Cooler, more relaxed draws — the sidecar mouthpiece sits off to the side, so you’re not hovering right over a hot bowl
  • Feels substantial, not flimsy — 7 inches (178mm) of solid glass gives you control without feeling bulky
  • Crafted in Oregon — you’re supporting true American-made glass, not mass-produced mystery imports
  • Clean flavor from glass — no weird tastes, just your flower doing its thing
  • Easy to grip and pass — sidecar design helps keep the bowl upright when you’re handing it around
  • Display-worthy — each piece brings that artisanal, small-batch vibe to your stash

Best For

This 7" Dry Sidecar is made for smokers who already went through a few cheap spoons and are ready for something with real character. If you like the simplicity of a dry pipe but want a little more comfort and style than a basic bowl, this fits right in next to your other favorite smoke shop products. It’s also a solid choice for anyone who prefers American-made glass and wants a daily driver that still looks good on the coffee table.

How to Use It

This piece works just like a standard dry hand pipe, but the sidecar layout changes the feel in a good way. The bowl sits out front while the mouthpiece is kicked off to the side, so the heat and any stray ash are farther from your face. That offset angle also makes it a little easier to see what you’re doing while you’re working the bowl, especially when you’re mid-sesh and not trying to think too hard.

Between rips, you can rest it gently on a flat surface and the sidecar helps keep the mouthpiece elevated. A lot of people like to park it on a dab mat or small pad so any ash or herb crumbs don’t end up welded to the table. When things get dirty, a quick soak and rinse brings the glass back to clear.

Function-wise, this is a straightforward dry piece: you get that instant, no-water drag with direct flavor from your flower. The longer 7" body gives the smoke a little more distance to travel compared to a tiny pocket spoon, which helps knock the edge off the heat. The sidecar mouthpiece also shifts your hand position, so it feels more natural if you like to relax your wrist instead of holding something straight out.

Because it’s glass, you don’t have to worry about off-flavors or weird coatings. If you want to really baby it, you can store it between uses with your other gear or keep it in the same spot you stash your nicer smoking accessories, so it’s always ready when you are.

Length 7 inches (178mm)
Material Glass
Style Sidecar mouthpiece

For deeper cleans when the resin builds up, soak the pipe in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before you use it again. Regular light cleaning keeps the airflow open and the glass looking like new.

    It’s 7 inches (178mm) long, which makes it longer than a typical pocket spoon but still super manageable as a daily hand pipe. That extra length helps with both grip and cooling.

    The sidecar mouthpiece is offset from the bowl, so heat and any stray ash are directed away from your face. It also gives you a more relaxed hand position and can feel more natural to hit than a straight-line pipe.
