The 13.5″ Highway Clear Twin Turbo Straight is a glass bong built for people who actually care how their hits feel, not just how their piece looks. At 13.5 inches (343mm) tall with twin inline percs and an ice pinch, it’s made for flower lovers who want dense clouds that still go down smooth. Clean, clear glass and a sandblasted logo keep it looking sharp while the bridged joint adds real-world durability.

Why It Works

  • Smoother pulls, less throat burn — Dual inline percs break your hit into tons of tiny bubbles, cooling and diffusing it before it ever reaches the ice pinch.
  • Extra chill with ice — Built-in ice pinch lets you stack a few cubes in the neck for seriously frosty hits when you want them.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Thick glass and a bridged joint mean you’re not babying this piece every time it leaves the table.
  • Easy plug-and-play setup — Comes ready with a 14mm flower bowl, so you’re not hunting for parts before your first sesh.
  • Clean, uncluttered style — Clear tubing, straight body, and a crisp sandblasted logo look good on any shelf without screaming for attention.
  • Comfortable height for couch or desk — At 13.5 inches (343mm), it’s tall enough for cool function but not so huge it’s annoying to pass around.

Best For

This piece is made for flower fans who like stacking big bowls but still want silky, filtered hits instead of coughing fits. If your ideal setup is a solid glass bong on a clean dab mat and a jar of fresh nugs on deck, this fits right into that routine. It’s also a strong pick if you want one main tube that can handle solo seshes and group circles without feeling fragile.

How to Use It

Set the Highway Clear Twin Turbo Straight on a flat surface and add water through the mouthpiece or joint until both inline percs are comfortably submerged. You’re aiming for enough water to cover the percs’ slits while still letting them fire freely when you pull.

Drop the included 14mm flower bowl into the joint, grind your herb, and pack the bowl to your usual preference. If you’re in the mood for extra-cold hits, feed a few ice cubes down the neck until they sit on the ice pinch — they’ll cool the smoke as it rises through the tube.

The twin inline percs do the heavy lifting: as you clear the chamber, they chop your hit into smaller bubbles and spread it through the water, which takes the edge off the heat and helps preserve flavor. You’ll feel the difference when you’re a few bowls in and your throat still isn’t wrecked.

When you’re done, let everything cool down. For regular upkeep, empty the water, then give the bong a rinse with isopropyl alcohol and water, and let it dry before the next sesh. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it keeps the percs from getting clogged and messing with your airflow.

Specifications

Height 13.5 inches (343mm)
Material High-quality glass
Percolation Double inline percolators
Joint Size 14mm
Features Ice cube pinch, sandblasted logo, bridged joint

This tube uses a 14mm joint, which plays nice with most standard bowls, ashcatchers, and banger setups in that size. Dump the water after your sesh instead of letting it sit so the percs don’t get gunked up.   • How hard is it to clean the double inline percs?
    It’s easier than it looks. As long as you stay on top of your cleaning, isopropyl alcohol and warm water will keep the percs clear. If you like to keep everything spotless, consider storing your flower in proper glass jars & packaging so it burns cleaner and leaves less residue.
  • Is 13.5 inches too tall for everyday use?

    If you already own 14mm bowls, ashcatchers, or bangers, they should plug right into this piece. Just match the 14mm size and you’re good. If you like to swap between flower and concentrates, having separate pieces stored in labeled storage & packaging makes it easy to grab the right setup.

  • What’s the benefit of the bridged joint?
    The bridged joint adds extra support where the joint meets the body of the bong — basically, the part that takes the most abuse from bowls getting pulled in and out. That reinforcement helps protect against cracks if it gets bumped, so you’re less likely to be explaining a broken joint to your roommate.

The 8″ Color Lip/Base Dewar Recycler Rig is a compact glass oil rig built for dabbers who care about smooth function and clean flavor in a small footprint. At 8 inches (203mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint and slit perc, it’s tuned for daily use—cool, consistent hits without taking over your table. Color accents on the lip and base give it that “this is my piece” look while the Dewar joint keeps things sturdy.

Why it works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Recycler design keeps water and vapor moving, so each pull gets extra cooling and filtration before it hits your lungs.
  • Less splash, more flavor — The bent neck and slit perc work together to cut down on splashback while still letting terps shine.
  • Compact but stable — At 8 inches (203mm), it’s easy to handle and pass, with a weighted base that feels planted on the table.
  • Ready to sesh — Ships with a 14mm 90° banger so you can plug it into your routine right away—no hunting for spare parts.
  • Dewar joint reinforcement — The reinforced joint setup adds strength where rigs usually fail, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the table.
  • Color where it counts — Color lip and base frame the function and make this rig stand out in a sea of clear glass.

Best for

This rig is made for dabbers who run a few seshes a day and want recycler function without going oversized or overly fragile. If you like to keep your setup tight on a tray or dab mat, the 8″ footprint is ideal—enough room for smooth function, not so big that you’re nervous moving it around. It’s also a solid pick if you’re stepping up from a basic straight-tube or mini rig and want to feel what a recycler actually does for flavor and smoothness.

How to use it

Fill the rig so the slit perc is fully covered and the recycler paths have just enough water to pull through without splashing. You want the water to cycle, not flood the top section. Then attach the included 14mm 90° banger to the Dewar joint and you’re good to go with your usual dabbing routine.

As you draw, watch the water pull through the perc, spin up into the upper chamber, and drain back down—that recycling motion is what cools and conditions your vapor. Setting the piece on a stable surface like a tray or a nonslip work pad from our accessories collection helps keep everything steady when you’re mid-sesh or passing it around.

When you’re done, let the banger cool before you move or clean anything. A quick rinse between uses keeps the recycler pathways from getting bogged down, so the function stays snappy instead of sluggish.

Specifications

Height 8 inches (203mm)
Rig Type Glass recycler oil rig
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90 degrees
Joint Style Dewar joint (reinforced)
Perc Type Slit perc
Included Piece 14mm 90° banger
Material Glass

Fit & compatibility

The 14mm 90° joint plays nice with most standard quartz bangers, terp slurpers, and similar nail styles in that size. If you already have a favorite carb cap or set of dab tools, they’ll drop right into your routine with this rig as your new daily driver. Just stick to 14mm male accessories and you’re set.

Care & cleaning

Keep the recycler pathways clear and it’ll function like new for a long time. When it’s cool, empty the water and give the rig a warm rinse. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse well and let it dry completely before you use it again. Regular maintenance keeps the flavor clean and the recycling action crisp.

FAQ

  • What size banger does this rig use?
    This rig uses a 14mm joint at a 90° angle, so any 14mm male banger or nail with that angle should work. If you ever swap to a different style like a slurper or blender, just make sure it’s 14mm and 90° to keep the fit and function dialed.
  • Can I use this with a flower bowl instead of dabs?
    You technically can if you use a 14mm flower slide, but this piece is really tuned as a recycler dab rig. The diffuser and compact chambers are optimized for vapor, not big flower rips—if you mostly smoke flower, you might want to peek at our broader smoke shop products for a more traditional bong.
  • How much water should I put in?
    Fill until the slit perc is covered and then test the pull. You want the water to rise and recycle without hitting your mouth or flooding the upper chamber. If you hear a lot of chugging or feel water creeping up the neck, dump a little out and try again.
  • What’s the advantage of a Dewar joint on this rig?
    The Dewar joint gives the banger extra support by anchoring the joint closer to the body instead of hanging out there on a long arm. That means less stress on the glass if the rig gets nudged, and a sturdier feel overall—especially when you’re using heavier quartz.
  • How do I keep the recycler from clogging?
    Swap the water often, avoid overfilling, and give it a quick rinse after heavier seshes. When things start feeling restricted or tasting off, an isopropyl soak and rinse will clear the recycler arms and perc. For long-term storage, you can keep the rig empty and your concentrates sealed in proper concentrate jars instead of leaving residue sitting inside.
  • Is this a good rig for travel?
    It’s compact enough to pack, but it’s still glass, so treat it like you would any nice piece. If you need something you can really toss in a bag or take on the move, a piece from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup will be way more forgiving in rough situations.
  • How does this compare to a non-recycler rig?
    Versus a standard single-chamber rig, the recycler setup runs the water and vapor through more contact and movement. That usually means cooler pulls, smoother function, and less harshness, especially on back-to-back dabs. If you like long flavor sessions or low-temp-style use, a recycler like this 8″ Dewar rig is a nice upgrade.

  • Comfortable to use — The mouthpiece and overall form are easy to hold when you’re passing it around or running back-to-back dabs.

Best For

This 8" Clear Dual Uptake Recycler is made for dabbers who prioritize smooth function in a small, simple package. If you’re running multiple dabs a day and want something that won’t roast your throat but also doesn’t take over your whole desk, this hits the sweet spot.

It’s also a strong pick if you already have a couple of bigger pieces and want a dedicated concentrate rig that pairs nicely with your favorite dab tools instead of using a giant flower tube for everything.

The Basics: How This Recycler Works

This rig uses a dual uptake recycler design, which means there are two glass tubes pulling water and vapor from the lower chamber back up into the top section while you draw. As you hit it, water and vapor cycle in a loop, repeatedly passing through water instead of going straight from banger to mouthpiece.

That extra circulation helps knock down heat and smooth out the pull, so even decent-sized dabs feel more controlled and less punishing. You also get that satisfying visual of water draining and refilling while you rip it, which makes it pretty fun to sesh with when you’re posted up at your dab pad.

Using it is straightforward: attach the included 14mm banger, add enough water to cover the perc section, and adjust the level until you get a clean, consistent chug without splash. After your sesh, let everything cool down, then wipe off any residue from the joint and banger. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry before you run it again.

  • Watch the recycle — If the water isn’t fully cycling back up the arms, you may be pulling too softly or running too low on water.
  • Keep the recycler pathways clean — A quick rinse after use goes a long way toward keeping the dual uptakes flowing freely so you don’t have to fight drag later.
  • Protect your glass — Set it on a soft surface or a silicone work area and keep it away from hard edges or crowded shelves; recyclers have more glass tubing, so treating it gently matters.

  • How hard is it to clean a recycler like this?
    It’s easier than it looks. Empty the water, add isopropyl alcohol (and a few coarse grains of salt if you like), shake gently, then rinse with warm water until it runs clear. Let it dry before using again. Cleaning regularly keeps the recycler arms clear and the function snappy.
  • Can I use this for flower too?

  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built for regular dabbing, but like any recycler, you don’t want to treat it like a football. With normal handling, careful storage, and cleaning over a sink or padded surface, it’ll hold up just fine to being a daily driver.
  • What should I pair this with for a full concentrate setup?

Many dabbers also like to add nonstick handling options or liners, especially if they’re pressing or staging their own material using gear from our rosin extraction collection, so they can keep their rig clean and their workspace organized.

The fumed egg body gives it that color-shifting, heady look that only gets better the more you sesh with it.

This rig comes ready to rip with a 14mm 90° male banger, so you can drop it straight into your rotation as a daily driver or special-occasion flex piece.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler dabs — The mini matrix perc stacks tons of tiny bubbles, breaking up your vapor so it feels smooth instead of harsh.
  • Heady look without going full gallery-piece prices — Fumed glass gives that shifting gold/blue/amber vibe that evolves as resin builds and you keep it in rotation.
  • Comfortable in the hand — The maria-style neck makes it easy to grab and pass without feeling like you’re going to drop someone’s favorite rig.
  • Stable on the table — The solid "foot" base helps keep it upright so you’re not holding your breath every time someone reaches across the coffee table.
  • Ready out of the box — Includes a 14mm 90° male banger that plays nice with most standard dab tools and setups.
  • Perfect height for flavor — At 8.5 inches (216mm), vapor doesn’t have to travel forever, so you still get those terps without the hit feeling too hot.

Best For

This Fume Exo Egg Rig is made for dabbers who want real function in a rig that actually looks good on a shelf. If you’re running a few seshes a day and want something that can be a true daily driver but still has that “damn, what rig is that?” factor, this checks the box. It’s especially solid for anyone who’s upgrading from a basic beaker or entry-level rig into something with real diffusion and style, but doesn’t want to worry about a big, fragile showpiece.

If your setup already includes a couple durable silicone rigs or bongs, this is a nice step up when you want better flavor and glass feel for your concentrates.

How to Use It

Using the 8.5" Fume Exo Egg Rig is straightforward. Add just enough water to cover the slits/holes on the mini matrix perc—too much and you’ll feel splashback, too little and you’ll lose diffusion. The sweet spot is where the perc is fully submerged, but the neck is still clear.

Once your water level is dialed, attach the included 14mm 90° male banger to the joint. Set the rig on a flat, safe surface—putting it on a nonstick dab mat is a pro move to keep your table clean and protect the base. From there, pair it with your favorite carb cap, heat your banger, and go at your usual pace.

The egg-shaped body and matrix perc will pull the water into a tight, choppy stack of bubbles as you draw, cooling and smoothing your vapor before it hits your lungs. You’ll notice the fume work light up under good lighting, especially when there’s a little bit of reclaim inside giving it that darker depth. Between seshes, let everything cool before handling or cleaning.

Design Details & Function

This rig’s "exo egg" shape isn’t just for looks—it gives extra internal volume for vapor and water to move, without making the rig overly tall or tippy. That means more room for diffusion and less chance of water splashing up the neck.

The mini matrix perc is all about stacking micro-bubbles. More bubbles = more surface area = more cooling and a smoother feel. If you’re used to simple downstem diffusion, you’ll feel the difference in how controlled and soft the pull is on this one.

The maria neck design (those glass rings around the neck) gives your fingers a natural place to grip, making it easier to hold when you’re three dabs deep and trying not to baby a hot banger. The fumed glass will slowly “develop” as resin and time do their thing, so your rig will actually look more unique the longer you own it.

Fit & Compatibility

This rig uses a standard 14mm female joint with a 90° angle, so it plays nicely with most common quartz bangers, thermal bangers, and similar 14mm accessories. If you’ve already got a favorite 14mm nail or banger setup, odds are it will fit right in. Just make sure you’re sticking with 90° pieces rather than 45° styles for the best look and function on this joint.

For storing the concentrates you’re running through this rig, pairing it with proper glass concentrate jars helps keep your terps fresh between seshes.

Care & Cleaning

To keep the fumed glass looking sharp and the perc hitting clean, give it a quick maintenance routine. After it’s fully cooled, empty the old water and rinse with warm water. For deeper cleans, soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, shake gently to break up residue, then rinse thoroughly and let it dry before using again.

To avoid stubborn buildup, try not to leave reclaim-heavy water sitting in the rig for days at a time. A quick refresh every few seshes keeps the matrix perc from getting clogged and preserves that color-shifting fume look.

Pair It With

Want a full, dialed-in dab station around this rig? Set the Fume Exo Egg Rig on a nonstick workspace and keep all your tools together with a few smart add-ons. A sturdy, easy-to-clean surface and the right accessories go a long way when you’re running regular seshes.

If you like rotating between rigs and other devices, you can round out your kit with a few durable options from our general smoke shop products collection—things like torches, storage, and other daily-driver pieces that keep your setup consistent.

FAQ

  1. Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm 90° male banger, so you’re most of the way there. You’ll still want a carb cap, a torch, and a solid dabber—check out our selection of dedicated nectar collectors and straws if you like to mix things up with different concentrate tools.
  2. Will the fumed color fade or wash off?
    No—the fume is part of the glass, not a surface paint or decal. Over time, as resin builds and gets cleaned, the look will shift and deepen, but it won’t just “wash off.” Regular gentle cleaning keeps it looking rich instead of dull.
  3. What kind of bangers or nails can I use with this?
    Any 14mm male accessory designed for a 90° joint should work, including standard buckets, terp slurpers, and thermal bangers. If you’re matching this with other gear, just remember: 14mm size, 90° angle. For flavor and consistency, many dabbers like to pair rigs like this with high-quality quartz and proper carb caps.
  4. Is 8.5 inches big enough for smooth hits?
    Yes—8.5 inches (216mm) is a sweet spot for dab rigs. The mini matrix perc and egg chamber do the heavy lifting for diffusion, so you get plenty of cooling without needing a tall bong-style piece. It’s compact but not cramped, which is ideal for concentrates.
  5. How do I clean the mini matrix perc without damaging it?
    Let the rig cool completely, then empty the water and add some isopropyl alcohol. Cover the openings, gently shake to work the alcohol through the perc, then rinse with warm water and let it air dry. Avoid using anything hard or pokey inside the perc—you don’t need brushes or tools in there.
  6. Can I use this rig for flower too?
    Technically, if you grab a matching 14mm bowl, you could run flower through it, but it’s really designed and shaped for concentrates. If you want a dedicated flower setup, it’s better to keep this for dabs and grab a separate piece or check our storage and packaging options to keep your flower and concentrates separate and fresh.
  7. Is this rig a good option for a first “nice” dab rig?
    Definitely. It’s not so big or delicate that you’ll be scared to actually use it, but it has real heady appeal and solid function. Compared to super-basic starter rigs you’ll find in many shops, the matrix perc and fumed egg body feel like a serious upgrade without requiring any special technique to enjoy.

FAQ

  • Does the 10" Fume Wrap and Rake Venetian Beaker come with a bowl?

    Fuming is when the artist uses metals like silver or gold in the flame so the glass takes on color-shifting, iridescent tones. The 12" Color Lip 9mm Thick Straight is a classic straight-tube glass bong built for smokers who want a simple, hard-hitting daily driver that doesn’t feel fragile. At 12 inches (305mm) tall with seriously thick 9mm glass, it’s made to handle regular use and the occasional bump without freaking you out. The clean straight design and colored lip give you that timeless look with just enough personality.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Built like a tank — 9mm thick glass gives this piece real heft, so it feels solid in your hand and less likely to chip from casual knocks.
  • Straight-to-the-point hits — the 12" (305mm) straight tube gives you a direct, powerful pull with enough length for the smoke to cool down before it gets to you.
  • Stays upright — the 50mm wide base helps keep it planted on the table so you’re not holding your breath every time someone reaches across the coffee table.
  • Easy to keep clean — no crazy percs or tight bends, just a straight shot that’s simple to rinse, soak, and get looking brand new again.
  • Clean flavor — simple water filtration means you taste more of your flower and less of stale resin trapped in hard-to-reach chambers.
  • Looks good on the shelf — the colored lip adds a subtle pop of color without turning it into some wild novelty piece.

Best For

This bong is made for people who want a reliable daily driver that hits hard and doesn’t require babying. If you’re the friend who always has the "house bong" out for smoke-and-chill nights, or you just like something straightforward that rips, this fits perfectly. It’s also a strong pick if you’ve cracked thinner glass in the past and are ready to upgrade to something with legit weight and durability over fragile, over-perced setups.

How to Use It

Usage is as simple as it gets with a straight tube. Add water so that the end of your downstem is comfortably submerged, then leave a bit of extra room so you’re not getting backsplash when you clear the chamber. Keep it on a flat, stable surface during your sesh—something like a dedicated dab mat or pad under it adds grip and catches any stray ash or water drops.

From there, you’re just packing your bowl, adjusting your water level to your preference, and letting the 12" of chamber give your smoke a second to cool off before it reaches you. Because there’s no complicated perc stack, the pull stays open and easy, even when it’s a bit resin’d up.

Cleaning is straightforward: let the piece cool down, empty the water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol and some coarse salt if you like. Cover the openings, swish, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before the next sesh. For people who hate deep-clean days, the simplicity here is a big win.

Specifications

Height 12 inches (305mm)
Glass Thickness 9mm
Base Width 50mm

Fit & Compatibility

The 12" Color Lip 9mm Thick Straight is designed around standard glass setups, so it plays nicely with common bowls and downstems. To get the best function, match your downstem and bowl sizes correctly—if you’re swapping parts from other pieces, double-check your joint sizes before forcing anything. If you’re dialing in a full kit, it pairs smoothly with basic sliders, herb bowls, and even adapters, so you can set it up the way you like.

If you’re building out a whole station, it works great alongside a few extra dab tools and accessories so everything lives in one place at your table.

The Basics of Straight Tube Function

Straight tube bongs are the workhorses of glass. The idea is simple: smoke moves from your bowl into the water at the bottom, bubbles up through, and then travels in a straight line up the neck to you. Fewer corners and percs mean less drag and easier clearing, which a lot of people prefer over super-complex rigs.

With 9mm glass and a 12" height, this piece balances function and durability—you get a direct, satisfying hit with enough volume in the tube to cool and stack smoke, without feeling like you’re lugging around an oversized tower.

If you keep it on a shelf or desk, you’ll notice it’s the one that quietly becomes the "always ready" option, while the more complicated stuff comes out only when you feel like babysitting it.

FAQ

  • Does this bong come with a bowl and downstem?
    The description here focuses on the bong itself; check the product listing details or images to see what’s included. If you need to complete the setup, it’s easy to add a matching bowl and downstem from your usual smoke shop accessories lineup.
  • What joint size does it use?
    The listing doesn’t specify the exact joint size, so if you’re planning to use a specific bowl or downstem, verify sizing before you pair it up. Most straight tubes in this style use common joint sizes, but always match glass-to-glass properly—no forcing pieces together.
  • Is 9mm glass really that much stronger?
    Compared to the more common 3–5mm glass, 9mm feels noticeably thicker and heavier in hand. That extra thickness helps with resistance to minor bumps and accidental taps on the sink or table. It’s still glass—so treat it with respect—but it’s a meaningful upgrade if you’ve broken thin pieces before.
  • How should I clean and maintain it?
    Let the bong cool down after use, dump the old water, then rinse with warm water. For deeper cleaning, soak or shake with isopropyl alcohol (and optional coarse salt), rinse thoroughly, and let it air dry. If you’re handling concentrates too, keeping a few clean concentrate jars nearby helps keep sticky stuff off the glass.
  • Is this a good piece for beginners?
    Yes—straight tubes are very beginner-friendly. There’s no complicated airflow to figure out and no maze of percs to clog. If you’re new to glass or upgrading from a tiny handheld pipe, this offers a clean, predictable experience that still feels "big bong" enough for serious rips.
  • How does it compare to percolator bongs?
    Perc bongs can add extra diffusion, but they also add drag and more places for resin to build up. This straight tube keeps airflow more open and is way easier to clean. If you like simple, strong function, this style usually wins out over multi-chamber science projects. If you want something totally different for travel or outdoor use, check out unbreakable styles like silicone bongs & rigs.
  • Can I use this with ice?
    The description doesn’t call out an ice pinch, so assume it’s designed as a standard straight tube unless you see one in the photos. Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Recycler function keeps water circulating so vapor is cooled and filtered multiple times before it hits your lungs.
  • Flavor-focused hits — Short vapor path and tight function help you taste your concentrate instead of just feeling the burn.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Comes with a 14mm male banger so you don’t have to hunt for a matching piece on day one.

Best For

If you’ve already got a solid collection of dab tools and just need a better rig to bring the whole setup together, this checks the box.

How to Use It

Set up is simple: fill the main chamber with enough water to cover the perc section, but not so much that it splashes into the neck when you pull. The recycler loops are designed to cycle that water and vapor together, creating that signature whirlpool effect while you draw.

The 90° 14mm joint holds the included banger at a comfortable angle, keeping it level and making it easy to see what you’re doing while you heat and cap. Drop it on a dab mat to catch any stray drips and keep your table clean.

Once everything’s cooled down after your sesh, you’ll get the best long-term performance by giving the rig a quick rinse regularly so reclaim and residue don’t clog the recycler paths. Let it cool, then a little isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry goes a long way.

The Basics of Recycler Function

Recycler rigs like this Encore Bread & Butter are built to keep water and vapor in motion instead of just bubbling straight up and out. As you pull, vapor moves from the banger into the main chamber, then up through an internal passage where water and vapor are drawn together and dropped back down repeatedly.

That constant circulation gives you a few perks: better cooling, smoother hits, and less splashback because the design keeps most of the water looping low instead of shooting up the neck. When a recycler is tuned right, you’ll notice you can pull a little longer and a little harder without getting cooked.

Care & Cleaning

To keep the recycler function smooth, avoid letting reclaim build up too heavily in the return lines and internal passages. When you’re done for the night, empty the water, let everything cool, then rinse with isopropyl alcohol, flush with warm water, and let it dry fully before the next use.

The 10″ Color Accent Tree Beaker is a compact glass bong built for people who want smoother, cooler rips in a piece that still looks good sitting on the table. At 10 inches (254mm) tall with a beaker base and internal tree perc, it balances solid function with easy handling, making it a killer daily driver that doesn’t eat up your whole shelf.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, less harsh hits — The built-in tree perc breaks smoke into smaller bubbles, giving you noticeably softer pulls.
  • Stable and spill-resistant — Wide beaker base keeps it planted, so a bump or clumsy pass-around is less likely to send it flying.
  • Compact but not tiny — 10 inches (254mm) is tall enough for real cooling, short enough to stash or travel with.
  • Color accents that pop — The colored sections give it personality without turning it into a gimmick piece.
  • Easy to live with — Straightforward beaker design is much easier to clean than some crazy multi-chamber science project.
  • Great function for the price — You’re getting a perc’d glass beaker without paying "art glass" money.

Best For

This 10″ Color Accent Tree Beaker is made for smokers who want real water filtration and percolation but don’t want to baby a huge, fragile showpiece. If your bong lives on the coffee table and sees multiple seshes a day, this is that dependable daily driver that still has enough style to feel special when friends come over. It also pairs nicely with other low-maintenance gear like our durable silicone pipes if you like to keep a backup piece around.

How to Use It

Setup is simple: add water through the mouthpiece until the tree perc is comfortably submerged but not drowning. You’re aiming for enough water to cover the perc slits while still letting bubbles move freely. Too little and you lose filtration, too much and it feels like you’re drinking the bong.

Drop in your bowl, attach it to the joint, and you’re ready to go. Take a couple of test pulls (without lighting anything) to check the water level and make sure you’re not getting any splashback up the neck. When it’s dialed, you’ll feel smooth airflow and see the tree perc stacking bubbles cleanly.

Between runs, parking the beaker on a dab mat or tray keeps resin rings and little water drips off your table, which your roommates or partner will quietly appreciate.

Keeping It Clean

The nice thing about a piece this size is that cleaning doesn’t turn into a chore. Let everything cool down, then empty the water and give it a quick rinse with warm water to knock loose anything floating around. For deeper cleans, add isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, give it a gentle shake, then rinse well with clean water and let it dry before your next sesh.

If you’re the type who likes to swap fresh bowls often, having a couple of backup slides in your kit with your other accessories makes life easier when this one gets gunked up mid-sesh.

Perc Type Tree perc

This piece is designed around standard glass bong sizing, so it plays well with most common bowls and downstems. If you already have a stack of spare bowls from other smoke shop products, there’s a good chance they’ll feel right at home on this beaker.

FAQ

    Tree percs are internal glass, so you’ll want to avoid super aggressive shaking or dropping anything into the neck. When cleaning, swirl your alcohol and water mix gently instead of going wild with it. The tradeoff for that smooth diffusion is treating the perc with a bit of respect.

  4. Is this good for everyday use or just special occasions?

    This piece is absolutely built to be a daily driver. The beaker base adds stability, the perc gives you smooth function, and the 10-inch height keeps it manageable for constant use. If you want a backup piece for more rugged situations, you can always grab something from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup and save the tree beaker for home.

    Swap out the water regularly and give it a quick rinse after heavy use so buildup doesn’t have time to bake on. When it starts to look hazy or stained, a soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry will usually bring the glass back to clear. If you’re handling concentrates, keeping your products in clean concentrate jars helps cut down on sticky messes around the bong area too.

    The main difference you’ll feel is how much smoother and more refined the hit is. A basic beaker relies on one water chamber and simple diffusion; adding a tree perc stacks another layer of filtration inside the bong. You still get that familiar beaker chug, just with added cooling and a little more visual action in the chamber when you clear it.

Pick the joint that matches your rig (10mm or 14mm female), slide the banger in, and make sure the bucket sits level so concentrates can spread out evenly. When you’re done, let the quartz cool down before you wipe it out or hit it with any cleaner.

For a cleaner station, park the banger on a dab mat between hits so you’re not setting hot quartz directly on your table. And if you’re swapping between rigs mid-sesh, give the joint a quick check each time so everything seats snug and airtight.

If you’re building out a full dab setup, you can pair it with dedicated dab tools and dabbers so you’re not scraping quartz with whatever metal object is closest.

Let the banger cool before cleaning so you don’t shock the quartz. Wipe out any leftover residue with a cotton swab, and for deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry fully before the next heat cycle.   • How do I clean the terp pillar and marble?

The 8.5" ENCORE FLOATING TREE RIG is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate fans who want smooth, flavorful hits without babysitting a wobbly piece. Its fused floating tree perc stacks bubbles hard for cleaner, cooler vapor, while the footed can-style base keeps everything planted on the table. At 8.5 inches (216mm) tall with a 14mm 90° joint and included banger, it’s ready to step in as a true daily driver.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler dabs — The fused floating tree perc breaks vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, giving it more time in the water for smoother pulls.
  • Less spill anxiety — Footed can base gives you a wide, stable footprint so a casual elbow bump doesn’t instantly equal heartbreak.
  • Comfortable posture — Bent neck keeps your face back from the heat and puts the mouthpiece right where you want it when you’re mid-sesh.
  • Dialed for concentrates — 14mm 90° joint with a matching banger means you’re set up out of the box for oils and dabs.
  • Clean flavor — Simple glass pathway with a single main perc lets your terps shine without feeling over-diffused or harsh.
  • Looks as good as it rips — The “floating” tree perc design adds some visual drama every time you pull and watch the stack climb.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a legit upgrade from a basic mini rig, but don’t want to jump into giant, hard-to-clean pieces. It’s especially nice if you’re running 2–6 dabs a day and want consistent function without fiddling with multiple percs or recyclers. If your setup already includes a solid dab mat and a couple favorite flavors, this is the kind of rig that can sit center stage on your desk or coffee table.

How to Use It

Drop your water level just above the slits on the floating tree perc so you get fast stacking without any splash back up the neck. Too little water and you’ll lose that signature chug; too much and you’ll start kissing water on hard pulls.

Pop the included 14mm 90° banger into the joint, warm it up, and let it settle into your comfort zone before introducing your concentrate. The bent neck keeps your face angled away from the hot banger while still giving you a direct, unrestricted pull.

Between dabs, it’s a good idea to park your rig on a nonstick surface so any stray reclaim, tools, or caps don’t glue themselves to your table — a dedicated work surface like our silicone-safe smoke shop accessories setup makes that whole area easier to keep clean.

The Basics of the Floating Tree Perc

The “floating” tree perc sits suspended inside the can, with multiple arms that each have diffusion cuts at the bottom. When you pull, air and vapor are forced down through these cuts, breaking everything into smaller bubbles.

Because the perc is fused and centered, you get even diffusion and a really satisfying visual as the bubbles climb up the tree. No extra chambers, no crazy maze for the vapor to get stuck in — just straightforward diffusion that hits the sweet spot between smooth and flavorful.

Height 8.5 inches (216mm)
Material Glass
Joint Size & Angle 14mm, 90°
Included Nail 14mm 90° banger
Perc Type Fused floating tree perc

The 8.5" ENCORE FLOATING TREE RIG uses a standard 14mm 90° female joint, so it plays nice with most common 14mm male bangers, terp slurpers, and nails. If you’re rotating multiple flavors or styles, having a few extra options in your drawer plus proper concentrate jars makes swapping things in and out painless.

Because of the compact height, this rig pairs best with reasonably sized bangers and caps. Oversized, super-heavy quartz won’t break it, but can feel a bit top-heavy on a smaller can, so just be mindful of weight when you’re loading up the joint.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you even think about cleaning. Once everything’s at room temp, you can wipe out the banger and empty the water from the main can.

For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a fresh water rinse and full dry will keep the glass clear and the perc flowing. If you want to baby that banger or keep reclaim from spreading everywhere, it helps to keep some nonstick options on hand, like liners or sheets from our parchment papers lineup.

FAQ

Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?

It comes with the rig itself and a 14mm 90° banger, so the core setup is covered. You’ll still want your favorite concentrates, a torch or compatible heat source, and at least one dabber from a proper dab tools kit to handle your material cleanly.

Will this fit my other 14mm bangers and nails?

Yes, the rig uses a standard 14mm 90° female joint, so any 14mm male 90° banger or nail should fit. If you’re using angled or oversized specialty pieces, just keep an eye on balance so you’re not risking a tip-over.

How much water should I put in it?

Fill until the water level sits just over the diffusion cuts on the tree perc. That’s usually the sweet spot where you get full perc action without any water climbing the neck. You can tweak slightly up or down depending on how hard you like to pull.

Is this a good rig for beginners?

Definitely. It’s simple to use, easy to understand, and not overly fragile or complicated. If you’re just getting into dabs and want something a step up from a tiny travel piece, this is a solid daily driver that won’t overwhelm you like some giant multi-perc rigs.

How hard is it to clean the floating tree perc?

Because there’s a single main perc and a relatively open can, it’s easier to clean than stacked or multi-chamber rigs. A bit of isopropyl and a good shake usually clears the tree; if you’re working with especially sticky material, keeping your workspace and storage dialed with proper storage & packaging can cut down on the amount of reclaim that ends up in the rig to begin with.

Can I use this rig for flower with a bowl piece?

Technically you can slap a 14mm bowl on it, but it’s built and balanced for concentrates. If you’re mostly burning flower, you’ll probably be happier with a dedicated piece or something from our more general silicone bongs & rigs lineup that’s designed to handle bigger, hotter bowls.

What makes this better than a super tiny mini rig?

The 8.5" height gives the vapor more travel time, and the floating tree perc adds way more diffusion than you usually get in micro pieces. That means cooler, smoother hits, especially on slightly larger dabs, while still keeping the rig small enough to stash on a desk or shelf without taking over your whole space.

Between the bent neck, cone drain recycler function, and tight showerhead diffusion, it’s built to keep water out of your mouth and terps in your hit.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The built-in showerhead perc breaks the vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, giving it more time to cool before it reaches you.
  • No surprise splashback — The bent neck plus recycler design keeps the water cycling in the body of the rig instead of rushing up toward your mouth.
  • Flavor over harshness — The compact 6 inch (152mm) profile and close diffusion mean the vapor doesn’t have time to go stale, so you taste more of your concentrate and less hot air.
  • Efficient recycling action — The cone drain recycler pulls water up and drops it back down in a loop, which helps maintain consistent function hit after hit.
  • Comfortable 90° setup — The 90° joint lines up perfectly with most bangers, keeping the hot side away from your face and your rig balanced on the table.
  • Full-color style — Multiple color options let you match your rig to your favorite banger, carb cap, or tray instead of settling for plain clear glass.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a compact recycler that can realistically be their daily driver, not just a shelf piece. If you already have a dedicated dab mat and a few bangers in rotation but want a smoother, more controlled hit than a basic mini rig, this fits that lane perfectly.

It’s especially nice for people who take multiple smaller dabs instead of one giant one — the recycler function and showerhead perc shine when you’re running flavorful, lower-volume pulls and actually paying attention to the function.

How to Use It

Set the 6″ Cone Drain Recycler on a stable surface, then add water through the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is fully covered and you can see it percolate evenly when you pull. You’re aiming for enough water to activate the perc and recycler without flooding the neck or splashing up toward the mouthpiece.

Attach your 14mm banger to the 90° joint and seat it snugly. Once everything is in place, you can heat your banger with your normal routine and watch how the recycler pulls water up and drains it back down while you pull. If you like to swap between rigs, it’s easy to keep this one in the rotation with your other silicone bongs and rigs thanks to the standard joint size and angle.

When you’re done, let the rig cool off before dumping and refreshing the water. Keeping fresh water in recyclers helps maintain flavor and keeps that satisfying vortex clear and visible.

The included banger gives you a clean starting point, and you can upgrade later if you want to dial in your perfect combo.

The Basics of Recycler Function

Recycler rigs like this cone drain are built to keep water and vapor moving in a loop. As you pull, water is drawn up through the internal recycler tubes, cools and filters your vapor, then drains back down into the base — over and over during your hit.

This does a couple of things you can actually feel: it helps prevent water from stacking too high in the main chamber, reduces splashback, and keeps the water fresh and moving instead of just sitting there. When you’ve got a good recycler paired with the right concentrates stored in proper concentrate jars, you’ll notice more flavor and less harsh edge, especially on back-to-back dabs.

Care & Cleaning

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you mess with them. Once everything is at room temp, empty the old water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol to the rig, plug the openings, and gently shake to loosen residue. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before your next sesh.

For the banger, let it cool, then wipe off any loose residue. When it needs a deeper reset, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse keeps it ready to go. Keeping your glass clean not only looks better, it helps your recycler function properly so the cone drain actually drains the way it’s supposed to.

  • What type of carb cap works best with this rig?
    Most standard caps will work as long as they match your banger style. Directional and bubble caps are popular choices for rigs this size, and you can explore different styles in our carb caps collection if you want to really dial in airflow and spin.
  • How do I fill the water to the right level?
    Add water slowly through the mouthpiece or joint until the showerhead perc is covered and you see good bubbling without water climbing too high. If you’re tuning in for competition-style dabs, running back-to-back pulls with friends, or building a dedicated dab station around a favorite rig, this piece belongs in that rotation. How to use it

Pop the 10mm male joint into any rig with a 10mm female joint at a 90° angle and you’re set. The extended 240mm (9.45 inches) length gives you extra room to work, so you can cap, spin, and watch the pillar do its thing without crowding the mouthpiece or your face.

As you dab, the slurper design, whistle pillar, and marble work together to keep concentrates moving and evenly exposed to heat. You’ll feel the airflow smooth out thanks to the three slits, and you can fine-tune that feel by the way you cap and pull. The 10″ Encore Honeycomb to Turbine Bong is a compact glass water pipe built for flower smokers who want big-rig diffusion in a smaller footprint. At 10 inches (254mm) tall with a 14mm joint and included flower bowl, it’s a ready-to-go daily driver that stacks bubbles hard without taking over your whole coffee table. The honeycomb-to-turbine perc combo is all about smoother, cooler hits and less drag, so you can rip it comfortably without feeling like you’re pulling through a straw.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Honeycomb and turbine percs work together to shred and spin your smoke through water for serious diffusion.
  • Less splash, more flavor — Built-in splash guard and smart waterline keep the function high and the bong water out of your mouth.
  • Compact but powerful — 10 inches (254mm) tall means plenty of cooling without needing a giant, fragile tower on your shelf.
  • Comfortable pull — The straight tube and well-matched perc stack keep drag in check, so clearing the chamber feels easy.
  • Stays upright, even on crowded tables — Stable base and bridged joint help prevent tip-overs when somebody bumps the table.
  • Ready out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm flower bowl, so you’re not hunting around for spare glass just to use it.
  • Clean look with personality — Accent colors give it some character without getting loud or gimmicky.

Best For

This piece is made for flower heads who want more than a basic straight tube but don’t need some giant, multi-chamber science project. If you’re the type who has a few bowls after work and wants smooth hits without coughing up a lung, this honeycomb-to-turbine stack will feel like a nice upgrade. It also fits in nicely with a compact setup on a dab mat so your glass, lighter, and grinder all stay in one clean zone.

How to Use It

Using the Encore Honeycomb to Turbine Bong is pretty intuitive. Add enough water so the honeycomb perc is just covered and the turbine section has room to spin the bubbles without splashing up into the mouthpiece. Too little water and you won’t get full diffusion; too much and you’ll mute the function and risk splashback.

Once it’s filled, pack your dry herb into the included 14mm flower bowl and drop it in the joint. As you pull, smoke will first hit the honeycomb perc — that flat, disc-style section with multiple small holes that break your hit into tons of tiny bubbles. Then it moves up through the turbine perc, where angled slits whip the water into a spinning vortex that cools things even more while keeping the hit surprisingly smooth and airy.

Between the dual percs and splash guard, you get dense, cooled smoke and a satisfying chug without water shooting up into your mouth. When you’re done, clear the chamber and let the bong fully cool before dumping the water and doing any cleaning.

Fit & Compatibility

If you ever want to swap bowls or add a pre-cooler, just make sure it’s 14mm and you’re good. For storing your flower nearby without drying it out, keep a small stash in dedicated glass jars so you’re not constantly opening big containers just for a bowl or two.

Cleaning & Care

Let the glass cool before you try to clean it. Dump the old water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol and gently shake to loosen resin from the percs and walls; for deeper cleans, a short soak in alcohol works well. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before your next use so you’re not tasting leftover cleaner instead of your flower.

If you like to keep your station extra tidy, pairing this piece with a few simple smoke shop accessories like brushes or plugs makes it easier to keep everything spotless between deeper cleans.

FAQ

  • Q: How big is this bong really? Will it fit on my desk or shelf?

    A: It stands 10 inches (254mm) tall, so it’s compact enough for a small desk or shelf but still has enough height for good cooling and function. It’s a nice middle ground between a tiny travel piece and a full-size tower.

  • Q: What joint size and bowl does it use?

    A: This bong has a 14mm female joint and comes with a 14mm male flower bowl out of the box. If you’ve got other 14mm bowls from your other pieces or smoke shop gear, they should work just fine here too.

  • Q: Can I use this with concentrates?

    A: It’s sold as a flower bong and comes with a flower bowl, but if you have a 14mm banger or nail you like, you can absolutely run light dab duty through it. Just remember it’s designed as a bong, so if you’re a heavy dabber, you might eventually want a dedicated rig from our silicone bongs & rigs for more heat resistance and easier cleanup.

  • Q: Is the honeycomb-to-turbine combo hard to clean?

    A: The percs have some detail, but regular rinsing and an alcohol soak keep them clear. If you don’t let resin build up forever, you won’t have to fight it later. Swirl the alcohol around and let it soak long enough to loosen residue, then rinse well with warm water.

  • Q: Is this a good choice for beginners?

    A: If you’re brand new to bongs, the dual perc setup might feel like a small step up in complexity, but in practice it’s still really straightforward. Fill to the right level, pack the bowl lightly, and you’ll get smooth, forgiving hits. If you’re coming from a simple straight tube or spoon pipe, this will feel like a big upgrade in smoothness.

  • Q: How careful do I need to be with the glass?

    A: It’s a glass piece, so you still want to treat it like something you don’t want to bump off the table. The bridged joint and compact height help with durability, but it’s best to set it on a soft surface or dedicated resting spot when you’re not using it, especially if you share a space with pets or clumsy roommates.

  • Q: What’s the main difference between this and a basic single-perc bong?

    A: The big upgrade is the way the hit feels. A basic single-perc piece will cool your smoke, but the honeycomb-to-turbine stack here really breaks it down and spins it, which smooths out harshness and gives you a dense but less scratchy pull. If you like flavor and smoother hits without having to go super tall, this combo hits that sweet spot.

Fill the base with just enough water to cover the percs in the lower chamber, then give it a test pull (no heat, no concentrate) to make sure it recycles smoothly without pulling water into your mouth.   • Way less splashback — Kickback design and carefully placed recycler loop keep water low and vapor high, so you’re not kissing the reservoir every hit.

Drop the included 14mm 90° Dewar banger into the joint, heat and cool it to your preferred style, then introduce your concentrate and pull steadily. As you inhale, water is pulled up the single uptake, then drains back down into the base, giving you that endless swirl and keeping vapor in contact with fresh water each time. When you’re done, park your tool and any leftover material in proper concentrate jars instead of leaving sticky stuff on the table.

If you like to switch between rigs, this one’s easy to keep in rotation: the clear glass lets you see when it’s time for a rinse, and the simple recycler pathway is way easier to keep clean than those crazy multi-arm designs.

Best For

This banger is made for dabbers who already have their setup mostly dialed and are now upgrading the last critical piece: the quartz. If you’re running multiple dabs a day, swapping flavors, and actually paying attention to how your rig functions, this is the lane you’re in. It also plays especially well with durable silicone rigs and bongs when you want a travel-friendly but still high-performance setup.

If you’re more of a “one dab every few days” person or rough on glass, this is probably overkill. But if you’re chasing consistency and you notice the difference between mid and top-tier quartz, this Competition Banger makes sense.

How to use it

Drop the 14mm male joint into any rig or water pipe with a 14mm female, 90° joint. Make sure the banger sits level so concentrates stay centered in the base instead of running to one side.

Use a proper dabber from our dab tools collection so you can keep your hands away from the hot quartz and place concentrates exactly where you want them. The marble is designed to cap the top and work with the whistle pillar and slits to push airflow; just set it in place and let the design do its thing.

Set your rig on a nonstick surface like a dab mat if you’re the type to multitask or pass the rig around the room—nobody likes reclaim all over the table. After your sesh, let the banger cool down before you touch or clean it.

For regular upkeep, a quick wipe after use goes a long way. When you want it looking fresh again, let it cool, then use a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before the next run.

Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°
Total Length 9.5 inches (240mm)

The extended 240mm length gives you more space away from the body of the rig, which helps with heat control and keeps torches and hot quartz a little further from your face and glass. Just make sure your rig has enough clearance so the end of the banger doesn’t bump into the base or table.

What You Get

  • 1 × 14M 90° 240MM Competition Banger (quartz)
  • Integrated whistle pillar design
  • Marble included for airflow and function

Why quartz for competition-style dabs?

Quartz is the go-to for dabbers who actually care about flavor and repeatability. It heats predictably, cools in a consistent curve, and won’t add taste or color to your concentrates. That’s why serious dabbers and many comp-style setups lean heavily toward high-quality quartz instead of generic glass or mystery materials.

If you’re dialing in for rosin or premium hydrocarbon extracts, pairing good quartz with quality concentrates and proper handling tools from our rosin extraction gear helps keep your terps and textures where they should be—on your tongue, not stuck in the equipment.

Care & Cleaning

Let the banger cool down fully before touching, wiping, or soaking it—thermal shock is how pieces crack. Once it’s back to room temp, you can wipe away fresh residue with a cotton swab or cloth.

For deeper refreshes, soak the banger in isopropyl alcohol for a bit, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before reheating. Avoid scraping aggressively with metal tools, especially around the slits and pillar, so you don’t scratch or stress the quartz.

  • Will this fit my rig?

  • How do I clean the slits and pillar without damaging them?
    Let the banger cool, then soak in isopropyl alcohol to loosen residue. Rinse with warm water and use soft swabs or cloths—no scraping or prying—so you don’t chip the edges or scratch the quartz.
  • Is this overkill for a beginner?
    If you’re totally new to dabbing, this might be more than you need starting out, but it’s not hard to use. Think of it as buying once and not having to upgrade later. Pairing it with sturdy pieces from our accessories collection can make your whole setup feel more put-together.
  • How fragile is it compared to a standard banger?
    Quartz is tough for glass, especially at this quality level, but it’s still glass. It’ll handle heat cycling very well, but drops onto hard floors or banging it against other pieces can still crack or chip it, especially around the joint and slits.
  • What’s the benefit of the 240mm length?
    The extra length gives you a more spread-out heat zone and keeps the hot end of the banger further from your rig, hands, and face. It also creates more room to work when you’re loading dabs or using directional caps and marbles, similar to the way longer nectar collectors offer more control.

Standing at 10 inches (254mm) with a 14mm joint and classic beaker base, it balances daily-driver function with heady fumed color work that actually looks good on the table.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Built-in ice pinch lets you stack cubes in the neck for noticeably chilled hits when you want to turn the temp down.
  • Comfortable, couch-friendly angle — Bent neck brings the mouthpiece to you so you’re not hovering over the table or craning your neck every time you clear it.
  • Stable beaker base — Wide beaker bottom keeps it planted during pass-arounds, so you’re not stressing about easy tip-overs on a cluttered coffee table.
  • Fumed glass that actually pops — Fume work and color wrap give it that shifting, iridescent look that changes with lighting and use, so it gets more character over time.
  • Plays nice with standard gear — 14mm joint size works with common bowls, downstems, and ash catchers, making upgrades and swaps simple.
  • Made in the USA — For people who care about supporting local glassblowers and consistent craftsmanship, not mystery imports.

Best For

This beaker is made for smokers who want a reliable daily piece with some personality, not just a clear cylinder. If you like taking cooled-down hits but don’t want a giant, top-heavy tower, this 10″ form factor hits the sweet spot. It’s also a solid choice if you’re building out a small glass lineup around one main tube and a couple of smoke shop accessories instead of hoarding ten cheap bongs you never use.

How to Use It

Fill the beaker base with enough water to cover the end of the downstem, then adjust up or down until you find the level of drag and chug you like. From there, you’re just loading the included 14mm flower bowl and using it like any other classic beaker, with the bent neck making it easier to relax back without leaning over the piece.

When you want extra-cool hits, drop ice cubes in through the mouthpiece and let them rest on the ice pinch; the smoke will pass over the ice on its way up, taking some bite off the top. If you’re particular about keeping your table clean, park it on a nonstick dab mat so any little spills, ash, or drips stay off your furniture.

For cleaning, let the glass cool, empty out any water, then wipe or rinse away loose residue. For a deeper reset, soak the beaker and bowl in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let everything dry before your next sesh.

    Exact wall thickness isn’t listed, but this is a made-in-USA piece with a sturdy beaker base, so it’s built for real daily use. Still, it’s glass—treat it with normal care, especially around hard floors and sinks.

    Functionally, the bent neck keeps the mouthpiece closer to you, helps keep water away from your mouth, and gives you a more relaxed posture during a sesh. It’s one of those design choices you really appreciate once you’ve used straight tubes for a while.
  • How do I keep the fume and color wrap looking good long-term?
    Avoid harsh scrubbing on the outside; instead, focus your cleaning on the inside of the tube where the resin builds up. Gentle rinsing and wiping the exterior is enough to keep the shimmer and color wrap looking fresh, and storing it away from direct sunlight helps preserve the look.
  • Can I use this as a dab rig?
    You can swap the flower bowl for a 14mm banger or nail if you like running one tube for both flower and concentrates. If you do, pairing it with a proper carb cap from our carb caps collection will help you get more consistent function out of your dabs.
  • How often should I change the water and clean it?
    Changing the water regularly keeps flavor and smoothness on point—most people do it every use or every day they’re hitting it. When the glass starts to look hazy or sticky inside, that’s your sign to give it a quick alcohol soak and rinse.
  • Is this a good first bong or better for experienced smokers?

Why You’ll Love It

This rig is made for dabbers who like to keep their setup small, cute, and efficient — think 2–5 quick seshes a day, not marathon cloud comps. How to Use It

Drop the included 14mm banger into the 90° male joint and you’re basically set. The short vapor path and small chamber mean you get quick, flavorful pulls without needing a ton of water or breath control, which is nice when you’re a few dabs deep and just want things to work.

For best feel, add just enough water to cover the two-hole perc openings in the tail — that’s where the diffusion happens, and you’ll hear that tight little chug when you’ve got it right. Set the egg on a stable surface during your sesh so the art and the joint stay safe; this is one of those pieces you don’t want rolling into your grinder or torch.

Between seshes, let the banger cool, then wipe off any residue. When it’s time for a deeper reset, you can soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry before reuse. If you like to keep everything organized, pairing this with a couple of labeled concentrate jars makes swap-outs way easier.

Keep this rig looking sharp by emptying the water after use and giving it a quick rinse — tiny pieces can gunk up fast if you let them sit. For heavier buildup, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry will get the glass and perc clean again.

Try not to grab it by the neck or the Baby Yoshi section when it’s wet or soapy; treat it like a little art toy that also happens to be your dab rig. If you travel with it, giving it its own padded spot in a case or box (away from torches and metal tools) helps avoid surprise chips or scratches. For ultra-mobile seshes where drops are more likely, some people like to keep a backup from our more rugged silicone bongs & rigs collection on hand.

    It’s genuinely small — 3.5 inches (89mm) tall from base to top, so it’s closer to a palm-sized mini rig than a full-sized table piece. That makes it great for desktops, shelves, or tight spaces where a big rig would be overkill.
  • What size banger does this rig use?
    This rig has a 14mm male joint at a 90° angle and already includes a 14mm banger that fits perfectly. If you ever replace it, just grab any 14mm female, 90° style banger and you’ll be set.
  • Is the included banger decent, or should I upgrade right away?
    The included 14mm banger is totally fine for everyday dabbing and matches the rig size well. If you’re picky about heat retention or very specific styles, you can always upgrade later, but it’s not mandatory out of the gate. Many dabbers pair it with directional caps from our carb caps section once they dial in their setup.

    Yes — the two-hole perc in the tail adds just enough diffusion to smooth things out without turning it into a draggy, over-bubbly piece. You’ll feel light chug and see the bubbles stack right around the character, which also looks cool during a pull.
  • Is this a good rig for travel or is it too delicate?
    It’s compact and easier to pack than tall glass, but it’s still glass, so you’ll want to treat it carefully if you’re taking it on the road. A padded case or box is recommended. If you’re rough on gear or planning camping trips and couch-hopping, consider pairing it with something unbreakable from our silicone pipes so you’re not risking your character piece everywhere you go.
  • How do I clean inside the egg and around the Baby Yoshi?
    For regular maintenance, just let the rig cool, empty the water, and rinse. When it gets grimy, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry thoroughly. Because it’s a small chamber, the soak does most of the work; you usually don’t need fancy tools or brushes.

    It can absolutely be a daily driver if you like smaller, flavorful hits and quick refills. Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

Pack your 14mm bowl, drop it into the joint, and you’re good to go. The straight-tube design gives quick, direct function, so you’ll notice your hits feel fast and efficient rather than slow and airy. Set it on a dab pad or bong mat if you’re the type who bumps tables or has clumsy friends around.

Built for heavy smokers, party hosts, and sharers, this carton keeps you stocked with 72 cones that burn slow and even, so you can focus on the sesh instead of the roll.

Each cone is made from unbleached, natural-fiber paper in classic Zig-Zag quality, with a built-in tip so you can just grind, fill, and go. If you love the taste of your flower and want it to come through without paper getting in the way, this is the kind of box you buy and forget about running out for a while.

Why You’ll Like These Cones

  • Zero rolling skills needed — Pre-rolled king-size cones mean you just fill, pack, and you’re ready, no practice runs or wasted papers.
  • Cleaner flavor from your flower — Unbleached, natural paper lets your terps shine instead of adding that "processed" paper taste.
  • Party- and trip-proof supply — 24 packs per carton (72 cones total) keeps you covered for parties, weekends away, or just a long stretch of daily use.
  • Travel-friendly packaging — Each 3-pack comes in a crush-resistant slide box that actually survives pockets, bags, and glove compartments.
  • Consistent, even burn — Quality Zig-Zag paper and tight machine-rolled cones help avoid canoeing and side burns when they’re packed right.
  • Built-in tips — Every cone has a paper filter/roach built in, so you’re not tearing cardboard off random boxes at the last minute.

Best For

This carton is made for smokers who burn through cones regularly — think people who roll up for the group, keep something twisted on weekends, or just prefer cones as their daily driver. It also hits for anyone who loves the classic Zig-Zag feel but wants a more natural, unbleached option with less paper taste.

If you already keep a dedicated setup with a dab mat or rolling station at home, this is the kind of stash item you buy in bulk so you’re never stuck mid-sesh without papers.

How to Use These Cones

Using king-size cones is simple: grind your material, load the open end, and gently pack it down until you reach the top. The cone shape and built-in tip do the shaping work for you, so the main things to focus on are getting an even fill and not overpacking.

For the best burn, use a consistent, medium grind and tap the cone lightly as you fill so it settles evenly all the way down to the tip. A small packing tool or the end of a lighter works fine for compressing the material near the base. Then twist the end closed and you’re ready when you are — no rolling tray gymnastics required.

If you like to prep a few at a time, you can fill multiple cones and store them safely in your carton or another protective container along with your other storage and packaging essentials.

Specifications

Feature Details
Product Type Pre-rolled cones
Brand Zig-Zag
Size King size
Paper Type Unbleached, natural fiber paper
Cones per Pack 3
Packs per Carton 24
Total Cones per Carton 72

Price $63.99 (carton)

Fit & Use Notes

These Zig-Zag king-size cones are king-size from end to end, with enough room to load up a serious amount of material compared to a standard 1 1/4 cone. That makes them perfect for sharing or slower, longer burns.

They play nice with most cone filling tools and loaders sized for king-size cones, so if you’re already using a cone filler with other brands, it should handle these just fine. Pair them with a consistent grinder from our broader smoke shop products lineup to get even burns every time.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the slide boxes closed when not in use, and store the carton in a cool, dry spot away from direct sunlight so the paper stays crisp, not wavy or brittle. Avoid humid areas so the cones don’t absorb moisture and lose their shape.

If a cone gets slightly misshapen from being carried around, you can usually reshape it gently with your fingers before filling. Treat them like you would any good papers: dry, flat, and out of the way until you need them. For pre-filled cones you’re saving for later, you can tuck them into a spare pack or even a dedicated tube alongside your other on-the-go joint tubes.

FAQ

  1. How many cones are in one carton?

    Each carton has 24 individual packs. Every pack contains 3 pre-rolled king-size cones, so you get a total of 72 cones per carton.

  2. Are these cones really unbleached?

    Yes. These are Zig-Zag’s unbleached king-size cones, made from natural-fiber paper without the bright white bleaching process. That’s why they have a more natural, brownish tone and a cleaner, less processed taste.

  3. Will these work with cone filling devices?

    Most cone-filling devices that are designed for king-size cones will work fine with these. Just make sure your filler is sized for king-size, not 1 1/4 or smaller. If you’re filling by hand, a simple funnel or packing tool from our accessories collection can make it even quicker.

  4. Are they good for beginners who can’t roll?

    Absolutely. If you can’t roll (or just don’t want to), cones are the easiest way to go. The tricky part of shaping and tucking is already done, so you just grind, fill, and gently pack. They’re a great way to get consistent results without learning traditional rolling.

  5. Do these burn slower than regular papers?

    Burn speed depends on how fine you grind and how tightly you pack, but Zig-Zag’s unbleached paper is known for a nice, steady burn. When they’re filled evenly, these cones tend to burn slow and smooth instead of racing down one side.

  6. How should I store the cones so they don’t get crushed?

    Keep them inside their original slide boxes until you’re ready to use them — those boxes are designed to be crush-resistant. If you’re on the move and carrying filled cones, you can also tuck them into a protective case or with other gear like silicone pipes that won’t crush them in your bag.

  7. What’s the difference between these and regular Zig-Zag papers?

    Functionally, these are pre-rolled king-size tubes with tips already built in, so you don’t have to do any rolling or filter folding. Compared to classic Zig-Zag white papers, these are unbleached and pre-formed, so you get a more natural paper and skip the learning curve. If you want less setup and more consistency, cones like these are the way to go.

column2: 7″ ELEMENT SILVER FUME GANDOLF PIPE W/ MARBLE CAB – MADE IN USA
column3:
The 7" Element Silver Fume Gandolf Pipe w/ Marble Cab is a handcrafted glass hand pipe built for flower lovers who care as much about the piece as the pack. This Gandalf-style profile gives you extra length for smoother pulls, while the silver fume and color/dichro marble cab turn every bowl into a show. Made in the USA and sized at 7 inches (178mm), it hits that sweet spot between display-worthy art and true daily driver.

Why You'll Reach For It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The 7 inch (178mm) Gandolf-style stem gives the smoke more distance to travel before it gets to you.
  • Color-changing character — Silver fume glass develops depth and shifts in tone as you use it, so the piece slowly “seasons” to match your sesh history.
  • Comfortable, balanced hold — The long neck lets you keep the bowl away from your face and fingers, which is clutch when things get hot.
  • Marble cab grip & style — The color/dichro marble cab isn’t just pretty; it also gives you a natural grip point and helps keep the pipe from rolling.
  • Made in the USA craftsmanship — Worked by Element Glass, so you're getting legit, small-batch quality instead of flimsy import glass.
  • Display-worthy but not fragile — It looks like a collector piece, but it’s still built to be packed, passed, and actually smoked.

Best For

This piece is made for flower smokers who like ritual: people who actually sit down for a sesh, not just sneak a quick hit and go. If you love long-stem "wizard" or Sherlock-style pipes and want something with more art and personality, this is it. It also plays nicely as the "fancy" pipe in a stash that already has a couple of rugged daily drivers and a few backup smoke shop basics.

The Basics: How to Use & Enjoy It

This is a straightforward dry hand pipe with a long Gandalf-style stem. You pack your ground flower into the bowl, use the carb (if present on the side) to control airflow, and draw through the mouthpiece at the tip of the curved stem. The extra length is what sets it apart: you're not right up on the bowl, and the smoke has more time to cool.

The silver fuming is where the magic happens visually. As resin and use build up over time, the colors in the fume layer deepen and shift, so the pipe slowly takes on a more dramatic, layered look. If you like watching pieces "develop" as you use them, this kind of glass is especially satisfying. Setting it down on a soft surface like a dab mat can help keep that finish looking clean between bowls.

The marble cab is both an art accent and a functional design touch. It adds a pop of color/dichro that catches the light, and it also helps keep the pipe from rolling off the table when you set it down. When you're passing it around, that marble becomes an easy reference point to grab without thinking about it too much.

Specifications

Brand Element Glass
Style Gandolf (long-stem hand pipe)
Length 7 inches (178mm)
Material Glass with silver fume
Accent Color/dichro marble cab
Origin Made in USA

Care & Maintenance

Let the pipe cool before handling, then tap out the ash and wipe the bowl and mouthpiece area to keep buildup in check. For a deeper clean, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next use. If you like to keep your whole setup tidy, pairing this with a few dedicated cleaning and storage accessories makes life easier.

FAQ

  • Is the 7" length awkward to handle?

    No, 7 inches (178mm) is actually a really manageable size for a Gandalf-style pipe. It’s long enough to cool things down and give that dramatic look, but still short enough to pass around a couch without feeling fragile or clumsy.

  • Does the silver fume really change color over time?

    Yes. Silver fume reacts visually as the glass gets used, so the pipe tends to develop richer blues, ambers, and other tones as you sesh with it. A quick clean will brighten things back up, but that "seasoned" look is part of the charm with fumed glass.

  • Is every marble cab the same?

    No, that’s part of what makes these fun. The color/dichro marble cab is worked individually, so each one has its own pattern and personality. If you like truly unique American-made glass, this is right in that lane alongside our other specialty pieces and premium glass storage options.

  • How fragile is this compared to a regular spoon pipe?

    It’s still glass, so you’ll want to treat it with some respect, but Element Glass pieces are made to be smoked, not just stared at. The main difference is length: be mindful when setting it down or tossing it in a bag. A padded pouch or case can go a long way toward keeping it safe next to your grinders, lighters, or even a small concentrate jar.

  • What kind of smoker is this best for?

    This piece fits people who like a slower, more intentional sesh and enjoy the look and feel of worked glass. If you’re rough on your gear or want something you can toss in a backpack without thinking, you might want to pair it with a more rugged option from our silicone pipes lineup as a backup.

  • Can I travel with this pipe?

    Plenty of people travel with 7" pipes, but the key is padding and discretion. A small padded case or pouch is ideal so the stem doesn’t get stressed, and you'll want to make sure it's clean and legal for wherever you're going. For more low-profile carry options, some folks also keep flower or pre-rolls in smell-resistant mylar bags.

  • How often should I clean it?

    That comes down to preference. If you like brighter glass and cleaner flavor, a quick clean every few seshes keeps things fresh. If you enjoy the deeper, more dramatic look fumed glass gets as it "seasons," you can stretch out the time between deep cleans and just handle obvious buildup.
