column2: 5.5″ TWO-TONE STACKED PUCK FLOWER IMPLOSION RIG
column3:
The 5.5" Two-Tone Stacked Puck Flower Implosion Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate fans who want real function in a piece that actually looks special on the table. At just 5.5 inches (140mm) tall, it’s small enough to travel, but the stacked puck body and thick base keep it feeling solid in the hand. The real flex here is the pair of flower implosion marbles in the center, giving you a little gallery piece that still rips like a daily driver.

This rig is all about clean, simple diffusion with a natural perc and a tight, direct pull that keeps flavor front and center. If you like art glass but don’t want a fragile “just for the shelf” piece, this hits that sweet spot: functional, stable, and pretty enough you won’t mind leaving it out.

Why It Works

  • Smooth, direct hits — The natural perc pushes vapor through water in one clean path, keeping your pulls smoother without over-diffusing your terps.
  • Compact but not tippy — The stacked puck body and evenly weighted base help keep the rig planted so you’re not babying it every time you set your banger down.
  • Art glass vibes without the gallery price — Twin flower implosion marbles give it that custom, heady look without jumping into triple-digit territory.
  • Great flavor at low water levels — Short vapor path and a smaller chamber mean less air to stale your hit and more taste from your concentrates.
  • Easy to live with — Fewer intricate percs means fewer tiny passages to clog, so cleaning stays quick and painless.
  • Travel-friendly size — At 5.5 inches (140mm), it drops right into a padded pouch or case for on-the-go seshes.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who like smaller, flavorful hits over massive cloud-chasing, and who appreciate a little art in their setup. It’s a great match if you already have a main rig at home and want a more compact piece that still looks good sitting on your desk or next to your dab mat.

If you’re working with nicer concentrates and care about taste, the simple diffusion and tight chamber are going to feel right at home in your rotation. It’s also a smart choice for anyone who doesn’t have a ton of shelf space but still wants something more interesting than another plain clear beaker.

How to Use It

Set the rig on a flat, stable surface and add a small amount of water to the main chamber — just enough to cover the bottom of the perc area. You’re aiming for gentle bubbling, not a splash zone up the neck.

Attach a properly sized banger or nail to the joint, then prep your dab tools and concentrates so everything is within reach. A good setup is keeping your concentrates in proper concentrate jars and your tools on standby so you’re not scrambling mid-sesh.

Once your banger is heated and ready (whatever method and timing you normally trust), cap it, draw through the mouthpiece, and let the natural perc do its thing. The short rig height keeps the vapor path tight and responsive, so you’ll feel and hear the function right away.

After your sesh, let everything cool down before moving, cleaning, or packing it away. For people who like to keep their station dialed in, pairing this with other small glass or rig accessories makes for a clean, compact dab setup.

Cleaning & Care

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you touch or clean anything. For quick freshen-ups, empty the old water and rinse the piece with warm water.

For deeper cleans, add a little isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, give it a gentle shake, then rinse thoroughly with clean water and let it dry before using again. Keeping up on regular cleanings will help those flower implosion marbles keep their pop and make the glass look new way longer.

Specifications

Height 5.5 inches (140mm)
Material Glass
Body Style Two-tone stacked puck design
Decoration Flower implosion marbles
Perc Type Natural perc

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is designed as a compact oil rig, so it plays best with smaller quartz bangers or nails that match the joint size it ships with. If you’re upgrading from a big water pipe, you’ll probably notice the draw is more direct and snappy.

Because the design is simple and low-profile, it also pairs nicely with things like directional caps and spinner caps from our carb caps collection, as long as you size them to your banger.

Why the Design Matters

The stacked puck shape isn’t just for looks — it keeps the center of gravity low, which matters when you’ve got a hot banger hanging off the side and don’t want to be paranoid every time someone bumps the table. Those pucks also tighten up the chamber, helping the rig feel responsive when you pull.

The flower implosion marbles bring legit heady energy without making the rig fragile or overly complex. They sit tucked into the body where they’re protected from bumps, but still front and center where you can zone out on them mid-sesh. Match that with the two-tone color work, and you’ve got a solid little centerpiece for a very reasonable price point.

FAQ

  • What size banger does this rig use?
    It’s built to use a standard banger that matches the joint size and gender it comes with, so check the listing details on your order or look at the joint to confirm before buying a new one. If you’re grabbing multiple attachments, you can keep everything organized with dedicated storage and packaging solutions so parts don’t get mixed up.
  • Is this rig good for daily use?
    Yes, this works well as a daily driver for dabbers who prefer smaller, flavorful hits and don’t need a huge chamber or stacked percs. If you’re doing long, back-to-back seshes all day, you might eventually want a larger rig to rotate in, but this one can easily handle your regular routine.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    The 5.5 inch (140mm) height makes it a solid travel option as long as you pack it safely. Empty the water, let it dry, then wrap it in soft material or a padded case. A lot of people toss it in a small bag alongside things like one-hitters or silicone pipes so everything’s ready when they land.
  • Can I use it for flower too?
    Technically, if you have the correct-sized bowl that fits the joint, you can run flower through it. That said, the size and design are really optimized for concentrates, so if you mainly smoke flower, you may want a dedicated bong instead.
  • How hard is it to clean the implosion marbles area?
    The nice part is there aren’t a bunch of tiny internal percs here. A simple isopropyl rinse reaches around the marbles pretty well, and regular quick cleans will keep any build-up from hiding their color and detail.
  • Does it need a lot of water?
    No, a small amount is usually enough to cover the perc area and give you active bubbles. Too much water will push up the neck and work against the compact design, so start low and adjust until it feels right for you. If you’re also pressing or handling your own material, pairing this rig with proper parchment paper and handling tools keeps your concentrates clean before they ever hit the banger.
  • How does this compare to bigger, multi-perc rigs?
    Larger rigs with multiple percs can feel smoother at very high volumes but sometimes mute flavor and take more effort to pull through. This 5.5" stacked puck rig is more about flavor, simplicity, and easy cleaning — ideal when you want something that just works without babysitting it, similar to the more compact rigs in our smoke shop products lineup.

  • Comfortable, cool pulls — The 5.5 inch (140mm) Sherlock profile gives the smoke more travel room, helping it cool off a bit before it reaches you.

  • Easy to pass, easy to hold — The Sherlock bend and length make it easy to grip and pass around without putting fingers near the hot bowl.
  • Looks good in any collection — The clean silver fume and marble accent give it a heady vibe without being over-the-top or fragile art glass territory.

Best For

This pipe is made for people who want something nicer than a gas station spoon, but still rugged enough to be a true daily driver. It’s a sweet spot piece for:

  • Dabbers and smokers who want a go-to dry option next to their silicone bongs & rigs
  • Anyone who likes color-changing fume work that “seasons” with use
  • People who want a Sherlock shape that actually fits a pocket or bag
  • Gift shoppers looking for a made-in-USA piece that feels special out of the box

How to Use It

If you’ve used a hand pipe before, you’re already dialed in—this one just feels better in hand. The Sherlock curve keeps the bowl a little farther from your face and angles the mouthpiece so you can chill back without hunching over your lap piece.

Set it down between hits with the marble cab facing down; that little bump acts like a built-in stand so the pipe doesn’t tip or roll. Pair it with a nonstick dab mat or tray if you want to keep ash, crumbs, and glass all in one clean zone on your table.

Cleaning is simple: let the piece cool completely, then wipe off surface residue. For deeper refreshes, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh.

Specs

Brand Element Glass
Category Hand pipe / Sherlock
Length 5.5 inches (140mm)
Material Glass (fumed)
Design Style Silver fume Sherlock with marble cab

Silver fume isn’t just paint or a decal—it’s actual vaporized silver worked into the glass as it’s being made. That’s why the color doesn’t “chip off” and why the pipe slowly changes tones with use.

As the inside builds a bit of resin, the way light passes through the glass shifts, and you’ll see deeper blues, golds, and greens peek out. If you like watching your piece evolve, this kind of fume work is where the magic’s at.

Care Tips

To keep the fume work looking sharp, give it a periodic soak instead of letting buildup cake on forever. After cleaning, you’ll really see how much the color has evolved compared to when it was brand new.

If you’re tossing this pipe in a bag or backpack, it’s worth pairing it with a soft case or pouch from our general smoke shop products lineup so you’re not explaining a cracked Sherlock later.

  • Dialed in for micro dabs — ideal for smaller loads when you want control and flavor instead of lung-busting clouds.

This 5-pack is made for Lookah fans who care more about flavor and efficiency than giant puddles. If you’re running quick, controlled dabs throughout the day instead of massive one-and-done clouds, these Type C coils will feel right at home. Using these is simple: treat them like any other 710-thread Lookah coil. Remove your old coil from the device, screw in a fresh Type C, and you’re ready to load and go once everything is seated snugly. The direct airflow design pulls air right across the quartz dish, so even a small amount of concentrate gets full exposure to heat and airflow.

Because the quartz plate is optimized for micro dabs, you don’t need to overfill the dish — a little goes a long way, and it helps keep things tasting fresh instead of burnt. If you like to pre-stage your material, pairing these coils with a few labeled storage containers makes it easier to swap flavors without sticky fingers all over your gear.

When the flavor starts to drop off or buildup gets heavy, it’s time to clean or swap coils. Keeping a clean coil isn’t just about taste; it also helps your Lookah device maintain strong function so you’re not wondering why hits suddenly feel weak.

    Type C coils use a square quartz plate designed to be efficient with small amounts of concentrate and emphasize flavor. Other Lookah 710 types may focus more on cloud production or a different airflow path. If you like measured micro dabs with good taste and minimal waste, Type C is the sweet spot.

Why it works

  • See your wax in real time — Transparent quartz dish makes it easy to see how much concentrate is left so you’re not hitting a dry coil.
  • Smoother, more even heat — Quartz chamber spreads heat across the dish, helping your wax melt evenly instead of pooling in one hot spot.
  • Flavor-forward hits — Quartz keeps your terps tasting clean so you’re getting more of the strain and less of that burnt coil vibe.
  • Built for micro dabs — Ideal for smaller loads so you can finish each dab in one go and avoid waste.
  • Dialed-in airflow — The dish and airway are designed to pull comfortably without feeling clogged or way too airy.
  • Always have a fresh coil ready — 5-pack means you can rotate coils and swap in a new one when performance drops instead of nursing a burnt-out heater.

Best for

These Type D coils are best for dabbers using Lookah 710-thread devices who prioritize flavor, control, and visibility over just max clouds. If you like doing multiple smaller seshes instead of overpacking one giant dab, this style of dish coil fits that routine nicely.

If your Lookah is your main daily driver, pairing these coils with a nonstick dab mat keeps sticky tools, caps, and devices from gluing themselves to your coffee table between hits.

How to use it

Pop a Type D coil into your compatible Lookah device just like any other 710-thread coil, making sure it’s threaded on straight and snug. Load a small amount of wax directly into the quartz dish — these are designed for micro dabs, so less is more and gives you better control over flavor and vapor output.

Let the device heat the quartz so it gently melts your concentrate across the dish. Because the chamber is clear, you can literally watch your wax melt down and decide when to stop before it gets overcooked. Once the dish is empty or starting to look dark and baked-on, it’s time to reload or clean.

Between seshes, you can keep your concentrates fresh and easy to scoop by storing them in proper concentrate jars instead of random silicone chunks or parchment scraps.

The basics on cleaning

Coils last longer when you don’t let thick residue build up. Let the coil cool completely, then gently wipe out any leftover material from the quartz dish with a cotton swab or similar tool. For a deeper reset when flavor starts to drop off, remove the coil from your device, soak the dish area in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and let it dry fully before using again.

If you’re the type to swap coils often, it helps to keep spare ones and other small parts organized with a few extra pieces of storage & packaging gear instead of letting them roll around in a drawer.

  • What’s the best way to clean the quartz dish without cracking it?

    Always let the coil cool fully first. Wipe out leftovers with a cotton swab, and when it’s really gunked up, remove the coil from your device and soak just the dish area in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and let it dry completely. Avoid scraping with metal tools so you don’t scratch the quartz.

A 5-pack keeps your Seahorse X, Swordfish, Mini Unicorn, Dragon Egg, or Q7 Mini running smooth for the long haul.

What You Get Out of It

  • Better flavor from your concentrates — The quartz dish heats evenly, so you taste your terps instead of hot spots or scorched residue.
  • Efficient micro dabs — The flat wax dish is made for smaller loads that fully vaporize, so you’re not wasting product or leaving puddles behind.
  • Less mess, fewer clogs — Keeping the concentrate on the center of the plate helps stop wax from running into the airway and gunking up your device.
  • Ready for your main Lookah lineup — Type B 710 coils are designed for compatible Lookah devices like the Seahorse X, Swordfish, Mini Unicorn, Dragon Egg, and Q7 Mini.
  • 5-pack = fewer emergency runs — When a coil finally taps out, you’ve got backups ready, not a dead device in the middle of a sesh.
  • Consistent performance — Fresh coils mean consistent clouds and smoother hits, instead of fighting with a burnt or flooded heater.

Best For

This 5-pack is made for dabbers running their Lookah device as a daily driver and who don’t want to think about coil drama every week. It’s especially clutch if you rotate between a few 710-thread devices or like keeping a cleaner “flavor coil” and a separate one for heavier use. If you’re already working with other electric gear or smoke shop products on your desk, this just keeps your Lookah setup dialed in.

How to use it

Start by making sure your device is powered off, then gently remove the old coil from the 710-thread connection. Thread a fresh Type B coil into place, turning it until it’s snug but not over-tightened. You want a solid connection, not a wrestling match.

When you’re loading, think micro dabs. Place a small amount of concentrate right in the middle of the quartz dish — that’s where the heat is most even and where you’ll get the cleanest vapor. Avoid overpacking; too much can bubble over the sides, which is how coils get sticky, clogged, and short-lived. Setting your device down on a dab mat is a good idea if you’re the type to miss the dish once in a while.

Between uses, let the coil cool down before handling. If you’re swapping coils or packing your rig away, give the chamber a quick wipe so you’re not pressing old residue into a fresh quartz dish. Keeping things tidy goes a long way when you’re three dabs deep and just want it to work.

Coil Style Type B quartz dish

Fit & Compatibility Notes

These are Lookah 710-thread Type B coils, so they’re meant specifically for Lookah devices that call for that style. Always check your device manual or existing coil to confirm it’s a Type B before you grab a pack. If your current coil housing looks different or uses a different lettering system, it may need another style in the Lookah lineup.

If you’re stocking up for multiple rigs, it can help to label the boxes or stash them in separate storage so you always know which coils go to which device.

Care, Cleaning & Coil Life

Coils are consumables — they don’t last forever — but you can stretch their life by keeping them reasonably clean and not drowning them in concentrate. Let the device cool, then gently wipe away loose residue from the dish. For a deeper refresh, you can soak the coil in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and fully dry before reusing.

There will still come a point where performance drops, flavor tastes off, or the coil struggles to heat. That’s your signal to rotate in a fresh one from the 5-pack. Some people even keep one “fresh” coil dedicated to top-shelf concentrates and another for day-to-day stuff, like how you might separate your best jars from your everyday concentrate jars.

Why Quartz Matters

Quartz is the go-to material here because it handles heat well while keeping flavor crisp. Unlike metal-only heaters that can feel harsh, a quartz dish gives you a cleaner taste and more predictable heating pattern. That’s especially nice with live resins, rosins, or anything terp-heavy where you actually care what you’re tasting.

If you’re already pressing or picking up higher-end extracts, pairing them with a decent quartz coil just makes sense, the same way you’d grab proper parchment or non-stick PTFE sheets when you’re handling sticky work in the lab or at home.

FAQ

  • Will these coils fit my Lookah device?
    These are Lookah 710-thread Type B coils. They’re made for devices like the Seahorse X, Swordfish, Mini Unicorn, Dragon Egg, and Q7 Mini that specifically list Type B compatibility. If your current coil or user manual says a different type (like A, C, etc.), you’ll want to match that instead of guessing.
  • What’s the difference between Type B and other Lookah coil types?
    Type B uses a flat quartz wax dish that’s ideal for micro dabs and flavor-focused hits. Other coil types may use different designs or materials that change cloud production, ramp time, or how much concentrate they comfortably hold. If you like controlled loads and clean taste, Type B is usually the sweet spot.
  • How do I keep these coils from burning out too fast?
    Use small dabs centered on the dish, avoid overloading, and try not to run the coil dry for extended periods. Letting the coil cool between longer seshes also helps. Treat it like you’d treat a good banger on a small silicone rig — reasonable heat, reasonable loads, and a little basic cleanup.
  • How should I clean the coil when it gets gunky?
    Let the device cool completely, then remove the coil and gently wipe away visible residue. For stubborn buildup, soak the coil in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and let it dry fully before using again. If it still tastes burnt or looks rough after that, it may just be time to swap in a fresh one from the pack.
  • Can I use larger dabs with this coil?
    You can load more, but these are really tuned for micro dabs. Bigger loads are more likely to bubble over the dish, run into the airflow, and shorten coil life. If you’re regularly doing heavy dabs, you might want to keep a cleanup area ready with parchment or a parchment sheet under your work space to catch any stickiness.
  • How many coils will I go through in a month?
    It totally depends on how hard and how often you sesh. Light to moderate dabbers might get weeks out of a single coil, while heavy daily use will burn through them quicker. That’s why having a 5-pack is nice — you’re covered whether you’re a weekend dabber or running it as a full-time pocket rig alongside your dab tools.
  • Do these coils work for all concentrates?
    They’ll handle most typical concentrates you’d use in a portable device — think waxes, budders, and similar textures that you can place neatly onto the dish. Very runny oils may spread too easily and be harder to control, so those are often better in cartridges or other setups, like pairing with nectar collectors if you prefer a different style of hit.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

The sculpted cactus body isn’t just for looks either—it gives you something solid to hold while the grid perc handles smooth, flavorful diffusion inside.

Why It Works

  • Smoother pulls, less harshness — The internal grid perc breaks your vapor into smaller bubbles so your hits come through cooler and easier on the throat.
  • Stays upright, even on crowded tables — A solid, footed base keeps the rig stable, so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Ready to sesh out of the box — Comes with a matching 14mm 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt for a nail that fits.
  • Comfortable, natural grip — The cactus sculpt gives your hand an easy place to land while you pass and pull, instead of clutching a slippery tube.

  • Looks as good on the shelf as it hits on the table — The colorful cactus design doubles as décor when it’s not in rotation.

Best For

This cactus rig is made for dabbers who like their setups fun, photogenic, and functional. If your sesh table already has a couple of character pieces and you want a small rig that still hits smooth, this fits right in. It also pairs nicely with durable smoke shop accessories if you’re building out a full station.

Drop your 14mm banger into the 90° joint, add water until the grid perc is just covered, and you’re basically set. From there, you’re just heating the banger, letting it cool a bit, and pulling through the angled mouthpiece while vapor moves down into the grid perc and up through the cactus body.

Because of the compact size, a little water goes a long way—too much and you risk splash, so start low and dial it in. Setting your rig on a nonstick dab mat will help catch any drips and keep sticky tools off the table.

When you’re done, let everything cool before moving or cleaning. For quick daily upkeep, a rinse and a light shake with warm water usually keeps things from building up too fast.

Let the rig and banger cool completely before cleaning—hot glass and cold liquid don’t mix. For quick refreshes, warm water rinses help keep reclaim from building up.   • How hard is it to clean the grid perc?
    The grid perc is relatively straightforward compared to more complex recyclers or multi-perc rigs. A soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a good rinse, usually clears the slits and holes. The 6.5" Cactus Rig hits that sweet spot between art piece and daily driver: small enough to keep on your desk, fun enough to show off, and functional enough that you’ll actually want to use it every day. If you like rigs with character that still deliver clean, smooth function, this cactus is ready to earn a permanent spot in your lineup.

  • Terp pearl spin for full vaporization — The included pearl moves concentrate around the bucket so you’re not left with cold spots and wasted puddles.

Best for

This Terp Wheel Banger is made for dabbers who are past the “any cheap bucket will do” phase and actually care about how their concentrates taste and vaporize. If you’re running a smaller recycler or compact rig as your daily driver and want smoother pulls without babysitting hot spots, this setup is right in your lane. Pop the 14mm male joint into any rig with a 14mm female, making sure the 90° angle keeps the bucket sitting nice and level. Drop the terp pearl into the bucket, then place the terp marble nearby so it’s ready once you’re at temp. Set your rig and banger on a clean, heat-safe station like a solid dab mat so you’re not cooking your table or chasing sticky tools around. Between hits, let the banger cool down enough to safely wipe out residue so the quartz stays clear and your next dab doesn’t taste like the last one.

  • Can I use this with different types of concentrates?

    Let it fully cool before setting it down, then keep it somewhere safe where it won’t roll or get knocked to the floor. A padded stash spot or a soft-lined area next to your other gear and storage accessories helps avoid accidental chips or cracks when you’re cleaning or rearranging your setup.

The 9" Encore Color Accent Honeycomb Straight is a compact glass bong built for smokers who want real diffusion in a daily driver without taking over the whole coffee table. At just 9 inches (229mm) tall with a honeycomb perc, it delivers smooth, filtered pulls while still feeling easy to handle and pass. Color accents on the mouthpiece and base give it personality without getting loud or gimmicky.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, less harsh hits — The honeycomb perc spreads smoke through tons of tiny holes for serious diffusion and cleaner pulls.
  • Desk- and couch-friendly size — 9 inches (229mm) tall is big enough for real function, small enough to stash or keep low-key.
  • Ready-to-rip joint spec — 14mm joint with a matching flower bowl means it plays nice with most glass accessories.
  • Stable, straight-tube design — Straight body keeps the function direct and easy to clear, while the base helps keep it from tipping during clumsy moments.
  • Clean, simple look — Color accents give style without making it a dust-collecting art piece you’re scared to use.

Best For

This piece is ideal if you want a solid daily bong that filters better than a basic straight tube but doesn’t get into crazy multi-perc territory. It’s great for shared living rooms, desk setups, or small spaces where a tall beaker would just feel like overkill. If you already run a main rig and want a separate flower piece that still looks good next to your silicone bongs and rigs, this slots in perfectly.

How to Use It

Start by adding water so the honeycomb perc is just covered — you want the holes submerged, not drowning the whole tube. From there, the piece does the work: as you pull, smoke is forced through all those little honeycomb holes, breaking it into tons of tiny bubbles that cool and filter before it reaches you.

Because it’s a straight tube, clearing it feels quick and snappy, which is perfect when you’re passing it around or moving between hits. Parking it on a nonstick dab mat is a clutch move to protect the base and catch any stray water or ash.

Cleaning stays pretty manageable thanks to the simple one-perc design. Let the bong cool, dump the water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse again with warm water, and let it dry fully before you put it back in rotation.

Specs

Height 9 inches (229mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Type Female
Perc Type Honeycomb percolator
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

The 14mm female joint makes this Encore tube an easy match for most standard 14mm male bowls, ashcatchers, and quartz bangers if you like using the same piece for both flower and concentrates. If you do double-duty it for dabs, grab a proper banger and a carb cap from our carb caps collection so you’re not wasting vapor.

  • 1 × 14mm glass flower bowl

FAQ

How much water should I put in it?

Add enough water to fully cover the honeycomb perc, but not so much that it splashes into the neck when you pull. You can fine-tune the level by taking a couple of test pulls and adjusting until it stacks bubbles smoothly without hitting your lips.

Can I use this for dabs too?

Yes, as long as you swap the flower bowl for a 14mm male banger or nail, you can absolutely run concentrates through it. For a cleaner dab setup, pair it with dedicated dab tools so you’re not mixing sticky oil with your flower gear.

Does it tip over easily?

For a 9" straight tube, it’s reasonably stable as long as you’re not knocking into it constantly. The base footprint keeps it upright for normal table or desk use. If your crew is on the clumsy side, putting it on a flat, grippy surface helps a ton.

What’s the difference between this and a basic straight tube with no perc?

The honeycomb perc is the big upgrade. A plain straight tube will hit harder and harsher because the smoke doesn’t get broken up as much. Here, the honeycomb forces it through many small holes, which cools it down and filters better, so you get smoother pulls without needing multiple stacked chambers like some bigger smoke shop pieces.

How do I keep the honeycomb perc from getting clogged?

Change the water regularly and give it a quick rinse after heavy use so buildup doesn’t harden in the holes. When it needs more love, soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and let it dry. Staying on top of it is way easier than trying to rescue a fully gunked perc later.

Is 9 inches big enough for daily use?

Definitely. 9" (229mm) is a sweet spot for a daily driver: enough volume for satisfying hits but not so tall that it’s annoying to store or clean. If you want something smaller for on-the-go or road trips, you might add a compact option from our silicone pipes lineup to your kit.

What should I store it in when I’m not using it?

Because it’s glass, you’ll want to keep it somewhere padded and away from ledges or tight spaces where it can get bumped. Some people repurpose packaging or cases they already have, or stash it alongside their jars and bags in a dedicated storage and packaging setup so everything lives in one place.

The 3" 14mm Male 90° Monark Ratchet Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for people who love smooth hits but hate a dirty bong. It slips into any 14mm female, 90° water pipe and takes the beating for your main piece, keeping your base water clearer for way longer. The star of the show is the ratchet perc, stacking bubbles in a small footprint so you get real diffusion without turning your setup into a tall, clumsy tower.

Why it works

  • Cleaner bong, less work — The ratchet perc catches ash and grime before it ever hits your main chamber, so you’re not scrubbing your daily driver every other day.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Multiple small slits in the ratchet perc spread the smoke through water, softening each hit without killing flavor.
  • Plug-and-play with 14mm pieces — 14mm male joint at a 90° angle means it drops right into most standard 14mm female water pipes designed for upright bowls or bangers.
  • Compact but effective — At just 3 inches (76mm) tall, it adds filtration without turning your setup into a wobbly skyscraper.
  • Protects your investment — Lets the ash catcher take the abuse instead of your favorite bong’s perc or base, which is way easier (and cheaper) to replace.
  • Monark build quality — Thick, clean glasswork that feels solid in the hand and holds up to real daily use when you’re passing it around.

Best for

This Monark ash catcher is made for people who actually use their glass—daily drivers, late-night couch seshes, and those “just one more bowl” evenings that add up fast. If you’re tired of cloudy water and dirty walls after a couple bowls, this lets you extend the time between full deep cleans on your favorite piece. It’s especially clutch if you rotate a few pieces and want one simple upgrade that makes every 14mm setup feel smoother and easier to maintain.

How to use it

Setup is simple: your bong’s 14mm female joint holds the ash catcher, and the ash catcher holds your bowl or slide. The 90° angle is meant for traditional upright pieces, so the ash catcher hangs level off the side instead of tilting or spilling.

When you pull, smoke first drops into the ash catcher, hits the ratchet perc, and gets chopped into a stack of smaller bubbles. That extra diffusion smooths out harshness and traps ash and debris in this little chamber instead of blasting it straight into your main water pipe. Set the whole setup on a sturdy dab mat if you’re clumsy or constantly passing it around—your table and glass will thank you.

For cleaning, just let the glass cool, empty the water, and rinse. When it starts to look grimy, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry completely before you put it back into the rotation.

Specifications

Height 3 inches (76mm)
Joint Size & Gender 14mm male
Joint Angle 90°
Perc Style Ratchet percolator
Material Glass

Fit & compatibility

This ash catcher is designed for water pipes with a 14mm female joint at 90°. That’s the standard joint on a lot of straight tubes and beakers where the bowl sits upright. If your piece has a 45° joint—or uses 10mm or 18mm hardware—you’ll need an adapter or a different ash catcher size/angle.

You can run your usual bowl, slide, or even certain adapters in the top joint of the ash catcher as long as they match the fitting on your piece. If you’re building out a full glass setup, you can pair this with sturdy smoke shop accessories so your whole station feels dialed.

What you get

  • 1 × 3" Monark Ratchet Ash Catcher
  • Joint: 14mm male, 90°
  • Built-in glass ratchet perc

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint and the joint comes out at a 90° angle (so the bowl sits straight up), this ash catcher should plug right in. If you’re not sure, compare your current bowl size to a known 14mm slide or check the manufacturer’s specs before grabbing one.
  • Can I use this with a 45° joint piece?
    Not directly. This Monark ash catcher is made for 90° joints—putting it on a 45° piece will tilt it awkwardly and can lead to spills or bad water levels. If your favorite tube uses a 45° joint, you’ll want an ash catcher specifically made for 45° setups or an angled adapter from our general accessories lineup.
  • Do I need to add water to the ash catcher?
    Yes, it’s a percolating ash catcher, so it needs a bit of water to let the ratchet perc do its thing. Fill just enough to cover the slits on the perc—too high and you risk splashback, too low and you won’t get much diffusion.
  • How often should I clean it?
    If you’re using it daily, a quick rinse every day or two and a deeper clean once a week keeps the glass clear and the function smooth. Since it grabs most of the ash before your piece, you’ll notice the ash catcher dirties up faster than your main bong—that’s a good thing. For longer-term storage or when you’re rotating flavors, you can keep your bowls or small parts in dedicated storage and packaging options to stay organized.
  • What’s a ratchet perc and why should I care?
    A ratchet perc is a disc-style percolator with a ring of slits or holes that creates a tight stack of small bubbles when you pull. Compared to a simple downstem-style ash catcher, ratchet percs give better diffusion and smoother pulls while still keeping the design compact and easy to clean.
  • Can I use this for concentrates?
    You technically can run a banger off the top joint as long as everything lines up and your rig is stable, but most people reserve ash catchers like this for flower to keep reclaim and resin from flooding their main tube. If you’re building a separate dab setup, pair your rig with purpose-built dab tools and proper carb caps instead.
  • How do I keep the glass from getting stained?
    Swap the water often, don’t let it sit for days full of reclaim, and give it a soak in isopropyl when it starts to haze up. If you’re handling concentrates or sticky flower, working over parchment paper or nonstick surfaces can help keep gunk off your glass and table so cleaning is faster all around.

Why You’ll Like It

  • More flavor, less waste — Terp vacuum design helps keep concentrates moving where the heat is, instead of pooling in a cold corner.

This banger is made for dabbers who are past the “cheap starter nail” phase and want something that actually keeps up. If you’ve already got a favorite rig from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup and want to upgrade just the business end, this is a clean move.

The opaque bottom is designed to soak up and hold heat, so you can work in that comfortable low-temp zone where flavor really shines. Pair it with your favorite carb cap from our carb caps collection to control airflow and keep vapor moving through the terp vacuum design instead of escaping.

It plays especially well with smaller and mid-sized rigs, nectar-style diffusion, and compact recyclers, and rounds out nicely when you store your concentrates in proper concentrate jars to keep your terps fresh.

Care & Cleaning

For best results, try to keep the opaque base as clean as possible. Let the banger cool down before you touch it, then wipe off any residue with a cotton swab. For a deeper reset, soak the cooled banger in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry completely before using again. Keeping the base clean not only looks better, it also helps it heat more evenly.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my rig?
    If your rig has a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle, this banger should drop right in. If you’re not sure on sizing, 14mm is a pretty standard joint size on many smoke shop products, but it’s always worth double-checking before you buy.

    It’s not recommended. This banger is built for 45° joints, so on a 90° setup it will sit at the wrong angle and your concentrates won’t pool correctly in the base.
  • What’s the point of the opaque base?
    The opaque quartz base heats up and cools down differently than clear quartz, tending to hold heat longer and distribute it more evenly across the surface. That gives you more time in that sweet low-temp range where flavor is best and less chance of scorching your oil.
  • How is a “terp vacuum” banger different from a regular bucket?
    A terp vacuum style banger is designed to help keep your concentrates moving where the heat and airflow are, instead of just sitting in one hot spot. That can mean smoother pulls and better vaporization, especially when you dial things in with the right tools from our dab tools collection.
  • What carb caps work best with this?
    Most standard carb caps that fit similar quartz buckets will work fine. Directional or bubble-style caps are popular here because they let you push oil around the opaque base and take full advantage of the terp vacuum design.

    Avoid overheating, and clean it regularly while it’s still just warm (never blazing hot). Let it cool, then wipe residue out. When it starts to look stained, give it a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry. Keeping your concentrates stored cleanly in quality glass jars & packaging also helps cut down on mystery gunk.
  • Is this a good upgrade from a basic quartz banger?
    Yes. If you’re moving from a plain clear bucket, you’ll notice better heat retention from the opaque base and more control from the terp vacuum design. It’s a solid step up for anyone who’s starting to care about flavor and efficiency but doesn’t want some super complex lab setup.

At 5 inches (127mm) tall with a 14mm male joint and a 45° angle, it’s a plug-and-play upgrade for most 14mm, 45° water pipes that want smoother pulls and way less buildup.

Why It Works

  • Cleaner bong, longer life — The ash catcher acts as a sacrificial filter, trapping ash and resin so your main piece stays clearer for longer.
  • Smoother, cooler function — The ratchet perc adds extra diffusion, turning harsher hits into smoother, more manageable pulls without killing your airflow.
  • Drop-in upgrade for 14mm setups — 14mm male joint at 45° is the standard for a ton of beakers and tubes, so it slides into most daily drivers without adapters.
  • Easy to watch and maintain — The clear glass body lets you see the water level and buildup, so you know exactly when it’s time to swap water or clean.
  • Keeps flavor fresher — By catching burnt particles before they reach your piece, you’re not dragging old ash through your hit every time.
  • Protects your main piece — If something clumsy happens at the joint area, better the ash catcher takes the hit than your expensive tube.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for glass fans who run 14mm beakers or straight tubes and want cleaner function without buying a whole new water pipe. It’s ideal if you’re a daily driver who’s constantly rinsing your bong, or if you’re the friend in the group who actually cares about how the piece looks after a long weekend.

If your setup already lives on a dedicated dab mat, this is a natural upgrade to keep your whole station looking dialed in instead of grimy.

How to Use It

Slide the 14mm male joint of the ash catcher into your piece’s 14mm female joint at the 45° connection. The angle is designed so the ash catcher hangs naturally in line with most 45° downstem beakers and tubes, keeping everything balanced and stable.

Once it’s seated, add a small amount of water to the ash catcher’s chamber, just enough to cover the slits in the ratchet perc when you tilt it to its normal position. Pop your bowl into the top joint, and you’re ready to go with extra diffusion and protection between your bowl and your bong.

After your sesh, let the glass cool, then dump the water and give it a quick rinse to keep buildup from getting out of hand. For a deeper reset, soak the ash catcher in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before you put it back on.

If you like to swap between different bowls or setups, keeping a few options organized with your other smoking accessories makes it easy to build the right stack for each sesh.

The Basics: Ratchet Ash Catcher Function

A ratchet ash catcher uses a circular perc with multiple slits or holes around the edge to break your hit into smaller bubbles. More bubbles mean more surface contact with water, which helps scrub out particulates and cool the hit before it ever reaches your main piece.

Because this piece sits before your bong, it’s your front-line filter: most of the ash, resin, and splash ends up here instead of caking your tube or base. When you’re a few bowls deep and don’t feel like full-on bong surgery, being able to just rinse this instead is a big win.

If you’re pairing this with heavy use or sharing with friends, you might also want to keep your flower or mixes in solid, airtight glass jars so everything going into that bowl is as fresh as the filtration coming out.

For people who run multiple setups, it’s handy to keep this as the designated “dirty work” attachment on your main tube while you reserve smaller pieces or other smoke shop products for quick solo rips.

Care & Maintenance

Because it catches so much debris, a little regular attention goes a long way. Empty and rinse the ash catcher after use or at least daily if you’re running it hard—stale water is where funk and stains start.

When buildup shows up on the glass or perc, soak it in isopropyl alcohol until the residue loosens, then rinse with warm water and let it dry. Keeping your ash catcher clean not only looks better, it also keeps flavor and airflow where you want them.

If you’re switching between flower and concentrates in the same area, it’s smart to keep your extracts stored separately in proper concentrate jars so ash and bong water never end up near your good sauce or rosin.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint and the joint is angled at 45°, this ash catcher should plug right in. If your joint sits straight up (90°), this model isn’t the right match.

  • How often should I change the water?
    Ideally every sesh, or at least whenever it starts to look cloudy. Fresh water helps the ratchet perc function better and keeps smells and stains from hanging around.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built as a functional, everyday upgrade piece, but it’s still glass—treat it like you’d treat your main water pipe. Avoid banging it against hard surfaces or twisting it at the joint when it’s stuck.
  • Do I need to fill the ash catcher and the bong with water?
    Yes, they each have their own water level. The ash catcher handles the first stage of diffusion, then your bong’s main chamber does the rest. Just don’t overfill the ash catcher or you’ll risk splash moving into your main piece.
  • Can I use this with a different bowl size?

  • Does this change how hard I have to pull?
    Any added piece adds a little drag, but the ratchet perc is designed to keep airflow open while still diffusing. Most people notice smoother hits more than any change in pull strength, especially if you keep the water levels dialed and the glass clean.

The 5″ 14mm Male 90° Black Sheep Large Clear Ratchet Ash Catcher is a glass add-on built for people who are tired of scrubbing their bong every other day but still like to rip it hard. Made for 14mm pieces with a 90° joint, this ratchet-style catcher adds extra filtration and keeps ash and gunk out of your main chamber so your hits stay smoother and your glass stays cleaner.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Way less cleaning — The ratchet perc traps ash and heavier debris before it ever hits your bong, so your main piece stays fresh way longer.
  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — That extra water chamber and diffusion help cool things down so big hits don’t feel like a throat punch.
  • Drop-in upgrade for most 14mm setups — 14mm male joint at a 90° angle means it plays nice with a ton of standard straight tubes and beaker-style pieces.
  • Clean, simple look — Clear glass with the Black Sheep logo keeps your setup looking sharp while still letting you see how dirty it’s getting.
  • Protects your investment — Catching resin and ash upstream helps prevent staining and reclaim buildup in your favorite daily driver.

Best For

This Black Sheep ash catcher is made for people running a solid glass bong as their daily driver who are tired of constant deep cleans but still care about flavor and function. If you like stacking function and turning your piece into a mini filtration lab, this is a simple way to level up without buying a whole new pipe. It’s also a nice match for anyone slowly building out a full smoke shop setup at home with dedicated glass, tools, and storage.

How to Use It

Using an ash catcher is pretty straightforward: this piece becomes the “front door” to your bong. The 14mm male joint on the ash catcher plugs into the 14mm female joint on your water pipe, and your bowl sits in the female joint on top of the catcher. The smoke (and all the junk) hits this chamber first, gets diffused through the ratchet perc, and then moves on to your main piece.

Fill the ash catcher with just enough water to cover the ratchet slits, keeping it light so you’re not adding a ton of drag or splash. If you’re working on a glass-heavy setup, parking everything on a good dab mat helps keep the table dry and gives you a soft landing when you set things down between rips.

Because this piece is clear, you’ll see exactly when it’s time for a rinse. When the water starts looking like old coffee and the glass is getting cloudy, that’s your cue for a quick clean so the flavor stays on point and the perc doesn’t get choked out.

Specifications

Height 5 inches (127mm)
Joint Type 14mm male (to bong), 14mm female (for bowl)
Joint Angle 90° (for 90° bongs)
Material Clear glass
Perc Style Ratchet percolator

Fit & Compatibility

This ash catcher is designed for water pipes with a 90° 14mm female joint. On most straight tubes and many beakers, that means it will sit upright and level, not tilted. If your joint is 45° or a different size, this won’t line up correctly without an adapter.

Because it’s a “large” ratchet catcher, there’s a bit more chamber volume than tiny micro catchers, which is great for filtration but something to keep in mind if your piece is already on the taller or heavier side. If you’re building out a whole glass workflow, it pairs really well with sturdy glass jars & packaging to keep your flower or concentrates organized right next to your piece.

Care & Cleaning

Let everything cool off first, then pull the ash catcher off your bong and dump the dirty water. Rinse with warm water and use isopropyl alcohol for the resin & reclaim. For deeper cleans, a quick soak in iso, rinse, and full dry will bring the glass back to clear so you can actually see the ratchet working again.

If you’re the type who hates buildup, keeping a little iso on hand with your other accessories makes it easy to give this piece a fast refresh every couple of days instead of wrestling with a totally caked perc later.

FAQ

  • Will this ash catcher fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, you’re good. The ash catcher’s 14mm male joint slides right in, and your 14mm bowl goes into the top. If your piece is 10mm, 18mm, or 45°, you’ll need a different catcher or an adapter.
  • Does it make my piece harder to pull?
    Any add-on adds a little resistance, but this ratchet catcher is designed to keep airflow pretty open. As long as you don’t overfill the water or let the perc clog with resin, the draw should still feel smooth and comfortable.
  • Can I use this for both flower and concentrates?
    Most people use ash catchers with flower bowls to keep ash out of the main chamber. If you’re dabbing through a bong, you can also run a banger on top, but remember that adds more weight and leverage. For heavy quartz setups, a dedicated rig from our silicone bongs & rigs collection can be a more bombproof option.
  • How often should I clean it?
    That depends how hard you smoke, but once the water is brown or you can see gunk on the ratchet slits, it’s time. Regular quick rinses with iso keep it from getting nasty and make full cleans way easier than waiting until it’s fully caked.
  • Will this tip my bong over?
    On a bong with a wide, stable base, you should be fine. On super skinny tubes or pieces that are already a little top-heavy, any ash catcher can shift the balance. If your setup feels sketchy, keep it on a flat surface and avoid bumping the table — or look into sturdier bases and gear in our storage & packaging section to organize and stabilize your station.
  • Does the ratchet perc really make a difference?
    Yes. Compared to a basic open chamber, the ratchet slits break the smoke up and keep more ash and junk from blasting straight into your bong. You’ll notice your main piece’s water stays cleaner longer and the flavor doesn’t fall off as fast.
  • What’s the benefit over a smaller ash catcher?
    Larger catchers like this give you more water volume and diffusion, which can mean smoother hits and more debris trapped before your bong. If you’re already running other gear like dab tools and multiple bowls, it’s a solid upgrade to keep the rest of your setup cleaner and tasting better.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The mini matrix perc breaks your vapor into tons of tiny bubbles, giving it more time in the water so the hit feels smooth instead of harsh.
  • Less splash, more comfort — The bent neck keeps water where it belongs and brings the mouthpiece closer, so you don’t have to hunch over the table.
  • Stays put on the table — The footed can base gives this rig a low, sturdy center of gravity, so it’s less likely to tip when someone bumps the coffee table.

This rig is made for dabbers who want a legit daily driver without going full “science project” on the shelf. How to Use It

The Encore Mini Matrix Rig is straightforward to run. Add just enough water so the mini matrix perc is fully covered, but not so much that it splashes up into the neck when you pull. That level lets the matrix do its job without turning your hit into a swimming lesson.

Drop the included 14mm 90° banger into the joint, get it up to your preferred temp, then apply your concentrates and pull steadily through the mouthpiece. A directional or bubble cap on top of the banger lets you control airflow and spin your concentrate around for more even vaporization, so if you like dialing things in, pairing this rig with one of our carb caps is a nice upgrade.

Between dabs, you can set the rig down by the base and let the matrix perc drain back cleanly. If you’re the type to swap flavors a lot, a quick rinse between strains keeps the perc from holding onto old terps. When you’re finished for the day, empty the water so you’re not waking up to stale funk in the morning.

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you start cleaning. Pour out the old water, then add a bit of isopropyl alcohol and gently shake to loosen residue in the matrix. For deeper cleans, you can soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry fully before using again.   • Does the 8.5″ Encore Mini Matrix Rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?

  • Is the mini matrix perc hard to clean over time?
    Matrix percs have a lot of slits, so they can gunk up if you never change your water. If you empty the rig regularly and give it an alcohol rinse once in a while, buildup stays manageable. For people who really hate cleanup, parking the rig on a nonstick accessory mat or pad helps keep drips and spills off your table so the whole station is easier to maintain.
  • Is 8.5 inches big enough for serious dabs, or is this more of a travel piece?
    At 8.5 inches (215mm), it sits in a sweet spot: small enough to be easy to handle and stash, but with enough volume and perc action to handle proper dabs. If your style is more low-temp, flavor-focused hits, this size is ideal. Heavy hitters who prefer big, lung-busting clouds might pair it with a larger rig for special occasions and keep this as the cleaner daily driver.
  • What kind of concentrates work best with this rig?
    You can run pretty much any style of concentrate through this rig — live resin, rosin, crumble, diamonds, you name it. If you like keeping multiple strains or consistencies on deck, storing them in proper concentrate jars will help preserve terps and keep the rig itself cleaner between swaps.
  • Is this a good option for someone newer to dabbing?
    Yes. The size is manageable, the function is forgiving, and the stable base makes it less intimidating for newer dabbers. You’re not juggling a giant piece, but you still get real filtration and comfort from the matrix perc and bent neck. Just remember to take things slow and stay within your comfort zone.
  • How should I store or transport this rig safely?
    For home storage, keep it upright on a flat surface away from edges and high-traffic spots. If you’re taking it to a friend’s place, padding it in a small case or wrapping it with soft material helps avoid surprises in transit. When it’s not in rotation, some people like to keep their more fragile pieces boxed while relying on tougher silicone bongs and rigs for travel and rougher environments.

At 7 inches (178mm), it’s small enough to stash but big enough to stack some bubbles for a comfortable rip.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Chiller hits in a small package — the built-in water chamber cools and filters your pull so you’re not getting cooked by dry pipe harshness.
  • Comfortable hammer grip — the hammer-style body balances nicely in your hand, so you’re not white-knuckling a tiny spoon or awkwardly holding a tall tube.

This hammer bubbler is made for smokers who want water filtration but don’t have the space (or patience) for a big, multi-chamber rig. Fill the bubbler by pouring a bit of water into the mouthpiece or bowl area until the downstem is just covered. You want enough water for good bubble action, but not so much that it splashes up toward the mouthpiece when you clear it. A quick test pull with no material will tell you if you’ve got the level right.

Once the water level feels dialed, pack the bowl with your favorite flower, hold the hammer in your dominant hand, and use the other to handle the lighter. The shape keeps the bowl angled up and visible, which is clutch when you’re sharing the piece or passing it around the table.     Let the piece cool, dump the water, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol until the buildup loosens. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry.   • Looks like a mini art piece — mushroom implosion and color accents make it way more interesting than a plain clear bubbler
  • Comfortable to hold — the classic bubbler shape sits naturally in your hand, even during long, chatty seshes

Pop off the silicone lid, drop in your herbs, hash, or dabs (inside your preferred packaging), then press the lid back on evenly around the rim. The Lookah Seahorse Type IV 510 Thread Coils 5-Pack is a quartz coil set built for Seahorse fans who care more about flavor than clouds-for-Instagram. Designed specifically for the Seahorse family of nectar-collector-style vapes, these tips use pure quartz to keep your concentrates tasting clean and terpy. You get five replacement coils in the pack, all with 510 threading and an upgraded airflow design for smoother pulls and better durability than earlier Seahorse tips.

Why It Works

  • Cleaner, brighter flavor — Pure quartz tips heat your concentrates without adding weird aftertaste, so you taste your material, not your hardware.
  • Fewer coil swaps — The reinforced Type IV design is built to outlast older Seahorse tips, so you’re not constantly re-ordering coils.
  • Smoother, less harsh hits — Improved airflow through the coil gives you more consistent pulls instead of tight, choked-off draws.
  • One pack, all your Seahorses — Works across the main Lookah Seahorse lineup, so you can keep a single coil style on deck for multiple devices.
  • Ready when one burns out — Five coils in each pack means you’re never stuck mid-sesh hunting for a backup.
  • Easy swap, no tools — Standard 510 threading means you just screw off the old tip and screw on a new one in seconds.

Best For

This 5-pack is made for dabbers who run their Seahorse daily and don’t want to sacrifice flavor just to stay portable. If you’re the “hit it off the jar and go” type, these quartz tips are a legit upgrade over metal or ceramic styles. They also pair nicely with compact rigs or nectar collectors when you want to keep a consistent flavor profile across your whole setup.

How to Use These Coils

Using the Lookah Seahorse Type IV coils is straightforward: screw a fresh quartz tip into the 510-threaded port on your Seahorse device until it’s snug and aligned. Make sure it’s seated fully so you get proper contact and steady power to the coil.

After your sesh, let the tip cool down, then do a quick burn-off to clear any leftover concentrate from the quartz. This helps prevent buildup, keeps flavor clean, and extends the life of each coil. When the tip looks heavily darkened, clogged, or flavor starts dropping off hard, it’s time to swap in another from the pack.

If you usually sesh at a desk or coffee table, it’s worth staging your Seahorse and coil pack on a nonstick dab pad or mat so any drips or sticky moments don’t end up glued to your table.

Specifications

Coil Type Lookah Seahorse Type IV
Material Quartz tip
Thread 510
Compatible Devices Lookah Seahorse, Seahorse Pro, Seahorse Max, Seahorse 2.0, Seahorse X, Seahorse Pro Plus
Pack Size 5 replacement coils

Fit & Compatibility

These Type IV coils are made specifically for the Lookah Seahorse line, so they play best with the devices listed: Seahorse, Seahorse Pro, Seahorse Max, Seahorse 2.0, Seahorse X, and Seahorse Pro Plus. They use standard 510 threading, but they’re shaped and tuned for Seahorse hardware, so results on random 510 batteries or pens may be disappointing even if they technically screw on.

If you like to keep your concentrates close to where you dab, grab some heavy-bottom concentrate jars so you can dip the quartz tip directly without juggling open containers.

Care & Coil Life Tips

To get the most out of each Type IV coil, treat the quartz tip like a small banger: don’t smash it into hard surfaces, avoid sudden temperature shocks, and try not to flood it with excess concentrate. Let it cool between heavier back-to-back pulls so the tip isn’t running at max heat for long stretches.

For general care, let the coil cool down, then gently wipe off the outside if there’s visible residue. For deeper cleaning, you can carefully swab the exterior once it’s fully cool and dry. Skip soaking the whole coil in alcohol or water — these are electronic components and liquid can ruin them. When in doubt, replacing a tired coil is better than pushing a burnt one and ruining the flavor of your stash.

If you’re building out a full portable kit with your Seahorse, it’s handy to toss your coils, jars, and loading tools into a small case along with other essentials like dab tools so you’re not hunting for them every time you want a quick hit.

FAQ

  1. Will these Type IV coils fit my non-Lookah 510 vape battery?
    They use standard 510 threading, so they may physically screw onto some 510 batteries, but they’re designed specifically for Lookah Seahorse devices. The airflow, power needs, and shape are tuned for the Seahorse line, so performance on random pen batteries isn’t guaranteed and may be poor.
  2. What’s the difference between Type IV and the older Seahorse tips?
    Type IV coils use a quartz tip with improved airflow and durability compared to earlier versions. You’ll usually notice cleaner flavor, better resistance to thermal stress, and less frequent replacements if you take care of them.
  3. How do I know when it’s time to replace a coil?
    If flavor drops off sharply, hits feel harsh even at your normal settings, or the tip is visibly dark, chipped, or clogged, it’s time to swap. You’ll also notice when it takes more effort to get vapor compared to a fresh coil — that’s a good sign to grab a new one from the pack.
  4. Can I soak the quartz tip in alcohol to clean it?
    Avoid soaking the whole coil in liquid, since there are electronic parts inside. Let the tip cool, then gently wipe the outside. If it’s heavily gunked up, it’s usually better to replace it rather than risk damaging it with aggressive cleaning.
  5. Are these coils good for all types of concentrates?
    Yes, the quartz Type IV tips work well with most standard waxy or dab-style concentrates. Just avoid super-runny liquids that could flood the tip, and always store your material properly in things like heavy glass glass jars so it stays stable and easy to work with.
  6. Do I need any special accessories to use these?
    Nothing special beyond your Seahorse device and your usual concentrate setup. A nonstick work surface, some parchment paper, and proper storage go a long way toward keeping the tips cleaner and making your whole routine smoother.
  7. Are these good for heavy, all-day use?
    They’re a solid choice for daily dabbers who run their Seahorse regularly throughout the day. If you’re absolutely chain-hitting nonstop, expect to replace coils more often — that’s just the reality of quartz tips. Keeping backups on hand and storing everything with your other storage and packaging gear makes it easier to swap and keep your flavor dialed in.

  • Carb caps: The included banger works with most standard directional and bubble caps sized for typical 14mm buckets. If you’re dialing in airflow, upgrading your cap is usually the first move.
  • Usage style: Best as a personal or two-person rig. It’s compact enough for quick solo seshes but still has enough volume for sharing a reasonable pull.

If you’re building out a full setup around it, adding a dedicated carb cap or other dab tools can make it a lot more fun to use when you’re a few dabs deep and just want things to work.

Care & Cleaning

To keep the glass clear and the flavor clean, don’t let reclaim build up forever. Let the rig and banger cool down, then empty any old water and wipe away loose residue where you can reach.

For deeper cleans, soak the glass parts in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let everything dry completely before you use it again. Swapping your water regularly will stretch the time between full deep cleans and keep hits tasting fresher.

FAQ

Will this rig fit my current banger or nail?
Yes, as long as your accessory is 14mm and made for a 90° joint, it should work. Double-check whether your banger is male or female and match that to the joint style on this rig before forcing anything.

Is 7.5 inches big enough for smooth hits?
For sure. The 2-hole perc and the fixed downstem move enough water to cool and diffuse your pull without needing a huge chamber. It’s designed as a compact daily driver, not a big, showy table piece.

What’s the benefit of the salt shaker body shape?
The salt shaker style gives you a stable, wider base and a nice central chamber for the perc to work in. It also makes filling and emptying simple—everything collects in one main body instead of a maze of tiny sections that are harder to clean.

Can I use this for flower if I swap the banger for a bowl?
If you have a 14mm flower bowl that matches the joint style, you can absolutely convert it, but it really shines as a rig for concentrates. If you want something more dedicated to bowls and dry flower, check out more traditional pieces in our broader smoke shop products lineup.

How do I keep it from tipping over?
The salt shaker body gives it a solid footprint, but like any glass rig, treat it with a little respect. Keeping it on a soft, grippy surface like a mat or tray and away from edges or swinging elbows goes a long way toward avoiding that "who knocked over the rig?" conversation.

What’s the best way to store it between seshes?
Dump the old water, give it a quick rinse, and let it dry before putting it away. If you’re traveling or packing up your gear, you can wrap it in a soft cloth and stash it with your other storage and packaging supplies so it’s not clanking around loose in a bag.

Is this rig okay for a first dab setup?
Yes, it’s actually a solid starter piece. The 14mm joint, simple perc, and included banger mean you don’t have to overthink matching parts. As you get more into dabbing, you can always upgrade things like your carb cap or banger style, similar to moving from basic glass pipes into more advanced silicone pipes or specialty glass.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Art on the table — the fully sculpted devil character gives this piece serious personality instead of looking like every other clear bubbler.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — water filtration in the hammer chamber helps knock down harshness and keeps hits easier on the throat.
  • Comfortable, classic feel — that hammer shape sits naturally in the hand so you’re not wrestling with it mid-sesh.

Best For

It’s also a nice upgrade for anyone moving from dry spoons into water pieces but not ready for a full-size bong yet.

If you’re already running a full rig or bigger water pipe, this makes a perfect "couch piece" while your main setup stays on the dab mat in the main station.

How to Use It

Think of this like a compact water pipe with a built-in personality. The hammer chamber holds enough water to smooth things out without making it feel bulky or heavy in the hand. Fit, Feel & Function

If you want something more throw-and-go for travel, this is a great “home base” piece, and you can grab a backup from our tougher silicone pipes for camping and road trips.

Care & Cleaning

Let the piece cool fully if it’s been in use. Then dump the old water and rinse the chamber with warm water.   • Can I use this for concentrates too?

The Lookah Seahorse Coil 510 Thread Coils Type V (4-pack) is a set of replacement quartz tips made for dabbers who live on their Seahorse, Seahorse Pro, Seahorse Max, and other compatible Lookah models. If you care more about flavor than massive clouds, these porous quartz coils are built for clean, tasty pulls from your wax and concentrates. Each pack includes four Type V coils, so you’re stocked for a while instead of scrambling mid-sesh.

Why it works

  • Terpene-forward flavor — Porous quartz tip keeps the taste clean and true to your extract instead of tasting like hot metal.
  • Made for Seahorse devices — 510-threaded Type V design is dialed in for the Lookah Seahorse lineup that supports these tips, so connection and performance feel right.
  • Efficient vaporization — The exposed quartz tip handles concentrates smoothly when you touch, not dunk, giving you consistent hits without wrecking the coil.
  • Less downtime — Pack of four coils means you’ve always got a fresh tip ready when one finally burns out or gets gunked.
  • Better control — Quartz responds quickly to heat changes, so it’s easier to find that sweet spot instead of getting surprised by harsh, overcooked hits.
  • Designed for dab-style use — Built for dipping/touching into concentrates, perfect if you like the nectar-collector style workflow with an electronic body.

Best for

This 4-pack is ideal for Seahorse owners who are hitting concentrates all week and don’t want to be stuck on a dead coil. If you’ve got multiple compatible Lookah devices around the house or you share gear with friends, keeping extra coils on hand is just smart. They also pair nicely with silicone or glass setups if you like to mix your vape style with more traditional smoke shop products in your rotation.

How to use it

Thread the coil into your compatible Lookah Seahorse device just like any other 510 accessory, making sure it’s snug but not overtightened. Once installed, you’ll use it like a touch-style tip, bringing the concentrates to the hot coil instead of scooping or loading directly inside it.

For best results and longer life, work with small amounts at a time and gently touch the edge of the quartz tip to your concentrate, rather than plunging the whole coil in. Setting your gear on a clean dab mat while you work helps keep sticky tools and tips off the table.

After a sesh, let the coil cool, then burn off any leftover residue with a short heat cycle instead of scraping it. Avoid cleaning brushes, pokers, or solvents on the quartz itself—those can crack, scratch, or shorten the lifespan of the coil. When a coil starts tasting off or looks heavily darkened, that’s your cue to swap in a fresh one from the pack.

Specifications

Product Lookah Seahorse Coil 510 Thread Coils — Type V
Material Quartz tip
Thread Type 510
Pack Size 4 coils
Compatibility Lookah Seahorse, Seahorse Pro, Seahorse Max, Seahorse 2.0, Seahorse Pro Plus, Seahorse X (Type V compatible models)

Fit & compatibility

These are Type V 510-thread Lookah coils, designed specifically for the Seahorse family that supports this style of tip. If your device is listed as compatible with Type V coils, you’re good to go. If you’re running multiple rigs on your desk—like silicone rigs or recyclers from our silicone bongs & rigs section—these coils are just for your Seahorse, not for direct rig use.

Always double-check your current coil model before ordering: Lookah makes different coil types (I, II, III, IV, V, etc.), and they’re not universally interchangeable across every Seahorse version. When in doubt, compare the product name in your device manual or on your current coil packaging to make sure you’re grabbing the right style.

Care tips

Let the coil cool before handling or swapping. To keep flavor clean, burn off leftover residue with brief heat cycles between heavy uses rather than scraping the tip. Don’t soak these coils or hit them with alcohol, water, or harsh cleaning tools—quartz tips don’t like thermal shock or abrasion.

When you’re not using your Seahorse, you can stash extra coils and your concentrates together in organized storage & packaging so they stay dust-free and easy to grab for the next sesh.

FAQ

  • Will these coils fit my Lookah Seahorse Pro?
    Yes. These Type V coils are compatible with the Lookah Seahorse Pro, along with models like the Seahorse, Seahorse Max, Seahorse 2.0, Seahorse Pro Plus, and Seahorse X that are listed as working with Type V tips.
  • How do I know if I need Type V coils or a different Lookah coil?
    Check the manual or original packaging for your Seahorse device; it usually lists the coil type (I, II, III, IV, V, etc.). You can also compare the shape and label on your current coil to this listing. If your device specifically calls out Type V or “Seahorse quartz” coils with this style, you’re in the right place.
  • Can I clean these coils with isopropyl alcohol or soak them?
    No, avoid liquids, soaking, or solvents on these quartz tips. Let the coil cool, then run a short heat cycle to burn off residue. For the rest of your gear like bangers, glass, or tools, keep separate cleaning routines and stash your fresh concentrates in proper concentrate jars so you’re not overworking the coil with old, dried material.
  • Why does my quartz tip taste burnt all of a sudden?
    Most of the time it’s from running the coil too hot, touching too much concentrate at once, or letting reclaim build up. Once flavor drops off and the quartz looks heavily darkened, it’s usually time to retire that coil and swap in a fresh one from the pack.
  • How should I store spare coils when they’re not in use?
    Keep them in a clean, dry spot away from dust, moisture, and extreme temps. Many people toss them in the same drawer or kit where they keep parchment, tools, and other essentials, or slip them into a small pouch with their dab tools so everything’s ready to grab.
  • Do these coils work with non-Lookah batteries or 510 devices?
    They use a 510 thread, but they’re specifically designed for Lookah Seahorse-style devices. Other generic 510 batteries may not drive them correctly or safely, so it’s best to stick with the intended Seahorse models instead of trying to hack them onto random vape pens.
  • What’s the difference between quartz coils and other Seahorse tips?
    Quartz tips like these Type V coils usually focus on cleaner flavor and a fast heat response, while some ceramic or other styles may be a bit more forgiving with heat but slightly different in taste. If you’re all about catching the full profile of your concentrates, pairing quartz tips with good parchment papers and fresh product tends to keep your flavor game strong.
