The EO VAPE (The Baker) is an electronic nectar collector built for dabbers who want rig-level hits without hauling a whole setup. It’s made for people who like quick, clean concentrate pulls straight from the jar, in the car, or between errands. With a compact 6.5 inch (165mm) body and fast electronic heating, you get on-demand vapor without a torch or messy loading.

Why It Works

  • On-demand dabs anywhere — Electronic heating means no torch, no butane, and no hunting for a lighter when you’re already in dab mode.
  • Use every last drop — Designed to sip directly from your concentrates so you can chase the corners of the jar and not waste the good stuff.
  • Pocket-sized but real power — At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s small enough for a jacket pocket but long enough to keep heat away from your face.
  • Quick heat-up — Heats in under 10 seconds so you’re not sitting around waiting for it to catch up to you.
  • Travel-friendly charging — USB-C charging keeps it simple, so you can plug into the same cords you use for most modern devices.
  • Less gear to carry — Skip the rig, torch, and banger; this takes their place when you just want straightforward hits without a full station.

Best For

The Baker is made for dabbers who live more out of their backpack or car than at a coffee table. If you’re always dipping into jars and want something more efficient (and less sketchy) than a glass straw and a torch, this will feel like an instant upgrade. It also pairs nicely with a good nonstick dab mat if you still keep a small home base sesh setup.

How to Use It

The Baker keeps things simple: power it on, let the tip reach temp, then bring your concentrates up to the heated tip for a controlled pull. You’re tasting what’s in the jar, not what picked up dust off the table, and you don’t have to juggle a red-hot nail or spinning cap.

For the smoothest experience, keep your concentrates in proper concentrate jars so the tip has a clean surface to contact. Soft or saucy textures tend to work really well with this style of device since you can easily guide the hot tip through the material without digging or scraping.

When you’re done, let the tip cool before pocketing it or tossing it back in your bag. Treat it like any other hot dab tool — give it a little time and a quick wipe so it’s ready for the next sesh.

Specifications

Product Type Electronic nectar collector
Length 6.5 inches (165mm)
Category Electronics / Nectar collector
Heating Time Under 10 seconds
Charging USB-C connectivity
Brand What You Need

Cleaning & Care

Let the device cool before you even think about cleaning. Once it’s cool, wipe the tip to remove any leftover residue. For a deeper reset, you can soak the removable tip in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry thoroughly before you put it back on and use it again.

Fit & Compatibility

The Baker is built to work with most common concentrate consistencies — think wax, crumble, sugar, and sauces — as long as they’re in a dish or jar with enough room for the tip. It’s especially handy with low-profile glass containers and heavier-bottom glass jars that you can hold steady while you tap around the corners.

If you like having different textures on hand, you can organize everything together with dedicated storage and packaging options, then just grab one jar and the Baker when you’re walking out the door. It behaves like any other nectar collector: the main thing is just giving it enough space to contact the material without smashing the tip into the glass.

FAQ

  • What kind of concentrates work best with The Baker?

    Most dab-ready concentrates work well — wax, budder, sugar, crumble, and similar textures. Super hard shatter can be trickier if it’s in a big chunk, but once it’s broken up or softened a bit, it’s still usable. Keeping your different strains split into labeled mylar bags or jars makes it easy to grab what works best with a nectar collector.

  • Can I dab straight from any jar?

    As long as the container opening gives the tip enough room to get in and move around without smashing into the sides, you’re good. Short, wide jars are usually the easiest, and heavy-bottom styles help you avoid tipping while you’re pulling a dab.

  • How portable is it really?

    At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s genuinely pocketable but still big enough to feel solid in your hand. It’s a lot easier to toss this in a bag than a full rig and torch, and it makes a solid on-the-go backup even if you already have a bigger setup at home.

  • How long does the battery last?

    Battery life depends on how often and how long you’re hitting it, but it’s built to last through multiple seshes before you need to recharge. Since it uses USB-C, you can usually share chargers with your other electronics or grab one from our general smoke shop products lineup that fits your setup.

  • Do I still need a torch or rig with this?

    No torch needed — that’s the whole point of going electronic here. Some people still keep a traditional rig at home and use The Baker as their travel piece, but it can definitely stand alone as your main way to hit concentrates if you like the nectar collector style.

  • How do I keep the tip from getting gunked up?

    Try not to bury the hot tip too deep into your concentrates; just touch and pull what you need. Wipe it down after use so buildup doesn’t bake on between seshes. If you let it go too long, a quick soak and rinse brings it back.

  • Is this a good option for someone new to nectar collectors?

    Yes — it removes the whole torch and open flame part of the equation, which is what usually puts people off. If you already use glass nectar collectors and want something easier and more portable, this feels like a natural upgrade.

The 3" 14mm Male 45° Monark Ratchet Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on for people who love their bong but hate cleaning it every other day. Built for 14mm female, 45° water pipes, it drops in a ratchet perc stage before your main piece so most of the ash and gunk never makes it into your tube. At just 3 inches (76mm) tall, it keeps your setup balanced while still adding real diffusion and smoother pulls.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Way less bong cleanup — catches ash and debris before it hits your main piece, so your water stays cleaner longer.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — the ratchet perc adds an extra layer of diffusion without turning your hit into a marathon.
  • Protects your favorite glass — keeps grime and hot ash off your main perc stack and walls, which helps your daily driver last longer.
  • Dialed for 45° setups — designed specifically for 14mm female, 45° joint bongs so it hangs just right instead of feeling awkward or tilted.
  • Easy to eyeball when it’s dirty — clear glass makes it obvious when it’s time to swap the water or give it a quick soak.
  • Low-profile add-on — only 3 inches (76mm) tall, so it doesn’t make your piece top-heavy or clumsy to pass around.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people running a 14mm, 45° water pipe as their main smoke shop setup and who are sick of scrubbing built-up resin out of every nook and cranny. It’s especially clutch for daily smokers who want cleaner water, smoother function, and a little extra protection for their favorite glass.

How to Use It

Pop the 14mm male joint of the Monark Ratchet Ash Catcher into the 14mm female joint on your bong (at a 45° angle), then attach your bowl to the ash catcher’s top joint if applicable. The 45° geometry keeps everything lined up so it sits naturally without stressing your joint. Once you’re set up, the ash catcher becomes the first stop in your airflow path, catching ash and cooling the smoke a bit before it ever touches your main chamber.

Between bowls, you can quickly dump the water from the ash catcher instead of tearing down your whole piece, which makes it way easier to keep things fresh on a busy day. Setting your setup on a solid dab mat while you empty or clean the ash catcher helps catch drips and keeps the table from getting gross.

When the perc slits start to look dark or the water gets cloudy, that’s your cue to give it a quick refresh. Let it cool first, then empty, rinse, and if it’s really gunked up, soak in isopropyl alcohol for a bit, rinse well, and you’re good to go again.

Joint Angle 45°
Perc Style Ratchet Perc

Fit & Compatibility

This piece is built to plug straight into any water pipe with a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle. If you’re building a full matching setup with silicone gear, this ash catcher plays especially well with compact rigs and smaller silicone bongs and rigs that already sit at a 45° angle.

Cleaning & Care

Let the ash catcher cool after use, then dump the water and tap out any loose ash into a trash bin. For light maintenance, a hot water rinse does the trick; for deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before your next sesh. Regular quick cleans here will save you from doing full rebuilds on your main piece as often.

Build & Function Details

The whole idea behind a ratchet perc is tight, even diffusion. Smoke passes through a series of small slits or holes arranged around the perc, breaking the hit into smaller bubbles for better contact with the water. That extra contact knocks down some harshness and pulls more ash and fine particles out of the stream before it ever hits your bong.

Because the Monark Ratchet Ash Catcher is short and compact, you get that extra filtration without adding a ton of drag or making the setup feel fragile. It’s the kind of upgrade you notice most after you go back to hitting your piece without it and realize how much more often you’re changing your main chamber water. If you’re already picky about how clean your rigs, bowls, and smoke accessories stay, this slots right into that routine.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your water pipe has a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle, you’re set. If it’s 18mm, 10mm, or a 90° joint, you’d need an adapter or a different ash catcher style to get a clean fit.
  • Does adding this make my piece harder to pull?
    There’s a small amount of extra drag, like you’d expect with any extra perc, but the ratchet design keeps airflow surprisingly open. Most people notice the smoother hit more than any extra resistance.
  • How often should I change the water in the ash catcher?
    Any time you see it getting cloudy, dark, or full of floaties, dump and refill. Since it’s way easier to clean than your main tube, most people refresh the ash catcher water way more often than the bong water and keep everything tasting cleaner. If you’re storing your flower or concentrates in clean glass jars and packaging, it’s worth keeping your water just as fresh.
  • Can I use this with a recycler or small rig?
    As long as your recycler or rig has a 14mm female joint at 45° and enough clearance for the added height, it should work fine. On very tiny pieces, just make sure the extra weight doesn’t make it feel tippy.
  • What’s the benefit of a ratchet perc vs a basic chamber?
    A simple ash catcher is basically just a pre-chamber, while the ratchet perc actively diffuses the hit through multiple slits. That means better filtration and smoother pulls, not just catching bigger chunks of ash.
  • How do I keep the perc from clogging?
    Rinse with hot water regularly and don’t wait until it’s totally caked before cleaning. If the slits start to look blocked, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and you’re good. Keeping your bowls packed cleanly and storing your stash properly in airtight storage and packaging can also help cut down on excess crumbs and dust.
  • Is this better for daily use or occasional seshes?
    It shines as a daily driver upgrade because it saves so much cleanup time, but even occasional smokers will appreciate how much it protects their main piece. If you already use things like joint tubes to keep gear neat and clean on the go, an ash catcher is that same mindset applied to your home glass.

Will this fit my existing 14mm accessories?

What does “fumed” glass actually mean?

Fumed glass is made by bonding thin layers of metal (usually silver or gold) into the glass during the blowing process. As resin builds up and the piece sees heat and use, the colors deepen and shift, so over time your bong slowly takes on a more vibrant, custom look.

How do I clean it without ruining the fume?

You can clean fumed glass like any other glass piece. Let it cool, empty the water, and rinse. For heavier buildup, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry. The fume is embedded in the glass itself, so normal cleaning won’t strip it away.

How fragile is the base?

Avoid dropping it on hard surfaces, don’t knock it against sinks or counters, and when you’re traveling, wrap it or stash it next to softer pieces like silicone bongs and rigs so it doesn’t get bumped around.

  • Easy match for common setups — 14mm male joint with a 45° angle plays nicely with a ton of standard water pipes.
  • Compact but effective — 5 inches (127mm) tall keeps things balanced without turning your rig into a top-heavy science project.
  • Adds a pop of color — The colored showerhead section makes your setup look more dialed-in instead of just “add-on glass.”
  • Protects your investment — Keeping grime out of your main piece helps preserve percs, joints, and overall function over time.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for daily drivers who want cleaner function without babying their glass. If you’re the type who hits the same piece all week and hates watching the base water turn tea-colored halfway through the day, this is for you. It’s also clutch if you already run a mid-size rig or tube and want an extra layer of diffusion without buying a whole new piece from the smoke shop products section.

How to Use It

Using this ash catcher is simple: plug it into your 14mm female 45° joint, make sure it’s sitting level, add a little water to cover the showerhead slits, and you’re ready to go. The smoke or vapor travels down into the showerhead, gets broken up through the perc, and then flows into your main piece already cooled and filtered.

Because this is an extra water chamber, it adds just a bit of drag—but in a good way. You’ll notice hits feel smoother and your main rig’s water stays noticeably cleaner, even after a long night of passing it around on a dab mat.

For cleaning, let the ash catcher cool, dump the dirty water, then rinse with isopropyl alcohol. For deeper cleans, give it a soak in ISO, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry before you throw it back on your setup.

Specifications

Height 5 inches (127mm)
Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 45°
Perc Style Showerhead perc
Material Glass
Color Multiple color options (colored showerhead section)
Brand Monark (Wyn Brands / What You Need)

Fit & Compatibility

This piece is built for 14mm female 45° joints, which you’ll find on a lot of classic-style bongs and smaller rigs. If your piece has a 90° joint or a different joint size, you’ll need a different style ash catcher or an adapter to make everything line up.

Because it’s only 5 inches (127mm) tall, it won’t usually make your setup feel awkward or front-heavy, but if your main piece is super tiny or super thin glass, just be mindful of how you set it down. If you’re running silicone as your daily driver, this ash catcher can still be used as long as the joint matches, and you can pair it with one of our durable silicone bongs & rigs for a combo that’s both colorful and hard to break.

Why a Showerhead Ash Catcher?

Showerhead percs are a sweet middle ground: more diffusion than a simple open downstem, but not so complex that they’re a pain to clean. The slitted disc design spreads smoke evenly through the water, which helps with cooling and filtering without clogging as easily as some micro-slit or stacked designs.

On a practical level, that means you get smoother function and your main rig or bong doesn’t take the beating. The ash catcher collects most of the heavier particles and buildup, which is way easier to soak and rinse than deep-cleaning your whole piece every time it starts looking rough.

What’s Included

  • 1 × 5” Monark Color Shower Head Ash Catcher (14mm Male, 45°)

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?
    If your piece has a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle, you’re good. If it’s 90° or a different joint size (like 10mm or 18mm), this specific ash catcher won’t line up correctly without an adapter.
  • Can I use this for both flower and concentrates?
    Yes. It’ll catch ash from bowls and also help keep reclaim and residue out of your main piece when you’re dabbing. Just be aware that if you swap back and forth often, you’ll want to clean it more regularly. For dab setups, pairing it with solid dab tools keeps your whole station feeling dialed in.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Add just enough to cover the showerhead slits when it’s sitting in its normal position. Too much water can cause splashback or extra drag; too little and you won’t get proper diffusion.
  • How do I clean it without risking breakage?
    Let it cool completely, dump any old water, then add isopropyl alcohol and gently shake or soak. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before reattaching. Avoid super hot water right after heavy use to reduce thermal shock on the glass.
  • Will this make my setup feel too heavy?
    At 5 inches (127mm), it’s fairly compact, so most medium-sized pieces handle it just fine. If your bong or rig has a really small base, be a little extra careful setting it down so nothing tips—especially if you’re running a heavy bowl or banger on the front.
  • Is this better than getting a more complex perc piece?
    It depends what you’re after. This ash catcher is a quick, affordable way to upgrade diffusion and keep your main piece cleaner without buying a whole new tube. If you’re buying new glass anyway, you might combine this with a good main perc and some proper glass jars & packaging to keep your flower and concentrates fresh between seshes.
  • How should I store or travel with it?
    Treat it like any other glass accessory: padded case, bubble wrap, or a protected box works well. If you’re packing up the rest of your stash in storage & packaging options, just make sure the ash catcher isn’t loose where it can knock into heavier items.

If you’re trying to stretch the time between deep cleans on your favorite piece while getting smoother, more filtered hits, this 5” Monark Color Shower Head Ash Catcher is the kind of upgrade you notice on day one and then never want to take off your rig.

The Cali by VIBES™ 1 Gram Box – Ultra Thin is a premium pack of 1-gram pre-rolled cones built for flower smokers who like big pulls without tasting paper. Each cone is made from ultra-thin French rolling paper so your strain’s flavor stays clean and loud from start to finish. With 24 cones per box, this is a stash-ready setup for anyone who rolls often and hates running out mid-week.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Full flavor, less paper — Ultra-thin French paper means minimal paper taste, so you mostly taste your flower, not the wrap.
  • Big 1g capacity — Each cone is sized for roughly 1 gram, perfect for sharing or a long solo sesh when you don’t want to keep re-rolling.
  • Smooth, open pulls — The Cali-style cone has a wide, cylindrical body that promotes easy airflow, so you’re not fighting for every hit.
  • Fast, consistent packing — Pre-rolled and shaped for stability, so filling is straightforward and your cones don’t collapse while you’re working.
  • Box built for real use — Comes as 8 packs of 3 cones (24 total), so you can toss a 3-pack in your pocket and leave the rest safe at home.
  • Berner-inspired design — Modeled after the big Cali-style cones you see on tour and in the studio, but ready for everyday use.

Best for

The Cali by VIBES™ 1 Gram Box is made for people who like real joints—heavier grams, slow burn, and room to taste the terps. Ideal if you’re rolling for a small group, pre-rolling for the week, or just like one solid cone instead of a bunch of tiny ones. If you already keep your flower dialed in with proper storage and packaging, these cones finish the job by letting that freshness actually come through.

How to Use It

Each cone comes pre-formed with a built-in tip, so you’re just filling and packing—no shaping or crutch cutting required. Grind your herb evenly, load the cone a bit at a time, and tap or lightly pack as you go to keep the shape tight and even from filter to tip.

Once it’s filled to your preferred level (up to about 1 gram), twist or fold the end to close. A gentle, even pack means smoother airflow and fewer runs, especially with ultra-thin paper. Setting your cones on a dab mat or small tray while you fill can help keep things tidy instead of scattering flower all over the table.

The box is meant to live in your bag, drawer, or glove box—pull out a 3-pack when you’re headed to a sesh, keep the rest tucked away for when you’re running late and don’t have time to deal with loose papers.

Specifications

Specification Details
Paper Type Ultra-thin rolling paper
Paper Origin France
Cone Capacity Approx. 1 gram per cone
Total Cones per Box 24 cones (8 packs of 3)
Style The Cali by VIBES™ pre-rolled cones

Fit & Compatibility

These are standard 1-gram pre-rolled cones, so they play nice with most cone fillers, packing tools, and rolling aids sized for king/1g cones. If you use a packing funnel or loader from your local smoke shop, it’ll likely line up fine with this shape. They’re also a great match with basic smoke shop accessories like storage tubes or smell-proof pouches if you like to pre-roll and take a few with you.

Care & Handling

Keep the box closed and store it somewhere dry and cool so the ultra-thin paper doesn’t wrinkle or get soft. Avoid crushing it at the bottom of a backpack—treat it like a pack of nice papers. If a cone gets slightly bent, you can usually straighten it gently before filling.

FAQ

  • Are these pre-rolled cones or flat papers?

    These are fully pre-rolled cones with tips already installed. You don’t have to roll or shape the paper yourself—just fill, pack, and you’re ready to go. If you’re used to flat papers, this is a nice upgrade when you want something quicker and more consistent.

  • How many cones do I actually get in one box?

    Each box comes with 24 total cones, broken up into 8 packs of 3. That makes it easy to toss a 3-pack in your pocket or stash bag and leave the rest safely stored at home or in your kit.

  • What’s special about the ultra-thin paper?

    Ultra-thin paper means there’s less material between you and your flower, so your strain’s flavor isn’t competing with a heavy paper taste. It also tends to burn more evenly when packed right, which is why people who care about terps gravitate toward thinner papers. If you like to preserve that flavor even further, pairing your cones with quality glass jars for your flower is a solid move.

  • Do these cones work well for sharing?

    Yes—each cone is sized for around 1 gram, which is ideal for passing around with a small group or running a longer solo sesh. The wide Cali-style body also helps keep the burn steady when it’s moving between hands, as long as it’s packed evenly.

  • Can I use these with grinders and loaders?

    Absolutely. A consistent grind always helps these cones pack better, and they play well with most cone loaders, funnels, and packing tools designed for king/1g sizes. If you’re setting up a full station, pairing them with simple rolling accessories like packing sticks, funnels, or trays makes the process even smoother.

  • How should I store the box so the cones don’t get damaged?

    Keep the box in a cool, dry place away from direct moisture and heavy pressure. A drawer, cabinet, or a dedicated stash spot in your bag works well. If you pre-fill cones, let them dry if needed and then tuck them into joint tubes or other protective cases for travel.

  • Are there different blends or just one paper type?

    This listing is specifically for the Ultra Thin version of The Cali by VIBES™ 1 Gram cones. VIBES makes different blends in their broader line, but this pack is all ultra-thin French paper for the cleanest flavor experience.

  • Is this a good choice for rolling multiple cones in advance?

    Yes. The 24-cone count and 1g size make it easy to prep a few for the next couple days or for an event. Just fill them, let them rest if needed, and then store your pre-rolls somewhere safe and dry—many people pair pre-roll prep with their use of parchment papers to keep their workspace clean and organized.

If you like clean flavor, easy packing, and reliable Cali-style cones, the VIBES™ 1 Gram Ultra Thin box is one of those upgrades that quietly becomes your new standard.

The Cali 1 Gram Rice Box is made for smokers who like big, slow-burning joints but don’t want to roll from scratch every time. If most of your gear lives in one stash spot with a grinder, lighter, and a couple of go-to smoke shop accessories, these cones fit right into that daily routine.

Think of these like a perfectly rolled joint shell waiting for your flower. Each cone already has a filter tip and that signature wide body, so you just load your ground flower, pack it down gently, and twist the end. The design is meant to keep airflow open even when you fill the full gram, so it still pulls nicely instead of turning into a clogged log.

Because the rice paper is thin and slow-burning, it’s great for longer hangs or when you’re passing around the circle and don’t want the joint to vanish halfway through. Keeping your workspace organized with a dedicated dab mat or pad helps catch stray crumbs and keeps the box clean between rolls.

Once you’re done, let any leftover cone cool completely if you set it down, then tap out the ash gently. For storage between seshes, tuck unused cones back into the box or move a few into your go-bag so you’ve always got a fresh Cali waiting.

FAQ

How many cones are in The Cali 1 Gram Box?
Each box comes with 24 pre-rolled cones. They’re usually packed as 8 smaller packs of 3 cones, which makes it easy to toss a pack in your bag while keeping the rest safe at home.

Do these come filled or empty?
They’re empty cones. You add your own flower, which is great if you care about what you’re smoking and want that Cali-style roll without needing to roll it yourself. If you’re also pressing your own rosin or working with solventless, you can keep your flower and concentrates dialed in using the same quality gear you’d grab from our rosin extraction lineup.

What’s the difference between rice paper and regular papers?
Rice papers are typically thinner and burn slower than a lot of standard papers, which helps with flavor and longer burns. With these VIBES rice cones, that means less paper taste and more of your strain coming through, especially noticeable on those longer 1 gram rolls.

Can I pack less than 1 gram in each cone?

Keep the box closed and somewhere dry, out of direct sunlight. You can also move a few into a small jar or tube if you’re traveling, and leave the rest in their original box at home. Protecting them from humidity swings helps the paper stay crisp and easy to pack.

Will these fit in a standard cone loader or packing tool?
Most cone loaders sized for 1 gram cones should work fine since these use the typical cone footprint, just with that wider style body. If you’re hand-packing, a small tool or multi-use dab tool works great to tamp down your flower without over-compressing it.

The 6" MAVEN MODEL K Torch is a compact, refillable butane torch built for dabbers, home cooks, and makers who want a dialed-in jet flame without dragging around a giant tabletop unit. At 6 inches (152mm) long with a single windproof jet, it gives you enough reach to stay back from the heat while still feeling super controlled in the hand. If you want a reliable, no-fuss torch that just lights every time and holds its flame, this is that piece.

The Model K focuses on simple, solid function: sturdy metal body, adjustable flame, and an ignition hold so you can lock it on when you need hands-off heat. It’s sized right for a daily driver — big enough to be stable on a desk, small enough to toss in a bag without feeling like you packed a flamethrower.

Why it works

  • Dial in your heat — Adjustable flame control lets you go from quick, small jobs to hotter, longer burns with a simple twist.
  • Stays lit when it’s breezy — Single windproof jet flame keeps going even when the air’s moving, so outdoor use doesn’t turn into a restart marathon.
  • Hands-free when you need it — Ignition hold/lock feature keeps the torch running without you having to clamp down on the button the whole time.
  • Comfortable, compact size — 6 inches (152mm) is that sweet spot: enough length to keep your hand away from the hot zone, short enough to handle easily.
  • Built to feel solid, not flimsy — Zinc alloy and metal construction give it weight and durability, so it doesn’t feel like a disposable lighter in disguise.
  • Easy refills, long-term tool — Runs on standard butane, so you can top it off in seconds and keep using the same torch instead of throwing out plastic.

Best for

This torch is made for dabbers who want consistent heat without messing around with finicky cheap lighters and for anyone who needs a compact, legit torch around the house. It’s right at home next to your rig on a dab mat, but it also pulls double duty for kitchen work, small DIY projects, and crafts that need focused flame.

If you’re heating glass, metal, or tools multiple times a day and don’t want to baby your gear, the MAVEN MODEL K is a strong choice. It’s especially nice for people who like a clean, simple torch that feels good in the hand instead of some oversized shop burner.

How to use it

Set your MAVEN MODEL K on a stable, heat-safe surface, then flip it upright in your hand when you’re ready to work. Use the ignition to spark the single jet flame and then adjust the flame size with the built-in control until it matches what you’re doing — smaller for quick touch-ups, larger when you need more heat on deck.

For longer tasks, use the ignition hold to keep the flame going without having to keep your thumb locked down. When you’re done, switch it off, set it somewhere safe, and let it cool before you stash it with your other dab tools or kitchen gear.

Refilling is straightforward: once the torch is cool and off, flip it upside down and use a standard butane refill can on the fill port. Give it a moment to settle after refilling before you light it again so the gas can stabilize.

Specifications

Fit & everyday use

It’s a single-jet design, so if you’re used to massive multi-jet torches, this one will feel more precise and controlled rather than brute-force. That’s perfect for targeted heating and everyday use, though heavy industrial-style jobs might call for something larger.

Care & maintenance

Let the torch cool completely before handling after use. If the exterior gets dusty or smudged, just wipe it down with a dry or lightly damp cloth — avoid soaking or submerging it. For long life, use clean, quality butane and don’t leave it stored in hot cars or direct sun.

When it’s not in use, keep it in a drawer, tool case, or alongside your other gear like accessories and storage pieces so it’s easy to grab for your next sesh or project.

FAQ

  • Is the 6" MAVEN MODEL K Torch good for dabbing?
    Yes, this torch works great for dabbers who want a reliable, windproof jet flame without going overkill on size. It’s a nice companion to smaller rigs and tabletop setups, especially when paired with a solid silicone bong or rig for a sturdy, heat-friendly station.
  • Can I use this torch outside?
    Definitely. The windproof single jet is designed to stay lit better than a typical lighter when there’s a breeze, making it a good option for patio hangs, camping, or outdoor projects.
  • What kind of fuel does it take?
    The MAVEN MODEL K is designed for standard butane. Use a refill can with the correct nozzle tip, connect it to the fill valve on the bottom of the torch, and refill according to the instructions that come with your butane.
  • How big is it compared to other torches?
    At 6 inches (152mm), it sits in that "mid-size" category — bigger and sturdier than a pocket lighter, but smaller and more portable than a big shop-style tabletop torch. It’s easy to store with your jars, bags, and other storage & packaging gear.
  • Is this only for dabs, or can I use it in the kitchen too?

  • How do I keep it working well over time?

  • Does it come filled with butane?
    Most torches ship empty or minimally filled for safety, so plan on having a can of butane ready when it arrives. Once filled properly, you’ll get plenty of lights before needing to top it off again.

The 6" MAVEN MODEL K Torch is the kind of reliable, no-drama flame source you end up reaching for every day — for rigs, for kitchen projects, and for random tasks where a lighter just doesn’t cut it. If you’re building out a full kit, it pairs nicely with solid concentrate jars, mats, and tools so your whole setup feels dialed instead of pieced together.

At only 3 inches (76mm), it gives you cleaner function without turning your setup into a bulky science project.

This little guy is all about keeping the piece you actually care about cleaner, longer, while adding a subtle pop of color instead of another plain clear attachment.

Why it works

  • Way less scrubbing on your main piece — Catches ash and gunk before it hits your bong or rig, so your actual glass stays clear and way easier to maintain.
  • Plug-and-play fit — 14mm male joint is made to drop right into any 14mm female joint, no weird adapters or guesswork.
  • Stays lined up with your piece — 90° angle is perfect for upright bongs and rigs with a 90° joint, keeping the bowl level and your function smooth.
  • Color where it counts — Colored joint and Encore decal add just enough style to make your setup look intentional, not random.
  • Pull-out design for quick dumps — Slide the bowl or slide out, clear the ash catcher, pop it back in, and you’re ready for the next round.
  • Protects higher-end glass — Acts like a sacrificial piece, taking the staining and heat so your favorite tube doesn’t have to.

Best for

This ash catcher is ideal for daily drivers who are tired of deep-cleaning their main piece every couple of days. If you’re hitting flower bowls back-to-back or passing around a single bong at every sesh, this keeps things tasting fresher and looking less grimy. It’s also a solid upgrade if you’ve got a nicer piece and want an affordable layer of protection before you risk chipping or staining it, especially if most of your other smoke shop gear is already dialed in.

How to use it

Using the Encore Pull Out Ash Catcher is straightforward: the 14mm male joint goes directly into your water pipe or rig’s 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, and your slide or bowl goes into the ash catcher’s joint. That way, ash drops into the catcher instead of blasting straight into your main chamber.

Keep a little bit of water in the catcher (if you prefer that extra bit of diffusion) and dump it when it starts to look cloudy or smell off. To keep your table from getting sticky when you pull it off, park your piece on a nonstick dab mat so any drips or spills stay contained instead of soaking into wood or cloth.

When you’re done for the day, let it cool down, pull it off your rig, and empty the water and ash. A quick rinse after each use goes a long way to keeping it from getting permanently stained, especially if you’re using it as a daily attachment alongside your favorite silicone bongs and rigs.

Think straight-tube or beaker style pieces with a vertical joint coming straight out — that’s the sweet spot for this accessory.

Let the ash catcher cool before you mess with it, then remove it from your piece and dump the water and ash. Rinse with warm water to knock loose the loose stuff.   • Will this fit my piece?

  • Does it change how my piece hits?
    It can add a tiny bit of drag because you’re adding another chamber, but most people barely notice it. What you will notice is less ash in your main water and a cleaner taste over time, especially if you keep up with basic maintenance and use it alongside fresh glass or even sturdy nectar collectors when you switch to concentrates.
  • Can I use it with concentrates too?
    It’s mainly designed as an ash catcher for dry herb bowls, not a dedicated concentrate rig. That said, some people do run small bangers off ash catchers — just remember that’s extra weight on the joint and more heat exposure to glass that wasn’t really designed for high-temp dabbing.
  • How often should I clean it?
    If you’re hitting bowls all day, every day, a quick rinse daily and a deeper clean every few days keeps it looking good and prevents that permanent brown ghost stain. Heavy flower smokers who like their glass clear usually treat the ash catcher as the “dirty” piece so their main tube can go longer between serious cleanings.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built as a functional, everyday accessory, not ultra-thin novelty glass. Still, it’s glass — try not to drop it in the sink or slam it against the table. If you’re clumsy or share seshes with a rowdy crew, pairing it with nonstick parchment paper or a soft work surface isn’t a bad idea when you’re breaking everything down.
  • Does it come with a bowl or slide?
    This listing is for the ash catcher itself. You’ll need your own 14mm bowl or slide to plug into the joint on top, which most people already have from their main bong setup.
  • How do I keep the labels and color looking fresh?
    Avoid scratching the outside with abrasive tools and don’t soak the decal in super hot water for long periods. A simple alcohol soak and rinse is enough. If you’re handling a lot of sticky material around your glass, storing concentrates in proper concentrate jars instead of open containers helps keep the outside of your gear cleaner too.

The 6″ Two-Tone Donut Glass Bubbler is a compact glass bubbler for flower lovers who want smoother, cooler hits without hauling around a full-size bong. It’s built for people who care as much about the look of their piece as the function, with a standout donut-shaped chamber that really pops on a coffee table. At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough to be a daily carry but still has enough water volume for genuinely comfortable pulls.

Key Benefits

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The donut chamber forces smoke to travel farther and interact with more water, helping mellow out harshness before it hits your lungs.
  • Art-piece vibes — Two-tone color work and unique swirls mean no two bubblers look exactly the same, so your piece doesn’t feel mass-produced.
  • Still pocketable — At 6 inches (152mm), it’s big enough to function like a real bubbler but small enough to tuck into a bag for a park sesh or a friend’s place.
  • Easy, familiar workflow — If you’ve used a spoon or Sherlock before, the transition to this bubbler is basically instant: just add a little water and you’re set.
  • Less splashback — The donut design and upright profile help keep water down in the chamber so you’re not drinking your bong water mid-hit.
  • Thick glass feel — Made from quality glass with a solid hand feel, so it doesn’t feel fragile every time you set it down.

Best For

This bubbler is made for people who want a smoother alternative to dry hand pipes but don’t have the space (or interest) for a big tube. It shines as a daily driver for solo flower heads, a coffee-table piece for small apartments, or a compact upgrade if you’re coming from basic spoons. If you’ve already got a big water pipe or silicone bongs & rigs, this is a perfect “grab-and-go” option that still feels special.

The Basics

Function-wise, this is a classic handheld bubbler with a twist: the body has a donut-shaped chamber. Smoke is drawn from the bowl, down into the water, then pulled around that donut space before reaching the mouthpiece. That extra path and surface area is what helps knock the edge off hotter hits.

Because it’s one solid piece of glass, there are no moving parts or connections to worry about. Just a bowl, a water chamber, and a mouthpiece all fused into one smooth profile — simple, quick, and reliable when you’re already a couple bowls in and just want things to work.

How to Use It

Start by adding a small amount of water through the mouthpiece or bowl area — you only need enough to cover the end of the internal downstem. Give it a quick pull to make sure you’re getting gentle bubbling without splashing into your mouth. Once the water level feels right, you’re good to load up.

Grind or break up your flower, pack the bowl to your preferred density, then use it like any other bubbler or pipe: pull through the mouthpiece while you heat the bowl and let the water and donut chamber do the smoothing for you. It pairs nicely with a clean work zone — dropping it on a soft dab mat or pad helps protect the glass when you set it down between hits.

For cleaning, let the piece cool fully, then empty any leftover water. A quick rinse and wipe usually keeps day-to-day buildup in check. When it needs a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before your next sesh.

Specifications

Height Material Main Design Feature
6 inches (152mm) Glass Donut-style chamber

Fit & Compatibility

This is a standalone bubbler — the bowl is built in, so you’re not swapping out slides or joints like a bong. That makes it super grab-and-go, but also means it’s not about modular add-ons. It plays best with good flower prep (a decent break-up or grind) and a lighter touch on packing so the airflow can do its thing.

If you like keeping all your gear organized, this piece fits right in with smaller tabletop setups alongside trays, lighters, and a couple of simple accessories like storage or basic tools.

What You Get

  • 1 × 6″ Two-Tone Donut Glass Bubbler
  • Unique two-tone color pattern (varies by piece)

FAQ

  • How much water should I put in this bubbler?
    Just enough to cover the end of the internal downstem is usually ideal. Too much and you’ll get splashback; too little and you won’t get that smooth bubbling. Add a little, test the pull, and adjust until it feels right for you.
  • Is the color exactly the same as the photos?
    No — that’s part of the fun. The two-tone swirls and patterns vary from piece to piece, so your bubbler will have the same style but its own unique look. Think of the photos as the general vibe, not an exact clone.
  • Can I use this with concentrate or is it just for flower?
    This piece is designed as a flower bubbler with a built-in bowl. If you mostly dab, you’ll probably be happier with a dedicated rig or nectar collector that’s built around concentrates from the start.
  • What’s the best way to keep it clean?
    Dump the water after each sesh so it doesn’t get funky, then rinse with warm water. When buildup starts to show, soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry. No fancy tools needed.
  • Is this fragile, or can it handle daily use?
    It’s still glass, so you don’t want to chuck it across the room, but it’s built for regular use. Treat it like any other nice glass piece: set it down gently, don’t drop it in the sink, and avoid super hard surfaces. If you’re rough on gear, you might want a backup in durable silicone pipes for travel or camping.
  • Does this replace a full-size bong?
    It can, depending on what you’re after. You’ll get smoother hits than a dry hand pipe, with way less bulk than a tall tube. Heavy hitters might still keep a full-size bong at home, while using this bubbler as their smaller daily driver or couch piece.
  • What else should I grab with this?
    Most people like to pair it with a decent grinder and some basic storage so their flower stays fresh between bowls. A small stash jar from our storage & packaging collection keeps your herb ready to go and helps the flavor stay on point.

If you want a piece that hits like a bubbler, carries like a hand pipe, and still looks like something you’d proudly leave out on the table, the 6″ Two-Tone Donut Glass Bubbler checks all the boxes.

The 5.5″ Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig from What You Need is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate lovers who want big function in a small footprint. At just 5.5 inches (140mm) tall with a triple ratchet perc and donut-style mouthpiece, it’s made for dabbers chasing smooth, flavorful hits without hauling around a giant piece. The 14mm male 90° banger means it’s ready to drop into your daily rotation right out of the box.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — The triple ratchet perc breaks your vapor into smaller bubbles so each hit feels softer on the throat.
  • Flavor without the drag — Short 5.5 inch (140mm) path keeps terps tasting fresh instead of washing them out with a tall tube.
  • Comfortable, grippy mouthpiece — Donut-style mouthpiece gives your lips a natural resting spot and makes the rig easy to grab and pass.
  • Compact but sturdy — Thick glass and a small form factor mean it feels solid in the hand and less awkward on crowded tables.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Includes a 14mm male 90° banger, so you don’t have to hunt down a nail just to try it.
  • Great function at a friendly size — Triple ratchet diffusion in a small rig gives you that “big rig” smoothness without needing a whole shelf.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want real percolation in a piece that doesn’t dominate the coffee table. If you’re doing a few dabs in the evening or quick hits throughout the day and want smoother pulls than a basic mini rig, this fits right in. It makes a nice upgrade from basic starter glass and pairs well with a dedicated dab mat so your station stays clean when things get sticky.

How to Use It

Think of the Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig as your compact flavor station. Your concentrates go into the included 14mm male banger, the vapor travels down through the joint, and the triple ratchet perc in the base does the heavy lifting by diffusing everything into smoother, cooler clouds before it hits the donut mouthpiece.

The 90° joint angle keeps your banger sitting level, which helps with even heating and makes it easy to cap and spin without awkward wrist angles. Grab your favorite tool from your lineup or from our selection of dedicated dab tools, drop in your concentrate, and let the perc and donut mouthpiece handle the rest.

After you’re done, let the rig and banger cool down fully, then rinse or wipe out any reclaim. For deeper cleans, you can soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and let it dry before the next sesh. Keeping it clean not only looks better, it helps the triple ratchet perc function at its best.

Specifications

Category Dab rig / oil rig
Height 5.5 inches (140mm)
Joint Angle 90°
Joint Size 14mm (rig accepts 14mm male banger)
Included Banger 14mm male, 90° angle
Percolator Triple ratchet perc
Mouthpiece Donut-style mouthpiece
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built around a 14mm joint, so it plays nicely with most standard 14mm male bangers and other 14mm accessories in your stash. The 90° angle is ideal for traditional bucket-style bangers, giving you a flat, level surface that works well with bubble caps, directional caps, and other airflow-focused tools. If you want a more rugged travel option to go alongside this piece, check out our lineup of unbreakable-style silicone pipes for on-the-go seshes.

What You Get

  • 1 × 5.5″ Triple Ratchet Donut Mouth Rig (glass)
  • 1 × 14mm male 90° glass banger

Tips to Get the Most From It

  • Mind your water level — Add enough water to cover the triple ratchet perc slits but not so much that it splashes into the donut mouthpiece when you pull.
  • Keep the donut clear — If reclaim builds up near the donut opening, a quick soak helps keep airflow wide open and comfortable.
  • Pair it right — A solid carb cap from our carb caps collection will help the triple ratchet perc really shine by controlling airflow and vapor density.
  • Protect your glass — When you’re not using it, stash it somewhere stable or inside a padded case so you’re not explaining broken glass to your roommate.

FAQ

Will this rig fit my existing bangers?

The rig is set up for 14mm accessories with a 90° angle, so any standard 14mm male 90° banger should fit just fine. If you’re coming from a different joint size or angle, you might need an adapter, but most modern bangers are a direct match.

How big of a hit can I get from a 5.5″ rig?

Even though it’s only 5.5 inches (140mm) tall, the triple ratchet perc moves a surprising amount of vapor. You can clear solid hits without the drag you’d get from taller, more complex pieces. It’s ideal for regular-size dabs rather than massive, competition-style clouds.

Is the triple ratchet perc hard to clean?

It’s more detailed than a basic downstem, but still easy to maintain if you stay on top of it. Let everything cool, rinse out loose residue, then soak the rig in isopropyl alcohol when it starts to look cloudy. A quick shake while it’s soaking helps keep the perc slits clear, and you’re good to go again.

Can I use this as a flower piece?

This rig is designed as an oil rig with a 14mm male banger included, but in theory you could swap the banger for a 14mm female bowl that matches the joint. Just remember the water level and perc are tuned for vapor, not big flower snaps, so most people keep it strictly for concentrates and use a separate piece from our general smoke shop products lineup for herb.

Is it stable enough for daily use on a desk or coffee table?

Yes. The short height and thick glass make it feel planted and secure, especially compared to tall, top-heavy towers. As with any glass, just give it a clear spot to live so it’s not competing with laptops, rolling trays, and snacks.

What kind of dab tools and accessories work best with this?

Any standard 14mm-focused setup works well: a solid dabber, a carb cap sized for your banger, and something to rest hot glass on after use. If you like keeping things organized, pair it with proper storage and packaging for your concentrates so you’re not juggling jars and tools mid-sesh.

How should I store it when I’m not using it?

Let everything cool fully, give it a quick rinse if needed, then park it somewhere stable where it can’t get knocked over. You can also keep your concentrates sealed up in dedicated concentrate jars nearby so your whole dab setup is ready to go when the next sesh calls.

The 7.5″ FAB PINCH BELL RIG is a compact glass dab rig built for dabbers who care about smooth function and steady, splash-free pulls. At 7.5 inches (190mm) tall with a sturdy bell base and a 3-hole perc, it’s made to be a reliable daily driver that doesn’t tip easily or chug too hard. This is the kind of piece you grab when you want clean diffusion, easy control, and something that still looks good sitting out on the table.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, more controlled hits — The 3-hole perc breaks your vapor into smaller bubbles, giving you pleasant diffusion without killing flavor.
  • Stays put on the table — Bell-shaped base gives you a low, wide footprint so you’re not stressing every time someone bumps the coffee table.
  • Ready to dab out of the box — Comes with a 14mm 90° banger so you can get straight to it instead of digging around for a spare.
  • Comfortable draw — Torch-style mouthpiece keeps your face away from the banger and gives you a natural angle when you pull.
  • Less accidental splash — Fab pinch and smart internal shaping help keep water where it belongs, even on stronger pulls.
  • Easy to aim your torch — The 90° joint keeps your banger level, so heating feels natural and stable.
  • Adds color to your setup — Multiple color options let you pick something that matches the rest of your glass, not just some random clear rig.

Best For

This rig is a sweet spot for dabbers who want something small enough to be efficient but not so tiny that every hit feels harsh. If you’re running a couple of dabs after work or keeping a clean station on a dab mat, this slips into the setup perfectly. It’s also a solid pick if you like bell-style function and want a go-to piece that won’t feel fragile or top-heavy.

How to Use It

Set the 7.5″ FAB PINCH BELL RIG on a flat, stable surface and make sure there’s just enough water to cover the openings on the 3-hole perc. Too much water and you’ll risk splashback, too little and you’ll lose that smooth, bubbly function this piece is built for.

Load your concentrates into the included 14mm 90° banger, pull from the torch-style mouthpiece, and let the bell base and perc do the work. The fab pinch and bell chamber keep the water moving in a tight path, so you get a mix of diffusion and flavor instead of just raw heat. Between dabs, you can park your tools on a nearby tray or stash them with your favorite dab tools so you’re not hunting around mid-sesh.

When you’re done, let everything fully cool before handling, especially the banger. For a quick reset before the next round, a simple rinse and wipe goes a long way. For longer breaks between seshes, you can keep your extracts sealed up in proper concentrate jars so your rig is always paired with fresh material.

Specifications

Height 7.5 inches (190mm)
Joint Size & Angle 14mm Male, 90°
Perc Type 3-hole perc
Base Style Bell-shaped base
Mouthpiece Style Torch-style mouth
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

The 7.5″ FAB PINCH BELL RIG uses a 14mm male, 90° joint, so it plays well with most 14mm female bangers, nails, and dropdowns. If you like to swap between different 14mm quartz bangers, terp slurpers, or similar styles, you’re set. The bell base has enough footprint to handle slightly heavier attachments without feeling sketchy, as long as you keep everything centered.

If you already have a favorite 14mm accessory or want to build out a matching setup with unbreakable gear, you can easily pair this rig with durable pieces from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup for travel and keep this one as the home base glass.

Cleaning & Care

Let the rig and banger cool completely before cleaning. For light maintenance, rinse with warm water and gently shake to loosen residue. For deeper cleans, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry before you use it again. Keeping the water fresh and giving it a quick rinse every few seshes will help the perc stay clear and the flavor stay crisp.

FAQ

  • What size banger or nail does this rig use?
    This rig comes with a 14mm 90° banger and uses a 14mm male joint, so any 14mm female banger, nail, or similar accessory will fit.
  • Is 7.5 inches good for daily dabs?
    Yes, 7.5 inches (190mm) is a great daily driver size — tall enough to cool things down a bit, but compact enough to feel responsive and easy to clear. If you want a tougher backup for travel, you can always add something from our unbreakable-style silicone pipes and keep this rig at home.
  • Does the bell base really help with stability?
    Definitely. The bell base spreads out the weight so the rig isn’t top-heavy. It’s way less likely to tip than straight-tube styles of the same height, especially once there’s water in it.
  • How do I stop splashback with this perc?
    The fab pinch and bell shape already help control water, but water level still matters. Keep the water just above the 3-hole perc openings; if you’re getting splash, pour a little out until the function feels right.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting too dirty?
    Change your water regularly, give it a quick rinse after heavier seshes, and don’t let reclaim sit for weeks. For storage between seshes, keeping your concentrates sealed in proper glass jars & packaging helps keep your rig from taking on old terp smells.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    You can, but it’s really better as a home piece. If you do move it around, empty the water, wrap it well, and stash it safely. For true on-the-go dabbing, a smaller piece or something from our broader smoke shop products lineup might be easier to toss in a bag.
  • Is the 3-hole perc really that different from other percs?
    It’s a nice balance: more diffusion than a simple open downstem, but not as draggy or overcomplicated as some stacked percs. You get smooth bubbles and good flavor without feeling like you’re pulling through a brick wall.

The Lookah Seahorse 510 Thread Coils – Type I (5-pack) are replacement coils built for Seahorse dab pen fans who are running their device often and hate weak or burnt-tasting hits. These are purpose-made for all Lookah Seahorse models, so you just swap and go with no weird fit issues. A full 5-pack means you can keep your Seahorse tasting fresh for weeks instead of limping along on a dead coil.

Why You’ll Actually Like These Coils

  • Keep flavor dialed in — Fresh Type I coils help your concentrates taste clean instead of cooked or burnt.
  • No guessing on fit — 510 threading built specifically for Seahorse devices, so they screw right in and work.
  • Ready for heavy use — 5-pack keeps you stocked so a fouled coil never kills the sesh.
  • More consistent vapor — Type I design is tuned for reliable, even heating from hit to hit.
  • Easy swap, no tools — Just unscrew the old coil, screw on a new one, and you’re back in business.

Best For

This 5-pack is made for Seahorse owners who use their device as a daily driver and don’t want to baby a single coil for months. If you’re running through premium wax or rosin from your favorite concentrate jars, these coils help you actually taste what you paid for instead of reheated leftovers. Also ideal for anyone who likes to travel with their Seahorse and wants backup coils in the bag so nothing cuts the night short.

How to Use Your Type I Coils

Using these is about as simple as it gets. Make sure your Seahorse is powered off, then gently unscrew the old coil from the 510 connection at the tip. Screw in a fresh Type I coil until it’s snug — hand-tight is plenty. Once it’s seated, you’re ready to go after you load your concentrate per your device’s usual routine.

Between hits, try to keep your Seahorse resting on a clean surface like a dab mat so residue doesn’t end up on your table, couch, or pants. Let the coil cool before wiping off any visible buildup on the outside to keep things looking clean.

When you start noticing flavor drop-off, darker residue, or weaker vapor even with a charged battery, that’s your sign it’s time to swap in a new coil from the pack. Heavier dabbers will run through coils faster than light, occasional use — there’s no strict schedule, just go by taste and performance.

Specifications

Brand Lookah
Product Seahorse 510 Thread Coils – Type I
Type Type I
Quantity 5 coils per pack
Threading 510
Device compatibility All Lookah Seahorse devices (including Pro and related models)
Category Electronics / replacement coils

Fit & Compatibility

These Type I 510-thread coils are designed specifically for the Lookah Seahorse family, so they play nice with standard Seahorse, Seahorse Pro, and other official Seahorse-branded variations using the same threaded tip. No adapters, no modifications — just screw them in where your old coil sits.

If you’re mixing these into a bigger setup with rigs, bongs, or other silicone bongs & rigs, just treat the Seahorse like your standard nectar-style device and use it however your current setup is arranged. The coil itself doesn’t change that workflow — it just keeps things tasting right.

Care & Coil Life Tips

Let the coil cool down between longer seshes whenever you can. Running it nonstop when it’s already hot will shorten its life and cook your material faster. Wipe the outside of the coil housing occasionally if you get sticky buildup; a quick wipe with a cloth or swab is usually plenty.

For deeper refreshes, let everything cool, remove the coil from the Seahorse, then carefully clean off any external residue. Avoid soaking the full electronic device — just focus on the removable coil and the contact areas. When the coil is too gunked up or flavor starts going flat, that’s when you pull a new one from the 5-pack. Keep spare coils stored somewhere dry with your other accessories so they’re easy to grab when you need them.

FAQ

Will these Type I coils fit my Lookah Seahorse Pro?
Yes. These Type I 510-thread coils are made to work with all Lookah Seahorse models, including the Seahorse Pro and similar variants that use the same threaded tip system.

How do I know when it’s time to replace a coil?
You’ll usually notice a drop in flavor first — concentrates start tasting dull or slightly burnt even when they’re fresh. You might also see heavy dark buildup on the coil or get weaker vapor than normal. When that happens, grab a new coil from the pack and swap it in. Many people time it with refilling or when they rotate in fresh concentrate from their storage & packaging stash.

Can I clean these coils to make them last longer?
You can gently wipe off exterior residue and keep the contact areas clean, which helps a bit. Just let the coil cool first, then wipe with a cloth or swab. Once the inside is heavily gunked or flavor is off, there’s no real way to fully restore it — that’s when you install a new one.

Do these coils work with other 510-thread vapes?
They’re designed specifically for Lookah Seahorse devices, even though they use 510 threading. Some non-Seahorse devices might physically screw on, but performance and alignment aren’t guaranteed. For best function and safety, stick to Seahorse units the coils were designed for.

How should I store unused coils?
Keep the remaining coils in their original packaging or another small, clean container, away from moisture and pocket lint. A drawer with your other smoke shop products works great — just somewhere they won’t get crushed or contaminated.

Will these coils change how much vapor I get?
Fresh Type I coils will usually give you better, more consistent vapor compared to a worn-out coil. You’ll notice smoother hits and more reliable clouds, especially if your old coil was near the end of its life. How big those clouds get still depends on your device settings and how you use it.

Are these good for all kinds of concentrates?
They’re designed for typical dab-style concentrates that people commonly run through Seahorse devices. Whether you’re dipping into softer material or something a bit more stable, these coils are made to handle everyday dab use without needing a special setup. If you’re working with fresh-pressed rosin or solventless from a rosin extraction setup, these coils help you keep that flavor intact when you finally go to enjoy it.

The 4″ ENCORE 14M 90° Large Honeycomb Ash Catcher is a glass add-on for people who love their bong but hate how fast it gets dirty. Built for 14mm female-jointed pieces with a 90° joint, it adds a full honeycomb perc and a big catch chamber, so ash and gunk land here instead of in your daily driver. You get smoother, cooler pulls and a cleaner main piece without changing the feel of your setup.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Way less scrubbing on your main piece — the oversized chamber traps ash and debris before it ever reaches your bong.
  • Smoother, cooler hits — the large honeycomb perc breaks smoke into tons of tiny bubbles for better diffusion and cooling.
  • Doesn’t ruin your pull — designed to keep airflow open, so you still get that satisfying, easy draw instead of feeling like you’re sucking a milkshake through a straw.
  • Easy upgrade for most glass setups — 14mm male, 90° joint works with a ton of modern water pipes without needing adapters.
  • Saves your nice piece from grime — let this catch the abuse so your favorite tube stays clearer, longer.
  • Adds some personality — color accents and logo decal give you a little flair without going full novelty piece.

Best for

This ash catcher is made for people who use their bong as a true daily driver and are tired of deep-cleaning it every couple of days. If you’re running lots of flower bowls and want smoother function without swapping to a totally new piece, this is a smart add-on. It also pairs nicely with sturdy glass as part of a full setup alongside practical smoke shop accessories when you’re dialing in your sesh table.

How to use it

Slide the ENCORE’s 14mm male joint into the 14mm female joint on your water pipe, making sure the 90° angle keeps the body hanging straight and not tipping forward. Then add water until it just covers the honeycomb perc so it can stack bubbles properly without splashing up into your bowl or your piece.

From there, you use your setup like normal — your bowl or other attachment sits in the joint on the ash catcher instead of directly in the bong. The ash drops into this chamber first, and the honeycomb breaks up the smoke for smoother pulls. When you’re done, set it down on a stable dab mat or pad so you’re not dealing with wet rings on your table.

For cleaning, let it cool, dump the water, then rinse. When it starts to cloud up, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry fully before you clip it back on your piece.

Specifications

Overall Height 4 inches (101.6mm)
Joint Type 14mm male
Joint Angle 90°
Perc Style Large honeycomb disc
Material Glass

Because it uses a 14mm male joint at 90°, this ash catcher plays best with 14mm female-jointed water pipes designed for upright, vertical bowls. If your piece is 45° or a different joint size, you’ll need a different style or an adapter.

Fit & Compatibility

This piece is ideal for straight tubes, beakers, and modern water pipes that have a 14mm female joint at a true 90° angle. If your bong’s joint is angled down at 45°, this ash catcher will sit awkwardly and may spill. For people with multiple pieces and bowls, it can act as a shared “front end,” so you’re only really deep-cleaning one attachment instead of your entire collection, especially if you’re also rotating through different bowls or even simple glass accessories.

Why honeycomb?

Honeycomb percs are all about surface area and consistency. The flat disc is punched with lots of tiny holes, so when you pull, the smoke is spread out across tons of small bubbles instead of one big chug. That means more contact with the water, better cooling, and less harshness without feeling like the piece is over-percolated.

Compared to tree or showerhead-style percs, honeycombs are also relatively low-profile and easier to keep clear. In an ash catcher, that’s clutch, because it sees the dirtiest part of your sesh. When the honeycomb starts to stain up, a quick soak brings it back way easier than trying to scrub awkward internals inside your main piece.

FAQ

  1. Will this fit my bong?

    If your water pipe has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, you’re good. If it’s 45° or a different joint size, this specific ash catcher won’t sit or seal correctly without an adapter. When in doubt, compare your piece to other 14mm setups in the silicone bongs and rigs section to get a feel for joint style and angle.
  2. Can I use this with a bowl and a banger?

    Yes, as long as your bowl or banger has the correct joint size for the top fitting on the ash catcher. Most people run it with a flower bowl to keep their bong clean, but you can technically drop a compatible banger on it if the angles line up with your rig.
  3. How much water should I put in it?

    Fill it just high enough to cover the honeycomb perc. Too little and it won’t bubble properly, too much and you risk splashback into your bowl or piece. It’s quick to dial in — add a little, test the pull, and adjust.

    Let it cool, dump out the dirty water, then rinse with warm water. For heavier buildup, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry. You can set it on a nonstick work surface like the ones used for parchment and processing so you’re not dripping on your counters.
  5. Will this make my hits too draggy?

    Honeycomb percs are designed to keep airflow fairly open, and this one is sized to match typical 14mm pieces. You’ll feel a little more draw resistance than with no ash catcher at all, but it shouldn’t feel like a chore to clear — just smoother and more controlled.
  6. Is it worth it if I already clean my bong a lot?

    Yes, because instead of doing full deep cleans on your bong constantly, most of the grime ends up in the ash catcher. You can quick-rinse this daily and save the full scrubdown for your main piece for every so often, same way you might rotate and store prepped flower in proper storage and packaging instead of keeping it in the grinder 24/7.
  7. Can I travel with it attached to my piece?

    It’s better to detach it. Glass-on-glass joints can wiggle and stress if they’re bouncing around together in a bag or case. Pack your bong and ash catcher separately, ideally wrapped or padded, like you would with other glass or concentrate jars, then reassemble when you’re ready to sesh.

The 4″ ENCORE 14M 90° Large Honeycomb Ash Catcher is one of those quiet upgrades that changes how you treat your glass: cleaner, smoother, and less annoying to maintain. If you love your current piece but wish it stayed clear longer and hit a little softer, this is an easy yes.

Using the Encore Color Showerhead Ash Catcher is simple: treat it like an extra mini-chamber that lives between your bowl and your bong. The 14mm male joint on the ash catcher plugs into your bong’s 14mm female joint, then your bowl (or slide) sits in the joint on the ash catcher itself.

Add a small amount of water so the showerhead perc is just covered, then hit your piece as usual. As you pull, smoke drops into the ash catcher first, where ash, debris, and some of the heavier particles get trapped in the water and extra chamber. By the time the smoke moves into your main piece, it’s already been cooled and pre-filtered.

Set your setup on a sturdy, nonstick surface like a dab mat if you’re the type who occasionally bumps the table mid-sesh — it helps keep drips and reclaim off your furniture and makes cleanup easier.

After a few bowls or when the water starts looking rough, pull the ash catcher off, dump it, and rinse. It’s a lot less stressful to deal with than dragging your entire bong over the sink when you’re three bowls deep and just want things to work.

Fit & Compatibility

This Encore ash catcher is designed to plug directly into any water pipe with a 14mm female joint set at a 45° angle. That’s the standard angle you’ll see on a lot of beakers and smaller tubes — the joint comes off the neck at a diagonal instead of straight out.

Because it uses a 14mm male connection, it plays nice with most mid-sized glass pieces that already use 14mm hardware. If you’ve got multiple pieces and bowls, this makes it easy to swap the ash catcher around and see which tube it pairs with best. For storing your bowls, slides, and extra parts you’re not using, keeping a small stash of storage & packaging options around can help keep your gear organized instead of rolling around a drawer.

Care & Cleaning

Let the ash catcher cool before cleaning, especially after heavy use. Dump the old water, rinse with warm water, and for heavier buildup, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry before using again. It’s usually easier to clean this often than to wait until it’s fully caked up — that’s also how you keep your main bong looking brand new.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint set at a 45° angle, you’re good. The ash catcher’s 14mm male joint plugs right into that. If your piece has a 90° joint, or a different joint size, you’d need an adapter or a different style catcher.
  • Can I use this with a rig for concentrates?
    Yes, as long as your rig has a 14mm female, 45° joint and you’re fine with a little extra diffusion. Many dabbers prefer to keep their concentrate rigs a bit simpler, but if you want extra filtration, pair this with your favorite banger and a good carb cap for smoother pulls.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Just enough to cover the slits or openings on the showerhead perc. Too much water and you risk splashback; too little and you won’t get the full filtration effect. A quick test pull without lighting anything will tell you if it feels right.
  • Will it make my piece tip over?
    On most medium-sized bongs with a stable base, you’ll be fine. This ash catcher is only 5 inches (127mm) tall, so it doesn’t add a ton of leverage. If your piece is super small or has a tiny base, just be mindful of balance and set it on a solid surface like one of our accessories trays or mats.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting stained?
    Change the water often and give it a quick rinse right after your sesh whenever you can. For deeper cleans, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry. Regular light cleanings are way easier than fighting thick resin later.
  • Is a showerhead perc better than other perc styles?
    “Better” depends on what you like. Showerhead percs are a great balance: solid diffusion, easy pull, and not too fragile or overcomplicated. They’re a good match for daily pieces and pair nicely with everything from simple tubes to more complex silicone bongs & rigs if you like customization.
  • Can I travel with this or store it safely?
    It’s glass, so treat it like any other nice piece. When you’re not using it, stash it in a padded spot or in a box or bag alongside your other gear. If you’re organizing a full setup with flower, concentrates, and hardware, pairing this with dedicated glass jars & packaging can help keep everything in one clean, protected place.

column2: 5″ 14 M 90° ENCORE COLOR SHOWERHEAD ASH CATCHER
column3:
The 5" 14mm Male 90° Encore Color Showerhead Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for people who are tired of scrubbing their main piece after every couple bowls. It slots into a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle and adds a showerhead perc stage in front of your bong, so ash gets trapped and diffused before it ever touches your main water chamber.

Why It Works

  • Way less cleaning on your main piece — the ash catcher takes the abuse, catching ash and gunk before it hits your bong.
  • Smoother, less harsh hits — the internal showerhead perc adds an extra water pass, mellowing things out without killing flavor.
  • Easy upgrade for 14mm glass — 14mm male joint and 90° angle are made to drop right into most 14mm female, 90° bongs and rigs.
  • Color that actually pops — the colored accents help your setup look intentional instead of random glass thrown together.
  • Nice size for daily drivers — at 5 inches (127mm), it adds function without making your piece feel tall or clunky.

Best For

This Encore showerhead ash catcher is made for people who run their glass hard but still like it to look clean. If you hate the look of stained percs or you’re the friend who always ends up cleaning the bong before a sesh, this is your kind of add-on. It’s especially nice on mid-size daily driver pieces with a 14mm female, 90° joint where you want a little more diffusion without swapping to a whole new tube.

If you’re building out a full daily setup, pairing an ash catcher like this with a solid nonstick dab pad or mat keeps both your glass and your table from getting wrecked.

How to Use It

Using the 5" Encore Showerhead Ash Catcher is basically like adding a mini bong in front of your main one. Fill the ash catcher with just enough water to cover the showerhead slits, then plug its 14mm male joint into the 14mm female joint on your piece. Load your bowl as usual into the joint on the ash catcher, and now all the ash and debris has to go through this chamber first before it ever reaches your main tube.

Because it’s a 90° design, it lines up best on pieces where the joint sticks straight out from the body rather than angled down. Once you’ve got the water level dialed, you can pretty much leave it there and just swap out bowls as you go. For storage between seshes, you can pop it off and keep it next to your storage and packaging gear so it’s less likely to get knocked over.

Cleaning is simple: let everything cool, empty the water, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and let it dry before you throw it back on your setup.

Feature Details
Brand Encore
Type Showerhead ash catcher
Joint Size 14mm male (to piece)
Joint Angle 90°
Height 5 inches (127mm)
Material Glass
Design Colored accents, internal showerhead perc

This ash catcher is built for glass with a 14mm female joint at a true 90° angle. If your joint is angled down (like 45°) or is 18mm, this specific model isn’t going to sit right or seal correctly. On the right piece, it’ll hang level and feel balanced without tipping your tube forward.

Because it’s a showerhead style perc, it pairs well with simple downstem or single-perc bongs that could use a little extra function up front. If you’re running a smaller rig for concentrates, adding this in front with a flower bowl lets you keep that rig cleaner for your dabs and keep your concentrates fresh in proper concentrate jars instead of crusting up your piece.

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your piece has a 14mm female joint that sits at 90° (straight out from the tube), this ash catcher should plug in and line up nicely. If you’re not sure about the angle, look from the side — if the joint points straight sideways, you’re good; if it tilts down, this isn’t the right style.
