    You can, as long as the rig has a 14mm female, 90° joint, but most people save ash catchers like this for flower and keep their dab rigs as clean as possible. If you are mixing it into a dab setup, make sure your banger or nail seats level and consider pairing it with a proper carb cap so the airflow still feels right.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Fill just enough to cover the showerhead slits at the bottom. Too much water and it may splash or restrict airflow; too little and you lose the extra diffusion. A quick pull test before packing a bowl will tell you if it feels right.
  • Does adding an ash catcher make my piece harder to pull?
    Any extra chamber adds a bit of drag, but the showerhead design is pretty open, so it still breathes well. On most medium-sized pieces, you’ll notice smoother hits way more than you’ll notice any extra resistance.
  • What’s the best way to keep it clean?
    Let the glass cool, dump the water, then give it a soak or rinse in isopropyl alcohol to loosen buildup. Rinse with clean water and let it dry before you pop it back on your setup. If you’re already cleaning bowls or dab tools, it’s easy to just toss the ash catcher into the same quick cleaning routine.
  • Will it make my piece too front-heavy?
    On a standard beaker or straight tube with a solid base, the 5" Encore ash catcher usually sits comfortably without feeling like it’s going to nose-dive. Super small or very narrow-base pieces are more likely to feel tippy with anything hanging off the front, so always check your balance before you walk away from it.
  • Is this better than a basic, non-perc ash catcher?
    You’re getting both ash protection and extra diffusion with the showerhead perc, so it’s an upgrade over simple dry catchers that only block debris. If you already love how your main piece hits but just want it to stay cleaner, this style is a nice middle ground before jumping to a whole new smoke shop setup.

This little Encore Fixie rig is made for dabbers who like quick, flavorful rips without dragging out a huge glass collection every time. If you’re the friend who always has a small travel rig in your bag, or you want something that lives on your nightstand instead of the kitchen counter, this piece fits that lane perfectly. The 5″ 14mm Male 45° Encore Babyface Slit Ash Catcher is a glass add-on for people who actually use their pieces and want them to stay clean. Built for 14mm female, 45° bongs, it stacks a Babyface slit perc in front of your main chamber so the ash and funk get trapped here instead of in your favorite tube. At 5 inches (127mm) tall, it adds real filtration without turning your setup into a top-heavy science project.

Why You’ll Actually Like This Thing

  • Smoother pulls, less bite — The Babyface slit perc breaks your hit into smaller bubbles so the smoke cools a bit and feels way less harsh.
  • Your main bong stays way cleaner — Ash, resin, and chunks stop here first, which means less scrubbing and fewer deep-cleans on your daily driver.
  • Perfect for 45° setups — Designed specifically for 14mm female joints at 45°, so it lines up naturally instead of forcing a weird angle.
  • Compact, not clunky — At 5 inches (127mm), it adds function and a little flair without making your piece feel like a glass tower.
  • Helps protect your investment — Catching debris before it hits your main chamber means fewer chances of hard, stuck-on buildup that can stain or etch glass over time.
  • Extra filtration for both flower and dabs — Whether you’re packing a bowl or running a banger, you get that added layer of water and diffusion.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people who run their bong as a true daily driver and are tired of constant deep-clean missions. If you’re already the type to sesh over a clean dab mat and like your setup dialed, this slots right into that vibe. It’s especially good for anyone with a 14mm, 45° beaker or tube who wants better function but doesn’t want to replace their whole piece.

How to Use It

Drop the Encore Babyface Ash Catcher into any 14mm female, 45° joint and it becomes the new front line for your hits. Your bowl or banger goes into the top joint on the ash catcher, and the bottom joint slides into your bong’s joint, giving your smoke an extra water stop before it hits the main chamber.

For flower, load your usual slide and let the ash catcher take the brunt of the mess so your main piece barely crusts up. For concentrates, pair it with a banger and keep it sitting on a heat-safe accessory setup so you’re not stressing about sticky drips on the table.

When the water starts to look murky or the perc starts collecting gunk, just pull it off, dump the water, and give it a quick clean so it’s ready for the next sesh. Keeping this part clean is way easier than fully detailing your main piece every few days.

Joint Size (to Bong) 14mm male
Joint Angle 45°
Perc / Diffusion Style Babyface slit
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This piece plays best with 14mm female bongs that have a 45° joint, which covers a ton of classic beakers and straight tubes. If your current bowl or banger is 14mm male, it should drop right into the ash catcher’s top joint without any adapters needed.

Because it’s glass-on-glass, treat it like your other nicer glass attachments: avoid knocking it around, don’t overload super heavy bowls on top, and make sure everything is seated snugly before you move the rig. If you’re running a heavier setup, pairing it with a sturdy silicone rig base or piece can help keep things stable.

Cleaning & Care

Let the ash catcher cool fully before you mess with it, especially after dab runs. Once it’s safe to handle, empty the old water, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and let it dry before you put it back into rotation. Keeping this part clean means your whole setup tastes better and your main bong needs way less elbow grease.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle, you’re good. The Encore Babyface Ash Catcher has a 14mm male joint designed to slide directly into that style of piece.
  • Can I use this with a straight tube or 90° joint?
    It’s really meant for 45° joints. You might be able to rig something with adapters, but the angle and water line will be off. If your piece has a 90° joint, you’re better off with an ash catcher made for 90° setups that matches your joint size, or just building a new daily driver from our broader smoke shop products collection.
  • Can I run this for dabs, or is it just for flower?
    You can absolutely run it for both. Just plug a 14mm banger into the top and you’ve got extra water and diffusion in front of your main rig. If you’re handling stickier concentrates, a solid set of dab tools will help you keep your banger and catcher cleaner between pulls.
  • How often should I change the water?
    Any time it starts to look cloudy, dark, or smell off, swap it out. The whole point of this thing is to be easy to clean, so it’s way less hassle to quickly refresh the ash catcher than to scrub your entire tube.
  • Does the Babyface slit perc really make a difference?
    Yes. The slit design breaks your hit into more, smaller bubbles, which means more surface area and better contact with the water. That gives you a smoother, more controlled pull than a simple open downstem-style catcher.
  • What’s the best way to keep my whole setup clean?
    Use this ash catcher as your first filter, change the water regularly, and give it a quick alcohol rinse when buildup starts. Storing your flower or concentrates in proper storage & packaging also helps keep your smoke tasting fresher, so you’re not baking old, dried-out material through clean glass.
  • Is this okay for travel or should it stay at home?
    It’s glass, so it’s better as part of your at-home setup. If you’re moving it around, pack it carefully and keep it separate from your main piece. For on-the-go setups or more rugged seshes, pairing your glass with tougher gear from our nectar collectors lineup can be a smarter move.

The NICKY DAVIS CONE FUNNEL & FILLER DISPLAY – 12-Pack is a rolling accessory set made for people who actually go through cones, not once-a-month smokers. You get a 3.5-inch (89mm) cone funnel and a 4-inch (102mm) filler stick that make packing cones fast, clean, and consistent, all wrapped in bright Nicky Davis artwork that actually looks good on the counter or coffee table.

Why It Works

  • Way less mess on the table — The funnel walls corral your flower so it drops straight into the cone instead of all over your lap.
  • Even-burning cones — The 4-inch (102mm) filler stick helps you tamp gently from top to bottom so you don’t get loose tops and canoeing.
  • Perfect for people who roll for the whole crew — A full 12-pack display means you can stash one at home, one in the car, one in the bag, or hand a few off to the homies who always “forget” to roll.
  • Fast fill, less fiddling — The 3.5-inch (89mm) funnel holds the cone upright, so both hands are free to scoop and level instead of pinching and praying.
  • Art that doesn’t look generic — Official Nicky Davis graphics turn a simple tool into a little collectible, not just another boring clear plastic funnel.
  • Solid shop-friendly display — Comes ready to sit on a counter or shelf so shops can offer grab-and-go cone fillers right at checkout.

Best For

This 12-pack is made for people who are constantly packing cones — daily rollers, party preppers, and anyone who ends up being “the one who knows how to roll” at every sesh. It also hits for shops and dispensaries that want a simple add-on item next to their cones and other smoke shop products without having to explain how it works every time.

How to Use It

Drop your cone into the funnel so the tip points down and the open end sits snug in the top of the funnel. The funnel holds it upright, so you can focus on loading instead of trying to balance a floppy cone with one hand.

Spoon or sprinkle your herbal blend into the funnel, letting it slide down into the cone. Every so often, use the 4-inch (102mm) filler stick to gently tamp things down. Work in light presses so you don’t overpack — just enough to keep everything even and supported as you go.

Once you’re filled to your preferred level, pull the cone out of the funnel, finish your twist or fold, and you’re ready. If you’re working over a dab mat or tray, any extra material that misses the funnel is still easy to scoop back up.

Specifications

Item Details
Funnel Length 3.5 inches (89mm)
Filler Stick Length 4 inches (102mm)
Design Official Nicky Davis artwork
Pack Size 12 individual cone funnel & filler sets in display
Category Essentials & Accessories

Fit & Compatibility

The NICKY DAVIS CONE FUNNEL & FILLER is built for most standard pre-rolled cones — the kind you’ll find in typical headshops and dispensaries. Slim, 1 1/4, and many king-size style cones will drop into the top and sit securely while you fill.

If you’re working with extra-short mini cones or huge specialty cones, they may sit differently in the funnel, but for a normal everyday pre-roll setup, this is designed to play nice without any weird adapters or extra parts. Pair it with the right size storage or joint tubes if you like to prep a lineup of cones in advance.

Care & Maintenance

Over time, you’ll get a little kief and dust buildup inside the funnel and on the filler stick — totally normal. Just tap or gently shake out loose material, then wipe the surfaces with a dry or slightly damp cloth when you want it looking fresh again.

If it ever gets really gunked up, a quick wipe with a bit of isopropyl on a paper towel, then a clean water rinse and full dry before use is plenty. No need to overthink it; this is a simple tool meant to get tossed in a bag and used hard, just like your everyday rolling accessories.

FAQ

  • Will this work with my favorite brand of cones?
    Most likely, yes. The funnel is sized for standard pre-roll cones you see in most shops (standard and king styles). Ultra-wide novelty cones may not seat as cleanly, but anything in the regular range should drop in and sit fine.
  • Do I have to hold the funnel while I fill?
    You can, but you don’t have to. A lot of people just set the funnel on a flat surface, let the cone hang down, and then load from the top. It’s balanced enough that you’re not constantly chasing it around, especially if you’re working over a tray or storage and packaging area.
  • How hard should I pack with the filler stick?
    Think gentle taps, not full-on ramming. The filler stick is there to help you level and lightly compress so your cone burns evenly from tip to filter. Overpacking can choke airflow, so it’s better to build up in light presses as you add more material.
  • What exactly am I getting in the 12-pack?
    You get a full display containing 12 individual NICKY DAVIS cone funnel & filler sets. Each set includes one funnel and one matching filler stick, all with Nicky Davis artwork ready to go right out of the box.
  • Is this more for personal use or for shops?
    Both. If you’re just a heavy cone roller, grabbing a 12-pack means you’ve got backups and can stash them everywhere. For retailers, the display is ready to drop on a counter next to your cones, wraps, and glass jars & packaging so customers can grab one without a long explanation.
  • How do I clean out stuck kief or dust?
    Tap it out first, then use a small brush, cotton swab, or cloth to wipe the inside of the funnel and the filler stick. For deeper cleans, a quick iso wipe and rinse is fine; just let everything dry completely before you start loading cones again.
  • Is this better than just using a business card or folded paper?
    If you’re doing one cone once in a while, a folded card works. But when you’re rolling multiple pre-rolls or you care about consistency, the dedicated funnel and filler stick save a lot of time and mess. It’s one of those things you don’t realize you needed until your third back-to-back cone fill actually goes smoothly. If you’re already dialed in with rosin tools or parchment papers for your concentrates, this is that same “why didn’t I get this earlier” upgrade for your cones.

Why You’ll Reach for This Bubbler

  • Smoother, cooler rips — The internal water chamber filters and cools smoke before it hits your throat, cutting down on harshness.
  • Comfortable Sherlock shape — The curved neck and angled bowl feel natural in your hand, so you’re not fighting the piece mid-sesh.

Best For

This bubbler is made for people who like the smoothness of a water pipe but don’t want to baby a giant bong all day. It’s a dialed-in daily driver for solo smokers, small groups, or anyone who prefers a quick bowl before bed over marathon sessions. If your setup is mostly durable gear like silicone pipes but you want one nice glass piece for home, this hits that sweet spot without being fragile and fussy.

The Basics: How to Use It

Use it like any classic bubbler: add a little water to the chamber, pack the bowl, and you’re ready to go. You want enough water to cover the bottom of the stem inside, but not so much that it splashes toward the mouthpiece when you pull.

The Sherlock-style neck keeps your face comfortably back from the bowl and heat, while the curve helps keep any splashback out of your mouth. Set it on a dab mat or small tray between hits so you’re not leaving water rings on the table.

When you’re done for the day, a quick empty-and-rinse keeps it from getting funky. If you’re packing it away with the rest of your smoke shop gear, just make sure it’s fully dry and padded so it’s not clinking against harder pieces.

Material Glass
Color Green
Style Sherlock-style bubbler

The 6.5" size makes this bubbler easy to handle whether you’ve got smaller hands or you’re just tired of managing oversized glass. It’s light enough to hold through an entire bowl without wrist fatigue, but still has enough weight so it doesn’t feel cheap or flimsy. If you like to rotate pieces, this pairs nicely with compact nectar collectors for a simple, travel-friendly kit that covers both flower and concentrates.

Care & Cleaning

Day-to-day, just dump the old water and give it a warm rinse. For deeper cleans, let it cool completely, then use a bit of isopropyl alcohol and a rinse with warm water afterwards, and let it dry before you put it away. If you’re serious about keeping your flavor on point, cleaning it along with your other accessories every so often keeps buildup from sneaking into your terps.

FAQ

  • How much water should I put in this bubbler?

    Fill it just enough so the bottom of the internal stem is under water, and then test the draw. You want to hear a light bubble without water splashing toward your mouth. You can tweak the level a bit until it feels right for your pull strength.

  • Is the glass thick enough to be a daily piece?

    It’s built as a compact daily driver, not a paper-thin novelty. It’ll handle normal use just fine if you treat it like glass: avoid drops, hard knocks, and tossing it into bags unprotected. For travel, a padded pouch or case is always a good idea.

    Function-wise, yes — the water chamber helps cool and smooth the smoke compared to a standard dry spoon or Sherlock. If you’re used to dry bowls and your throat is over it, this is a nice middle ground before jumping up to a full-size water pipe. You can still keep a dry pipe around for ultra-stealthy hits and use this as your main at-home piece, especially with a clean surface like a dab pad under it.

  • Will this fit in a standard stash box or smell-proof bag?

    Most medium-sized stash boxes and padded smell-proof pouches will fit a 6.5" bubbler with room for a lighter and some herb. Just make sure the glass is cushioned so it’s not banging against jars or grinders while you’re on the move.

  • What’s the best way to store it when not in use?

    Empty the water, let it dry, and keep it in a safe spot where it won’t get knocked off a shelf or table. A padded corner of a drawer or cabinet works well, or you can stand it next to your glass jars and packaging if you have a little home smoking station set up.

    This piece is designed as a flower bubbler. You could technically use certain add-ons, but for concentrates you’ll have a much better time with a proper rig or dab tools and banger setup. Think of this as your go-to for flower and save your extracts for gear built for that job.

  • How often should I change the water?

    Swapping the water every sesh or every day keeps flavor fresh and helps prevent resin buildup inside the chamber. Old water makes any piece taste off fast, so treating it like a quick reset button for your bubbler is worth the 10 seconds it takes.

If you’re running a more serious pressing or handling setup, keeping tools like this clean pairs nicely with organized storage & packaging so everything is ready when you are.

FAQ

  1. Is the wood handle just for looks, or does it change how it feels?
    The wood isn’t just cosmetic. It gives you a warmer, more tactile grip than bare metal or glass, so it feels secure in your hand even when you’ve been dabbing for a while. The grain and shape also make it easier to orient the tool without looking right at it.
  2. Can I use this with any type of rig or banger?
    Yes. This is a standalone dabber, so it plays nice with pretty much any rig, nail, or banger setup you already have. Whether you’re running a small recycler, a full-size setup, or even portable silicone bongs & rigs, the length and tip shape work with all of them.
  3. How should I clean it without ruining the wood or epoxy?
    Let it cool completely, then wipe off any fresh residue with a paper towel or cloth. For stubborn buildup, a short soak or wipe-down with isopropyl alcohol works well; just rinse with water afterward and dry fully. Avoid super abrasive scrubbing so you keep the epoxy finish looking clean and glossy.
  4. Is the tip sharp? Am I going to stab myself or scratch my gear?
    It’s shaped like a sword, but it’s not knife-level sharp. The tip is tapered and precise enough to handle concentrates cleanly but not designed to cut you or dig into glass. Just treat it like any metal dab tool and you’ll be fine.
  5. Will this feel too small or too big in hand?
    At 4.5 inches (114mm), it hits a nice middle ground — long enough to stay away from the heat, short enough to stay nimble. If you’re used to basic dab tools, the balance will feel natural, with the wood giving it a slightly more substantial, comfortable feel in the hand.
  6. What kind of concentrates does this work best with?
    The tapered “sword” edge works well with most textures — shatter, wax, badder, crumble, and similar consistencies. If you’re pressing your own material, it’s a nice companion to rosin-focused setups from our rosin extraction collection, making it easy to portion out what you’ve just collected.
  7. Is this more of a display piece or a real daily driver tool?
    It looks like something you’d want to show off, but it’s definitely designed to be used. The materials, length, and shape are all practical for daily dabbing. If you like gear that earns its keep and still looks cool on the table next to your other dab tools, this fits right in.

The 7" Silicone Hammer Rig with Glass Body & Dab Tool is a compact hybrid dab rig built for people who are rough on glass but still want to see every bubble and hit. It’s a true grab-and-go daily driver: silicone on the outside for durability, clear glass in the center for clean flavor and visuals, and a 14mm 90° joint that plays well with standard bangers. At just 7 inches (178mm) tall, it’s small enough to travel but solid enough to live on your coffee table.

Why It Works

  • Travel-ready without the stress — Silicone outer body shrugs off drops, knocks, and clumsy passes across the couch.
  • Still get that clean glass flavor — Glass body keeps your vapor path pure so your concentrates taste how they’re supposed to.
  • Built-in convenience — Comes with a metal dab tool, so you’re not digging through drawers before every sesh.
  • Easy viewing — Clear chamber lets you watch the function and see when it’s time for a fresh clean.
  • Standard joint, easy upgrades — 14mm 90° joint means you can swap in other nails, bangers, or attachments without hunting for weird sizes.
  • Low-key footprint — 7 inches (178mm) tall, so it fits on a tray, in a backpack, or in a small stash spot without taking over your space.
  • Color to match your setup — Multiple color options so it doesn’t look like random gear in the middle of your station.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a reliable daily driver that won’t shatter the first time it hits the floor. If you toss your gear in a backpack, sesh outside, or just share with friends who aren’t always gentle, the silicone housing gives you a lot more peace of mind than straight glass. It’s also great if you already run a few silicone bongs and rigs and want something that fits right in with that unbreakable vibe but still gives glass-style flavor.

How to Use It

Fill the glass body with just enough water to cover the percs or diffusion area, keeping it low enough that you’re not getting splashback. Attach your 14mm 90° banger, and you’re ready to load concentrates with the included metal dab tool. The hammer-style design keeps everything balanced in your hand or on the table, while the glass chamber shows off the function as you pull.

Because the outer shell is silicone, you can set this rig down on a hard surface or dab mat without worrying about chips or scratches. When you’re done, just let everything cool before you start cleaning or packing it away.

The Basics

The magic here is the combo of materials: silicone on the outside, glass on the inside. The silicone section helps absorb impact and makes the piece easier to grip, even with sticky hands or rosin on your fingers. The glass body still handles the water and vapor, so you’re not sacrificing taste just to get something more durable.

The 14mm 90° joint is the standard setup for a lot of compact rigs, so most quartz bangers or nails you already own in that size will slide right in. And since you’ve got a dedicated metal dab tool included, you’re starting with a complete rig kit instead of having to track down accessories one by one. If you like swapping tools, you can always add more from our range of dab tools and dabbers to build out your station.

Specifications

Height 7 inches (178mm)
Rig Style Hammer-style dab rig
Materials Silicone outer body & glass inner body
Joint Size & Angle 14mm 90°
Included Accessory Metal dab tool
Color Options Multiple colorways available

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built around a 14mm 90° joint, which is one of the most common dab rig standards. That means most 14mm male bangers, nails, and attachments you already have should plug in without an issue. Its compact height also makes it easy to pair with small torches, travel cases, and other smoking accessories without needing a ton of extra room.

Cleaning & Care

Let the rig and banger cool completely before you touch or clean anything. Remove the glass body from the silicone shell if the design allows, then soak the glass part in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before putting it back. The silicone sections can be washed with warm soapy water, rinsed well, and air-dried for a fresh, clean setup next time.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with everything I need to start dabbing?
    It comes with the rig itself and a metal dab tool, plus a 14mm 90° joint ready for a banger. You’ll just need your preferred 14mm nail or banger, concentrates, and a safe work surface like one of our parchment papers or mats to round out your setup.
  • Will my existing 14mm banger fit this rig?
    If your banger or nail is 14mm and designed for a 90° joint, it should fit right in. This rig is meant to play nice with standard 14mm dab hardware, so you don’t have to rebuy everything just to upgrade your piece.
  • Is the glass part fragile even with the silicone around it?
    The glass body is still glass, so it’s not invincible, but the silicone shell adds a big layer of protection against everyday bumps and drops. It’s a lot more forgiving than a fully exposed glass rig, especially if you’re the type to knock things over while reaching for your concentrate jars.
  • How hard is it to clean?
    Cleaning is straightforward: let everything cool, remove the glass, soak that piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry. Wash the silicone with warm soapy water, rinse thoroughly, and you’re good to go. Because you can access both parts, it’s easier to keep this rig fresh than some all-in-one designs.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    Yes, that’s one of the best parts about the silicone-and-glass build. The 7" size makes it easy to tuck into a padded case or stash bag, and the silicone helps protect it from knocks. Just make sure it’s empty and clean before packing, and keep any extras in proper storage and packaging if you’re on the move.
  • How does this compare to a full glass rig?
    A full glass rig can offer more complex percs and designs, but it’s also way easier to break. This hammer rig gives you glass where it matters for flavor and vapor, and silicone where you need durability and grip. It’s a smart middle ground if you like clean taste but don’t want to baby your piece every time you set it down next to your other smoke shop gear.
  • Is this a good first rig for new dabbers?
    Absolutely. The size is manageable, the joint is a standard 14mm 90°, and the silicone body is beginner-friendly because it’s less likely to get destroyed by a simple accident. If you’re just starting to build a dab setup, this is a solid base piece to grow around with better bangers and tools over time.

The 4.5" Mushroom Hand Pipe is a compact glass spoon pipe built for people who want their sesh gear to be as fun as it is functional. At 4.5 inches (114mm), it’s small enough to pocket but big enough for a comfy grip and a proper bowl. The playful mushroom head and dotted cap give it that whimsical, trippy look that stands out in any tray or collection.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Whimsical vibe — Mushroom cap design with colorful dots turns an everyday spoon into a little piece of glass art.
  • Pocket-ready size — 4.5 inches (114mm) is easy to stash, pass, and carry without feeling tiny in the hand.
  • Comfortable to hold — Rounded contours and a classic spoon shape sit naturally in your fingers for chill, one-handed use.
  • Sturdy glass build — Thick-walled glass helps handle heat and daily use, so it can actually be your daily driver.
  • Easy to spot — Bright colors and fun shaping make it much harder to lose in couch cushions or in a cluttered tray.
  • Simple to clean — Straightforward bowl and airway mean no crazy percs or tight corners to scrub.

Best For

This piece is made for mushroom fans, festival-goers, and anyone who wants their hand pipe to have a little personality instead of just being another clear spoon. If you like collecting fun, heady-style glass but still want something grab-and-go, this is a solid pick. It also plays nicely as a small daily driver alongside more durable options like our silicone pipes when you want something you’re less worried about dropping.

How to Use Your Mushroom Pipe

The basics are what you’d expect from a classic spoon: fill the bowl, use the carb on the side to control airflow, and clear it when you’re ready. The mushroom cap bowl is shaped to be easy to pack while still holding a decent amount, so you can load a couple of hits or a full sesh depending on your mood.

Because it’s glass, you’ll get clean flavor and can actually taste your flower instead of mystery material. Setting it down between hits is easy too — the mushroom head gives it a nice visual presence on your tray, especially if you’re running it over a bright dab mat to catch ash and crumbs.

While it’s definitely pocketable, treat it like any glass piece when you’re out and about: stash it somewhere padded and away from keys or other hard stuff so you’re not explaining a broken mushroom to your roommate later.

Care & Cleaning

Let the pipe cool fully before you mess with it — hot glass and cold liquids don’t mix. Once it’s cool, you can knock out ash and wipe away loose residue. For a deeper reset, soak the pipe in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before using again.

If you’re the type who hates buildup, keeping a small corner of your stash area dedicated to cleaning supplies alongside your other smoke shop accessories makes it way easier to stay on top of it.

Specifications

Category Hand pipe (spoon style)
Length 4.5 inches (114mm)
Material Glass
Design Theme Mushroom with colorful dotted cap
Use Dry herb
Color Options Multiple colorways (varies by availability)

Fit & Function Notes

The 4.5" Mushroom Hand Pipe is a classic spoon layout, so if you’ve used a basic glass hand pipe before, you’ll feel right at home. The bowl sits under the mushroom cap, with a side carb and a straight neck leading to the mouthpiece. That means it works well as a personal piece or something you keep on the coffee table for guests who appreciate fun glass.

If you like keeping everything matching, it also pairs well with colorful storage and packaging options, so your stash, lighter, and pipe all live in one spot instead of being scattered across drawers.

FAQ

  • How big is the pipe really? Will it feel tiny?
    At 4.5 inches (114mm), it’s in that sweet spot where it’s portable but still feels like a full-size spoon in your hand. It’s not a mini, so you get a real bowl and comfortable airflow, but it still slides into a pocket or small pouch easily.
  • Is every mushroom pipe the same color?
    No — this design comes in multiple color options, and the exact combination you get can vary by batch. That’s part of the fun: you’re getting a unique little mushroom rather than a cookie-cutter clone. If you’re deep into matching your glass, you can pair it with complementary glass jars and packaging to keep your flower looking as good as your pipe.
  • How do I keep the bowl from clogging up?
    Knock out the ash after each use and give the bowl a quick tap or wipe so buildup doesn’t get a chance to harden. When airflow starts to feel restricted, that’s your sign to give it a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry before your next sesh.
  • Is this okay as a first pipe?
    Definitely. The classic spoon layout is simple to use and easy to understand, and the mushroom design makes it feel a little more special than a plain clear tube. If you’re just getting started, it’s a nice step up from cheap gas-station glass and pairs well with basic smoke shop products like lighters, grinders, and trays.
  • Can I travel with it?
    It’s small enough to travel with, but remember it’s still glass. Use a padded case or stash it in a soft spot in your bag, and make sure it’s fully cooled and emptied before you pack it. For longer trips or rough environments, some people like to have a backup from our more rugged silicone bongs and rigs lineup too.
  • Does it stand up on its own, or will it roll away?
    The spoon-style shape is designed to sit with the bowl facing up when you set it down on a flat surface. Always place it on something stable and heat-safe, and avoid balancing it on soft or uneven spots where any glass piece might tip.
  • What else should I grab to go with this pipe?
    At minimum, you’ll want a lighter, a grinder, and somewhere to keep your herb fresh. Many people like to store their flower in dedicated concentrate jars or small glass containers and keep everything together in a tray or pouch so their mushroom pipe is always ready to go.

The Zig Zag Hemp Wraps NPP – Summer Slice are flavored hemp blunt wraps made for smokers who want that slow, smooth burn without any tobacco in the mix. Built for flavor chasers and people easing off traditional cigar wraps, these give you a juicy, sun-ripened fruit vibe with every roll. Each carton packs 25 resealable packs, and every pack comes with 2 wraps and packing straws so you’re always ready for a fresh roll.

Why You’ll Like These

  • Skip the tobacco, keep the ritual — 100% hemp wraps give you that familiar blunt-style roll without the cigar leaf.
  • Tasty but not candy-level sweet — Summer Slice flavor adds a light fruity sweetness that complements your blend instead of drowning it.
  • More chill, less relighting — designed for a smooth, slow, even burn so you’re not constantly babysitting the cherry.
  • Dial in the perfect pack — included packing straws help you shape and tighten your roll the way you like it.
  • Fresh every time — resealable packaging keeps the wraps from drying out between seshes.
  • Carton-ready for heavy smokers or shops — 25 packs per carton makes sense if you roll a lot or you’re stocking up for the crew.

Best For

These Zig Zag hemp wraps are made for blunt lovers who like flavor but don’t want to taste straight tobacco leaf anymore. If you’re that person who always shows up to the sesh with a flavored wrap and a fresh grinder, this is your lane. They’re also a solid choice for smoke shops and buyers building out a smoke shop products section that leans into flavored, hemp-based options.

How to Use Them

Using Zig Zag Hemp Wraps is pretty straightforward: open the resealable pouch, pull out a wrap, fill it with your legal blend, use the included straw to tuck and shape it, then seal it up along the natural gum line. The hemp material is flexible enough to work with you, so you don’t need to be a pro roller to get something smokable.

Because they’re hemp and not a thick cigar leaf, they tend to burn smooth and steady when packed evenly and not over-stuffed. If you’re rolling at a table, dropping the pack onto a dab mat or nonstick pad keeps sticky bits from welding themselves to the surface.

Each resealable pack helps keep the wraps from drying out between uses, so you can open a pack for one roll and come back later without finding a crunchy, cracking mess. If you’re stocking up multiple flavors or brands, tossing the cartons near your other storage and packaging gear keeps everything in one easy reach spot.

Specifications

Material 100% hemp wraps
Flavor Summer Slice (fruit-inspired)
Wraps per pack 2 wraps
Packs per carton 25 packs
Includes Packing straws in each pack
Packaging Resealable pouches

What You Get

When you grab this product, you’re getting a full carton of Zig Zag Hemp Wraps NPP – Summer Slice with 25 individual packs inside. Every pack has 2 hemp wraps plus packing straws, all sealed up in a pouch designed to preserve freshness.

Fit & Compatibility

These are standard blunt-style hemp wraps, so they play nice with most rolling styles and sizes where you’d normally use a cigar wrap or larger paper. If you usually pair your rolls with a travel pipe, dugout, or one of your silicone pipes, they’ll sit right at home in the same kit. Just keep them in their resealable pouch so they don’t dry out next to your other gear.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the wraps in their original resealable pouch when you’re not rolling to prevent them from getting stiff or brittle. Store the carton somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sun or extreme heat. If you’re pre-rolling for later, stash your finished rolls in solid glass jars and packaging to help protect the paper and preserve aroma.

FAQ

  • Are these wraps actually tobacco-free?
    Yes. Zig Zag Hemp Wraps are made from hemp, not tobacco leaf, so they’re a good option if you like blunt-style rolls but want to avoid cigar wrappers.
  • How strong is the Summer Slice flavor?
    It’s noticeable but not over the top. Think a light, fruity sweetness that pairs with your blend rather than a super artificial candy flavor. If you usually avoid super heavy flavoring, this sits in a pretty balanced spot.
  • Will these dry out quickly once I open the pack?
    As long as you use the resealable pouch properly and don’t leave it open, they hold moisture well. If you’re keeping multiple packs around, you can tuck them near your other mylar bags and storage supplies to keep your rolling area organized and everything sealed up.
  • Do they roll like regular blunt wraps?
    They’re similar, but since they’re hemp, they’re usually a bit more forgiving and less harsh than some thick cigar leaves. Just don’t overstretch or overpack and you’ll be able to shape a solid roll, especially with the included packing straw.
  • Is this carton size good for personal use or more for shops?
    Both. If you roll daily or have a crew that runs through wraps, a 25-pack carton makes sense and saves trips to the shop. It also works well for retailers building a flavored hemp-wrap shelf next to their joint tubes and cones.
  • How should I store the carton so the wraps stay fresh?
    Leave each inner pack sealed until you’re ready to use it, and keep the carton in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight or heaters. Once you open a pouch, make sure to press the seal shut so the wraps don’t dry out between rolls.
  • Can I use these with filters or tips?
    Yes, you can absolutely roll with crutches or tips if that’s your style. Just size your filter to the width of the wrap and roll as usual. If you’re pre-rolling a batch, stash them upright in your favorite glass jars or stash containers so they don’t get crushed.

The 7.5″ Fume & Cane Swirl Bubbler is a handmade glass bubbler for smokers who want smooth water-filtered hits without giving up style. At 7.5 inches (190.5mm), it’s big enough to stack a nice pull but still small enough to pass around or keep on the nightstand. The fumed glass and cane swirl work together so the piece slowly shifts color as it gets loved on, turning into something that’s uniquely yours over time.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Water in the bubbler chamber takes the edge off your smoke so your throat doesn’t get cooked on every pull.
  • Color that evolves with you — Fumed glass reacts to use, so the more you sesh, the deeper and richer the tones get.
  • Easy to grip, less likely to slip — Six clear glass dots add both style and extra grip when you’re passing it or clearing a bowl.
  • Showpiece vibes without being fragile art glass — Cane swirl design gives it that heady look while still being a solid daily driver.
  • Perfect mid-size bubbler — 7.5 inches (190.5mm) strikes a sweet spot between tabletop piece and couch companion.
  • Comfortable home base piece — Built for people who prefer the classic feel of flower in water over tiny dry pipes.

Best For

This bubbler is made for flower smokers who want smoother hits than a spoon pipe but don’t feel like committing to a big bong on the coffee table. If your gear rotation already includes a couple of simple spoons and maybe one of our tougher silicone pipes, this is the “nice” glass you break out when you actually want to taste your strain and enjoy the function.

How to Use It

The design here is classic and familiar: a fixed bowl and stem that pull smoke down into the water, up through the neck, and out the mouthpiece. You get that satisfying little chug sound and gentle bubbles that help cool things off before they hit your throat.

To dial it in, start with a small amount of water in the base, then test-draw until you’re getting bubbles without water splashing toward the mouthpiece. Once it’s set, you’re good to go until it’s time to refresh and clean. Setting the bubbler on a nonstick dab mat or tray is an easy way to catch stray ash and keep your table from looking like the bottom of a grinder.

The six clear glass dots aren’t just for looks — they give your fingers something solid to hold onto, especially when the piece has a little condensation on it mid-sesh. That extra grip is the kind of small detail you appreciate when you’re a few bowls in and passing it across the couch.

Specifications

Height 7.5 inches (190.5mm)
Material Glass
Design Fume & Cane Swirl
Accent Features 6 Clear Glass Dots
Color Multiple color variations (each piece is unique)

Cleaning & Care

Let the bubbler cool before you mess with it, then dump the old water and rinse with fresh warm water. For a deeper clean, soak with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry completely before your next sesh. If you keep it stored near your other gear in a dedicated spot or alongside your storage and packaging setup, it’s less likely to get knocked over or forgotten dirty.

FAQ

  • Does the color really change as I use it?

    Yes. The “fume” in the glass means the piece is made with vaporized metals in the glasswork, so as resin builds and gets cleaned over and over, the colors appear deeper and more complex. You’ll notice the look evolve the more you smoke out of it, especially if you clean it regularly so the glass can shine through.

  • Is 7.5 inches considered big for a bubbler?

    It’s a solid mid-size. At 7.5 inches (190.5mm), you’ve got enough room for real water filtration and comfortable pulls, but it’s not an oversized tabletop piece. Think of it as a step up from a hand pipe and a step down, size-wise, from a full bong.

  • How much water should I put in it?

    Add just enough to cover the end of the internal stem, then take a quick test pull and adjust until you’re getting steady bubbling without water reaching the mouthpiece. You don’t need to overfill it — a little water goes a long way in a bubbler this size. If you’re moving between this and other pieces like nectar collectors, it’s worth taking a second to reset the water level when you come back to it.

  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?

    It’s built as a daily driver, not a fragile display piece. It’s still glass, though, so treat it with respect — avoid hard drops, tight backpacks, and wobbly shelves. Pairing it with some silicone-based accessories or padding where you set it down can help it stay in your life longer.

  • What do the 6 clear dots actually do?

    They’re both style and function. The dots add a nice contrast to the fume and cane work, but they also act as little grip points so the piece feels more secure in your hand. They can also help keep the bubbler from rolling if it gets laid on its side.

  • Can I travel with this bubbler?

    You can pack it up carefully, but it’s best treated as a home piece. If you travel a lot or are rough on your gear, consider grabbing one of our nearly unbreakable silicone bongs & rigs for the road and keep this bubbler as the nicer piece waiting for you at home.

  • What else do I need to use with it?

    All you really need is your herb and a lighter, but most people like to keep a small tray or pad under their glass to catch ash and spills. If you’re already stocking up on smoke shop staples like grinders, papers, and tools, this bubbler fits right into that setup as your go-to water piece.

Glow-in-the-dark mushroom decals wrap the neck and can-style body, so your rig still looks alive when the lights go low.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Night-mode ready — Glow-in-the-dark mushroom decals charge under normal light, then pop once the room gets dark so you can still spot your rig mid-sesh.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The showerhead perc breaks everything into fine bubbles, giving you less harshness and more flavor out of your concentrates.
  • Stable little tank — The footed can-style base gives this smaller rig a sturdy footprint, so it’s less likely to tip when you bump the table.
  • Easy banger swaps — 14mm female, 90° joint means it plays nice with most standard quartz bangers and nails you already own.
  • Compact but not cramped — At 6.5 inches, there’s enough distance from banger to mouth so you’re not getting cooked by the heat.
  • Fun piece that still rips — The whimsical mushroom theme is playful, but the internal perc and joint design keep this as a legit daily driver, not just a shelf piece.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want something that feels special every time they pull it off the shelf, not just another clear tube. If you’re running a smaller torch, doing a few dabs a night, or building out a cute but functional setup on your coffee table, this fits right in. It’s also a solid match if you’re pairing it with other colorful gear like silicone pieces from our silicone bongs & rigs collection and want a glass rig that still brings some personality.

As you pull, the showerhead perc at the bottom forces everything through multiple small slits, creating stacks of tiny bubbles that cool and smooth out each hit.

The 90-degree joint keeps your banger sitting level, which helps with even heating and keeps hot quartz away from the glass body. Set the rig on a dab mat or pad to catch any drips and protect your table—especially helpful when you’re running in low light and relying on those glow shrooms to guide you.

After your sesh, let everything cool down before you move it or clean it. The compact size makes it easy to rinse and refresh more often, so you can keep the glass clear and enjoy the artwork instead of staring at reclaim.

Specs

Height 6.5 inches (165mm)
Joint Type 14mm female, 90-degree angle
Material Glass with glow-in-the-dark mushroom decals
Perc Showerhead perc

Fit & Compatibility

If you like running different styles of bangers—deep buckets, opaque bottoms, or inserts—you’re covered as long as they’re 14mm male and made for a 90° joint.

With a zinc alloy core wrapped in a lightweight plastic finish, it hits the sweet spot between durability and comfort in the hand.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Confident, controlled flame — Adjustable single jet lets you fine-tune the heat, whether you’re gently toasting or really cranking it.
  • Stays lit when it’s breezy — Windproof design keeps the flame steady so you’re not fighting it outside or near a fan.
  • Feels solid, not cheap — Zinc alloy body gives it weight and durability, while the plastic finish keeps it comfy and easy to grip.
  • Safe to toss in a drawer — Built-in safety lock and ignition hold help prevent accidental triggers when it’s not in use.
  • Refillable, not disposable — Runs on standard butane and refills easily so you’re not burning through cheap single-use lighters.
  • Stands on its own — Hand torch/table torch form factor sits upright, so you can park it on the counter between uses without it tipping over.

Best For

The MAVEN NIGHT TORCH is made for dabbers and cooks who use a flame often enough that a tiny pocket lighter just doesn’t cut it. If your daily driver is a compact rig or you’re running multiple heats in a sesh, this size keeps your hand back from the heat without being clunky. It also pulls double duty for the kitchen, garage projects, or lighting up camping gear so you’re not juggling multiple tools. If you’re building out a full dab station, it pairs nicely with unbreakable gear like our silicone bongs and rigs.

How to Use It

Using the 7" MAVEN NIGHT TORCH is straightforward. Make sure it’s filled with butane, disengage the safety lock, then press the ignition to spark the windproof jet flame. Use the flame adjustment to set your preferred size — smaller for quick, precise work, larger when you need more heat and coverage.

Because it’s a table-style design, you can either hold it like a hand torch or park it upright on a flat surface while you work. At 9.6 ounces (272g), it has enough weight to stay stable without feeling like a brick in your hand. For dab setups, keep it on a heat-safe surface like a dedicated dab mat so any stray heat, tools, or residue don’t trash your table.

When the flame starts to weaken or sputter, it’s time to refill. Flip it over, use a standard butane refill can at the refill port, and give it a moment to settle before lighting again. Let the torch cool down before handling the tip area or putting it back into storage, especially if you’ve run it for a while.

For general care, avoid dropping it or storing it somewhere extremely hot, and don’t leave it in direct sun or in a hot car. Treat it like any quality butane tool: store it upright, respect the flame, and lock it when you’re done.

Care & Maintenance

Let the torch cool fully before wiping it down. If residue builds up around the nozzle or body, use a dry or slightly damp cloth to clean the exterior — avoid soaking or submerging it. For deeper refreshes, you can bleed any remaining gas outdoors in a safe area before refilling with fresh butane, following the lighter/torch safety directions from the fuel manufacturer.

Always keep the safety lock engaged when you’re not actively using it, and store it upright in a cool, dry place away from open flames or direct heat. If you’re tossing it into a kit or bag with other gear, a small padded pouch with your other smoke shop accessories helps prevent accidental bumps to the ignition.

FAQ

  • Is this torch good for dabbing?

    Yes. The single windproof jet flame is strong enough to heat typical bangers and nails, and the 6.5 inch (165mm) height keeps your hand a comfortable distance from the heat. Pair it with sturdy pieces or even unbreakable silicone pipes and rigs if you want a low-stress setup.

  • Does it come filled with butane?

    Most torches ship without butane due to shipping regulations, so you should plan on having a can of quality butane ready for the first fill. Always fill and use it in a well-ventilated area, following the instructions on your butane can.

  • How do I adjust the flame size?

    There’s a built-in flame adjustment that lets you increase or decrease the output. Turn it down for more precise work, or up when you need more coverage. Make small changes and test between adjustments so you don’t overshoot your ideal flame.

  • Can I use this outdoors for camping or BBQs?

    Absolutely. The windproof jet flame holds up far better than standard lighters in breezy conditions, making it handy for lighting grills, camp gear, or fire starters. Just keep it stored safely when not in use and don’t leave it sitting in direct sun.

  • How do I refill the torch safely?

    Turn the torch off, engage the safety lock, flip it upside down, and connect your butane can to the refill port. Give it short, controlled fills, then let it rest a bit before igniting. If you’re refilling near your dab or press station, keep flammables like parchment papers and other disposables out of the way.

  • What should I do if the flame seems weak or inconsistent?

    Weak flame usually means low fuel, trapped air, or using the torch in a very cold environment. Try refilling with fresh butane and allowing the torch to come to room temperature. If there’s still an issue, make sure the flame adjuster isn’t turned too low.

  • Is this overkill if I only light things occasionally?

    If you just need a flame once in a while, a basic lighter might work, but this torch shines if you’re heating things regularly — like working with rigs, culinary projects, or crafts. If you’re already grabbing other smoke shop products for a home setup, a reliable torch quickly becomes one of those "how did I live without this?" pieces.

Drop the pillar into the center of the tower and set the dichro marble to the side while you heat the banger. The 4" ENCORE 38mm Honeycomb Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on for people who are tired of nasty bong water and harsh pulls. Built for smokers who actually care about their glass, this ash catcher stacks a honeycomb perc into a 4 inch (102mm) body to smooth things out and trap crud before it ever hits your main piece. If your daily driver is getting dirty way too fast, this is the upgrade that makes every sesh feel cleaner and easier on the lungs.

At 38mm wide, it’s chunky enough to be stable without turning your setup into some giant science project. And with 14mm and 18mm joint options in both 45° and 90° angles, it drops into most modern water pipes without needing funky adapters.

Why it hits better

  • Cleaner bong, less scrubbing — The honeycomb perc acts like a pre-filter, catching ash and debris before it ever reaches your main chamber.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Dozens of tiny holes in the honeycomb turn smoke into a stack of small bubbles, which cool and condition your hit on the way through.
  • Compact without being fragile — The 4 inch (102mm) height and 38mm chamber give you real diffusion without making your setup top-heavy.
  • Dials in the angle — Available in both 45° and 90° joints, so you can match your beaker, straight tube, or anything in between.
  • Plays nice with your existing glass — Joint options in 14mm and 18mm let you match most standard water pipes and rigs you already own.
  • Better flavor over time — Keeping gunk out of your main piece means fresher water, less stale buildup, and hits that actually taste like your flower.

Best for

This ash catcher is made for people running a daily glass setup who are tired of constant deep cleans and cloudy water after a couple of bowls. It’s especially clutch if you’ve invested in a favorite tube or rig and want to keep it fresh instead of scrubbing resin out of tight percs every weekend. If you’re slowly building out a full station with things like dedicated smoke shop accessories, this is one of those “why didn’t I get this sooner” pieces.

How to use it

Using the 4" ENCORE Honeycomb Ash Catcher is straightforward: you plug it into your water pipe’s joint, then put your bowl or slide on the ash catcher’s joint, and let the honeycomb do its thing. Smoke hits the honeycomb perc first, diffuses through all those tiny holes, and lands in the ash catcher’s water before traveling into your main piece.

Because this piece comes in both 45° and 90° options, it’s easy to set up in a way that keeps everything level and balanced. Just match your bong’s joint angle (45° for most beakers, 90° for most straight tubes) and you’re set. If you like to keep your setup tidy, parking it on a nonstick dab mat between rips helps protect your glass and your table.

Cleaning is simple: let everything cool down, empty the water, and rinse out loose debris. For a deeper refresh, soak the ash catcher in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse thoroughly with water and let it dry completely before the next sesh. Regular quick rinses will keep the honeycomb from getting clogged and keep your main tube almost shockingly clean.

A 45° joint usually lines up best with beaker-style bases, while a 90° joint is more at home on straight tubes or pieces where the joint comes straight out from the side.

Because it adds a little height and weight to your setup, make sure your base is sturdy and set it down on a stable surface. If you’re pairing it with more compact gear like small silicone bongs and rigs, just double-check that everything sits flat and doesn’t feel tippy before you start packing bowls.

Care & maintenance

Let the glass cool before you start handling or cleaning. Dump the old water out frequently so resin and ash don’t cake up in the honeycomb. For everyday upkeep, a quick hot water rinse keeps things moving; when it starts to look stained or airflow feels restricted, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry fully.

If you’re storing it between uses or swapping between different pieces, it’s smart to keep it on a soft surface or tucked near your other glass accessories so it doesn’t roll off a shelf or get knocked off the coffee table.

FAQ

  • Will the 4" ENCORE Honeycomb Ash Catcher fit my bong?
    If your piece uses a standard 14mm or 18mm joint and you pick the correct angle (45° or 90°) to match your bong’s joint, you should be good to go. Just check whether your joint leans out at an angle (usually 45° on beakers) or sticks straight out (typically 90° on straight tubes) before ordering.
  • What’s the point of the honeycomb perc in an ash catcher?
    The honeycomb perc is a flat disk full of tiny holes that breaks the smoke into a ton of small bubbles. That gives you more surface area in the water, which helps cool things down and catch more crud. You end up with smoother hits and cleaner water inside your main piece.
  • Is this better than a basic, non-perc ash catcher?
    Function-wise, yes. A plain ash catcher mostly acts as a debris trap, while the honeycomb in this ENCORE piece adds real diffusion and extra cooling. If you’re trying to actually improve how your setup hits, not just keep it cleaner, a honeycomb style like this is the way to go.
  • Does it make my setup harder to clean overall?
    Not really — it actually makes life easier. The ash and resin collect mostly in the ash catcher instead of your main tube. It’s a lot less work to soak and rinse this smaller piece regularly than it is to deep clean a full multi-perc bong. Storing your main piece empty and your flower in sealed storage packaging between seshes also keeps things fresher.
  • Can I use this with a rig for concentrates?
    Yes, as long as the joint size and angle match, it will technically work on a rig the same way it does on a flower tube. Just remember that more water and diffusion can slightly soften flavor and response, so some dabbers prefer a more direct setup, especially with smaller nectar collectors and straws.
  • How often should I change the water?
    Any time it starts to look cloudy or smell off, swap it out. Many people change the ash catcher water daily or every few bowls, since it’s super quick and keeps that stale taste from creeping into your main piece.
  • What’s the best way to keep the honeycomb from clogging?
    Don’t let dirty water sit for days, and give it a rinse after heavier use. If the holes start to look gunked up, soak the whole piece in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry. It’s the same kind of simple care you’d give to good glass jars and packaging you want to keep crystal clear.

Best For

This 8" ENCORE beaker is made for smokers who want a simple, reliable water pipe that doesn’t hog space or scream "giant bong" on the shelf. How to use it

Fill the beaker base with enough water to cover the bottom of the downstem without flooding it. You want bubbles, not splashback. Load the included 14mm bowl with your herb, set your ice cubes in through the mouthpiece until they rest on the ice pinch, and you’re ready for chilled hits. Once you’ve got your preferred water level figured out the first time, it becomes a quick, repeatable routine.

The basics of beaker function

Beaker bongs are popular because they give you a solid mix of volume, stability, and easy pull. The widened base allows more water and smoke to build up, so each hit has room to cool down before it reaches you. The ENCORE’s ice pinch adds another cooling stage above the waterline, so the smoke passes by chilled glass and melts some of that harshness.

The 14mm joint is standard for a lot of bowls and even some smaller ash catchers, so if you want to tweak diffusion or switch bowls for different grinds, you’re not locked into a proprietary setup. A: Fill just enough to cover the bottom of the downstem so you get proper bubbling without water splashing up the neck. You can experiment a bit to find the sweet spot you like best, but if you see water creeping toward the mouthpiece, pour a little out.

At just 3 inches (76mm) with a 14mm male, 90° joint, it adds filtration and color without turning your setup into a clunky science project.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Way less gunk in your bong — Catches ash and debris before it ever touches your main piece, so your water and glass stay cleaner way longer.
  • Smoother, less harsh pulls — Extra filtration cools things down a bit and keeps burnt particles out of the hit.
  • Small but mighty upgrade — Short 3" (76mm) body gives you the benefits of an ash catcher without making your setup front-heavy.
  • Rainbow swirl that actually pops — Colorful glass that stands out on the shelf and makes clear pieces look way less boring.

Best For

This piece is made for daily drivers who love their glass but hate deep-clean days. If you’re running a compact bong or rig with a 14mm female, 90° joint and want just a bit more filtration and a lot less mess, this is the kind of accessory that quietly becomes part of your permanent setup. It’s also a great pick if you’re starting to upgrade your kit beyond basics and want something more fun than plain clear glass before you dive into full silicone bongs and rigs.

How to Use It

Using the Rainbow Swirl Ash Catcher is as simple as adding one more piece to your normal setup. Slide the 14mm male joint of the ash catcher into the 14mm female joint on your bong so it sits at a clean 90° angle, then add your existing bowl piece to the top joint of the catcher (or whichever connection point your current bowl is made for).

When you pull, smoke and ash first travel into the ash catcher, where the debris drops and the smoke gets a quick wash before continuing into your main piece. That means most of the grime gets trapped in this small chamber instead of coating the inside of your bong. If you like to keep your table clean too, park your setup on a nonstick dab mat so any stray ash or water droplets don’t end up on your furniture.

Cleaning is straightforward: let everything cool, remove the ash catcher, empty any leftover water and ash, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry before using again. Keeping the catcher clean regularly is what keeps your hits tasting fresh.

Specs

Overall Length 3 inches (76mm)
Joint Size 14mm male
Joint Angle 90°
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This ash catcher is designed to plug directly into any piece with a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle. That’s a pretty standard setup for a lot of modern bongs and smaller rigs. As long as your joint is 14mm female and sits upright at 90° (not a 45° slanted joint), it should play nice.

Because it’s only 3" (76mm), it doesn’t add a ton of weight or length, which is great for smaller water pipes that can get tippy with oversized accessories. If you’re rebuilding your kit from scratch, this pairs well with basic glass tubes and other daily-driver-level smoke shop essentials.

The Basics: Why Ash Catchers Matter

If you’ve ever looked at your bong and thought, “Did it really get this dirty after one night?”, this is the fix. An ash catcher acts like a pre-filter and pre-chamber. Instead of ash blasting straight into your water and sticking to every surface, it collects in this separate piece that you can pop off and clean in a couple minutes.

Function-wise, you’re adding a little extra path and sometimes a touch more water for the smoke to move through. That can tame harsher bowls and keep flavor cleaner over time because you’re not constantly pulling through old resin and spent ash stuck in your main chamber. It’s a small upgrade, but once you run an ash catcher for a while, going back to bare bong feels… messy.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep the Rainbow Swirl Ash Catcher looking good and working right, give it a quick rinse every few uses instead of waiting until it’s totally caked. Let it cool, dump out the water and ash, then rinse. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before you put it back into your setup.

If you’re someone who likes to keep all your gear in order, stash your bowls, screens, and lighters together with your ash catcher in a dedicated tray or small storage spot. A simple organizer or smell-proof container from our broader storage and packaging lineup can help keep your kit from turning into a junk drawer.

FAQ

    If your bong or rig has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, this ash catcher should fit right in. If your joint is 45° or a different size (like 18mm), this specific piece won’t be the right match.
  • Does it make my piece tip over?
    Most likely not. At only 3" (76mm), it’s compact and lighter than big percolated catchers, so it usually keeps your setup balanced. Just be mindful with super small or super thin glass pieces.
  • Can I use this with a dab setup?
    This ash catcher is mainly designed for dry herb bowls, but some people do run them in mixed setups if joint sizes and angles line up. If you’re putting together a concentrate rig specifically, you may want to look at dedicated dab tools and accessories built for that kind of use.
  • Is there any special way I should clean the rainbow design?
    No special tricks needed. Treat it like any other glass: let it cool, soak in isopropyl alcohol for a deeper clean, rinse thoroughly with water, and let dry. Avoid scratching it with hard brushes or abrasive pads.
  • Do I need to add water to the ash catcher?
    Some people like to run a little water in their ash catcher, some prefer it dry depending on their piece and pull. Use it the way that gives you the draw you like; just remember extra water means you’ll want to empty and rinse it more often.
  • Will this change how my bong hits?
    Yes, but in a good way for most people. You’re adding a bit more filtration and a small amount of drag. Most folks find it makes the hit feel smoother while keeping the main chamber cleaner, which usually keeps flavor fresher too.
  • What else pairs well with this?
    A steady base (like a tray or pad), some backup bowls, and a good lighter or hemp wick will round out your kit. If you’re expanding your collection, this ash catcher looks especially good next to colorful spoons and other pieces in our silicone pipe selection for a mix of glass and unbreakable gear.

If you already keep your rig parked on a dab mat, this torch is the natural next piece in your station upgrade.

The taller body and footed base give you control whether you’re heating a banger, bowl, or anything else in your ritual. For anyone who rotates between flower and concentrates, it’s a solid all‑around flame source for bowls, bangers, and more.

Let the torch cool fully before you move it, refill it, or put it away. For general upkeep, wipe the exterior with a soft cloth to keep the glossy finish clean and free of residue. The 14mm male joint with a 45° banger placement keeps your hits comfortable while that cat eye marble gives the whole piece a little personality.

Key Benefits

  • Way less stress about drops — The glass chamber is wrapped in a silicone body that helps soak up bumps and knocks so you’re not explaining broken glass to your roommate.
  • Clean glass flavor, travel-ready body — You still rip from glass on the inside, but the silicone armor makes it much more bag- and backpack-friendly.
  • Comfortable 45° angle — The 45° joint makes it easy to see what you’re doing with the banger and keeps the heat away from your face and hand.

  • Grab the color that fits your vibe — Multiple color options let you build a setup that doesn’t look like everyone else’s.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a tough daily driver they can actually toss in a bag without panic. If you already run a few small silicone bongs and rigs and want something with glass flavor but the same no-worries energy, this hits the sweet spot. How to use it

Drop your 14mm banger into the male joint and make sure it’s snug and sitting naturally at that 45° tilt. Add a little water in the glass bottle until you get the pull and chug you like — start low and adjust so you’re not getting splashback.

From there, treat it like any other compact rig: keep the rig on a stable surface, rotate the banger so you’re comfortable, and use the angled joint to keep heat aimed away from your face. Parking it on a nonstick dab mat keeps your station clean and gives the rig a little extra grip so it’s not sliding around.

After your sesh, let everything cool. The silicone is easy to handle, and the glass inside can be cleaned with a basic isopropyl soak, then rinsed and dried before you put it back in rotation.

The basics

The magic of this piece is the glass + silicone combo. The inner glass bottle does the real work for flavor and function, while the outer silicone shell is there to protect, insulate, and add grip. That means you get the smoothness and taste you expect from glass, but with a body that doesn’t feel like a disaster waiting to happen.

The 45° joint is a nice middle ground too — it’s angled enough that you can get a clear view of your banger and use directional caps comfortably, but not so steep that it feels awkward to handle. Swapping to different 14mm attachments, like other bangers or a nail, is straightforward as long as they share the same joint size and angle-friendly style.

Let the rig and banger cool before you touch anything. The 3″ Joint Paper Dispenser Grinder is a 5-piece metal grinder built for rollers who hate digging around for papers every time they pack a cone. It holds your 1 1/4 papers right in the body, gives you a reliable coarse grind for easy-burning joints, and keeps kief stashed in its own chamber. Everything you need to prep a roll lives in one compact, 3-inch (76mm) setup.

What You Get Out of It

  • Always have papers on deck — built-in paper compartment keeps a full 1 1/4 pack right where you grind.
  • Joints that burn the way they should — coarse grind texture is perfect for airflow and even, consistent burns.
  • Less mess, more stash — multi-chamber design sifts and saves kief instead of letting it stick to your tray.
  • No extra tools needed — integrated kief scoop lets you actually use what you collect instead of just looking at it.
  • Dial in your vibe — available in multiple color options so your grinder doesn’t look like everybody else’s.
  • Compact but functional — 3 inches (76mm) across is small enough for a bag or pocket, but still comfy in hand.

Best For

This grinder is made for joint lovers who roll more than they bowl. If you’re the type who keeps a tray, lighter, and papers all laid out for nightly seshes, this pulls two of those tools into one. It also makes a solid upgrade if you’re moving up from a small 2-piece grinder and want something that actually collects kief and stores papers without needing extra storage and packaging around.

The Basics: How It Works

The top section is your standard metal tooth grinding chamber. Load your herb, twist the lid, and it breaks everything down to a slightly chunky, coarse grind that’s ideal for rolling. That ground material drops through into the main chamber where you can scoop it out and build your joint.

Below that, you’ve got a screened kief catcher that slowly fills as you grind through your stash. The included scoop lets you tap that extra potency back on top of a joint or into whatever piece you’re using. Off to the side of all this is a dedicated compartment sized for 1 1/4 papers, so the same grinder that preps your herb also keeps your papers clean, flat, and ready to grab.

If you like to keep your rolling station clean, pairing this with a nonstick dab mat or work mat makes it easy to catch crumbs and herbs while you grind and roll.

How to Use It (Without Overthinking It)

Pop the top, toss in your herb, and twist until you feel everything move smoothly with a bit of resistance — that’s how you know you’ve hit that nice coarse consistency. Unscrew the middle chamber to access your ground flower and load up your paper from the side compartment, which is sized for standard 1 1/4 packs. When you’re done, check the bottom kief catcher and use the built-in scoop whenever you want to give a roll a little extra kick.

When it starts to feel sticky or hard to turn, that’s your cue to clean it. Just separate the pieces, tap out any loose material, and wipe or soak metal parts in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry thoroughly before putting it back into your daily setup next to your favorite smoke shop products.

Specifications

Category Herb grinder with integrated paper dispenser
Material Metal
Diameter 3 inches (76mm)
Pieces 5-piece construction
Paper Size Compatibility Designed for 1 1/4 joint papers
Grind Type Coarse
Special Features Built-in paper compartment, kief chamber, integrated kief scoop

Fit & Everyday Use

At 3 inches (76mm), this grinder is big enough for decent-sized loads but still easy to palm and stash in a bag. The coarse grind works especially well if you’re rolling cones or straight joints and want airflow without having to break up dense chunks by hand. If you’re usually packing bowls or topping off silicone pipes, the grind texture still works, but the real shine is for rollers who live out of 1 1/4 packs.

FAQ

  • Q: What size papers actually fit in the dispenser?
    A: The built-in compartment is designed specifically for standard 1 1/4 joint papers. Kingsize, minis, or unusually packaged papers usually won’t slide in cleanly.
  • Q: Does it grind fine enough for bowls or just coarse for joints?
    A: It’s tuned for a coarse grind that’s ideal for rolling, but you can usually get a bit finer by twisting longer. If you only smoke bowls and want a super fine grind, you might pair this with a more traditional fine-grind piece from your regular smoke shop gear.
  • Q: How do I clean the kief screen and scoop?
    A: Let everything cool off if it’s been near any heat, then tap out loose material and wipe with a dry or slightly alcohol-dampened cloth. For deeper cleans, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and full dry works well.
  • Q: Will this replace my rolling tray?
    A: It can definitely simplify your setup by combining grinder and paper storage, but you’ll still probably want something to catch spills while you roll. A small mat or tray plus this grinder is a nice compact alternative to a full rolling station or separate accessories.
  • Q: Is this good for travel?
    A: Yes, the 3-inch size is easy to pack and having papers inside the grinder means fewer loose items to forget. Just make sure everything inside is legal where you’re traveling and keep it emptied if you’re crossing stricter checkpoints.
  • Q: Does the paper compartment crush or bend my papers?
    A: As long as you’re using standard 1 1/4 packs and don’t overstuff it, your papers should stay flat and protected. It’s a big step up from loose packs getting folded in your pocket next to a lighter and a couple of joint tubes.
  • Q: Can I use it without loading papers in the dispenser?
    A: Absolutely. The grinder works just fine on its own; the paper compartment is just a bonus. You can keep it empty or stash an extra pack so you’re never stuck mid-grind without something to roll.

If your ideal setup is “less clutter, more rolling,” the 3″ Joint Paper Dispenser Grinder pulls your essentials into one solid metal piece that actually earns its spot in your kit.

It catches ash and junk before it ever hits your base water, while the included 3.5-inch (89mm) downstem adds extra diffusion for smoother pulls. If you like your daily driver looking (and hitting) clean, this is the kind of upgrade you feel on the first bowl.

Why It Works

  • Keep your main piece cleaner, longer — Ash and debris collect in the catcher first, so your actual bong stays clearer and smells better between deep cleans.
  • Smoother, cooler hits — The removable 3.5-inch (89mm) downstem adds another layer of water diffusion so your hits feel less harsh on the throat.
  • Easy to clean when it gets gunked up — Simple, straight-forward glass design with a removable downstem means you can shake and soak it instead of scrubbing weird corners.
  • Swappable downstem setup — The removable downstem lets you experiment with other compatible downstems if you like to tweak diffusion or color match a setup.
  • Protects your investment — Taking the abuse in front means less staining, less resin buildup, and fewer “how did this crack?” moments on your favorite piece.
  • Looks clean on the table — Sleek borosilicate glass with a color logo decal gives you that matching-accessory vibe instead of a random Frankenstein attachment.

Best For

This 5″ Encore ash catcher is made for daily smokers who hate how fast their glass gets nasty but still want to burn bowls or snap hits regularly. It’s ideal if your current setup rips hard but feels a little harsh, and you want extra diffusion without swapping to a whole new piece. If you’re building out a full station with grinders, tools, and backup bowls, it slots right in with other essential smoke shop products as a smart “why didn’t I get this sooner” add-on.

How to Use It

Using the 5″ Encore Removable Downstem Ash Catcher is simple: you plug it into your bong or rig’s joint like any other attachment, and then drop the included 3.5-inch downstem into the ash catcher itself. Your bowl goes into the catcher (instead of directly into your main piece), so all that ash, resin, and dirty water lives in the catcher first.

As you burn through bowls, the ash will settle in this piece instead of hammering your main chamber.
