column2: 5″ 14 M 90° ENCORE BABYFACE SLIT ASH CATCHER
column3:
The 5" 14mm Male 90° Encore Babyface Slit Ash Catcher is a glass add-on built for smokers who want cleaner water pipes and smoother pulls without scrubbing their main piece every other day. It rocks a 14mm male joint at a true 90° angle, so it drops right into most upright bongs and rigs with a 14mm female joint. Inside, the Babyface slit perc breaks up and cools your hit while catching ash and reclaim before they ever touch your favorite tube.

If your daily driver is starting to gunk up fast, this little attachment becomes the first line of defense between dirty bowls and clean glass. At 5 inches (127mm) tall, it adds just enough extra filtration and volume without making your setup feel tall and tippy.

Why it works

  • Keep your main piece cleaner — The ash catcher grabs ash and debris in its own chamber, so your bong stays clear longer and deep cleans are way less brutal.
  • Smoother, cooler hits — The Babyface slit percolator slices your pull into smaller bubbles, adding an extra level of diffusion before the smoke even hits your main water chamber.
  • Plug-and-play with most 14mm setups — 14mm male joint at a 90° angle plays nice with standard upright water pipes that use a 14mm female joint.
  • Protect your investment — Taking the abuse in a separate piece means fewer chances of resin stains and hard water buildup in that expensive tube or rig you love.
  • Easy to maintain — Straightforward shape and simple slit perc design make this way easier to clean than a stacked multi-chamber perc bong.
  • Nice function without overcomplicating things — You get legit diffusion and smoother pulls, but it doesn’t add weird drag or make clearing your piece a workout.

Best for

This ash catcher is made for daily drivers who are sick of scrubbing resin out of every corner of their bong but still want clean-tasting smoke. It’s especially clutch if you’ve got a favorite straight tube or beaker and don’t feel like upgrading to some wild multi-perc tower just to get smoother hits.

If you’re already running a glass setup and want to keep your table cleaner, pair this with a solid dab mat or bong pad underneath so drips and splash stay off your desk or coffee table. It’s a small upgrade that makes your whole station feel more dialed.

How to use it

Pop the 14mm male joint of the ash catcher into the 14mm female joint on your bong or rig, making sure the 90° angle lines everything up so the chamber sits upright. Your bowl or banger then goes into the joint on the ash catcher, turning it into an extra mini water chamber between your piece and your smoke.

As you pull, the smoke drops into the Babyface slit perc, which forces it through multiple narrow slits. That creates a bunch of smaller bubbles, adding extra cooling and filtration and giving ash and heavier particles a place to drop out before going through to your main piece. When you’re done, you can pull the whole ash catcher off with the bowl still in it if you like snapping everything in one move.

For people who bounce between flower and concentrate, this kind of add-on is an easy way to keep your main rig from getting coated in reclaim and soot. If you’re running concentrates on your setup, pairing it with a proper set of dab tools helps keep your glass clean and your reclaim more contained.

Specifications

Type Glass ash catcher
Height 5 inches (127mm)
Joint Size 14mm male (main joint)
Joint Angle 90°
Percolator Style Babyface slit perc
Material Glass

Fit & compatibility

This piece is built specifically for 14mm female joints at a 90° angle. That means it plays perfectly with most straight tubes, many beakers, and upright rigs that use a 14mm female joint facing straight out.

It won’t sit right on pieces with 45° joints or 18mm joints unless you add an adapter, and on very small rigs it may feel a little top-heavy. If your favorite rig is silicone, you can still run this as long as the joint sizing and angle match, and pairing a glass catcher with durable silicone bongs or rigs is a nice combo of function and durability.

Cleaning & care

Let everything cool down first, then empty any water and loose ash out of the chamber. For daily upkeep, a quick rinse with warm water keeps buildup from getting out of hand. When it starts to look hazy or sticky, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before putting it back on your piece.

Because this catches a lot of the mess that would normally end up in your bong, expect to clean it more often than your main tube. That’s the trade-off: easy-to-clean accessory instead of scrubbing your whole piece every time.

FAQ

  • Will this ash catcher fit my bong?
    If your bong or rig has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle (the joint points straight out horizontally and the piece stays upright), you’re good. If the joint is angled at 45° or is 18mm, this exact catcher won’t line up correctly without an adapter.
  • Does this change the way my piece hits?
    Yes, in a good way. The Babyface slit perc adds extra diffusion and a bit more volume, so hits usually feel smoother and slightly cooler. You might notice a bit more drag than running your bong bare, but it’s typically minimal and most people feel the extra smoothness is worth it.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Add enough water so the Babyface slit perc is submerged, but not so much that it splashes up into the joint when you pull. You can fine-tune the level by adding a little, taking a test pull (without lighting anything), and adjusting. If you’re working around a bigger setup or press space, keeping your station on something from our parchment papers and sheets lineup can help catch any spills.
  • Is it worth using an ash catcher if I already have a percolated bong?
    If you like clean glass and smoother hits, usually yes. A good ash catcher keeps a lot of heavy resin, ash, and reclaim out of the tighter parts of your main percs, which can be a nightmare to scrub. It’s basically a sacrificial piece that gets dirty first, so your main tube doesn’t have to.
  • Can I use this with a dab rig?
    As long as your rig has a 14mm female joint at 90°, you can drop this in front of a banger. It works as an extra reclaim and cooling chamber between your banger and rig. Just remember it’s still glass, so treat it with the same care as the rest of your setup and consider pairing it with proper storage and packaging for your concentrates so your rig stays tasting fresh.
  • How do I clean the Babyface slit perc area?
    For regular maintenance, warm water rinses after use help a ton. When it gets really gunked up, a soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a thorough rinse and full dry, will clear the slits and restore function. Try not to let resin sit in there for weeks; a quick clean every few days keeps it from turning into a chore.
  • What else do I need to run this with my setup?
    Most people just drop it onto their existing bong and keep using their usual bowl or banger. If you’re building out a full kit, grabbing a couple extra bowls or slides and some backup accessories from our general smoke shop products collection means you’re not stuck when something rolls off the table or disappears between couch cushions.

The 4″ Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for people who are tired of dirty water pipes and harsh hits. It’s ideal if you’re running a favorite daily driver and want smoother pulls plus way less gunk in your main piece. At just 4 inches (102mm) tall with a turbine perc, it adds legit filtration without making your setup feel huge or clunky.

This ash catcher is a nice sweet spot: big upgrade in function, small footprint on your table. If you like your glass clean, your hits cooler, and your bong or rig doing less of the dirty work, this is the kind of accessory that earns its keep fast.

Why It Works

  • Smoother, cooler hits — The turbine perc spins your smoke through water, creating a vortex that adds extra diffusion without dragging your pull.
  • Keeps your main piece cleaner — Ash and debris get trapped in the catcher instead of baking into the downstem or base of your bong.
  • No awkward, top-heavy setup — At 4 inches (102mm), it adds function without turning your rig into a skyscraper.
  • Doubles as a mini pre-cooler — The extra water chamber cools things down before smoke even hits your main perc.
  • Dialed-in fit for angled joints — 45° joint angle makes it a natural match for classic beaker and tube-style water pipes.
  • Built from real borosilicate — Heat-resistant glass that can actually hang with daily seshes if you treat it right.
  • Clean look with color accents — Color logo options let you match or contrast your favorite setup without going over the top.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people who actually use their glass and don’t want to scrub it every other day. If you’re constantly pulling your downstem to rinse out resin and chunks, dropping a turbine catcher in front is a simple fix. It’s also a smart upgrade if you’ve got a favorite piece from your main smoke shop gear lineup and want to stretch its lifespan instead of replacing it.

Because it’s compact, it works especially well for folks who keep their piece on a desk, nightstand, or small coffee table where huge accessories just get in the way or risk getting knocked over.

How to Use It

Using the 4" Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is straightforward: it sits between your bowl and your water pipe and does the dirty work before anything hits your main chamber. Just slide the male joint of the ash catcher into the female joint on your piece, then put your bowl into the joint on the catcher.

Add a little water to cover the slits of the turbine perc, but don’t overfill — you want that spinning action, not splashback. When you pull, smoke or vapor will hit the turbine first, spin through the water in a vortex, and then move on to your main piece already cooled and partially cleaned up. Set the whole setup on a solid surface like a nonstick dab mat if you’re clumsy or working in a crowded space.

Between seshes, you can quickly dump the water from the ash catcher instead of having to rinse your entire bong or rig every time. That’s really where this piece shines — it takes the abuse so your main glass doesn’t have to.

Specs

Brand Encore (Wyn Brands)
Type Glass ash catcher
Height 4 inches (102mm)
Material Borosilicate glass
Joint Size Options 14mm or 18mm
Joint Angle 45°
Perc Style Turbine perc
Logo/Color Multiple color decals (varies by unit)

Fit & Compatibility

This 4" Encore Turbine Ash Catcher is designed for water pipes with a 45° female joint in either 14mm or 18mm size. As long as your piece matches the joint size and angle, it should plug right in and sit naturally without leaning too far forward or back.

If you’re pairing it with other glass or a favorite bowl you already own, just double-check that both the size (14mm vs 18mm) and the angle (45° vs 90°) are correct. A 45° ash catcher on a 90° upright joint will sit weird and can feel unstable — that’s the one thing you really want to avoid.

Cleaning & Care

Since this catches most of your ash and reclaim, regular light cleaning goes a long way. Let it cool down, then empty the water and rinse. For a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before using again.

If you’re working with sticky concentrates around your setup, pairing it with proper storage and packaging for your material can help keep spills and drips off your glass in the first place.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?
    If your piece has a 45° female joint in 14mm or 18mm, you’re good. Just match the joint size: 14mm catcher for 14mm joint, 18mm for 18mm. If your joint is a straight 90°, look for a 90° ash catcher instead so it sits level.
  • Is a 4" ash catcher big enough to make a difference?
    Yes — the height isn’t what does the work here, the turbine perc does. That spinning diffusion plus the extra water chamber is plenty to cool and clean up your hit, especially if your main piece already has a perc inside.
  • Do I need a special bowl for this?
    No special bowl is required as long as it matches the joint size on the ash catcher (14mm or 18mm). If you’re building out a full setup from scratch, you can grab bowls or even dab tools that match your joint size so everything plays nice.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    You only need enough water to cover the turbine slits so the smoke can spin and diffuse. Too much water can cause splashback or restrict airflow. Start low, pull a test draw, and adjust by feel.
  • Does this work for both flower and concentrates?
    Yes. It doesn’t care what you’re running through it — flower bowls, bangers, or anything else that fits the joint size. Many people use turbine ash catchers on their flower tubes, but it can absolutely sit in front of a small rig as long as the angle and joint size line up with your setup or silicone bongs and rigs.
  • How fragile is it?
    It’s made from borosilicate glass, which handles heat and normal use well, but it’s still glass. Treat it like the rest of your good pieces: avoid hard knocks, don’t let it tip over on a hard surface, and be careful when taking bowls in and out.
  • What’s the point of a turbine perc vs a basic downstem perc?
    A simple downstem just pushes smoke through a few slits or holes; the turbine is shaped to spin your smoke through the water, which increases contact and cooling without feeling super chuggy. If you’re already into percs and recyclers, think of this as an extra mini stage of function before everything hits your main glass or concentrate jars area on the table.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Smoother, more controlled hits — The sculpted shape helps restrict and direct airflow over your puddle so you get fuller, more efficient pulls.
  • Art that actually works — Detailed “sexy lady” design isn’t just for looks; it’s shaped to sit nicely over a banger without feeling awkward or clunky.

Best for

How to use it

Use it like a normal carb cap: once your banger is ready, set the pendant piece directly over the top to cover the opening and manage airflow while you draw. You don’t need to do a ton of twisting or spinning—just cap the bucket and let the restricted airflow help move vapor and keep things tasty.

When you’re done dabbing, wipe off any residue, then slide it back onto the necklace and wear it out the door. Setting it down on a dab mat between hits will help keep fume glass clean and avoid micro-scratches from hard tables.

Because this is glass, treat it like you would any other heady piece: don’t drop it on tile, don’t toss it in a bag with keys, and give it a quick clean regularly so buildup doesn’t dull the colors or details.

Fit & Compatibility

    Regular quick cleanings are key. Wiping off reclaim and fingerprints after use keeps the fume glass bright and reflective. If it does get cloudy, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a good rinse and dry usually restores the shine.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Cosmic look on the coffee table — Iridescent glass shifts color in the light, so it always catches your eye.
  • Comfortable, handheld size — 6.5 inches (165mm) is big enough for real function but small enough to stash away quickly.
  • Art piece that actually gets used — Sculpted rocket design gives you a themed piece that isn’t just for show.

Best For

This bubbler is made for herb lovers who want water filtration without committing to a full-size bong. If you like the idea of a piece that doubles as decor, this rocket design fits right in with other display-worthy gear and plays nicely with your existing smoke shop products setup.

Think of this like a mini water pipe built for dry herb. Add a small amount of water to the base so the downstem area is covered, then load the bowl with ground flower and use it the same way you’d use a standard bubbler. For smoother sessions and less mess, park your rocket bubbler on a nonstick surface like a dab mat or pad while you’re packing and clearing it. When it’s time to clean, just let the piece cool, dump the water, and do a quick rinse; for buildup, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry keeps the glass looking fresh.

The sculpted rocket shape gives you natural grip points so you’re not white-knuckling a slippery cylinder, especially when you’re a few bowls in. The iridescent finish shifts between colors depending on lighting and angle, which makes the contours of the rocket body pop even more.

This kind of bubbler is a nice middle ground between a spoon pipe and a full water pipe: you still get that quick, casual feel of a hand pipe, but with extra comfort from the water filtration. To keep the iridescent finish shining, avoid abrasive scrubbers on the outside; a soft cloth works best there. Inside, let the bubbler cool, dump any used water, then rinse with warm water. Fill the bubbler through the mouthpiece or bowl opening with just enough water to cover the downstem or internal opening inside the chamber. You’re aiming for a light, crisp bubble sound when you pull, not a splashy mess in your mouth.

Let the bubbler cool completely before you mess with it. Pour out the old water, then rinse with warm water to clear loose residue. For a deeper clean, use isopropyl alcohol, optionally with a bit of salt, soak briefly, rinse thoroughly, and let it dry fully before you load it again.

This is a self-contained glass bubbler: no removable bowl, no add-ons, no standard joint to swap pieces. It’s designed specifically for dry herb.     Add enough to cover the internal opening in the chamber, then test the pull. You want it to bubble smoothly without water splashing up the neck. If you’re getting water in your mouth, dump a bit out and try again.

    Over time, yes. As you use it and it builds a light layer inside, you’ll see deeper blues, purples, and other tones come forward. If you like the way it looks at a certain stage, you can clean the outside but go a little easier on the inside scrub so you don’t reset it completely.

The 3.5" 14M 90° Mini Hollow Foot Tower Box Set is a quartz banger kit built for flavor chasers who want full function in a compact package. It’s sized for 14mm female rigs and uses a hollow foot tower design to spread heat evenly across the dish so your concentrates vaporize smoothly instead of burning in one hot spot. If you like playing with carb caps and terp pearls to dial in your sesh, this little tower is made for you.

Why It Works

  • Better flavor, less waste — Hollow foot tower design helps distribute heat more evenly across the surface, so your concentrates vaporize instead of pooling in cold spots.
  • Easy, complete setup — Comes with a mushroom top marble cap and two terp pearls, so you’ve got everything you need to get spinning and locked-in airflow right out of the box.
  • Dialed function on small rigs — 3.5" (about 89mm) overall size and 14mm male, 90° joint make it a natural fit for compact rigs and recyclers.
  • Quartz you can actually taste — Clean quartz build lets you taste your terps instead of metal or mystery coatings.
  • More control over your hits — Cap plus pearls give you adjustable airflow and agitation, so you can go from light sips to dense clouds just by changing your draw and spin.
  • Consistent reheats — The tower section holds heat longer than a basic flat-bottom banger, which helps when you’re going in for that second dab without fully starting over.

Best For

This setup is ideal for dabbers running small to medium dab rigs and recyclers with 14mm female joints who want to get into terp pearls and marble caps without buying everything separately. It’s also a solid pick if you like shorter, controlled seshes instead of overheating a giant, heavy banger.

How to Use It

Drop the terp pearls into the banger, seat the 14mm male joint into your rig, and set the mushroom top marble cap within reach. Heat the bucket area of the tower evenly, focusing on the walls and lower section rather than just the lip, then let it cool briefly before introducing your concentrates. Once you’re loaded, cap it and let the airflow do the work—those pearls should start spinning and spreading your concentrates across the hot surface for smooth, even vaporization.

For the cleanest setup, park your rig on a nonstick dab mat so any stray drips or tools don’t end up glued to your table. The compact size of this banger plays especially nice with smaller rigs where big, heavy buckets would throw off the balance.

When you’re done and everything has fully cooled, you can pop out the pearls and cap and give them a quick clean so they’re ready for the next sesh. Keeping quartz and pearls clean is the easiest way to keep flavor sharp and function consistent from dab to dab.

Overall Size 3.5 inches (≈89mm)
Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°

If you’re building out a full station, pair it with solid dab tools so you can load precisely and keep the tower clean.

Care & Cleaning

Let the banger, cap, and pearls cool completely before handling. Once cool, wipe off any visible residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For a deeper clean, soak the quartz parts in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and dry fully before your next use.

FAQ

Will this banger fit my rig?
It fits any rig with a 14mm female joint and a 90° joint angle. If your piece has a 45° joint or a different joint size, you’ll want to match a different style from our broader smoke shop selection instead.

What's the point of the hollow foot tower design?
The hollow foot increases the mass and surface area in the lower section of the banger, which helps hold and distribute heat more evenly. That means your concentrates get spread across a consistently warm surface by the terp pearls, instead of scorching in one hot patch or pooling in a cold corner.

Can I use the mushroom cap and terp pearls with other bangers?
Yes, as long as the other banger has enough internal space for the pearls to move and a bucket that works with a marble-style cap, you can swap them around. If you end up building out a full pearl and marble collection, it’s handy to keep them in dedicated concentrate jars so they don’t roll off or get lost.

How do I keep the pearls spinning smoothly?
Good airflow is key: cap placement, your draw speed, and keeping the interior clean all matter. If you notice the pearls sticking or slowing down, give the banger and pearls a quick clean and avoid overloading so there’s enough room for them to move.

Is this better for small dabs or big globs?
This mini tower shines with small to medium dabs where you want control and flavor over brute-force cloud size. If you’re constantly dropping huge globs back-to-back, you might want to add a beefier banger to your lineup and keep this one as your flavor-focused daily driver. Either way, having extra packaging and storage on hand—like proper storage containers—makes juggling different strains and consistencies way easier.

How fragile is it compared to a standard banger?
It’s still quartz, so it can handle heat but won’t love being dropped on a hard floor or slammed on the sink. Treat it like any other nice quartz piece: avoid thermal shock, don’t torch it red-hot on the regular, and let it cool before cleaning or rinsing.

Can I use this in a professional or medical-style setup?
Function-wise, yes—it’s just a well-designed quartz banger with accessories. If you’re in a licensed space or more lab-like environment, you might pair it with proper parchment papers and handling tools to keep everything clean, organized, and compliant with whatever rules you’re working under.

Load ground flower into the bowl, keeping things loose enough for airflow but packed enough that it won’t pull through. Use the side carb to control how tight or airy your draw feels and clear the chamber when you’re ready between hits.

If you like classic spoon pipes with clean glass flavor and zero fuss, this is that reliable piece you reach for without thinking.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Pocket-sized but not tiny — 5 inches (127mm) gives you a comfortable grip and a little distance from the bowl so you’re not getting cooked every time you clear it.
  • Real glass flavor — Borosilicate glass keeps things neutral so you taste your herb, not the pipe.

Best for

This 5″ Glass Hand Pipe is made for smokers who want a classic dry pipe as their daily driver—something that lives in the tray, gets tossed in a backpack, and just works. The basics are familiar: pack your dry herb into the bowl, cover the carb, and pull through the mouthpiece—this style of hand pipe is pretty much the standard for a reason. The 5-inch length gives the smoke a short path to cool just enough without making the piece awkward to stash or carry. When you’re done, tap out the bowl gently and give the bowl area a quick wipe so it doesn’t cake up on you over time.

Between hits, setting your hand pipe down on a nonstick dab mat helps keep ash, crumbs, and heat away from your table or rolling tray. Let it cool before cleaning; for deeper refreshes, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry will bring the glass back to clear.

Fit & everyday use

Care & cleaning

Glass pipes stay way nicer if you don’t let resin fully take over. Let the pipe cool, tap or gently scrape out the bowl, and wipe what you can reach. For deeper cleans, soak the piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before you use it again. If you’re rotating between a couple of pipes, you can stash this one freshly cleaned and ready to go beside your silicone pipes so you always have a clean option.

    That depends how much you’re seshing. If you use it daily, a quick wipe or alcohol swab every few days keeps flavor fresher and makes deep cleans easier. Once resin builds up, an isopropyl soak, rinse, and dry will restore clarity.

    Like most traditional hand pipes, it’s meant to rest on its side. Set it down gently so the bowl faces up and any loose ash stays put. Keeping it on a small tray or parchment sheet also helps contain crumbs and ash.

The hourglass slurper works by pulling your concentrate into the lower dish and then slurping it up through the center as you draw, spinning that 30mm x 4mm pillar while it goes. The 7″ Full Color Fume Bubbler is a compact glass bubbler built for flower lovers who want smoother water-filtered hits without dragging out a full bong. At 7 inches (178mm) tall, it’s an easy daily driver for couch seshes, desk hits, or passing around a small circle. The full-color fumed glass gives each piece its own shifting, iridescent look as it builds character over time.

With a chunky, large bowl and sturdy hand-held design, this bubbler hits like a small water pipe but stays as grab-and-go as a spoon pipe. If you like your pieces to function hard and also look good sitting on the table, this one checks both boxes.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother hits, less scratch — Water filtration helps cool and mellow your smoke so you can take bigger pulls without getting cooked.
  • Full-color fume that ages with you — Fumed glass develops deeper tones the more you use it, so your bubbler slowly shifts and gets more character over time.
  • Fewer repacks mid-sesh — The large bowl is clutch when you’re posted up and don’t want to stop every couple hits to reload.
  • Easy to palm and pass — Around 7 inches (178mm) is that sweet spot where it still feels like a hand pipe, but you get real water function.
  • Looks good on the shelf — Full-color design makes this as much a display piece as a workhorse, so it doesn’t have to hide in a drawer.
  • Simple to maintain — Straightforward glass construction means no crazy percs or tight corners to scrub.

Best For

This bubbler is made for flower smokers who like the smoothness of a bong but don’t want to commit to a big, fragile tube every time. It’s a great couch piece for nightly seshes, or a “leave at the homie’s place” pipe that feels special without being too precious. If most of your glass is basic clear, this is an easy upgrade into something more artistic without going full heady.

It also plays really well as a compact counterpart to your larger glass or silicone bongs & rigs when you want something more portable but still water-filtered.

How to Use It

Fill the bubbler’s chamber with a little water through the mouthpiece or bowl opening, just enough to cover the bottom of the downstem inside so you get that classic bubble without any splashback. Pack the generously sized bowl with your favorite herb, hold it comfortably in your hand, and you’re ready for a smooth, bubbled pull.

Between bowls, you can quickly dump and refresh the water to keep flavors cleaner. Setting it on a dab mat or bong mat is a nice move if you want to keep resin rings off your table and have a soft landing spot between hits.

When it’s time to clean, let everything cool, empty the water, then rinse. For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry will keep the glass looking fresh and the fume shining.

Specs

Height 7 inches (178mm)
Material Glass
Style Full color fumed bubbler
Bowl Size Large
Intended Use Dry herb / flower

Color & Fume Glass Details

Fumed glass isn’t just painted — it’s created by bonding metal fumes into the glass during the blowing process, giving it that trippy, color-shifting look. Over time, as resin and oils build behind the glass, you’ll notice your 7″ Full Color Fume Bubbler changing tones and depth, almost like it’s “breaking in” visually.

Each piece comes in a multicolor full-fume style, so no two are identical. If you like that collectible, one-of-a-kind vibe, this fits right in alongside more custom glass or even simple clear jars and glass packaging you may already keep on your shelf.

Maintenance Tips

To keep function and flavor on point, swapping the water regularly and giving it a quick rinse after heavy use goes a long way. Let the piece cool completely before handling or cleaning.

For gunked-up situations, a soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a solid rinse with warm water, will usually bring it back. Resin breaks loose easier if you don’t let it sit for weeks, so a little consistency here makes life easier when you’re deep into your rotation of pipes and storage & packaging gear.

FAQs

  1. Is the 7″ Full Color Fume Bubbler good as a daily driver?

    Yes, this is a great daily piece. It’s small enough to keep on your desk or nightstand, but the water filtration gives you much smoother hits than a dry spoon. If you usually bounce between a hand pipe and a bong, this is a nice middle-ground that can easily become your go-to.

  2. How much water should I put in it?

    You only need enough water to cover the bottom of the internal downstem so you get reliable bubbling without water reaching your mouth. Start low and adjust based on how much chug and drag you like. For neat, spill-free filling, some people pour using a small spout bottle they already use with their nectar collectors and other glass.

  3. Is the glass thick enough to handle regular use?

    The bubbler is made from sturdy glass and built to be used, not just stared at. Like any glass, it can still break if dropped or knocked off a table, but the compact size and hand-held design make it easier to grip and less likely to get bumped compared to tall, skinny tubes.

  4. What can I smoke out of this bubbler?

    This piece is designed for dry herb/flower. The large bowl is perfect for packing your favorite strains. If you also enjoy concentrates, you’ll probably want to keep a separate setup with proper nails, bangers, and dab tools so your flower bubbler stays tasting clean.

  5. Does each bubbler look exactly the same?

    No — that’s part of the appeal. Because it’s full color fumed glass, every piece will have its own unique patterning and color transitions. You’re getting the same size and function, but the exact look and swirl of colors will vary, making your bubbler more personal.

  6. How do I keep the bowl from getting clogged?

    Using a medium grind and not over-packing the bowl helps keep airflow open. When you notice pull getting tight, gently tap out the ash and clear any loose debris. If you like to keep the rest of your gear dialed, pairing this with a grinder and a few parchment papers or trays for prep makes everything smoother.

  7. Can I travel with this bubbler?

    At 7 inches (178mm), it can fit in many padded cases or backpacks, but always treat it like any other glass — wrap it or pad it so it’s not rattling around. Make sure it’s fully empty, dry, and clean if you’re taking it anywhere it needs to look low-key, just like you would with any glass from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

  • Can I travel with this?
    You can, but quartz is still glass at the end of the day, so treat it gently. Use the box it came in or another padded case, and keep the slurper, cap, and pillar separated so they’re not clinking around together in a bag.

Why You’ll Love It

How to Use It

Think of this like a more refined hand pipe with built-in water filtration. The fixed bowl and downstem pull smoke straight into the water chamber, where it bubbles, cools, and then travels up the neck to you. The longer body gives that extra bit of cooling time you notice when you’re taking back-to-back hits.

Start by adding a small amount of water into the chamber—just enough to cover the bottom of the downstem. Test the pull without anything packed to make sure you’re getting gentle bubbling, not water in your mouth. You can do all of this over a dab mat or tray to keep the table clean if you tend to spill when you fill.

Load the bowl with your favorite flower, get comfortable, and use the carb (if present on your specific piece) like you would on a regular hand pipe to control airflow. If you’re rotating between pieces, this one’s easy to grab as a quick-change daily driver alongside any rigs or silicone bongs you might already have.

Let the bubbler cool completely before you mess with the bowl or water. For light maintenance, empty the water, rinse with warm water, and let it air dry. FAQ

  • Is each Fume Critter Bubbler exactly the same?
    No—because the critters and details are hand-crafted, each bubbler has its own personality. The overall size and function are consistent, but the exact critter shapes, color patterns, and fume tones will vary, which is part of the fun for collectors.
  • What kind of material is the glass?
    It’s made from borosilicate glass, which is commonly used in quality glass pieces because it handles temperature changes better than soft glass and is less likely to crack from normal use. Still, treat it like glass—don’t drop it, don’t thermal-shock it, and store it somewhere safe.

    This bubbler is designed with flower in mind, with a fixed bowl like a traditional hand pipe. If you’re mainly dabbing, you’ll have a better time with a dedicated rig or nectar collector that’s built for concentrates. You can technically improvise, but it’s not what this piece is optimized for.

    Add just enough water to cover the end of the downstem inside the chamber. You want gentle bubbling when you pull, not water splashing up into your mouth. If you hear it chugging or feel water creeping up the neck, pour a little out and test again.

    Yes. Fuming reacts with use over time—heat, resin buildup, and regular cleaning all affect how the colors develop. As it seasons, you’ll see deeper blues, ambers, and other tones come forward. A quick clean can also make the color shift pop harder.

After your sesh, let the rig cool before you move or clean it. A quick rinse goes a long way in keeping flavor fresh from one dab to the next.

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built with a 14mm male joint at a 90° angle, which means it plays best with 14mm female bangers, nails, and dropdowns. If you already own a few standard quartz bangers, there’s a good chance they’ll drop right onto this piece with no adapters needed.

The compact chamber size pairs especially well with smaller bucket bangers and inserts when you want to keep temps and flavor dialed in. For anyone running multiple rigs, this makes a great "flavor rig" in the lineup alongside your larger daily drivers and silicone rigs.

Care & Cleaning

Keep it simple: let the rig cool completely before cleaning. Then empty the water, add a bit of isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, and gently shake until the residue breaks up. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before your next sesh.

For really stuck-on spots, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, followed by a good rinse, will usually bring the glass back to clear. If you’re handling sticky tools nearby, consider using parchment or nonstick sheets on your table to keep reclaim off your glass and surfaces.

  • Will this fit my existing bangers?

    Check the product options on the page — many rigs are sold without a banger so you can choose your own style and quality level. If you’re upgrading your setup, this pairs nicely with a quality quartz banger and a directional cap from our carb cap collection.
  • How much water should I use?
    Add just enough water to cover the two holes at the end of the perc. Too much water can cause splashback, while too little won’t give you that smooth diffusion this rig is designed for.
  • Is this okay as a travel rig?
    It’s small and easy to pack, but it’s still glass, so treat it with care. For road trips and rough environments, a lot of people keep this as their home piece and grab something from our general smoke shop lineup or silicone gear for true travel duty.
  • Can I use this for flower too?

  • What should I store my concentrates in to go with this rig?
    For a clean setup, keep your oils in proper nonstick or glass containers so you’re not scraping from random packaging. Matching this rig with some solid storage and packaging keeps your flavors locked in and your dab station organized.

The 5" Clear Barrel Ash Catcher is a glass add-on for your bong built for people who hate dirty water and harsh hits. It slots into a 14mm setup and adds an extra water chamber with a barrel perc to scrub and cool your smoke before it ever touches your main piece. At 5 inches (127mm) tall, it’s compact enough for daily use but has plenty of room for real diffusion.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Way less gunk in your bong — The ash catcher grabs ash and crumbs before they ever make it to your main chamber, so you’re not dumping filthy water every other sesh.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The barrel perc breaks the smoke into smaller bubbles, giving it more contact with water for a noticeably easier hit.
  • Quick cleanup instead of full scrub-downs — It’s way faster to rinse out a small attachment than tear down and deep-clean your whole tube.
  • Clean look, easy to monitor — Clear glass makes it obvious when it’s time to change water or do a quick soak, so function doesn’t sneak up on you.
  • Plug-and-play with 14mm setups — Built for standard 14mm joints, so it drops right into most modern glass without needing funky adapters.
  • Protects your investment — Keeps resin and ash off intricate percs and colored sections in your main piece, which means less wear and less risk of over-scrubbing delicate glass.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people who reach for the same bong as their daily driver and are tired of seeing it get trashed after a couple bowls. If you like stacking percs for a smoother rip but don’t want a giant, top-heavy setup, this compact barrel-style catcher hits the sweet spot. It also pairs nicely with more rugged gear like silicone bongs and rigs when you want glass-level function without babying every piece on the table.

How to Use It

Using the 5" Clear Barrel Ash Catcher is straightforward. Remove your bowl from your bong, slide the ash catcher into the 14mm joint, then place your bowl into the ash catcher’s joint. That’s it — your bong now has an extra chamber and perc stage working for you.

Fill the ash catcher with just enough water to cover the slits/holes on the barrel perc without flooding it. Too much water and you’ll feel drag; too little and you lose that smooth, bubbly function. Once it’s dialed, you’ll notice the smoke stacking and diffusing in the ash catcher first, leaving your main piece noticeably cleaner.

If you’re already using a dab mat under your setup, set the ash catcher and bong on it while you swap pieces around. That little bit of cushion helps avoid the "clink" moments that crack joints or chip glass when you’re moving things around mid-sesh.

Between bowls, you can just dump and refresh the water in the catcher instead of your whole bong. When it starts to look cloudy or the walls are coated, give it a quick rinse or soak and you’re back to clean function in minutes.

Specs

Height 5 inches (127mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Material Glass

Fit & Setup Notes

This ash catcher is designed around a standard 14mm joint size, which is what most newer water pipes run. As long as your bong has a 14mm joint and enough clearance so the catcher doesn’t bump the side or base, you’re good. If you’re running a more complex setup with multiple attachments, keep an eye on weight and angle so you’re not stressing the joint on your favorite tube.

If you’re building out a cleaner station or trying to keep your flower and tools organized, consider pairing this with solid storage and packaging options so you’re not knocking loose jars and bags into your glass while you swap the ash catcher on and off.

Care & Cleaning

Let the ash catcher cool before you mess with it, especially after a long sesh. Dump the dirty water, then rinse with warm water to loosen surface residue. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before putting it back into your setup. Keeping this attachment clean means your main bong stays noticeably fresher, longer.

If you’re rotating between different bowls or extra pieces, keeping a little tray or a few accessories around your station can help you park hot glass safely instead of balancing it on the edge of a table.

FAQ

  1. Will this fit my bong?

    It’s made for 14mm joints, which is the most common size on modern glass. If your bong has a 14mm joint where the bowl sits, this ash catcher should slide right in. If you’re not sure, compare the joint to a known 14mm bowl or check the specs from where you bought your piece.

  2. Does it change how my bong hits?

    Yes, but in a good way. You’ll get a bit more drag because you’re adding another water chamber, but the barrel perc also smooths and cools the smoke. Most people notice much cleaner, easier pulls and are happy to trade a tiny bit of resistance for way better function.

  3. How often should I clean the ash catcher?

    That depends on how hard you run it, but plan on changing the water daily and giving it a quick clean when you see resin building on the walls or the perc. Because it’s small and clear, it’s easy to spot when it’s time. A quick alcohol soak, rinse, and dry is usually all it needs.

  4. Will this keep my bong completely clean?

    It won’t make your bong self-cleaning, but it dramatically cuts down on how fast the main piece gets dirty. Most of the ash and heavier particles get trapped in the catcher first. You’ll still want to clean your bong, just not nearly as often or as intensely.

  5. Can I use this with other attachments?

    As long as they share the same 14mm joint size and your setup doesn’t get too tall or heavy, you can stack things like different bowls or simple dropdowns. Just be mindful of stability — if things start to feel wobbly, simplify your stack or move to something more rugged like a smoke shop-ready daily driver that can handle add-ons.

  6. Is this only for flower, or can I use it with concentrates?

    It’s primarily designed for flower bowls, but some people run them in front of dab rigs for extra filtration. If you’re going that route, make sure your banger or nail matches the 14mm joint and keep an eye on reclaim buildup so it doesn’t restrict airflow. For more dab-focused setups, pairing this with proper dab tools and heat-safe gear will give you a smoother sesh.

  7. Is the glass thick or fragile?

    It’s glass, so you still want to treat it with respect, but it’s built as an everyday accessory, not a disposable toy. The real protection comes from how you use it: avoid hard knocks, don’t torque it sideways in the joint, and park it safely on a mat or near your concentrate jars instead of balancing it on an edge when you’re not hitting it.

The 4″ Element Yoshi Hand Pipe is a compact, American-made glass hand pipe built for smokers who want a legit daily driver without a ton of bulk. At just 4 inches (102mm), it’s pocketable, sturdy, and shaped for comfy, easy pulls when you want a quick sesh without dragging out a full setup. Handmade in Washington by Element Glass, each one has that clean, small-batch feel you don’t get from factory pieces.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Pocket-ready size — 4 inches (102mm) is short enough to stash easily but long enough that you’re not cooking your eyebrows.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Thick, quality glass from Element means it can handle real-life use, not just shelf display.
  • Smooth, straightforward function — Simple hand pipe design that clears nicely and doesn’t overcomplicate the airflow.
  • Made in Washington — You’re supporting an actual glass artist, not a random overseas factory run.
  • Unique look every time — Hand-blown construction means no two Yoshis are identical; yours will have its own personality.
  • Easy to keep clean — Minimal curves and chambers make it quick to rinse, soak, and get back into rotation.

Best For

This piece shines if you’re the type who wants a trustworthy, grab-and-go pipe you can toss in a case and not baby. It’s a solid choice for people who like keeping one nice glass piece on deck alongside their more rugged silicone pipes for rougher situations like camping or road trips.

How to Use It

The Element Yoshi is a classic spoon-style hand pipe, so there’s no learning curve here. Load your flower into the bowl, use the side carb to manage airflow, and you’re good to go. The short, straight profile gives you direct flavor and a quick clear without needing a huge pull.

Between bowls, let the glass cool down so you’re not shocking it with temperature swings. When you’re done, tapping out the ash and setting it on a dab mat or soft surface helps avoid accidental chips and keeps your table from getting dusty and ashy.

Cleaning is simple: let the pipe cool, then wipe or rinse away loose debris. For deeper refreshes, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh. Keeping up with quick cleanings will help the colors and glass details stay sharp instead of getting buried under resin.

Specifications

Type Hand pipe (spoon-style)
Length 4 inches (102mm)
Material Borosilicate glass
Origin Washington, USA (Element Glass)

Fit & Everyday Use

At 4 inches (102mm), this Yoshi sits right in that sweet spot where it fits easily in a pocket, pouch, or small case, but still gives you enough distance from the bowl to keep the heat off your face. It works well as a coffee table regular or as a backup stashed in a smell-proof bag alongside your storage and packaging gear for on-the-go sessions.

FAQ

  • Is every Element Yoshi Hand Pipe exactly the same?

    No, and that’s the fun part. Each pipe is individually hand-blown by Element Glass in Washington, so you’ll see small variations in shaping, color distribution, and personality. You’re not getting a cookie-cutter factory clone.

  • How fragile is it compared to a silicone piece?

    It’s made from solid glass and designed for daily use, but it’s still glass—so treat it with some respect. If you’re super rough on gear or want something you can throw in a backpack without thinking, pair this with one of our more rugged rigs from the silicone bongs & rigs collection.

  • What’s the airflow like on a 4″ hand pipe?

    The short body keeps things direct and snappy. You get quick clears and straightforward airflow with minimal drag, which is great for short breaks or when you don’t want to rip on a big water piece.

  • How do I keep resin from building up too fast?

    Dump the ash after each use and give the bowl and mouthpiece a quick wipe or rinse when you notice buildup starting. When things feel sticky, a simple alcohol soak does the heavy lifting. If you store your herb in proper glass jars & packaging, you’ll also cut down on random debris and crumbs getting baked into the bowl.

  • Is this a good gift piece?

    Yes. It hits that sweet spot of being affordable, American-made, and actually usable every day. It’s a much better gift than a novelty pipe that never leaves the shelf—especially for anyone who loves supporting smaller glass shops and curated smoke shop products.

  • Can I travel with this pipe?

    As far as size and durability go, it’s great for throwing into a padded pouch or smell-proof case. Just make sure you’re following local laws wherever you’re going, and keep it clean if you’re moving between areas with stricter rules. Some people like to keep a dedicated travel setup and leave their nicer pieces safely at home with their accessories.

  • How often should I deep clean it?

    That depends how often you’re using it. If it’s your main daily pipe, a proper soak every week or two keeps airflow open and flavor decent. Light users can stretch that longer, as long as you’re still doing quick wipe-downs when it starts to look cloudy.

The JUST THE TIP Dab Swabs 6-pack is an essentials bundle for dabbers who actually clean their gear. You get six screw-top tubs, each with 300 tightly woven cotton swabs (1,800 total), built for hitting every corner of your banger, rig, or insert so residue doesn’t have a chance to build up. One pointed tip on each swab gives you the control to chase gunk out of tight spaces instead of just smearing it around.

Why You’ll Actually Use These

  • Keep your banger tasting fresh — Pointed tips reach the edges and corners of your bucket, so yesterday’s reclaim isn’t ruining today’s flavor.
  • Less effort, more cleanup — Tightly woven cotton has better absorbency, so a couple swabs do the job instead of burning through a whole handful.
  • No fluff left behind — Firm, tight fibers mean way fewer stray threads getting stuck to hot quartz, glass, or metal.
  • Perfect for tight spaces — The slim, tapered tip gets into small joints, recycler arms, terp slurpers, and those annoying little elbows.
  • Session-friendly storage — Each tub stays closed and clean in your kit or backpack, so you’re not grabbing dusty bathroom cotton swabs mid-sesh.
  • Heavy-use ready — 1,800 total pieces means daily dabbers can stay on top of cleaning without constantly reordering.

Best For

These dab swabs are made for people who actually care about taste and function, not just clouds. If you’re running a couple dabs most nights, or sharing a rig at the homie’s house every weekend, keeping a container of these next to your rig and dab mat will make cleanup almost automatic.

They’re also clutch for anyone with more intricate setups—recyclers, multi-chamber rigs, or detailed glass pieces—where normal cotton swabs just don’t reach right.

How to Use Them

After a dab, let your banger or nail cool down until it’s warm but safe to touch. That’s the sweet spot where residue is still soft enough to wipe, but you’re not cooking the cotton. Use the pointed end of the swab to trace the inside edge of the bucket, around the bottom, and into any corners or lips where oil loves to hide.

For tough, baked-on spots, lightly dip the tip in a small amount of isopropyl alcohol before you swab, then wipe and toss when it’s saturated. Keep a little cleaning cup or tray next to your dab tools so everything you need to clean between hits is in one place.

They work just as well on glass, quartz, ceramic, silicone, and metal—so you can hit your rig joint, carb cap air holes, inserts, and even the outer walls of your piece where splashback sometimes lands. When you’re done, bag or toss your dirty swabs so you’re not leaving sticky cotton all over your table.

Specifications

Product JUST THE TIP Dab Swabs
Category Essentials & Accessories
Total Quantity 1,800 swabs (6 containers × 300 pieces)
Packaging Six individual storage containers
Tip Style Single pointed tip
Material Tightly woven cotton swabs

Fit, Surfaces & Compatibility

The pointed tips are sized for typical dab gear: they’ll fit inside most standard bangers, slurpers, and inserts, and can be angled into rig joints, recycler arms, and carb cap openings. They’re safe to use on glass, quartz, ceramic, metal, and silicone pieces, so they’re a solid match with everything from classic glass rigs to unbreakable silicone bongs and rigs.

Because the cotton is tightly woven, the tips hold together better than cheap pharmacy swabs, especially when you’re working around warm surfaces. Still, always let your gear cool to a safe temperature before cleaning and swap swabs as soon as they’re saturated.

Care & Storage Tips

Keep the containers sealed when not in use so your swabs stay clean and dry. Store them somewhere cool and away from splash or spray—ideally in the same drawer or kit as your storage and packaging so all your maintenance gear stays together.

Used swabs should be thrown away after one pass; they’re not meant to be reused. If you’re using alcohol with them, let your gear fully dry before the next use so you’re not heating any leftover liquid.

FAQ

  • Are these different from regular cotton swabs?
    Yes. The pointed tip and tighter weave make these way better for dabbing gear. Regular bathroom swabs tend to be too fluffy and round, so they smear oil around and can leave little fibers behind in your banger or rig.
  • Will the tips fit inside smaller bangers and terp slurpers?
    The tapered design works well in most standard buckets, slurpers, and small inner chambers. If your setup has extremely tiny or specialty openings, you may need to angle the swab or only use the very point of the tip to reach inside.
  • Can I use these with isopropyl alcohol?
    Definitely. A light dip in ISO helps break down tough residue and is especially handy for cleaning after hotter runs. Just avoid oversoaking the swab and let your quartz or glass dry fully before your next dab. For long-term storage after cleaning, keep your favorite concentrates in proper concentrate jars so the fresh, clean banger actually makes a difference in flavor.
  • Are they safe for silicone pieces?
    Yes, they’re safe on silicone, glass, quartz, ceramic, and metal. The cotton is soft enough that it won’t scratch your gear, making them great for detail work around joints, percs, and mouthpieces on more flexible pieces.
  • How long will 1,800 swabs last?
    It depends how often you dab and how picky you are about cleaning. Heavy daily dabbers who wipe after every use can still get months out of a bundle like this. Occasional dabbers will probably forget when they even bought them before they run out.
  • Do these come loose or in sealed containers?
    They come pre-packed in six containers with screw-on or snap-style lids, so the swabs stay clean until you need them. You can keep one container at home by your rig, toss one in your travel kit with your nectar collector, and stash the rest as backup.
  • Can I use them for anything besides dabs?
    For sure. They’re great for cleaning carb caps, vape chambers, tight corners on grinders, and even little spill spots on your desk or smoke shop gear. Anywhere you’ve got small, sticky messes, these pointed swabs are handy.

The 6″ Element Steamroller is a classic glass hand pipe built for smokers who like their hits strong, simple, and straight to the point. At 6 inches (152mm), it’s long enough to cool the smoke a bit, but still compact enough to toss in a bag and take anywhere. Made in Washington, USA, this is a no-frills, hard-hitting piece for people who care more about function and flavor than gimmicks.

You get that trademark steamroller punch thanks to the open-ended design and direct airflow path, so every pull feels big, clear, and satisfying. If you already know you like a more intense dry pipe experience and want something clean, reliable, and made in the States, this checks every box.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Big, direct hits — Straight-through steamroller design pushes dense, full-bodied smoke with very little restriction.
  • More distance from the bowl — 6 inches (152mm) of glass keeps the heat a bit further from your face and fingers while you’re snapping bowls.
  • Made in USA craftsmanship — Built in Washington by people who know glass, not some random mystery import.
  • Minimalist, easy-to-use shape — No extra parts, no moving pieces, just a bowl, a tube, and an open end that clears fast.
  • Great flavor from glass — Borosilicate-style glass (material tag: glass) keeps the taste of your herb clean with no weird flavors.
  • Travel-friendly size — Slim, compact profile that disappears into a backpack or small case without taking over your whole kit.

Best For

This 6″ Element Steamroller is made for smokers who already have their routine dialed in and want something that just hits hard and works every time. It’s ideal if you like dry pipes but want more punch and faster clears than a standard spoon. If your daily driver is a bong or rig and you want a simple piece for quick hits away from your main setup, this pairs nicely with the rest of your smoke shop gear.

If you’re newer or prefer softer, more filtered hits, a water piece might make more sense, but if you’ve ever thought “my spoon hits fine, but I wish it smacked a little harder,” this is exactly that upgrade.

How to Use It

The beauty of this steamroller is that there’s almost no learning curve. The bowl sits on top near one end, and the opposite end is open — that open end acts as your carb. You cover it with your hand while you draw, then let go when you’re ready to clear the chamber. Once you get the feel for how much you like to draw before clearing, it becomes second nature.

Because it’s a straight tube, it’s easy to tap ash out, give it a quick wipe, and stash it until the next sesh. A small tray or dab mat under it helps keep stray ash and herb off your coffee table so you’re not cleaning up after every bowl.

For cleaning, let the pipe cool, then rinse or soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry before using again. Keeping it reasonably clean not only looks better, it keeps the airflow open and the flavor fresher.

The Basics (What Makes a Steamroller Different)

If you’re coming from spoons or chillums, a steamroller is basically the “open carb” version of those — designed for fast clears and more intense hits. Instead of a small side carb, the open end gives you a big rush of fresh air when you release, which sends the smoke straight through in one go. That’s why steamrollers have a rep for hitting harder than they look.

The 6″ length on this Element model lands in that sweet spot where it’s still portable but not so short that every hit feels blazing hot. The direct airflow also means less drag than many standard hand pipes, so you can pull as lightly or as aggressively as you want and it will keep up.

If you’re rotating between different ways to smoke — maybe a bong at home, a one-hitter on the move, and something in between — a piece like this is a nice middle ground that doesn’t need water, screens, or extra parts. Just herb, glass, and airflow.

Specifications

Product Type Glass steamroller hand pipe
Length 6 inches (152mm)
Material Glass
Origin Washington, USA
Brand / Series Element Glass

Fit & Everyday Use

This is a solid fit if you want something you can toss in a small pouch and bring to a friend’s place without worrying about water spills or a big setup. It’s also good for quick solo snaps — pack a small bowl, take a couple pulls, clear it, and you’re done. If you like to rotate different strains, keeping them labeled and fresh in proper glass jars makes swapping bowls with this pipe way more enjoyable.

Because it’s glass, you’ll still want to treat it like a real piece of gear — it can survive normal use but won’t love being dropped on tile or knocked off a counter. A little padded case or wrapping it in a soft cloth in your bag goes a long way.

Care & Cleaning Tips

Glass steamrollers are pretty straightforward to maintain. Try to tap out ash after each use rather than letting it sit and cake in the bowl. When you start to see resin building up inside the tube or the smell gets stronger, that’s your sign it’s time for a quick clean.

Let the piece cool completely, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and dry before using it again. For people who like to keep their whole setup tidy — from glass to tools to packaging — it’s easy to build this into your regular cleanup routine along with your other storage and packaging gear.

FAQ

  • How hard does a 6″ steamroller hit compared to a regular spoon pipe?
    Steamrollers generally hit harder because of the open-end carb and straight airflow. Even at 6 inches (152mm), this Element piece can feel noticeably punchier than a typical spoon, especially when you clear it in one rush. If you’re used to smaller hand pipes, expect a stronger, more direct hit.
  • Is this a good first pipe if I’m new to smoking?
    It can be, but keep in mind steamrollers are known for strong hits. If you’re brand new, something with a side carb and slightly more gentle draw might feel more forgiving. That said, if you’re comfortable taking it slow and like the idea of a simple, straight pipe, this is easy to use and doesn’t require any special technique. You can always pair it with other pieces like silicone pipes if you want a softer option too.
  • What can I smoke out of this steamroller?
    This is a dry glass hand pipe, so it’s meant for traditional smokable herbs. Many people use it for flower or similar legal materials. It’s not designed for concentrates like dabs — those work better with rigs, bangers, or nectar collectors.
  • How do I keep it from rolling off the table?
    Steamrollers are usually cylindrical, so set it down with the bowl facing up and the mouth-end slightly angled so it’s more stable. Some people like to rest it across a lighter or set it on a non-slip surface like a small mat or tray to keep it from moving around.
  • How often should I clean it?
    That depends on how often you use it and how picky you are about flavor. If you’re smoking daily, a quick clean every few days keeps the airflow open and the taste fresher. When you notice the draw feels tighter or the glass looks cloudy and dark inside, that’s your reminder to give it a rinse with isopropyl alcohol, then wash and dry.
  • Is this more fragile than silicone or metal pieces?
    Glass always needs more care than silicone or metal. This 6″ Element Steamroller is made from solid glass but can still crack or break if dropped. If you know your crew or your environment is rough on gear, you might want this as your “home piece” and lean on unbreakable options when you’re out and about.
  • Does it come with any accessories?
    No, this listing is for the steamroller pipe itself. You won’t need much extra to use it, but a simple carrying case and some basic cleaning supplies will make your life easier, especially if you’re building out a full kit with other tools and accessories.

The 10″ Iridescent Straight is a classic straight-tube glass bong built for people who want clean, direct hits with a little extra shine on the table. At 10 inches (254mm), it’s tall enough for solid function without being a clumsy giant, and the ice pinch lets you stack cubes for cooler pulls when you’re running longer seshes.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — Built-in ice pinch lets you drop in cubes so your smoke has to pass through a chilled neck before it reaches you.
  • Looks wild under any light — The iridescent finish throws rainbow reflections that really pop in sunlight or LEDs, so it never just blends into the background.
  • Simple straight-tube function — No crazy percs to clog, just classic downstem diffusion in a straight body that clears fast and rips hard.
  • Dial in your setup with 14mm gear — Standard 14mm joint size means you can swap bowls or add a banger or ash catcher without hunting for weird adapters.
  • Easy to keep clean — Straight walls and a modest height make rinsing, soaking, and shaking way less of a chore than big multi-chamber pieces.
  • Great balance of size and stealth — At 10 inches, it’s a solid daily driver that still tucks into a cabinet or backpack with some padding.

Best For

This bong is made for people who like straightforward function with just enough style to feel special. If you’re upgrading from a tiny beaker or old hand pipe and want a clean-hitting water piece that doesn’t take over the whole coffee table, this is that sweet spot. It’s also a nice match for anyone already using a dab pad or mat and wants a dedicated flower tube that still looks good in the setup.

How to Use It

The 10″ Iridescent Straight runs on the classic straight-tube formula: water in the base, smoke pulled down through the bowl and downstem, then straight up the tube. That simple path is what gives you those fast, snappy clears that straight-tube fans swear by.

Start by adding enough water to cover the bottom of your downstem so you get that tight, bubbling diffusion without splashback. Pack your 14mm bowl to your liking and you’re ready for a rip. If you want to cool things down, drop a few ice cubes into the mouth of the tube; the ice pinch will catch them above the water and force the smoke through a chilled section before it hits your lungs.

If you ever decide to run concentrates through this piece, you can swap the bowl for a 14mm banger and turn it into a simple dab rig. In that setup, it pairs nicely with directional caps and other carb caps to help you get more control over airflow.

Between uses, you can park it on your desk or shelf as functional decor. The iridescent glass throws different colors depending on the angle and lighting, which is half the fun when you’re a couple bowls in and just watching the tube milk up.

Specifications

Height 10 inches (254mm)
Material Glass
Style Straight tube bong with ice pinch
Joint Size 14mm

What’s Included

  • 10″ Iridescent Straight Glass Bong
  • 14mm flower bowl

Fit & Compatibility

The 10″ Iridescent Straight uses a standard 14mm joint, which is the most common size for modern bowls, ash catchers, and bangers. That means you can upgrade the stock bowl, add an ash catcher, or convert it for concentrates with a 14mm nail or banger without hunting for oddball glass. If you’re building out a full station with other glass and silicone pieces, it’ll sit right in with typical smoke shop accessories you already own.

Care & Cleaning

Let the bong cool after use, then empty the water and give it a warm rinse to get rid of loose residue. For deeper cleans, add isopropyl alcohol, plug the openings, give it a gentle shake, then rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry completely before your next sesh. Keeping up with quick rinses between bowls will make those deep cleans way easier over time.

FAQs

  • Does this bong come with a downstem, or do I need to buy one?

    It comes ready to go with a 14mm flower bowl included. If your version includes a removable downstem, it will be sized to work with the 14mm joint on the bong, and you can always upgrade to a different style later. If you like to keep multiple bowls or stems on deck, you can stash extras with your other bong accessories so they’re easy to grab.

  • Can I use this with concentrates instead of flower?

    Yes, you can. Just swap the 14mm flower bowl for a 14mm banger or nail and you’ve got a simple, tall dab setup. For better control and vapor direction, pair it with one of your favorite dab tools so you’re not fighting sticky concentrates with the wrong gear.

  • Is the iridescent finish going to fade or peel?

    The iridescent effect is part of the glass itself, not a cheap sticker wrap. Normal cleaning with isopropyl alcohol and water is fine and won’t strip the finish. Just avoid scratching it up with abrasive pads or tools, same as you would with any nice glass piece.

  • How much water should I put in?

    Fill the base just high enough to cover the bottom of the downstem so you get proper bubbling without water climbing the tube. You can tweak the level a bit to find your sweet spot depending on how chuggy or airy you like the pull. If you’re used to smaller pieces like silicone hand pipes, you’ll probably enjoy the extra diffusion you get here.

  • Is 10 inches big enough for daily use?

    For most people, 10 inches is a perfect daily driver height: stable base, enough volume for satisfying hits, but not so big that cleaning and storage are annoying. If you like to run mixed setups with rigs and nectar collectors, this bong fills the “easy flower rip” slot really well.

  • What’s the best way to store it when I’m not using it?

    Keep it upright on a flat, stable surface where it’s not getting bumped by doors, elbows, or pets. If you want extra protection, you can wrap it in a towel or keep it in a padded bag or box. Storing it dry and empty between uses helps keep it fresh, especially if you also store your flower or concentrates in proper storage packaging.

  • Does the straight tube style hit harsher than a beaker or perc bong?

    Straight tubes like this clear faster and feel a bit more direct than big multi-perc or beaker-style pieces. The ice pinch helps smooth it out by cooling the smoke, and the water still does its job filtering. If you like fast, snappy clears and easy maintenance, this design is hard to beat.

The GRUNGE OFF Glass Cleaner is a heavy-duty glass cleaner built for people who actually use their pieces and don’t want to spend all night scrubbing them. It’s ideal for smokers with multiple glass rigs, bongs, and bowls in rotation who need something that actually melts through buildup instead of just swirling it around. This 16 oz (473ml) ready-to-use bottle is all about soak-and-go convenience, giving you repeat deep cleans without harsh shaking or abrasive tools.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Real deep clean with almost no effort — the solution breaks down built-up residue so you’re not fighting with brushes and cotton swabs.
  • Better flavor from every hit — clean glass means you’re tasting your flower or concentrates, not last week’s leftovers.
  • Perfect for people with more than one piece — 16 oz (473ml) goes a long way across rigs, bongs, bowls, and attachments.
  • No mixing, no guessing — pre-mixed formula means you just pour it in and let it work.
  • Less wear on your glass — soaking instead of hard scrubbing helps protect delicate joints, percs, and intricate designs.
  • Good for regular upkeep, not just emergency cleans — makes it easy to keep a consistent cleaning routine instead of waiting until everything is crusted over.

Best For

This cleaner is made for:

  • Daily drivers who are tired of cloudy glass and dull flavor
  • Collectors with multiple water pipes, rigs, and bowls that need regular love
  • People who hate scrubbing down intricate percs and tight corners by hand
  • Anyone who uses their glass on a dab mat and wants the whole setup looking fresh, not just the pad
  • Smokers who like their pieces looking “new glass” clean when friends come over

How to Use It

Think of GRUNGE OFF as a soak-and-forget cleaner. You’re letting chemistry do the heavy lifting instead of your wrists. Pour enough solution into your piece to cover the dirty areas, or place smaller items in a container and fully submerge them.

Let your glass sit in the solution so it can break down the built-up residue. The dirtier the piece, the longer you’ll want to leave it soaking. When the grime has lifted, rinse everything thoroughly with warm water and let it dry completely before you load it back up. Setting your freshly cleaned piece on a clean smoke shop accessory stand or tray helps keep it spotless between seshes.

For routine care, you can use smaller amounts of solution more frequently instead of waiting for your glass to get completely wrecked. That way your percs, downstems, and mouthpieces stay clear, and you’re not embarrassed to hand your piece to a friend.

Specifications

Spec Detail
Product type Glass cleaner
Intended use Cleaning glass smoking pieces
Volume 16 oz (473ml)
Format Ready-to-use liquid solution
Application Soak-based cleaning (no mixing required)

Care & Cleaning Tips

Let your glass cool down fully before adding any cleaner or liquid. After soaking with GRUNGE OFF and seeing the residue lift, rinse thoroughly with warm water until no cleaner remains, then let your piece air dry completely before using again. If you’re cleaning multiple small parts like slides or dropdowns, keep them together in a small container so you’re not chasing pieces around your sink.

Between deep cleans, storing cleaned rigs and bowls near your storage and packaging setup makes it easier to keep everything organized and ready for the next sesh.

FAQ

Is GRUNGE OFF safe for colored or worked glass?

Yes, it’s designed for glass of all types, including colored, fumed, and worked pieces. It works by soaking and loosening residue rather than scratching or scouring the surface. Just make sure you rinse thoroughly with warm water after cleaning.

Can I use this on silicone or acrylic pieces?

This cleaner is intended for glass only. For non-glass gear, check out our lineup of silicone bongs and rigs that are easy to clean with more basic methods like warm water and mild soap.

How often should I clean my glass?

If you’re a heavy smoker or dabber, cleaning every few uses keeps flavor and function on point. Light smokers can stretch it out a bit more, but once you see visible buildup in your perc or your hits start tasting stale, it’s time to give everything a soak. Keeping a consistent routine makes each clean much easier than waiting until the piece is totally caked.

Will this remove really old, baked-on buildup?

Yes, that’s what it’s made for. Extra-dirty pieces might need a longer soak or a couple of rounds with fresh solution, especially if you haven’t cleaned them in months. Pairing the soak with a simple rinse and shake after can help get any last bits out of tight corners and percs. For pieces that have been neglected for a long time, you might want to protect your work area with a sheet of parchment paper or towel while you dump and rinse.

Do I need to heat it up or mix it with anything?

No mixing, no heating, no nonsense. GRUNGE OFF comes ready to use straight from the bottle. Just pour it into or over your glass and let it soak. Heating or altering the solution isn’t recommended.

Can I reuse the cleaner after soaking a piece?

Many people do reuse it a few times, especially for lighter cleanings. Once the solution looks heavily discolored or full of debris, it’s time to replace it with fresh cleaner. If you’re bouncing between rigs, bowls, and dab gear, consider keeping your cleaner bottle next to your dab tools so you remember to give everything a quick refresh on the same day.

Is it okay for small pieces like bowls, slides, and banger attachments?

Yes, it works great on smaller glass parts. Pop them into a small glass or container, cover with GRUNGE OFF, and let them soak. This is especially nice for pieces with tight airpaths where brushes and swabs can’t reach. Afterward, rinse well and let them dry on a clean surface like one of our glass jar lids or a drying rack so they don’t pick up dust before your next sesh.

The 12oz (354ml) bottle gives you enough cleaner to keep multiple bongs, rigs, and pipes in rotation without running out mid-clean.

Why It Hits Different

  • Fast clean, less hassle — Strong formula attacks tar, goo, and resin on contact so you’re not shaking your arm off forever.
  • Saves your favorite pieces — Designed for glass, metal, and ceramic, so you can use one cleaner for your bong, dab rig, and bowl without worrying about damage.
  • Better flavor, smoother pulls — A clean piece means you actually taste your flower or concentrates instead of burnt leftovers from last week.
  • Perfect size for regular upkeep — 12oz (354ml) is dialed in for people who clean often but don’t need a giant jug taking up space.
  • Great for stubborn buildup — Clings to grime in tight spots like percs, downstems, and bowls where brushes can’t always reach.
  • Less mess on cleaning day — Liquid cleaner handles the heavy lifting so you spend more time rinsing than fighting crusty residue.

Best for

Randy’s Black Label is made for smokers and dabbers who run their glass hard and don’t want it looking like a science experiment. If you’ve got a couple of daily-driver pieces plus a backup rig and a few bowls, this bottle will slide right into your regular cleaning routine. It also plays nice if your setup includes a mix of pieces like glass rigs and unbreakable options from our silicone bongs & rigs collection, letting you focus this cleaner where it shines: glass, metal, and ceramic.

How to use it (the basics)

Start by making sure your piece is empty and cool. Add enough Randy’s Black Label to coat the dirty areas inside your glass, metal, or ceramic, then cover any openings and give it a good shake so the cleaner can reach all the resin-heavy spots. You’ll see the liquid darken as it breaks down tar and buildup.

Let the cleaner work for a short time, then pour it out and rinse well with warm water until there’s no cleaner left and everything feels smooth instead of sticky. For really stubborn sections, you can repeat the process or focus some cleaner directly on those trouble areas while you gently agitate. It’s a good move to do this over a dab mat or sink to catch any drips and keep your space from getting messy.

If you’re cleaning smaller pieces like slides, bowls, or metal dab tools, you can use a small container, add enough cleaner to cover them, swirl, and then rinse thoroughly. Once everything’s dry and residue-free, your piece is ready to go back into the rotation without that old, burnt taste lingering.

Size 12 oz (354 ml)
Compatible Materials Glass, metal, ceramic
