This cleaner is built specifically for hard materials: glass, metal, and ceramic. It’s ideal for things like bongs, dab rigs, bowls, slides, ashcatchers, basic smoke shop products made of those materials, and metal dab tools. Don’t use it on silicone, acrylic, painted exteriors, or anything the manufacturer says to keep away from strong cleaners. When in doubt, spot-test a tiny, hidden area first.

Care & storage tips

Close the cap tightly after each use and store the bottle upright in a cool, dry spot, away from direct sunlight or heat. If you’re cleaning multiple pieces in one go, pour only what you need so you’re not wasting product. After each clean, let your piece cool, rinse everything thoroughly with warm water, and allow it to dry before you pack it away in your usual storage & packaging setup.

Level up your cleaning routine

Randy’s Black Label does the heavy lifting for the inside of your gear, and pairing it with the right accessories makes the whole process smoother. FAQ

  • Can I use Randy’s Black Label on silicone or acrylic pieces?
    No, this cleaner is meant for glass, metal, and ceramic only. For anything soft, flexible, or plastic-based, stick with gentle methods or pieces designed to be cleaned differently, like items from our silicone pipes line that are easier to maintain.
  • Do I need to dilute it, or use it straight from the bottle?
    Use it straight from the bottle. Pour in enough to contact the dirty areas, shake or swirl so it reaches all the buildup, then pour it out and rinse thoroughly with warm water until there’s no cleaner left.
  • Is it safe for colored or worked glass?
    It’s designed for glass, including most colored or worked pieces. Avoid using it on painted, plated, or finished exteriors that aren’t true glass color work. If your piece has special finishes or decals, you can always spot-test a tiny area first to be safe.
  • How often should I clean my bong or rig with this?
    That depends on how hard you run your gear. A lot of people like to give their daily driver a cleaning once a week or whenever they notice flavor dropping off or buildup starting to creep up the neck. Regular quick cleans with Randy’s keep you from dealing with full-on, concrete-level resin.

    Yes, it’s strong enough to handle stubborn, long-term buildup. You may need to let the cleaner sit for a bit longer inside the piece or repeat the process a couple of times for really neglected glass, especially around percs and tight chambers.
  • Can I soak small parts like bowls and metal tools in it?
    You can submerge glass, metal, or ceramic parts in a small container with enough cleaner to fully cover them. Swirl occasionally, then rinse thoroughly with warm water and let everything dry before putting it back with your other dab tools or accessories.
  • Does this cleaner leave any taste or smell behind?
    As long as you rinse your piece thoroughly with warm water after using Randy’s Black Label, it shouldn’t leave a noticeable taste or smell. Make sure all cleaner is fully rinsed out and the piece is dry before your next sesh so you’re only tasting what you pack.

The 4.5" Color Lip Snow Globe Rig is a compact glass dab rig built for concentrate fans who want real function in a small footprint. It’s ideal if you’re tight on space, sesh at your desk or bedside, or just don’t want a giant tower of glass to babysit. The round snow globe chamber and 4.5 inch (114mm) height give you surprisingly smooth hits from a rig that’s easy to grab, clear, and stash.

With a 14mm male, 90° joint, it’s ready to pair with a standard 14mm female banger and fits right into most small‑to‑medium dab setups without any weird angles or adapters. Color lip accents around the mouthpiece add just enough personality so it doesn’t look like every other clear micro rig on the shelf.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Rig

  • Smoother-than-expected pulls — The snow globe-style chamber gives your vapor room to expand and cool, so you’re not getting scorched on a tiny rig.
  • Desk-friendly size — At 4.5 inches (114mm) tall, it’s easy to pass around, easy to hide, and way less likely to get knocked over than a tall tube.
  • Clean angles, easy setup — 14mm male joint at 90° means most 14mm female bangers drop in and line up right over your rig.
  • Comfortable hits — The color lip mouthpiece isn’t just for looks; that rounded edge makes longer draws feel better.
  • Easy to clear — The compact globe shape and short neck make it simple to drain the chamber without feeling like you’re pulling forever.
  • Great price for a daily driver — Solid little glass rig that you won’t be scared to actually use every day.

Best For

This rig is made for dabbers who want a small, dependable daily driver instead of a big, fragile art piece. If you like quick solo hits, keep your setup on a nightstand or coffee table, or want a travel-friendly backup for your main rig, this one fits right in. It’s also a smart pick if you already have a few dab tools and bangers and just need a compact, reliable base to run them on.

How to Use It

Fill the rig with just enough water to cover the percolation in the bottom of the globe, without sending water up the neck when you pull. Too much water in a small rig will splash, so start low and test the pull before you load anything.

Drop in your 14mm female banger on the 90° joint, load your concentrate, and you’re good. The globe chamber gives your vapor a quick spin and cool-down before it reaches the color-lipped mouthpiece, so even short hits feel smooth. Setting the rig on a nonstick dab mat keeps reclaim off your table and gives you a safe landing spot for your banger between pulls.

When you’re done, a quick rinse and dry goes a long way. For heavier use, let the glass cool first, then give it a simple alcohol soak, rinse with warm water, and let it dry completely before the next sesh.

Specs

Height 4.5 inches (114mm)
Material Glass
Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 90°

The 14mm male, 90° joint makes this an easy plug-in for most small bangers you’ve already got, and the short overall height keeps your torch work comfortably close without feeling cramped.

What’s Included

  • 1 × 4.5" Color Lip Snow Globe Glass Dab Rig
  • 1 × 14mm 90° banger (female) to match the joint

Pair it with a sturdy travel case or stash it alongside other compact pieces in your main smoke shop products lineup so it’s always ready to go.

Fit & Compatibility

This rig is built around a 14mm male joint, so you’ll want any 14mm female banger, nail, or compatible attachment. The 90° angle works best with flat-bottom or slightly angled bangers, keeping the bucket level while you heat and load. If you like running carb caps or pearls, make sure they match the size of whatever banger you’re using — the rig itself will happily run pretty much any standard 14mm female piece.

If you want an indestructible backup or travel option alongside this glass rig, mixing in a small piece from our silicone bongs & rigs collection gives you a no-worries option for camping, beach days, or clumsy friends.

Care & Cleaning

Let everything cool down before you clean — hot glass and sudden temperature changes don’t mix. Dump the water, rinse with warm water, and for built-up residue, a soak in isopropyl alcohol does the heavy lifting. Rinse again and let it fully dry before you refill and use it.

For banger cleanup, the same basic idea applies: let it cool, wipe or soak, rinse, and dry. Keeping things clean not only looks better, it keeps your terps tasting the way they should so you’re not dragging old, burnt flavors into a fresh dab.

FAQ

  • Does this rig come with a banger?
    Yes. A matching 14mm 90° banger is included in the box, so you can go from unwrapping to dabbing with no extra parts needed.
  • Will this fit my other 14mm accessories?
    If your accessories are 14mm female and designed for a 90° joint, they should drop right in. Anything like standard 14mm female bangers, terp slurpers, or basic 14mm attachments will generally play nice.
  • How much water should I use?
    Use just enough to cover the perc area in the bottom of the globe. Then take a few test pulls without any concentrate to make sure you’re not getting splashback. Small rigs don’t need much water to function well.
  • Is 4.5 inches too small for decent hits?
    Not with this shape. The snow globe-style chamber gives the vapor enough space to expand and cool, so you still get smooth, flavorful hits without needing a tall rig. It’s built to be compact but effective, not just tiny for the sake of it.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting too dirty?
    Change your water regularly and give it a quick rinse after heavy use. Let it cool, then rinse and set aside. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and dry before your next use. Keeping a dedicated spot for it on your table next to your concentrate jars also helps keep everything organized and clean.
  • Can I travel with this rig?
    You can, just treat it like any other glass piece. A padded case, wrapped towel, or foam insert goes a long way toward avoiding cracks. If you’re always on the move and want something more rugged to complement it, check out flexible gear like silicone pipes for toss-in-the-bag durability.
  • Is this better for beginners or experienced dabbers?
    Both. Beginners will appreciate the small size and simple design, while more experienced dabbers will like having a compact, low-maintenance daily driver or backup rig that doesn’t waste space or budget.

The 4" Round Rasta Stripe Hand Pipe is a compact glass hand pipe built for on-the-go smokers who want something bright, simple, and ready every time. At just 4 inches (102mm), it’s small enough to pocket but still has a comfy, rounded shape that feels solid in your hand. The bold Rasta striping gives you that classic vibe piece without being huge or fragile.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Pocket-ready size — 4 inches (102mm) is perfect for tossing in a pocket, bag, or case without taking over your whole kit.
  • Comfortable rounded feel — the round body sits naturally in your palm, so it’s easy to grip and pass around during a sesh.
  • Rasta stripes that pop — bold Rasta colors make this piece stand out on the coffee table or in a circle.
  • Sturdy glass construction — thick glass gives it a more durable feel than super-thin spoons, so you’re not stressing every time it taps the ashtray.
  • Quick, simple setup — no water, no moving parts, just pack and go when you want a fast sesh.
  • Easy to stash and clean — compact shape is simple to wipe out and fits in most small pipe cases or padded pouches.

Best For

This 4" Round Rasta Stripe Hand Pipe is made for smokers who want a no-fuss daily driver they can grab on the way out the door. It’s ideal if you like quick solo bowls, low-maintenance glass, and a little color in your lineup without going to a full heady piece. If you already run heavier glass or silicone pieces at home, this is a perfect backup or travel piece to complement your main smoke shop setup.

How to Use It

This is classic hand-pipe territory: a bowl on one end, mouthpiece on the other, and a carb on the side. Pack your ground flower into the bowl, control airflow with the carb, and you’re good to go for quick, controlled hits. The rounded body gives you plenty of space to hold without getting too close to the hotter end of the pipe.

For cleanup, let the pipe cool completely, then tap out any ash and wipe away loose residue. When it starts to feel sticky or taste off, a simple soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and full dry before reuse will keep your Rasta colors bright. Setting it on a nonstick dab mat between uses is an easy way to keep your table from getting grimy.

Specifications

Length 4 inches (102mm)
Material Glass
Style Hand pipe (dry)
Design Rasta stripe color pattern

Fit & Everyday Use

At 4 inches (102mm), this pipe hits the sweet spot between truly pocket-sized and still big enough to clear comfortably. The rounded design gives you a decent bowl size for a quick solo sesh or a couple of passes with a friend. It rides well in a small pouch or case so it doesn’t get banged up against keys or lighters when you’re on the move, and pairs nicely with odor-controlled storage and packaging if you’re trying to keep smells down.

Care Tips

Glass will always last longer if you keep it reasonably clean and avoid sudden temperature shocks. Let it cool before cleaning, don’t rinse piping-hot glass in cold water, and give it a deeper soak when buildup starts sticking to the bowl and airway. If you like to keep things tidy, storing your packed bowl or leftover flower in proper glass jars also helps cut down on crumbs and resin transfer in your pockets.

FAQ

  • Is 4 inches actually small enough to carry every day?

    Yes. At 4 inches (102mm), this pipe is compact enough to fit in most hands, pockets, and small cases without feeling bulky. It’s a comfortable everyday piece for people who don’t want to haul around a big spoon or mini bong.

  • How big is the bowl on this pipe?

    The rounded body gives it a medium bowl size that works well for quick personal snaps or a couple of shared hits. It’s not a micro one-hitter, but it’s not a huge party bowl either — right in that "one more and I’m good" zone.

  • Are all the Rasta stripes exactly the same?

    Because these are glass pieces, there can be slight variations in how the Rasta colors swirl and line up from pipe to pipe. You’ll always get that classic Rasta stripe look, but your exact pattern may be a little unique, which is part of the charm.

  • How do I keep the colors looking clean and bright?

    Don’t let resin build up forever. Let the pipe cool, then tap out ash and wipe the bowl area regularly. For a reset, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry completely before using again. Keeping sticky tools and jars on a nonstick surface or non-stick paper can also help keep less residue on your glass overall.

  • Is this better as a home piece or a travel piece?

    Honestly, it works well as both. It’s small and sturdy enough to be a throw-it-in-the-bag travel pipe, but the Rasta design also looks good on the coffee table as a daily driver.   • Can I use this with any extra accessories?

    Most people run this pipe on its own, but you can absolutely keep it in a padded case, use a travel-friendly lighter, or add simple cleaning plugs if you like. If you want to round out a small kit, grab a compact grinder and a few basic accessories so everything lives together.

  • What’s the best way to store it when I’m not using it?

    Let it cool down completely, then stash it in a soft pouch, small case, or a drawer where it’s not rolling around with heavy stuff. Keeping it separate from keys or hard metal tools will help avoid chips, and pairing it with the right mylar bags or jars for your flower keeps your whole setup cleaner and more organized.

Built around a 10mm titanium tip, it’s made for people who want quick, flavorful dabs with precise control, without hauling around a full rig. At just 4 inches (102mm), it’s a pocket-friendly piece that still hits like real hardware, not a toy.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Thing

  • Real performance in a tiny package — The 10mm titanium tip heats fast and holds temp long enough for smooth, controlled dabs.
  • Fun without being goofy to use — Sculpted cow body and pierced udder give you a conversation starter, but it still feels like a legit dab tool in the hand.
  • Great for low-temp flavor — Short vapor path keeps taste clean and lets you stay in that low-temp sweet spot.
  • Fewer “oh no” moments — Plastic clip keeps the tip locked in so you’re not chasing hot metal across the table.
  • Travel-friendly — 4 inch (102mm) length slides into small cases or pockets without being bulky.
  • Easy upgrade later — Standard 10mm size means you can swap to other compatible tips when you’re ready.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who like the simplicity of nectar straws but don’t want plain, boring glass. If you’re bouncing between friends’ houses, going on quick trips, or just don’t feel like setting up a full rig, this cow straw covers your quick dab needs. It’s also a fun addition for anyone who already has a main rig and wants a small, quirky backup that still plays nice with their other dab tools.

How to Use It

The 4" Cow Pierced Udder Nectar Straw works like any classic nectar collector: one side is your mouthpiece, the 10mm titanium tip is your contact point for concentrates. The short body keeps everything close and easy to control, which is especially nice when you’re trying to hit just the edge of a dab instead of wasting the whole glob at once.

Set your concentrates in a small dish or on a heat-safe surface like a dab mat so you’re not leaving sticky spots all over the table. Let the tip come back down from its hottest point before you touch your material if you’re chasing flavor over clouds.

When you’re done, let the titanium cool fully before you set it down or toss it back into a bag or case. A quick wipe of the tip and the inside of the mouthpiece every few uses will keep flavor from getting murky and make deep cleans way easier later.

Overall Length 4 inches (102mm)
Body Material Glass
Tip Material Titanium
Joint / Tip Size 10mm
Style Nectar straw / nectar collector
Design Cow theme with pierced udder detail

This straw is built around a 10mm tip, so stick with 10mm nectar tips if you ever want to swap or replace the titanium one it comes with. The glass body is sized for the included clip and tip, so avoid forcing oversized or off-spec aftermarket parts. For storage, it rides nicely alongside small glass jars or other compact pieces in your regular storage and packaging setup.

Care & Cleaning

Let the titanium tip cool down before you do anything with it. Once it’s safe to touch, you can wipe off surface residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For deeper cleaning, remove the tip and plastic clip, then soak the glass body and titanium tip in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before putting it back together. Keep the plastic clip out of harsh solvents if you want it to last.

FAQ

  • Does the 4" Cow Pierced Udder Nectar Straw work with other tips?

    Yes, as long as they’re 10mm nectar tips. The joint and clip are designed around that size, so most standard 10mm titanium or quartz tips should play nice. If a tip feels loose or too tight, don’t force it — stick with something that fits cleanly.

  • How fragile is the glass body?

    It’s glass, so treat it like any other glass nectar collector or mini rig. It’s sturdy enough for normal use but won’t love drops onto hard floors. If you’re accident-prone, consider pairing it with a padded pouch and resting it on a soft surface like a protective accessory mat between dabs.

  • What kind of concentrates can I use with this?

    It works well with most standard dabbable textures — shatter, crumble, live resin, rosin, diamonds in sauce, all of it. Just keep your material in a shallow dish or flat surface so the tip can reach it easily; heavy-bottom concentrate jars are great for storage and staging.

  • Is this better than a full dab rig?

    It’s different, not “better” or “worse.” A full rig with a banger is nicer if you’re doing long, relaxed seshes at home. A nectar straw shines when you want quick, precise hits with minimal setup, or when you don’t feel like pulling out a whole dab rig or bong. A lot of people keep both and grab whatever fits the moment.

  • How do I keep the flavor clean over time?

    Try not to overcook the tip between hits, and give it a quick wipe after use so burnt residue doesn’t build up. When flavor starts tasting off, that’s your sign to give both the glass and titanium a soak in iso. Keeping your concentrates on clean surfaces like fresh parchment paper also helps keep weird tastes out of your hits.

  • Can I travel with this nectar straw?

    The 4" length makes it easy to stash in a small case or bag, but you should always follow local laws about carrying cannabis gear. Empty it, let the tip cool, and store it in something padded so the glass cow body doesn’t get cracked next to your other smoke shop essentials.

  • Does the pierced udder actually change how it hits?

    The pierced udder is mostly about style and attitude. Function-wise, it still works like a classic straight nectar collector, with a short, direct path from the heated tip to your mouth for quick, punchy hits. You’re getting full function with extra personality, not a gimmick that’s hard to use.

This pipe is made for flower smokers who want something nicer than a gas-station spoon but don’t need a massive heady piece. The Fume Flower Glass Hand Pipe works like a classic spoon: pack the bowl, cover the carb, and you’re off. The bowl size is dialed in for personal hits or a couple of passes around the circle, so you’re not overpacking and wasting herb when you just want a quick sesh.

If you’re cleaning multiple pieces at once, keep everything staged near your smoking accessories so you’re not losing track of small tools and plugs.

FAQ

  • Are all the color patterns the same?

  • Is 5 inches big enough for a smooth hit?

At 6 inches (152mm), it’s small enough to be a couch-side daily driver, but still has enough water volume to noticeably smooth things out. The fumed glass slowly shifts color as it gets used, so the more you sesh with it, the more it becomes your own.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The bubbler chamber gives your smoke a quick wash through water before it hits you, taking the edge off harsh hits.
  • Color that actually evolves — Fumed glass reacts with heat and residue over time, building deeper, richer tones the more you use it.
  • Comfortable, compact size — At 6 inches (152mm), it’s easy to grip, pass, and stash without feeling fragile or bulky.
  • Classic glass flavor — Clean glass keeps your flower’s flavor true, so you’re tasting terps, not metal or plastic.
  • Looks good on the table — Multiple color options and the fume effect make it a piece you actually want to leave out when friends come by.
  • Easy to clean and reset — Simple shape and clear water path make it quick to rinse and refresh between strains.

Best For

This bubbler is made for people who like the function of a small water pipe but don’t want to commit to a full-sized bong. If you’ve been living on dry pipes and want smoother hits without a giant piece on your desk, this sits right in that sweet spot. It’s also a nice upgrade if you already have some basic smoke shop pieces and want something with a little more personality.

How to Use It

Using the 6" Fume Glass Bubbler is straightforward: add a small amount of water to the chamber, just enough to cover the bottom of the downstem, then pack your bowl and you’re set. As you draw, the smoke pulls through the water, cooling and filtering before it reaches your mouthpiece. You’ll hear that light bubble sound when you’ve got the water level in a good spot.

Over time, the inside of the piece will start to pick up color from the fume work as it reacts with heat and build-up, which is what gives you that "broken in" color-changing look. If you like keeping your station tidy, park it on a dab mat or pad so any drips or ash stay off your table.

For cleaning, let the bubbler cool, empty the water, then wipe or rinse out loose residue. When it needs a reset, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse and dry will bring the glass back to clear and shiny.

Specifications

Overall Height 6 inches (152mm)
Material Fumed glass
Style Glass bubbler
Design Color accents with color-changing fume effect

The Basics of Fumed Glass

As you use it and a light layer of resin builds up behind the fume work, the colors deepen and shift, often moving from lighter tones into blues, purples, greens, or warm honey shades depending on the original fume.

At 5.5 inches (140mm), it’s long enough to cool things down but still small enough to toss in a bag. The fumed glass slowly shifts color as you use it, so the more you sesh with it, the more it becomes your own.

This is the kind of piece you keep out on the table because it actually looks good, not something you hide in a drawer. The hammer-style shape gives it a low, stable footprint, so it sits without tipping and feels natural in the hand when you’re passing it around.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Comfortable, stable hits — Hammer shape sits flat on the table and feels balanced in your hand, so you’re not babying a wobbly spoon.
  • Cooler, smoother pulls — The 5.5 inch (140mm) length gives smoke a little more travel time compared to tiny pocket pipes, helping it mellow out before it reaches you.

  • Good for sharing, not just tiny snaps — Bowl is sized for medium packs, solid for a solo sesh or a couple friends without repacking every 30 seconds.
  • Feels like real glass, because it is — Weight and thickness give it that durable, satisfying hand-feel you don’t get from cheap, thin pieces.
  • Easy to stash and travel with — Compact enough for a bag or case without feeling like a toy pipe.

Best For

This piece is made for smokers who like their gear to have personality but still want something they’re not afraid to actually use every day. If your setup is mostly compact bowls and one solid daily driver instead of a giant glass collection, this fits right in. It also pairs nicely with unbreakable travel gear like our silicone pipes when you want options for both home and on-the-go seshes.

The Basics: How to Use It

The 5.5″ Fume Hammer Glass Hand Pipe works just like any classic hammer-style hand pipe: you pack your flower in the bowl, use the side carb to control airflow, and clear it at your own pace. The flattened base lets you set it down between hits without it rolling off the table or dumping your bowl when someone bumps the surface.

Because it’s fumed glass, you’ll notice the color start to deepen and shift after a few bowls. For some people, that “before and after” is half the fun — you can even put it on a clean dab mat and snap photos over time to watch the transformation.

If you’re passing it around, the hammer shape makes it easy to tell which end is which (no awkward “which side do I hit?” moments), and there’s enough length that your fingers stay back from the heat when the bowl’s cooking.

Length 5.5 inches (140mm)
Material Fume glass

Cleaning & Care

Let the pipe cool completely before you try to clean it. Wipe away loose residue as needed, and for a deeper reset, soak the pipe in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry it fully before your next sesh. If you’re rotating a few pieces, you can stash this one safely between uses with your other gear and accessories so it doesn’t get knocked around.

FAQ

  • How big is this compared to a normal spoon pipe?
    It’s a bit longer than most basic spoons at 5.5 inches (140mm), which means it feels more substantial in the hand and gives smoke more room to cool before it hits.
  • Will this fit in a standard pouch or case?
    Yes, most medium-sized pipe pouches or smell-proof bags will fit a 5.5-inch hammer comfortably. If you’re already stocking up on storage and packaging, it’s smart to throw in a padded case for this too.
  • What does “fumed glass” actually do?
    Fumed glass is made by exposing the glass to metals like silver or gold during the blowing process. Over time, as resin builds and you keep using it, the colors deepen and shift, giving you that classic color-changing heady glass look.
  • Is the bowl good for solo use, or is it more of a group piece?
    The bowl is sized in that sweet spot for medium packs: totally fine for solo seshes without feeling like overkill, but also enough for a couple friends to take their turn before you need to clear and repack.
  • How do I keep it from rolling or tipping over?
    The hammer shape is designed with a flat resting area so it naturally sits in a stable position. As long as you set it down on a reasonably flat surface (like a tray or even beside your glass jars on a table), it shouldn’t roll.
  • Does the color change go away if I clean it?
    Some of the “color” you see is from resin buildup and some is from the actual fume work. When you deep clean it, you’ll remove the resin layer and it may look brighter or lighter again, but the underlying fume pattern and base colors are permanent.
  • What kind of smoker is this pipe best suited for?
    This is a great fit if you want one solid, reliable glass hand pipe that looks good and hits comfortably without being fragile or overly huge. It’s for people who appreciate functional glass art, not just throwaway pieces, and who might mix this in with rigs, nectar collectors, or other specialty gear as part of their lineup.

The rasta fume glass catches light in wild ways, so every sesh looks as good as it hits.

What You Get Out of It

  • Smoother, cooler hits — Built-in water chamber diffuses and cools your smoke so it feels more like a mini bong than a dry hand pipe.
  • Easy, comfy grip — Classic hammer shape keeps it stable in your hand and on the table, so you’re not stressing about it rolling off mid-sesh.
  • Head-turning rasta fume glass — Fumed colors shift and glow in different lighting, and each piece ends up with its own unique pattern.
  • Portable size, real function — At 5.5 inches (140mm), it’s big enough for satisfying rips but still fits in a bag or drawer without a fight.
  • Simple to pack and clear — Straightforward bowl and carb setup keeps the learning curve low, even if this is your first bubbler.
  • Great upgrade from a spoon — If you’re tired of dry hits but don’t want to commit to a full water pipe, this is the sweet spot.

Best For

This hammer bubbler is made for flower fans who want that "mini bong" feel but still need something you can toss in a bag and bring to a friend’s place. It’s especially nice for people who usually rock dry spoons and are ready to step up to water filtration without adding a whole shelf of glass to the house. If you’re building out a travel kit with a lighter, a small grinder, and a compact piece, this slots in perfectly alongside your other go-to smoke shop products.

How to Use It (The Basics)

This piece works like any classic hammer bubbler: water in the chamber, herb in the bowl, and you’re off. The hammer shape keeps the mouthpiece elevated and the bowl forward so you get a comfortable angle when you’re passing it around the circle or chilling on the couch.

Start by adding a small amount of water to the chamber, just enough so you hear a light bubble when you pull. You don’t need much; the point is to cool and smooth the smoke, not flood the piece. If you’re packing a few bowls in a row, it helps to set it down on a stable surface like a dab mat to catch any stray drips and keep resin off the table.

For cleaning, let the bubbler cool completely, then pour out the old water. A quick rinse with warm water is usually enough between casual uses. When it really starts to get cloudy or sticky, a soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a thorough rinse with clean water will bring back the shine. Let it dry fully before the next sesh.

  4. How do I keep the glass from getting stained or cloudy?

  7. Is this a good daily driver or more of a backup piece?
    It can easily be either. The durable glass and comfy hammer design make it a solid daily bubbler for solo use or small circles. Fill the chamber conservatively — you just want enough water to cover the end of the built-in downstem when you draw on it, not a full reservoir that splashes into your mouth. Key Benefits

  • Stretch every dab further — Proper airflow control helps you vaporize more of your concentrate instead of leaving a puddle behind.
  • One pack, multiple styles — Different cap designs let you match your banger and your mood without buying caps one by one.
  • Plays nice with most quartz bangers — Built around standard sizes and shapes, so odds are high it’ll work with the setup you already use as your daily driver.
  • Better flavor at comfortable temps — Capping the banger keeps heat where it belongs so terps stick around longer instead of burning off instantly.

  • Great backup kit — Keep extras on hand for friends, travel rigs, or that one clumsy homie who always drops the glass.

Best for

This pack is made for dabbers who run a few seshes a day, rotate between different rigs, and actually care about how their concentrates taste. It’s especially handy if you already have a couple of pieces in your rotation or a mix of glass and silicone rigs and want caps that can keep up with all of them.

How to use it

Think of a carb cap as the “throttle” for your dab. Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, the cap goes on top to trap heat and control airflow. That small amount of air coming through is what keeps the vapor moving and your hit feeling smooth instead of harsh or wasted.

Different caps in this pack will behave slightly differently: some are better at spinning puddles around the dish, others are more about simple, steady restriction. Try each one with the same rig and concentrate so you can really feel how the airflow changes your hit. Set your rig on a solid dab mat so you can swap caps without getting everything sticky.

Cleaning is simple: let the carb cap cool completely, then wipe off residue. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry before you toss it back into your kit.

The basics of carb caps

All the caps in this pack are built around the same idea: cap the banger, restrict the airflow, and keep heat and vapor where you want it. Directional-style caps help push and swirl concentrates across the hot surface, which is perfect if you like running lower temps or thicker sauce. Simpler styles still give you heat retention and smoother pulls but with less spinning action — easy, reliable function when you’re a few dabs deep and just want things to work.

Because this is a variety pack, it’s also perfect for dialing in new setups. When you grab a fresh rig or switch up to a different style of banger, you’re not stuck hoping your old cap still fits. You’ve got options ready to test until you find the one that rips exactly how you like.

    Let them cool down completely, then wipe with a cotton swab or cloth to clear fresh residue. For a deeper clean, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before using again.

    If you only own one rig, one banger, and never change anything, a single cap might be fine. But if you swap glass, share rigs, or like to actually experiment with function, a pack like this is way more useful and usually saves money versus buying several singles.

Use the adjustment control on the torch to dial your flame to the size and intensity that feels right for your setup, whether you’re heating a thick quartz banger or just touching up the edge of a bowl.

Between uses, flip on the safety lock to keep it from firing accidentally, then park it upright on its footed base. If you’re building out a more organized station, pairing this with proper concentrate jars for your extracts keeps everything right where you expect it when you sit down to sesh.

Refilling is straightforward: when the flame gets weak or starts sputtering, top it off with quality butane through the refill port on the bottom (follow the torch’s markings and instructions). Let the torch cool down after use before handling the nozzle or refilling. If you notice the flame getting uneven or weak even with fresh butane, a quick wipe around the nozzle area to clear dust or residue can help. For long-term reliability, avoid dropping the torch or storing it where it’s constantly getting knocked over, and keep it away from direct heat sources when not in use. When you’re cleaning the rest of your sesh gear, it’s also a good time to give your torch a once-over and make sure everything is working smoothly.

FAQ

  • Q: Does this torch come filled with butane?
    A: No, the 7" Scorch Torch Mega Table Torch ships empty. You’ll need to fill it with standard butane before first use. Keeping an extra can of butane in your general storage area is a good idea so you’re not stuck with a dead flame mid-sesh.

    A: Yes. The torch is designed with adjustable flame control so you can run a smaller, more precise flame or open it up for faster heating. Just be sure to adjust in small steps until you find the sweet spot for your banger or bowl.
  • Q: Is this too big to use as a travel torch?
    A: At 7 inches (178mm) tall with a footed base, it’s really meant as a stay-at-home table torch. You can move it around the house easily, but if you want something for on-the-go, a smaller handheld torch or lighter will be more convenient.

If you’re building out a new setup, check out our selection of dab tools so you’ve got everything you need next to the torch.
  • Q: How do I refill it correctly?
    A: Turn the torch off, make sure it’s cool, then flip it upside down and press the nozzle of your butane can into the refill valve until the tank is full (follow the can and torch markings). Let it sit upright for a few minutes before lighting again so the fuel can stabilize.

    A: First, confirm there’s enough butane in the tank. If it’s low, refill and let it rest upright for a few minutes. If there’s fuel and it still won’t light, try lowering and then slowly raising the flame adjustment, and gently clean around the nozzle area to remove dust.
  • Q: Is this safe to leave out on the coffee table?
    A: It’s designed to be a table torch with a stable base and safety lock, but it’s still a flame tool. Lock it when not in use, keep it out of reach of kids and pets, and never leave it near open flames, stoves, or anything else that gets hot. When you’re done with a sesh, it’s smart to park it in the same safe spot you keep other hot tools or smoke shop accessories.

The 5″ Clear Showerhead Ash Catcher is a glass add-on built for people who are tired of scrubbing their bong after every few bowls. It’s perfect if you love smooth, clean hits but hate resin and ash caking your favorite piece. At 5 inches (127mm) tall with a showerhead perc, it catches the mess and pre-filters your smoke so your main rig stays looking fresh way longer.

Why It Works

  • Keep your bong cleaner, longer — Smoke hits the showerhead perc first, so ash and gunk stack up in the catcher instead of your main piece.
  • Smoother, cooler pulls — The showerhead perc breaks smoke into smaller bubbles, giving it more contact with water for less harshness.
  • See when it’s time to clean — Clear glass body lets you literally watch buildup so you can rinse it before things get gnarly.
  • Protect your investment — Acting as a buffer, it helps keep your favorite tube or rig from staining and smelling like old resin.
  • Daily driver ready — Built from solid glass that can handle regular seshes without feeling fragile in the hand.

Best For

This ash catcher is made for people running a daily driver bong who want cleaner function without rebuilding their whole setup. If you’re sharing bowls with friends, ripping multiple times a day, or you just cleaned your piece and want it to actually stay clean, this is an easy upgrade. It’s also a solid match for anyone slowly dialing in a full glass kit with smart accessories rather than buying a new bong every time.

How to Use It

Slide the ash catcher into the female joint on your bong, fill it with just enough water to cover the showerhead slits, and you’re good to go. Your bowl then sits in the ash catcher’s joint, so every hit has to pass through this mini filtration chamber before it ever touches your main piece.

Function-wise, think of it as a pre-filter: ash drops into the catcher, smoke gets diffused by the showerhead, and your bong only sees already-filtered smoke and cleaner water. Set your setup on a nonstick dab pad or mat if you’re the type who tends to splash when you clear a big hit.

When you notice the water in the catcher starting to darken or the walls getting hazy, just pop it off, empty it, and give it a quick clean. Way easier than pulling a full bong deep clean every time ash starts floating around.

Specifications

Height 5 inches (127mm)
Material Glass
Perc Type Showerhead perc

Fit & Compatibility

This ash catcher is designed to play nice with most standard glass set-ups that use 14mm or 18mm female joints. As long as your bong has the right size female joint and a sturdy base, you’re in good shape. If you’re building out a full station, pairing it with quality dab tools and dabbers or bowls that match your joint size will keep everything feeling dialed in and secure.

Cleaning & Care

Let the glass cool before handling, then empty the water and tap out loose ash. For light buildup, a quick rinse with warm water is usually enough. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry before reusing. A clean catcher means better flavor and way less smell hanging around your setup or storage area.

Why Add an Ash Catcher at All?

Once you run a few bowls with an ash catcher, it’s hard to go back. Your bong water stays clearer, the inside of your tube doesn’t coat as fast, and your hits taste less like they’re dragging through old buildup. It’s one of those small upgrades that makes a big difference when you’re a few seshes deep and just want things to work without stopping to clean.

Instead of constantly scrubbing your piece or letting it slowly turn brown, you can just swap and rinse this smaller attachment. And if you like your glass looking presentable on a shelf or in a case, this does a lot of heavy lifting to keep your main piece from getting cooked with stains. If you’re rotating multiple rigs or water pipes, this kind of accessory pairs nicely with having a few dedicated smoke shop essentials ready to go.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    If your bong has a 14mm or 18mm female joint, you’re set — that’s what this ash catcher is built for. Just match the joint size and make sure your bong has a stable base so the extra piece doesn’t make it feel tippy.
  • Does it change how my bong hits?
    You’ll notice smoother, slightly cooler pulls thanks to the showerhead perc doing extra diffusion. There may be a tiny bit more chug or drag compared to running your bong bare, but most people find the cleaner, smoother draw well worth it.
  • How much water should I put in it?
    Add just enough water to cover the showerhead slits, then adjust to taste. Too much water and it may bubble up toward your bowl; too little and you lose the benefit of the perc. If you’re running a full dab setup too, keep everything parked on a non-stick work surface so stray drips don’t wreck your table.
  • How do I clean the inside properly?
    Let it cool, pour out the old water, then soak in isopropyl alcohol to loosen resin and ash. Rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry before using again. Regular quick cleans keep the glass from getting permanently cloudy.
  • Will this help with flavor?
    Yes — by catching ash, old plant material, and some of the heavier junk before it reaches your bong, it helps keep your main chamber water and walls cleaner. Cleaner glass and fresher water mean your flower’s flavor isn’t fighting through layers of old residue. For full flavor control, storing your flower properly in good glass jars and packaging helps too.
  • Is this only for big bongs, or will it work on smaller pieces?
    It works on both, as long as the joint size matches and the piece is balanced. On smaller bongs, just make sure the combined weight of the ash catcher and bowl doesn’t pull the piece forward when it’s empty.
  • Can I use it with different bowls or accessories?
    As long as your bowl has the correct joint size, it’ll sit right in the ash catcher’s joint. A lot of people like to keep a dedicated bowl and catcher for their main tube, and then swap bowls between pieces they store in travel or stash bags when they’re on the go.

Silver fume isn’t just a paint job—it’s a technique where the glassblower fumes silver onto clear or lightly colored glass, which creates depth and shifting tones as the pipe gets used. Early on, the piece may look lighter and more transparent; as the interior starts to build up a little resin, you’ll see blues, purples, and honey tones deepen. It’s like watching your pipe slowly level up with every bowl.

If you’re the type who enjoys seeing your gear evolve, this is way more fun than a plain clear spoon. A thorough cleaning can brighten it back up, but it will always keep some of that earned character. For people who love watching their setups evolve, this is a big part of the charm.

Care & Cleaning

Day-to-day, just let the stainless tip cool down after use, then wipe off any residue. FAQ

  • Is 5.5 inches long enough to keep my fingers away from the heat?

  • Will the resin handle get soft or weird from heat?

  • Can I use this with all types of concentrates?

  • How do I keep it from getting sticky over time?

    Let it cool after each dab, then give the tip a quick wipe so residue doesn’t build up. When it gets really coated, use a short soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry. Storing your concentrates in clean, wide-mouth concentrate jars also helps keep your tool cleaner when you’re scooping.

  • Is this better than a glass or ceramic dab tool?

    It depends what you like. Stainless steel is tougher, less likely to chip, and handles drops and knocks way better than glass or ceramic.   • Does the color of the resin handle affect performance?

The 2.5″ 14mm 45° Encore Color Accent Pull Out Ash Catcher is a compact glass add-on built for people who want their bong to stay cleaner, function better, and look a little louder. Made for 14mm setups with a 45° joint, it grabs ash and crud before it ever hits your main chamber. The pull-out style bowl and colored accents keep things simple and stylish at the same time.

Why It Works

  • Keep your bong cleaner longer — The ash catcher takes the abuse first, trapping ash and debris before it can stain your main piece.
  • Less scrubbing, more seshing — Pull-out design makes it easy to dump, rinse, and get back to it instead of doing a full deep clean every other day.
  • Better function for 45° bongs — 14mm male joint at a 45° angle is made for standard angled water pipes, so it sits right where it should.
  • Color accent, not color overload — A pop of color on the downstem and joint gives your setup personality without clashing with your favorite piece.
  • Compact 2.5″ profile — Short height keeps your rig from feeling top-heavy or awkward, especially on smaller or mid-size bongs.
  • All-glass build — Clean taste and easy visibility so you can see when it’s time to empty and rinse.

Best For

This Encore ash catcher is made for people who actually use their bong as a daily driver and are tired of watching the base get swampy after a few bowls. If you’re running a smaller 14mm piece and want a simple way to cut down on tar lines and chunky water, this slots right in. It pairs especially well with durable setups like our silicone bongs and rigs when you want easy cleaning from top to bottom.

How to Use It

Using this ash catcher is as straightforward as it looks: plug the 14mm male joint into a 14mm female, 45° joint on your bong, and you’re set. The pull-out section acts like your bowl, so you pack and clear from the ash catcher instead of your main piece.

When you’re done with a bowl, just remove the pull-out, tap out the ash, and give it a quick rinse when it starts to look cloudy. Setting it down on a dab mat or nonstick pad between hits keeps resin rings off your table and makes cleanup around your station easier.

Because the ash catcher is handling the dirtiest part of the sesh, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol every so often will keep it looking sharp and pulling smoothly. Always let it cool before cleaning so you’re not shocking hot glass.

Joint Size 14mm Male
Joint Angle 45°

This piece is built for 14mm female joints at a 45° angle, which is the standard on a lot of beaker and straight-tube bongs. For people dialing in a full station with matching gear, browsing our broader smoke shop products line is a good way to keep everything on-spec and looking cohesive.

    This ash catcher fits bongs with a 14mm female joint at a 45° angle. If your bong joint is 90° or a different size (like 10mm or 18mm), it won’t line up properly.

    Yes, you’ll use the pull-out section on the ash catcher as your bowl instead of the one that came with your bong. That way, all the ash and burnout stays in the catcher instead of getting pulled into the main chamber.
  • How do I clean it without making a mess?
    Let the glass cool, tap or dump the ash out, then wipe off residue. For deeper cleans, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry before throwing it back on your piece. Storing freshly cleaned glass with your other gear in a dedicated storage and packaging setup helps keep everything organized and safe.

    The color is part of the glass accents on the downstem and joint area, not cheap surface paint. Still, treat it like any glass piece: avoid drops, sudden temperature swings, or banging it against your sink or other glass.
  • Will this make my bong harder to pull through?
    Any extra piece adds a little more airflow resistance, but this ash catcher is small and simple, so it won’t choke your hit. If anything, it helps keep the drag consistent by stopping chunks of ash from getting into the main water and clogging things up.
  • Can I use this with other accessories?
    As long as they’re 14mm and meant for a 45° setup, you can get creative with your stack. Just remember that every extra piece adds height and weight, so don’t go too crazy if your bong has a small base. For concentrates or mixed setups, a sturdy rig from our nectar collectors and straws lineup can round out your station without overloading one piece.

The 4.5″ Full Color Hammer Glass Bubbler is a compact, water-filtered hand pipe for smokers who want smoother hits without lugging around a full-size bong. It’s built for people who like a comfy handheld piece with just enough water action to cool things down. At 4.5 inches (114mm), it’s small enough to toss in a bag but still has a stable hammer base that won’t roll off the table between pulls.

The full-color glass makes every piece feel like part of your collection, not just a throwaway travel pipe. It’s the kind of bubbler you keep near the couch because it hits right and looks good doing it.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother hits than a dry spoon — The water chamber takes the edge off your smoke so you’re not getting cooked on every pull.
  • Comfortable hammer shape — That hammer-style layout puts the bowl and mouthpiece at an easy angle, so it feels natural in the hand.
  • Won’t tip over easily — The flat hammer base lets it sit upright, so you’re not stressing about spills or broken bowls mid-sesh.
  • Full-color glass that pops — The entire piece is colored, so it still looks good even when it’s not crystal clean.
  • True travel size — 4.5 inches (114mm) is small enough for a pocket or pouch but big enough for a comfortable grip.
  • No extra parts to lose — It’s one solid glass piece, so you’re not chasing down downstems or slides when you just want a quick rip.

Best For

This hammer bubbler is made for people who like the smoother feel of water filtration but don’t want to commit to a big, fragile table piece. It’s a great daily driver for couch seshes, a backup piece when your big glass is dirty, or a go-to travel bubbler to toss in your bag (just empty the water first). If you’re already running a bigger rig or bong at home, this makes a nice “grab-and-go” option alongside your other smoke shop essentials.

The Basics: How to Use Your Hammer Bubbler

Start by adding a little water into the bubbler’s chamber from the mouthpiece or carb side, just enough to cover the end of the downstem inside. You want it to bubble without splashing back toward your mouth.

Pack the built-in bowl with your favorite dry herb, holding it by the handle like a regular hand pipe. Cover the carb (if present), draw through the mouthpiece, and let the water do its job as your smoke passes through. Think of it as a mini water pipe that still feels as simple as a spoon.

When you’re done, dump the used water out so it doesn’t sit and get funky between uses. Setting it on a dab mat or nonstick pad will help keep ash and drips off your table.

For deeper cleans, let the piece cool, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, followed by a freshwater rinse and full dry before you load it again.

Specifications

Type Hammer glass bubbler
Length 4.5 inches (114mm)
Material Glass
Design Hammer-style, free-standing
Color Full-color glass (multiple options available)

Fit & Use Notes

This is a stand-alone hand bubbler with an integrated bowl, so you’re not swapping in other bowls or joints — just load and go. It plays best with ground dry herb and standard lighters or torches; no special adapters or add-ons needed. If you like to keep your gear organized, stashing it next to your favorite smoking accessories makes it easy to grab for quick solo seshes or passing around.

  • How much water should I put in this bubbler?
    Add just enough water to cover the bottom of the internal downstem so it bubbles when you pull, but not so much that it splashes up. You can fine-tune it over a couple of test pulls to find your sweet spot.
  • Is this better than a regular hand pipe?
    If you like smoother, slightly cooler hits, yes. The water in this hammer bubbler helps filter and cool your smoke more than a dry spoon, but it’s still way more compact than a full water pipe.
  • How do I clean the inside when it gets dirty?
    Empty the water, let the glass cool if it’s warm, then soak or rinse with isopropyl alcohol, shake gently, and finish with a clean water rinse. Make sure it’s fully dry inside before you pack it again so you’re not smoking with stale water or residue.
  • Will this fit in my usual carrying case?
    At 4.5 inches (114mm), it fits in most small padded pouches or smell-proof cases. If you’re already carrying stuff like storage and packaging for your herb, this won’t take up much extra room.
  • Can I use this with concentrates?
    This piece is designed for dry herb. You’ll want a proper dab rig or nectar collector if concentrates are your main thing, but this is perfect for flower-only seshes.
  • Does it stand up on its own, or will it roll?
    The hammer shape includes a flat base, so when you set it down carefully, it should sit upright without rolling around. That makes it easier to load, pass, and park on the coffee table without drama.
  • Is this a good first water piece?
    Yes — if you’re moving up from a basic spoon and want to try water filtration without committing to a big, fragile bong, this is a solid starting point. You can always level up later to larger bongs or rigs, but this covers the basics in a small, affordable package.

At just 2 inches (51mm), it’s compact, easy to handle, and shaped to sit comfortably on most standard quartz bangers.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Cap

  • Better vapor from the same amount of concentrate — The spiral binky shape focuses airflow so your puddle actually vaporizes instead of just burning off.
  • Less waste, more flavor — By helping retain heat in the banger, this cap lets your dab keep cooking smoothly, so you’re not leaving a bunch of oil stuck to the walls.
  • Comfortable, easy grip — The pacifier-style “binky” pull gives you something solid to hold and twist, even when your fingers are a little slick.
  • Add some color to the table — The vibrant spiral design stands out in a lineup of plain clear glass and makes it easy to spot mid-sesh.
  • Plays nice with most rigs — Sized and shaped to work with most standard quartz bangers, so you don’t have to rebuild your whole setup around one accessory.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Durable glass construction holds up to regular heating and cooling when treated with basic care.

Best For

This cap is made for dabbers who actually care about how their rig functions, not just how it looks. If you’re running a small to medium-sized rig or recycler as your daily driver and want tighter airflow and better flavor without messing with complicated spinner setups, this fits the bill. It’s also a fun upgrade if you already have a basic cap and want something with more character to match your favorite silicone bongs & rigs.

How to Use It

Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, just set the Spiral Binky Carb Cap over the top to restrict and direct airflow. From there, you can gently twist or tilt the cap to move the puddle around and help it vaporize evenly, instead of pooling in one spot.

Because of the compact 2″ (51mm) size, it’s easy to maneuver with one hand while you stabilize your rig with the other. Setting your rig down on a solid dab mat helps keep your station clean while you cap and spin.

When the sesh is over, let the cap fully cool before touching any residue. A quick wipe after use helps keep the colors looking crisp and the airflow nice and open.

Specifications

Product Type Carb cap
Material Glass
Length 2 inches (51mm)
Design Spiral binky (pacifier-style pull)
Colors Multiple color options available

Fit & Compatibility

The 2″ Spiral Binky Carb Cap is designed for most standard quartz bangers with a typical bucket opening. If you’re running a very oversized bucket, a super tiny micro banger, or a specialty shape (like some terp slurpers and blender-style nails), this style may not seal as tightly as a purpose-built cap.

For classic flat-top buckets and standard daily-driver rigs, it’s a plug-and-play upgrade with no learning curve. Pair it with clean, well-made bangers and stash your concentrates in solid concentrate jars so you’re actually giving this cap something tasty to work with.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool completely before cleaning or handling any sticky spots. Wipe off light residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry fully before you put it back into rotation.

If you’re the type who likes everything spotless, keeping your tools on clean surfaces and storing your rigs and caps with other dedicated smoke accessories helps cut down how often you need to do full deep cleans.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my banger?
    It’s made to work with most standard quartz bangers, especially flat-top buckets in a typical size range. If you’ve got a very large or unusually shaped nail, check that the opening isn’t dramatically bigger than the cap — if it’s a normal everyday banger, you’re probably good.
  • Does the spiral actually change airflow or is it just for looks?
    Both. The spiral and binky shape help focus the incoming air instead of just dumping a big open rush into the bucket. That focused airflow helps move your puddle around so more of it vaporizes evenly instead of clinging to one side.
  • Is this directional or spinner-style?
    This isn’t a "spinner marble" or terp pearl-specific design, but you can still steer and direct airflow by tilting and rotating the cap as you draw. If you’re big into pearl tornadoes, you might pair this cap with a banger designed for pearl movement or explore other options in our carb caps lineup.
  • How do I clean off burnt or dark residue?
    Let the glass cool first, then soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol until the buildup loosens. Rinse with warm water and dry completely. Regular quick wipe-downs after a dab help prevent that heavy crust from forming in the first place.
  • Is it easy to handle when things get hot?
    Yes — the binky-style pull gives you a larger, thicker area to hold onto, so you’re not pinching a tiny, hot glass nub. Just remember to avoid touching the part that sits directly over the banger until it’s cooled down.
  • Will the colors fade or burn out?
    Under normal dab temps and basic care, the color spiral stays bright. Try not to leave the cap sitting directly in the hottest part of the torch flame or on a glowing-hot banger, and store it safely with your other smoke shop gear when you’re not using it.
  • Is this a good first carb cap?
    Absolutely. It’s simple, durable, and easy to control, so there’s no weird learning curve. If you’re moving up from open dabs or a cheap generic cap, this is a nice quality-of-life upgrade without getting into overcomplicated designs. And when you’re ready to fine-tune your setup even more, it pairs nicely with better bangers and quality parchment papers for handling your concentrates.

Best for

This carb cap is made for dabbers who actually use their rig every day, not just when friends come over. If you’re already picky about your temps and you hate wasting good concentrate, this is a solid upgrade over basic, non-directional caps. It also pulls its weight in the looks department, so it fits right in with colorful heady rigs or rugged silicone bongs and rigs you drag everywhere.

How to use it

From there, a gentle spin or tilt of the ball will direct air through the oil, helping it move, vaporize more evenly, and stay flavorful instead of getting cooked in place.

You’ll feel the difference in how the rig pulls — more resistance when it’s sealed, more air when you crack or tilt the cap. What You Get Out of It

  • Better flavor from the same amount of concentrate — Dual-sided design lets you fine-tune airflow so more of your dab gets vaporized instead of pooling and wasting.
  • Two airflow moods in one cap — One side more open, one more restrictive, so you can switch it up depending on the dab, the temp, or just your mood.
  • Easy to handle, even when you’re cooked — The 1.5 inch (38mm) footprint gives you enough glass to grip without feeling clumsy over the banger.
  • Cleans up quick — Smooth glass surface wipes down easily so you’re not staring at baked-on reclaim every time you sesh.
  • Adds color to your setup — Full-color glass looks good on the rig and makes it easy to spot on a crowded coffee table.

Best For

This cap is made for dabbers who already have a favorite rig and just want tighter control over airflow without investing in a whole new piece. If your setup lives on a dedicated dab mat and you’re picky about getting full flavor from small-to-medium dabs, this is right in your lane.

It’s also a solid pick if you like to keep your gear simple: no spinning marbles or moving parts, just a reliable, dual-sided glass carb cap that does what it’s supposed to every time.

How to Use It

Once your banger is ready and you’ve dropped in your dab, set one side of the carb cap over the top of the nail to cover it fully. Tilt and rotate the cap as you pull — that directional movement helps push vapor around and keeps your concentrates from pooling in one cold corner of the bucket.

When you want a different feel, just flip the carb cap to the other side and cap the banger again. You’ll notice a change in resistance and vapor density, so you can choose which side works best for that particular dab. Pair it with one of our metal or glass dab tools so you’re not trying to juggle sticky concentrates with improvised tools.

After you’re done, let the carb cap cool on your rig tray or accessory station, then wipe off any fresh residue before it hardens. A quick habit like that keeps your cap looking new and hitting clean.

Diameter 1.5 inches (38mm)

Fit & Compatibility

This 1.5" Full Color Double Sided Carb Cap is sized to play nice with most standard flat-top quartz bangers and small-to-medium buckets. As long as your banger opening is around 1.5 inches (38mm) or smaller, you’ll be able to get a solid seal by centering the cap and tilting slightly as you pull.

Because it’s glass and relatively compact, it pairs especially well with smaller dab rigs and compact setups, including many silicone bongs and rigs that use quartz inserts or bangers. Just check your banger diameter if you’re running anything oversized or specialty.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool down before you clean it — hot glass and liquids don’t mix well. Once it’s at room temp, wipe off any fresh residue with a dry or slightly damp cloth. For deeper cleaning, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse it with warm water, and dry fully before your next sesh.

If you like to keep everything spotless, store your clean cap next to your concentrate jars so it’s always ready to go when you bust out your favorite extracts.

FAQ

  • Will this carb cap fit my banger?
    If your banger opening is around 1.5 inches (38mm) across or smaller, you’re good. Just set the cap over the top and tilt slightly to get a seal. Oversized or specialty buckets may need a larger cap, but this covers most standard flat-top styles people use as daily drivers.
  • What’s the point of it being double sided?
    Each side gives you a different airflow feel. One side is more open for easier pulls, the other is a bit more restrictive for denser vapor. You can flip between them depending on how thick you want your clouds or how you like your rig to function.
  • Is it okay to use this with an e-banger or electronic setup?
    Yes, as long as the opening size matches and your coil or heater doesn’t interfere with the cap sitting on top. Just treat it like any other glass carb cap and be sure it doesn’t touch any exposed heating elements, especially on more complex smoke shop products or custom builds.
  • How do I keep it from getting covered in reclaim?
    Let the cap cool slightly after each dab, then wipe the edges and underside with a cloth or cotton swab to catch the fresh residue. For buildup that’s already hardened, a quick iso soak works great — just rinse and dry before you put it back in rotation.
  • Is the color on the glass going to fade or burn?
    The color is in the glass itself, not a painted-on layer, so under normal dab temps it shouldn’t fade or peel. Just avoid dropping it, slamming it on hard surfaces, or shocking it with sudden temperature changes.
  • Can I use this with a nectar collector or dab straw?
    No, this style of carb cap is meant for bucket-style bangers on rigs, not for nectar collectors and dab straws. For those, you just need a good tip and a safe dish or surface for your concentrates.
  • Is this a good option for a first carb cap?
    Absolutely. It’s simple, affordable, and gives you two airflow options in one piece of glass. If you’re just getting into dabs and want something that will work with most standard bangers while you dial in your setup, this is a strong starter that will still hold up once you upgrade the rest of your gear.

The reclaim area will catch any extra oil that runs back instead of letting it drip out the front or back into your dish.

When you’re done, let the tip fully cool before handling or packing it away. The reclaim chamber will slowly build up with use, which you can clean out when it gets gunked up, or save depending on how you like to run your setup.

Fit, Flow & Real-World Use

Because it’s short and stiff, this straw is easy to control over your dish without feeling like you’re waving a wand around. The quartz tip gives you a tighter, more focused contact point, which is great when you’re working with smaller amounts and want to be precise.

It also plays nice with most standard dab tool setups, so you can use the silicone puck alongside your favorite dab tools and dabbers instead of digging straight out of jars. The reclaim function makes it especially solid as a daily driver for people who hate seeing oil go to waste on the table or in random cotton swabs.

Care & Cleaning

Keep it simple: let the straw and tip cool all the way down, then wipe off any visible residue from the quartz tip and mouthpiece. For a deeper reset, disassemble the tip from the body, soak the glass and quartz parts in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and allow everything to dry fully before putting it back together.

If you’re saving reclaim, you can carefully warm the body just enough to loosen it and collect it with a tool, then store it in one of your preferred concentrate jars for later.

FAQ

How big is this compared to a normal nectar collector?

At 3.5 inches (89mm), this straw is shorter than most full-sized nectar collectors, which usually run closer to a small rig in length. It’s more of a pocket piece than a tabletop setup, but still has a full reclaim section and quartz tip, so you’re not sacrificing function — just saving space in your kit.

Can I use this with the same concentrates I’d put in a rig?

Yes. Anything you’d normally dab out of a banger will work with this straw — just stage it in the silicone puck or a small dish, then tap the heated quartz tip to the concentrate. If you’re handling stickier or more delicate textures, consider pairing it with proper parchment paper or liners to keep your surfaces clean and your product easy to scoop.

Does the reclaim chamber really make a difference?

It does. Without a reclaim area, anything that runs back from the hot tip either winds up in your mouthpiece or all over your table. Here, the extra oil settles in the chamber instead. You can clean it out regularly for a fresh feel, or carefully collect reclaim if that’s part of your routine.

How should I store this when I’m not using it?

Let the piece cool down completely, wipe it off, and keep it in a padded case, pouch, or drawer where it won’t get knocked around. Many people store it with their other storage and packaging gear so all their concentrate tools live in one place instead of getting lost.

What torch works with this straw?

Any standard dab torch or refillable butane torch that you’re comfortable with will work to heat the quartz tip. Just make sure you’re heating evenly and allowing it to cool slightly before touching concentrate so you’re not burning product or shocking the glass.

How often do I need to clean it?

It depends how hard you run it. If you’re dabbing all day, you’ll probably want to give the tip and mouthpiece a quick wipe every day or two, and do a full soak clean when the reclaim chamber starts looking cloudy or sticky. Light dabbers can stretch that out longer, but regular cleaning keeps the airflow smooth and the flavor fresh.

Is this better than a full nectar collector kit with a water chamber?

They’re just different tools. A full water-filtered nectar collector can offer cooler, smoother hits, but it’s bulkier and has more parts to clean and pack. This 3.5″ Color Reclaim Nectar Straw is all about quick, compact function with less to carry and fewer pieces to knock over, which makes it ideal as a travel piece or backup alongside your bigger rigs and other smoke shop essentials.

The Gavel Set is a quartz dab kit built for terp-chasers who want consistent, flavorful pulls without juggling a bunch of random parts. You get a thick-bottom quartz banger, spinner carb cap, and two terp pearls working together so your concentrates melt evenly and keep moving. Sized for 14mm female joints, it’s a simple way to upgrade a basic rig into a legit daily driver setup.

If you’re tired of guessing airflow or watching puddles burn in the corner of your bucket, this set gives you controlled spin, better heat retention, and way more mileage out of each dab.

Why It Works

  • More flavor from every dab — The thick-bottom quartz banger holds heat longer, giving your concentrates a chance to melt and vaporize evenly instead of scorching.
  • Dialed-in airflow — The spinner carb cap creates directional airflow, pushing vapor around the bucket instead of straight up and out.
  • Terp pearls that actually move — Two clear terp pearls spin inside the banger to keep the puddle moving, boosting vapor production and efficiency.
  • Easy upgrade for most rigs — 14mm joint size plays nice with the most common dab rigs, so you don’t have to rebuild your whole setup.
  • Consistent hits, less guesswork — Matching banger, cap, and pearls are designed to work together, so you’re not mixing random pieces and hoping for the best.

Best For

This Gavel Set is made for dabbers who are past the “any banger will do” phase and actually care about flavor and function. If you’re running a few dabs a day and like to experiment with different consistencies of concentrate, this combo keeps things predictable without feeling overly technical. It’s also a great move if you’ve got a solid rig already and just want to bring it up to par with modern quartz setups instead of buying a whole new piece from the silicone bongs & rigs section.

How to Use It

Drop the terp pearls into the banger before you heat it so they’re ready to spin once things warm up. After heating and letting it cool to your preferred range, load your concentrate into the bucket and cap it with the spinner carb cap. The cap’s airflow pulls air in at an angle, which gets those pearls moving and keeps your puddle from just sitting in one hot spot.

You’ll know it’s working when you see the pearls start to orbit around the bottom of the banger and your vapor looks dense but still smooth. Setting your rig on a dedicated dab mat helps keep everything stable and your table from getting sticky when you’re in the middle of a heavy sesh.

When you’re done, let the banger cool down before you even think about cleaning or moving anything. Once it’s back to a safe temp, you can pop the pearls and cap off for a quick wipe-down and you’re ready for next time.

Specifications

Component Details
Banger Thick bottom quartz
Carb Cap Clear spinner carb cap
Terp Pearls 2 clear terp pearls
Joint Size 14mm (for 14mm female joints)
Material Quartz (banger & pearls)

Fit & Compatibility

The Gavel Set is built around a 14mm joint, which is the most common size on compact dab rigs and many hybrid water pipes. As long as your rig has a 14mm female joint and is set up for a 90° or standard banger-style attachment, this will slide right in and be ready to go. If you’re building out a full station, it pairs nicely with dedicated dab tools so you’re not trying to scoop with whatever’s lying around.

The Basics of Quartz & Pearls

Quartz is the go-to material for modern dab setups because it handles high heat, cools predictably, and doesn’t add any weird taste to your concentrates. A thick-bottom bucket like this one gives you a bigger heat reserve, which means you get a more stable surface instead of wild temperature swings. That’s what helps you chase flavor instead of burnt leftovers.

Terp pearls aren’t just for show. As they spin, they push concentrate through hot and cooler spots, constantly redistributing the puddle. That movement keeps things vaporizing steadily instead of pooling in one place and scorching. Add in a spinner cap that’s actually designed to move air in a spiral, and you’ve got a setup that makes your concentrates work harder for you.

If you’re the type who likes to keep strains separated and organized, pairing this setup with a few dedicated concentrate jars makes it easy to grab the exact flavor you’re in the mood for without cross-contamination.

Care & Cleaning

Let everything cool down fully before you touch or clean it—hot quartz and cold liquid do not mix. For light cleaning, a quick wipe with a cotton swab while the banger is still slightly warm (not hot) helps keep residue from building up. For deeper cleans, soak the cooled banger, carb cap, and terp pearls in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and dry before reuse.

Storing your clean set with the rest of your glass and storage accessories keeps it from getting dusty or chipped between sessions.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my 14mm bong or rig?
    Yes, the banger is made for 14mm female joints. If your piece has a 14mm female joint and is set up to accept a banger, this set should drop right in with no adapters needed.
  • Can I use this without the terp pearls?
    Definitely. The thick-bottom quartz banger and spinner carb cap will still work fine on their own. The pearls just add movement and help squeeze more vapor and flavor out of each dab.
  • How do I clean the banger, cap, and pearls?
    Let everything cool first, then remove the pearls and cap. For light maintenance, wipe out leftover residue. For a deeper clean, soak the cooled pieces in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and dry before your next sesh.
  • Is this set good for low-temp dabs?
    Yes, that’s where the thick bottom really shines. It holds heat and cools more gradually, which helps you find that sweet spot where flavor pops without burning. Using a spinner cap and pearls also helps keep low-temp puddles moving and vaporizing more completely.
  • What’s the difference between this and a basic quartz banger?
    A basic banger usually doesn’t include a matched spinner cap or terp pearls, and many have thinner bottoms that lose heat quickly. This Gavel Set gives you a thicker base plus airflow and pearls tuned to work together, so you get more consistent performance instead of piecing a kit together yourself or relying on more barebones gear from the general smoke shop products aisle.
  • Can I use different pearls or carb caps with this?
    Yes, as long as they’re sized reasonably for the bucket and meant for quartz bangers. You can swap in other pearls or caps to experiment with airflow and spin, but the included pieces are a solid everyday setup.
  • Is this a good option for my first real dab setup?
    If you already have a compatible rig, this is a great way to step up from the freebie banger that came in the box. You get better heat retention, a proper spinner cap, and pearls in one shot, instead of guessing your way through random clearance parts from the clearance section.
