It’s made for people running proper seshes with pearls and pillars, not just dropping globs in a basic bucket. With 10mm and 14mm male options and both 45° and 90° angles, it’s ready to drop into most rigs and turn them into a true slurper setup.

Why It Works

  • Better flavor from your concentrates — The terp slurp design pulls oil up from the bottom dish, spreading it thin so your terps actually get a chance to shine.
  • Fewer wasted puddles — The included terp pillar and marbles keep concentrates moving instead of pooling in one hot spot and burning out.
  • Eye candy on every pull — Color dichro marbles spin and shimmer while you hit it, so the function looks just as good as it feels.
  • Dial it in to your rig — Available in 10mm and 14mm male joints with 45° or 90° options, so you can match the angle and size your piece was built for.
  • Quartz where it counts — Full quartz build means solid heat retention and quick response, so you’re not fighting with temperature swings mid-sesh.
  • All-in-one slurper kit — You get the banger, terp pillar, and both marbles in one shot, so you don’t have to piece together a setup from random parts.

The Basics

This is a full terp slurper-style quartz banger, which means instead of dropping concentrates into a simple bucket, you’re feeding them into the bottom dish and letting airflow pull them up through the channels. The terp pillar and marbles help spread your oil thin so it vaporizes evenly instead of burning in one spot.

The color dichro marbles aren’t just for looks. The top marble acts like a cap to help control airflow, while the smaller marble and pillar inside keep the concentrate moving and interacting with hot quartz. On a good pull, you’ll see the pillar spinning and the marbles dancing, which is your sign that the banger is doing its job.

It’s a great upgrade if you’re moving from a basic bucket-style quartz and want something more efficient without going deep into custom lab glass. Just match the joint size and angle to your favorite rig and this becomes an easy daily driver.

Best For

Made for dabbers who already care about temp, airflow, and flavor, and want to step their game up from a standard flat-top. If you’re the type to keep a clean station on a proper dab mat and actually finish your puddles, this setup fits right into that routine.

It’s also a solid pick for people with smaller rigs that need a more efficient banger. With both 45° and 90° options, you can pick the angle that matches how your piece sits so you’re not fighting gravity or spilling oil.

How to Use It

Drop the terp pillar into the body of the slurper before you heat anything up. That way it’s already in place and warms up with the rest of the quartz instead of shocking hot glass later. Once everything is at your preferred temp, concentrates go into the bottom dish and airflow pulls them up past the pillar and marbles.

The marbles do a lot of the heavy lifting. The smaller marble and pillar inside help keep your oil moving and spread out, while the larger top marble helps seal the top and control airflow so vapor stays where it’s supposed to. You’ll know things are running right when the pillar and inner marble are spinning smoothly instead of just sitting there.

If you like to bounce between this and other setups—like rigs, straws, or nectar collectors—this slurper is an easy “special occasion” banger you can keep clean and ready to go for your favorite concentrates.

Pick 10mm or 14mm male based on what your rig uses—if your rig has a female joint, you’re good. The 45° option plays best with angled “bong-style” pieces, while the 90° option is usually the move for upright rigs with straight joints.

If you’re building out a new setup from scratch, this slurper makes a strong centerpiece on a silicone or glass rig. Pair it with one of our durable silicone bongs & rigs if you want something you don’t have to baby every time you clean the coffee table.

Let the banger cool down before you touch or clean it. Once it’s safe to handle, wipe off any leftover residue. For deeper cleans, soak the quartz, pillar, and marbles in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with water and let everything dry fully before your next sesh.

To keep your glass and station from getting sticky during cleanups, it helps to work over a nonstick surface or stash cleaned parts in dedicated accessory storage so they’re not rolling around picking up dust.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my rig?
    Check two things: your joint size and angle. This slurper comes in 10mm and 14mm male joints, so it will fit any rig with the matching female joint. Then match 45° to angled joints (common on bongs) and 90° to straight, upright joints (common on smaller rigs).
  • What do the marbles actually do?
    The large marble sits on top and helps control airflow, keeping heat and vapor in the banger. The smaller inner marble, along with the terp pillar, helps keep your concentrates moving so they vaporize evenly instead of just scorching in one spot. If you like playing with different airflow setups, you can also experiment with other carb caps and marbles to change the way it pulls.
  • Is quartz really better than glass for this?
    For this kind of design, yes. Quartz handles high heat much better than standard glass and recovers quicker between pulls. That means more consistent temps, better flavor, and less risk of cracking when you’re cycling through regular seshes.
  • How do I keep it from getting chazzed?
    Let the banger cool before cleaning, wipe out residue instead of letting it bake on, and give it an occasional soak in isopropyl alcohol. Clean pillars and marbles matter too—keeping the whole kit fresh helps you see how your oil is moving and keeps flavor on point. When you’re not using it, you can stash your concentrates in proper concentrate jars so you’re not burning old, dried-out material.
  • Can I use different pearls or marbles with this?
    As long as they’re appropriately sized and made of heat-safe material, you can absolutely swap in other pearls, marbles, or different style pillars. Just don’t overload the chamber—too many inserts can kill airflow and make the function feel sluggish.
  • Is this a good daily driver or more of a special piece?
    It can do both. If you’re the type who dabs a couple times a day and likes to see your function working, this makes a fun daily banger. If you’re more casual, you can keep it as your “nice” setup for tastier or heavier concentrates and use simpler gear from our broader smoke shop products lineup for quick hits.
  • What angle should I choose if I’m not sure?
    Look at your current rig from the side. If the joint points out at an angle, you probably want 45°. If it sticks straight out from the body at a right angle, you want 90°. Worst case, snap a quick pic and compare the joint orientation to the options before you buy—getting the angle right makes heating and function way smoother.

Multiple borosilicate glass designs in one pack mean you can swap styles without constantly buying single caps.

What You Get Out of It

  • Dial in your airflow — Different carb cap shapes let you tweak restriction and direction so your banger runs the way you like it.
  • Stretch every dab further — Proper capping keeps heat and vapor where it belongs, so you’re not watching clouds escape into the room.
  • One pack, multiple setups — Having a mix of caps makes it easy to bounce between daily drivers and backup rigs without gear drama.
  • Experiment without guessing — Spin, rock, or just cap and chill — you’ll actually feel how each design changes the pull and flavor.

Best For

This pack is made for dabbers who are already past the “any cap will do” phase and want to actually tune function. It’s a solid choice if you’ve got more than one rig on the shelf, or if you share a setup with friends who all like a different pull style. If you’re building out a full dab corner at home, these pair nicely with heat-safe dab pads and mats so your glass and tools have a clean landing zone.

How to Use These Caps

Pick the carb cap that matches the mood and the banger you’re using. After your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrates, set the carb cap on top of the bucket opening to trap heat and control airflow. From there, you can gently spin or tilt the cap to move oil around and keep things vaporizing evenly.

Some caps in the pack will feel more “open,” giving you a freer pull, while others will tighten the airflow for dense, milky rips. It’s worth trying each style back-to-back on the same rig so you can really feel what you like best. To keep everything organized between dabs, stash your concentrates in proper concentrate jars instead of leaving sticky containers scattered around the table.

The Basics

Carb caps are all about managing air and heat. By restricting airflow at the top of the banger, they let your concentrates vaporize efficiently at the surface instead of getting blasted by cold air. Directional styles let you swirl or push oil around, which helps prevent puddles and makes low-temp hits actually work.

Because this is a mixed pack, you can see how different shapes change your sesh: some might excel with larger buckets, while others feel perfect on smaller nails. If you’re already running a full silicone travel setup, these caps also play nicely with most compact rigs from our silicone bongs & rigs collection.

Pack Contents Multiple carb cap styles
Material Borosilicate glass
Use For standard dab rigs and bangers

Cleaning & Care

Let the carb cap cool down completely before you touch it for cleaning. Wipe off fresh residue with a cloth or cotton swab, and for deeper cleans, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and dry fully before using again. Keeping them clean helps your terps taste the way they’re supposed to, especially if you rotate between caps often.

FAQ

  • Will these carb caps fit my current banger?

    They’re designed for most common flat-top bangers and standard rigs, so they should play nice with a lot of setups. If you’re building a new kit and want to be sure everything lines up, you can match them with pieces from our general smoke shop products collection.

  • Are these directional or just simple caps?

    This is a mixed pack, so you’ll get a variety of airflow styles. Some caps are better for spinning and moving concentrates around, while others are more about straightforward capping and retaining heat.

  • How fragile are they?

    They’re made from borosilicate glass, which is tougher and more heat-resistant than basic glass, but they’re still glass — avoid dropping them on hard surfaces or knocking them into your rig when you’re a few dabs deep.

  • Do I need a specific rig or nail to use these?

  • How do I keep them from getting sticky so fast?

At just 4 inches (102mm) tall, it’s easy to palm, stash, and travel with, while the silver fume line work slowly color-changes as you sesh, giving it a look that’s unique to you over time.

This is the kind of piece you keep on your desk or toss in a bag when you’re heading to a friend’s place—small, low-maintenance, and surprisingly smooth for the size.

Why It Works

  • Smoother than a dry pipe — Built-in water chamber cools and filters your smoke so it’s less harsh than a standard spoon.

  • Color-changing fume design — Silver fume line work reacts with use, so the more you smoke, the more it shifts into deeper blues, purples, and greens.

  • Low water, big payoff — Just a little water is enough to cover the downstem and take the edge off your hits.
  • Simple to clean — One-piece glass design with no complex percs makes it easy to rinse and refresh.

Best For

This mini bubbler is made for smokers who like the smoothness of a water pipe but don’t want to babysit a big, fragile bong. If your daily driver needs to fit on a nightstand or in a backpack, this hits that sweet spot between function and portability. It also pairs nicely with a small dab mat if you want to protect your table and catch any stray ash or water.

How to Use It

Fill the bubbler by pouring a bit of clean water through the mouthpiece until the end of the internal downstem is just covered. You don’t need much—too little and you lose filtration, too much and you’ll risk splashback.

Once the water level’s right, pack your bowl, find a comfortable grip around the body, and use the carb (if present) the same way you would with a regular hand pipe. Because of the small size, gentle pulls work best; you’ll still get satisfying hits without overloading the chamber.

When you’re done, set it down on a flat surface—like a dedicated smoke shop accessory station—to keep any residual moisture off your furniture and make it easy to grab for the next sesh.

Height 4 inches (102mm)

Care & Cleaning

Let the bubbler cool down completely before handling or cleaning. For quick maintenance, empty the water and rinse with warm water to knock out loose residue.

For deeper cleaning, add isopropyl alcohol, let it soak briefly, then rinse thoroughly with warm water and let it dry fully before using again. If you keep it on a designated accessory pad, it’ll also help keep sticky spots and water rings off your table.

FAQ

  • How much water should I put in the mini bubbler?
    Use just enough water to cover the end of the downstem inside the chamber. Too much water can cause splashback; too little means you lose the benefit of water filtration.
  • Can this really give smoother hits than a regular spoon pipe?
    Yes. Even with its small size, the added water layer helps cool and filter your smoke, making it noticeably smoother compared to a dry hand pipe. If you like smooth hits but don’t want a full bong, this is a nice middle ground.
  • How does the silver fume color change work?

  • Is this a durable travel piece?

  • Can I use this bubbler for concentrates?
    This piece is designed as a small water pipe for flower, not as a dedicated dab rig. If you’re mainly into concentrates, a rig or nectar collector will give you better control and flavor.
  • How often should I change the water?
    Swapping the water regularly keeps your hits tasting fresher and helps prevent buildup. If you’re seshing often, changing it daily or after a few bowls keeps things clean and pleasant.
  • Does it come with any extra parts or accessories?
    This listing is for the 4" Silver Fume Mini Bubbler itself. If you want to round out your setup, you can add things like storage containers from our storage & packaging lineup or grab glass-friendly cleaning supplies separately.

The 2.5" Classic Zinc Grinder is a five-piece herb grinder built for people who actually care how their flower breaks down. Why It Works

  • Fluffy, consistent grind — Sharp, diamond-shaped teeth chew through dense nugs instead of just mashing them.
  • More kief over time — Multi-piece design with a dedicated kief chamber lets the good stuff fall and stay separate.
  • Less mess, more control — Included kief scoop makes it easy to move pollen where you want it instead of using your fingers.
  • Built to take a beating — Solid zinc construction gives weight and durability so it feels planted in your hand, not flimsy.
  • Smooth twist every sesh — Tight machining and a clean thread pattern help prevent grinding or squeaking as it wears in.

Best For

This grinder is made for people who go through enough flower that a cheap plastic piece just doesn't cut it anymore. If you keep a regular rotation of strains and like having a dedicated stash of kief for “bonus hits,” this five-piece is a big upgrade. It also pairs nicely with more durable storage and packaging setups when you're trying to keep your whole kit organized.

How to Use It

Pop the magnetic lid, drop in a few medium-sized pieces of flower (don't overpack it), and twist the top back and forth until everything moves freely. The teeth break your herb down, it falls through the holes onto the middle plate, and finer particles work their way through the screen into the kief chamber below.

When you're ready to reload, unscrew the grinding chamber to access your fluffy herb for bowls, vapes, or whatever gear lives on your dab mat. Over time, you'll notice a nice layer of kief building up in the bottom — that's where the included scoop comes in clutch, so you're not scraping with a card or messing up your nails.

For cleaning, gently tap out loose material, then brush the teeth and screen. For deeper cleans, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol, thorough rinse, and full dry before reassembly will keep things spinning smoothly.

Material Zinc
Diameter 2.5 inches (63.5mm)
Piece count 5-piece design

Fit & Everyday Use

At 2.5 inches (63.5mm), this grinder strikes a nice balance between pocketable and "leave it on the coffee table" size. It's big enough to grind for a few people without constant refilling but still easy to palm and twist, even if you don't have huge hands. If you're building out a complete kit with pipes, papers, and a few backup tools, it fits right in with other daily-driver smoke shop products.

FAQ

  • Is this grinder good for daily use?

    Yes. The zinc body and solid tooth pattern are made to handle regular grinding without feeling loose or cheap. If you're breaking down flower most days of the week, this is built with that level of use in mind.

  • What's the advantage of a five-piece grinder?

    A five-piece setup gives you separate layers: one for grinding, one for holding ground herb, and another for collecting kief under a screen. That extra separation means less plant material in your kief and an easier time scooping it out when you want to top a bowl or pack something special into your joint tubes.

  • Does it really come with a kief scoop?

    Yes, it includes a small scoop that actually fits into the corners of the kief chamber. It beats using a folded piece of paper or your fingernail when you're trying to grab every last bit.

  • How should I clean and maintain it?

    For regular upkeep, tap out loose herb and use a soft brush or cotton swab on the teeth and screen. When things start to feel sticky, you can soak the metal parts in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let them dry completely before putting it back together. Keeping the threads and screen clean will help it spin smoothly for longer.

  • Will it work with small amounts of herb?

    It handles both small and medium loads well. For tiny amounts, just center the herb over the teeth so everything makes contact. If you often grind very small nugs for micro-dosing or for loading tiny bowls or silicone pipes, this size still works comfortably.

  • How fine does it grind?

    The diamond teeth give you a medium-fine grind that works for most bowls and rollers. If you want it a bit finer, just give it a few extra turns; if you like it chunkier, stop once things start moving freely and don't over-twist.

  • How does this compare to aluminum grinders?

    Zinc grinders tend to feel heavier and more planted in the hand, which some people prefer. If you're the type to toss your gear in bags or backpacks, that extra heft can feel a little more rugged. Whichever style you lean towards, it still plays nicely alongside your other glass and glass jar storage in a home setup.

If you're ready to retire the old acrylic grinder and step into something sturdier, the 2.5" Classic Zinc Grinder is a simple, effective upgrade that keeps your prep clean, your kief separated, and your flower ready for whatever you're loading next.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Cap Every Day

  • Ready for heavy use — Thick glass construction stands up to regular heat cycles when you’re running multiple dabs in a night.
  • Easy swap for most setups — Simple, universal-style design that plays nice with common flat-top bangers.

Best For

This spinner orb carb cap is made for dabbers who care about function and aesthetics—people who have their favorite rig dialed in and just want a cap that spins well, looks good, and isn’t annoying to grab when you’re mid-sesh. If you’re already running a compact rig or one of our sturdy silicone bongs & rigs, this cap is an easy upgrade that you’ll actually notice in your day-to-day dabs.

Once your banger is at the temp you like, you drop in your concentrate and set the orb carb cap over the top. The cap helps trap heat in the bucket and shapes the airflow so it pulls your oil around instead of letting it pool in one hot corner. Give the orb a gentle spin or twist between your fingers to really get the spinner effect and keep the vapor moving.

Between dabs, you can rest the cap on your table or stash it on a stand; putting it on a dab mat keeps sticky reclaim from welding itself to your glass coffee table. When the sesh is done and the glass has cooled off, a quick wipe keeps it ready for next time.

The Basics

This is a spinner-style orb carb cap, which means it’s designed to work with the airflow in your rig to help move oil around the surface of the banger. The color frit pattern is made from small bits of colored glass melted into the clear body, giving each cap a unique speckled look. Function-wise, the orb shape is all about comfort and control—easy to grab, easy to twist, and easy to park on the side when you’re not actively hitting.

It’s a simple piece of glass with a job: focus airflow, retain heat, and help you get the most out of the concentrates you’re loading. Pair it with a good banger and some stable dab tools, and you’ve basically upgraded your whole rig without buying a new piece.

The 2" Color Spiral Bubble Carb Cap is a compact glass carb cap built for dabbers who care about both flavor and style. At about 2 inches (51mm) across, it’s sized to sit comfortably on most standard bucket-style bangers while you chase smooth, efficient hits.

Key Benefits

  • Stronger flavor from every dab — Bubble shape lets you angle and spin the cap so airflow hits your puddle instead of just the rim.
  • More mileage from your concentrates — Focused airflow keeps vapor moving across the surface, helping you finish off leftovers instead of wasting them.
  • Comfortable, one-hand control — Rounded bubble body gives you a solid grip, even when things get a little sticky mid-sesh.
  • Eye-catching spiral design — Color spiral pattern pops on any rig and actually makes it easy to spot on a cluttered coffee table.
  • Plays nice with most quartz bangers — The 2 inch (51mm) diameter works well with common bucket sizes, so you don’t have to overhaul your whole setup.
  • Built for daily use — Sturdy glass construction stands up to regular heating and cooling when you’re dabbing all week.

Best for

This bubble carb cap is made for dabbers who already have a solid rig and banger and just want their setup to hit better without getting complicated. If you’re the type who likes to run slower, flavorful pulls instead of scorching your concentrates, this cap will feel right at home on your favorite rig. It also pairs nicely with silicone rigs from our silicone bongs & rigs collection if you like durable, travel-ready setups.

How to use it

Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, place the 2" Color Spiral Bubble Carb Cap over the top of the bucket and start drawing. Use your fingers to gently tilt and rotate the bubble so the airflow pushes the puddle around the bottom of the banger, helping it vaporize evenly instead of sitting in one spot.

You’ll feel the difference in resistance as you move the cap around; more tilt usually means more direction and movement inside the banger. On flat-top quartz buckets, you can give it a light spin to create that swirling effect people chase, especially if you like using pearls or inserts. For a cleaner setup, park your rig on a nonstick dab mat so you’re not setting sticky caps straight on the table.

When you’re done with the dab, let the cap cool on a safe surface. Avoid dropping it onto hard floors or countertops while it’s hot, since glass doesn’t love sudden impacts or temperature shocks.

Specifications

Product Type Bubble carb cap
Material Glass
Diameter 2 inches (51mm)
Design Color spiral bubble
Compatibility Plays best with most standard quartz bangers
Vendor What You Need
Category Carb caps

Fit & compatibility notes

This cap is a great match for common flat-top and bucket-style quartz bangers in the ~20–25mm range. Oversized bangers may still work but won’t feel as snug, and tiny micro bangers might be overwhelmed by the 2" (51mm) diameter. If your current setup already runs a standard bucket, odds are high this cap will sit and seal nicely.

Because it’s a bubble carb cap, it’s designed to sit on the rim, not lock in like a plug or stopper. That floating fit is what lets you tilt, spin, and steer the airflow where you want it. Combine it with your favorite rig and stash your concentrates in proper concentrate jars to keep your flavors consistent from dab to dab.

Cleaning & care

Let the carb cap cool down fully before handling or cleaning. Once it’s at room temp, wipe off any fresh residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before putting it back into your rotation.

If you’re tossing this in a travel kit or case, give it a little padding or wrap so you’re not clinking it against heavier gear like metal dab tools, which can chip glass if they knock around together.

Why a bubble carb cap?

Bubble caps took over for a reason: they give you way more control than basic flat caps. The rounded body lets you tilt and angle the airflow so it doesn’t just shoot straight down, it actually chases your puddle around the bottom of the banger. That means better use of your concentrates and fewer half-finished dabs stuck to the corners.

The 2" Color Spiral Bubble Carb Cap keeps that same functionality but adds a bright, swirling look that stands out. It’s the kind of piece you don’t have to hunt for when you’re already a couple dabs in because the colors are easy to spot, especially if you’re working on a cluttered tray loaded with jars, tools, and other accessories.

  • Will this carb cap fit my banger?

    It’s designed to work with most standard quartz bucket bangers, especially in the 20–25mm range. If your banger is way larger or smaller than that, it may not seal as well. A quick way to check is to measure the outside diameter of your bucket and compare it to the 2" (51mm) cap size.

  • Does it work with thermal or reactor-style bangers?

    Yes, in most cases. As long as your thermal or reactor-style banger has a flat top and a bucket opening that isn’t huge compared to the cap, you’ll still get solid airflow control. Just keep in mind this is a standard bubble cap, not a directional spinner specifically built for terp pearls.

  • Is each color spiral pattern the same?

    No, that’s part of the fun. The overall style is the same, but because of how colored glass is worked, swirl placement and color emphasis can vary slightly from piece to piece. If you like unique-looking glass, that little bit of variation is a bonus.

  • How thick is the glass — is it fragile?

    It’s sturdy enough for daily dabbing, but it’s still glass, so try not to drop it onto tile or concrete. Treat it like you do your rig or banger — set it down gently and don’t blast it with water when it’s hot to avoid thermal shock. For a safer landing spot, keep it on your rig tray or a soft storage & packaging insert when you’re not using it.

  • How do I clean off dark, baked-on residue?

    Let the carb cap cool fully, then soak it in isopropyl alcohol for a bit to loosen the buildup. After soaking, rinse with warm water and wipe away any remaining residue. Repeat if needed, then dry before using again.

  • Can I use this on an e-rig or electronic banger?

    If your e-rig or electronic banger has a bucket-style top similar in size to a traditional quartz banger, this cap can work just fine. Some proprietary systems have odd shapes or built-in caps, though, so if your device is very specialized, double-check the top opening before expecting a perfect fit.

  • Is this a good first carb cap for a new dab setup?

    Yes. The bubble style is easy to use, forgiving, and works with most basic quartz buckets, so it’s a solid first cap if you’re building your kit. Pair it with a simple rig from our general smoke shop products lineup and you’ll have a reliable daily driver setup without overcomplicating anything.

Fit, Feel & Style

    You can pair it with standard accessories like lighters, grinders, and trays—no special hardware needed. If you like keeping everything in one spot, collecting your basic smoking accessories (grinder, storage, cleaning tools) around this pipe makes a simple but solid everyday setup.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Pocket-sized without being tiny — 4 inches (102mm) gives you a legit bowl and some distance from the heat, while still disappearing into a bag or hoodie pocket.

This pipe is made for flower smokers who want a dedicated, low-maintenance piece that lives in a pocket, purse, or glove box. Grind or break up your flower, then lightly pack it into the cup-shaped bowl so air can still move through it. The built-in glass screen helps keep material in place and cuts down on ash pulling through, so you can focus on your hit instead of coughing on crumbs.

Because of the 4 inch (102mm) length and thicker horn shape, it feels secure in the hand — you’re not pinching a tiny tube and hoping it doesn’t slip. Material Fumed glass
Bowl Style Cup-shaped bowl with built-in glass screen

Fume glass is popular because it never stays looking exactly like it did on day one. As smoke and resin pass through the pipe, the light refracts differently against the thin layer of metal fume in the glass, slowly shifting the color and depth. It’s like getting a subtle, built-in color change pipe without loud graphics or decals that can scratch or peel.

If you like seeing that “story of use” and don’t mind a little character in your glass, this is the kind of piece that just gets better with time. When you want it looking fresher again, a good soak brings back a lot of the original clarity while still leaving that fumed glow underneath.

  • How do I keep the fume effect looking good?

  • Can I pick the exact color I’ll get?

    Fume glass is all about variation, so each pipe will have its own unique pattern and color shift. You’re getting the same style and size, but the exact hues and how they develop over time will be unique to your piece.

Load your flower into the cup-shaped bowl, making sure you don’t pack it so tight that you choke off airflow from the built-in screen. That glass screen acts like a permanent filter, helping keep loose bits from flying through while still pulling smoothly.

The 4" Silicone Rabbit Pipe with Glass Bowl is a compact little flower pipe built for people who are rough on their gear but still care about flavor. At just 4 inches (102mm), it disappears into a pocket or bag, while the 2-inch (51mm) glass bowl and integrated glass screen keep your hits tasting clean. If you want something cute, durable, and easy to forget in your hoodie without worrying about it breaking, this is that piece.

The silicone rabbit body shrugs off drops and falls, and the glass insert pops out for quick cleaning or replacement. It’s the kind of travel pipe you toss in a backpack and don’t think about again until the next sesh.

Why you’ll actually use this every day

  • Pocket-friendly size — 4-inch (102mm) length makes it easy to stash in a pocket, bag, or glove box without being bulky.
  • Flavor from glass, durability from silicone — glass bowl and screen keep your flower tasting right, while the silicone sleeve takes all the abuse.
  • No loose flower in your mouth — integrated glass screen helps keep ash and particles out of your pull.
  • Heat-resistant body — silicone won’t melt or warp, so you can set it down right after a sesh without stressing the material.
  • Travel-proof build — silicone + glass insert design means if you drop it on concrete, the pipe itself is very forgiving compared to an all-glass piece.
  • Simple clean-up — the glass bowl pops out, and the silicone body wipes down easily, so you’re not fighting resin in weird corners.
  • Fun, non-stealthy (in a good way) look — rabbit shape and color options give it personality instead of looking like the same old spoon pipe.

Best for

This rabbit pipe is made for flower fans who want a true throw-and-go piece: hikers, festival-goers, people who sesh at friends’ houses, or anyone who’s broken one too many small glass spoons. If your daily driver is a bigger rig or bong at home, this makes a perfect little sidekick for the road, especially if you already rock other silicone pipes and like the unbreakable vibe.

How to use it

Using the rabbit pipe is straightforward. The removable glass bowl is sized for a 14mm connection and includes a built-in glass screen. Load it with ground flower, making sure the screen stays seated so it can do its job catching ash and bits. The rabbit’s body acts just like a standard hand pipe, giving you an easy, familiar draw path.

Between bowls, you can tap out the ash, then let everything cool before cleaning. For quick maintenance, remove the glass insert and wipe the bowl and screen with a cotton swab or cloth. When you’re at home, setting the pipe down on a dab mat keeps stray ash and crumbs off your table and makes cleanup easier.

When it needs a deeper refresh, pop out the glass bowl and screen and soak them in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry fully before popping them back in. The silicone body can be wiped with a bit of alcohol on a cloth or rinsed with warm soapy water, then dried.

Specifications

Category Flower hand pipe
Overall Length 4 inches (102mm)
Bowl Diameter 2 inches (51mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Body Material Food-grade silicone
Bowl & Screen Material Glass bowl with integrated glass screen
Design Rabbit-shaped silicone body

Fit & compatibility notes

The main working area here is the glass bowl insert, which is sized to work with a 14mm connection and drops into the silicone rabbit body. This isn’t a bong slide; it’s a dedicated hand pipe, so you won’t be plugging this directly into a water pipe the way you would a standard flower bowl. If you’re building out a full setup, keep this as your grab-and-go piece and let your dedicated smoke shop products handle the heavy home rotation.

Care & cleaning tips

Let the pipe cool after use so the glass isn’t hot, then remove the bowl and gently tap out ash. Wipe down the bowl and screen when they start to look cloudy. For a deeper clean, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and dry before reuse. Silicone can be rinsed with warm soapy water or wiped with a bit of alcohol on a cloth, then rinsed and dried.

If you’re the type who likes to keep everything tidy, storing your flower in proper storage & packaging instead of random bags will help keep the bowl cleaner between fills.

FAQ

  • Is the glass bowl actually removable?
    Yes, the glass bowl pulls right out of the silicone body, so you can clean it or swap it without fighting the shape of the rabbit. That also makes it easier to knock out ash without banging the silicone around.
  • Will this fit into my bong or water pipe?
    Even though the spec lists a 14mm joint size, this is meant to be used as a standalone hand pipe, not as a slide for a bong. If you’re looking for something to drop into a water piece, check out our dedicated flower-friendly gear in the broader silicone bongs & rigs lineup instead.
  • How big is the bowl on this rabbit pipe?
    The glass bowl is about 2 inches (51mm) across, with a nice medium pack size—enough for a solid personal bowl or a quick share without it feeling tiny. The integrated glass screen helps keep material from pulling through as it burns down.
  • Can I toss this in a bag without a case?
    You can. The silicone body is made to handle being thrown into a bag or backpack, and the glass bowl is protected by the surrounding silicone. For extra peace of mind (and smell control), you can always pair it with one of our resealable mylar bags or another small carry pouch.
  • How do I keep the screen from clogging?
    If you’re using stickier or fresher flower, the glass screen will slowly collect residue. Let the piece cool, then tap out loose ash and wipe the screen with a cotton swab. When airflow starts feeling tight, that’s your sign to give the bowl and screen a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry fully.
  • Is food-grade silicone really okay with heat?
    Yes, food-grade silicone is made to handle high temperatures without deforming or releasing weird tastes. The actual combustion happens in the glass bowl, and the silicone mostly acts as a shell and mouthpiece, so your flower is contacting glass where it counts. If you want a fully nonstick setup for your concentrates, that’s where our non-stick paper & PTFE line shines.
  • What if I already have a bunch of glass pipes?
    Think of this as your "no-stress" piece. Use your fancier glass at home, and keep the rabbit for travel, camping, or tossing in a jacket pocket. If you’re building out a little kit, you can match it with proper concentrate jars and other storage so everything lives in one place instead of rolling around loose.

The HAND PIPE – Pack is a compact glass flower bowl built for people who want a tiny, tough daily driver they can toss in a bag or pocket without stress. At just 2 inches (50.8mm) with a 14mm joint, it’s perfect for quick hits, tight spaces, and keeping your setup low-key. The thick horn handle and cup-shaped bowl give you real grip and durability, not some dainty piece you’re scared to touch.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Pocket-sized but real volume — 2 inches (50.8mm) long, so it stays discreet while still holding a legit bowl pack.
  • Easy to grab, even mid-sesh — thick horn design gives you something solid to hold so it doesn’t spin or slide when you’re passing it.
  • Smoother pulls, less junk — built-in glass screen helps keep ash and flower bits from shooting through or clogging your airflow.
  • Sturdy glass where it matters — the cup-shaped bowl and horn add extra thickness where pieces usually crack if they get knocked.
  • Color that stands out (or disappears) — multiple color options so you can either flex it on the table or keep it stealth in your kit.
  • Beginner friendly, vet approved — simple design with a comfortable bowl that doesn’t require any learning curve.

Best for

This hand pipe is made for flower smokers who want something small and dependable they can bring anywhere without babying it. If you’re running a main rig at home and just need a quick grab-and-go bowl instead of firing up a big setup, this fits that role perfectly. It also pairs nicely with other compact gear in our broader smoke shop products if you’re building out a travel kit or backup stash box.

How to use it

Think of this as the tiny workhorse in your collection: pack your ground flower into the cup-shaped bowl, hold the horn for control, and you’re set for a fast, clean burn. The glass screen helps keep your pulls cleaner by stopping loose bits from dropping through and clogging things up. When you’re done, tap out the bowl gently and let the pipe cool before cleaning.

For basic maintenance, let it cool, then wipe off residue or lightly scrape buildup from the bowl area. For a deeper clean, give it a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh. If you’re prepping multiple strains or like to keep everything tidy, laying this piece down on a nonstick dab mat keeps your table free of ash and resin smudges.

The basics & fit

This piece is technically a hand pipe and a 14mm flower bowl in one compact form factor. That means you can use it as a standalone pipe, or—if your setup is right—as a slide-style bowl in certain 14mm joints. The thick horn acts like a handle, making it easy to pull off or pass around without getting near the hot bowl.

Because it’s all glass, flavor stays clean, especially if you keep up on your cleaning routine. For people who like to rotate strains, it’s small enough that you can keep a few colors on deck and dedicate each to a different type of flower, then stash them in proper storage & packaging so your kit stays organized and smell-controlled.

Specifications

Category Hand pipe / flower bowl
Length 2 inches (50.8mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Material Glass
Design Style Thick horn with cup-shaped bowl

Compatibility notes

The HAND PIPE – Pack is a 14mm glass piece, so it plays best with setups that are already rocking 14mm connections. Depending on your gear, it may be used purely as a standalone hand pipe or, where appropriate, as a 14mm bowl on select water pipes or rigs—just make sure your joint style and angle line up before you try to marry it to your favorite piece. If you’re working with silicone setups and want something equally tough but more flexible, check out our range of silicone bongs & rigs for a nearly unbreakable combo.

FAQ

  • Is this a regular hand pipe or a bowl for a bong?
    It’s primarily a compact hand pipe with a 14mm connection, but its joint size means it can sometimes act like a bowl for compatible 14mm pieces. Always check how it seats on your bong or rig before using it that way, since not every joint angle or depth will match perfectly.
  • Will this fit my 14mm water pipe?
    It may fit if your piece has a standard 14mm joint and the geometry lines up, but it’s not guaranteed for every bong on the market. If you want a sure-fire bowl for your water piece, you might also browse our dedicated nectar collectors & straws and related accessories for more specialized setups.
  • Is it okay for left-handed smokers?
    Yes, the horn design is symmetrical enough that left-handed and right-handed folks can both hold it comfortably. There’s no awkward one-side-only carb or handle you have to work around.
  • How fragile is the glass?
    It’s glass, so it’s not indestructible—but the thick horn and bowl areas add a lot of extra strength compared to thinner, cheaper pipes. Treat it with basic care, avoid hard drops, and you’ll get plenty of mileage out of it. If you’re accident-prone, backing it up with some unbreakable silicone pipes isn’t a bad move either.
  • How do I clean the built-in glass screen?
    Let the piece cool, then gently tap or blow out loose debris from the screen area. For deeper cleans, soak the entire piece in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and let it dry completely before you use it again.
  • Does it change the flavor of my flower?
    The all-glass construction keeps your hits tasting like your strain, not the pipe. As long as you clean it regularly, you’ll get fresh flavor without old resin taking over. If you want to keep strains super dialed in, storing your flower in proper glass jars & packaging helps lock in terps between refills.
  • Is this a good piece for beginners?
    Yes. It’s small, easy to handle, and not overcomplicated, so new smokers aren’t fumbling with weird shapes or multiple parts. The horn makes it easy to grip, and the cup-shaped bowl is intuitive to pack—even if this is your very first proper pipe.

The Beveled Edge Concave Pinch Bucket is a 14mm glass flower bowl built for people who actually pack full bowls and don’t want their herb falling through. The concave pinch and built-in screen keep your flower right where you want it, while the beveled edge makes for a snug, wobble-free fit in your piece. If you’re rotating between a couple of daily drivers, this is the kind of bowl you leave on your favorite and forget about.

What You Get

  • Easy, even packs — Concave bucket shape naturally centers your flower, so you’re not fighting gravity every time you load up.
  • Less debris in your glass — Internal glass screen helps keep ash and crumbs out of your piece, so the water stays cleaner longer.
  • Secure connection — Beveled edge joint seats nicely in your 14mm female joint so you’re not nervously checking if it’s about to tip.
  • Comfortable handling — Thick horn handle gives you something solid to grab when the bowl’s warm and you’re mid-sesh.
  • Dial in your look — Multiple color options let you match your favorite tube or add a pop of contrast.
  • Simple upkeep — Smooth glass walls and built-in screen are quick to wipe down and easy to deep-clean when it’s time.

Best For

This bowl is made for flower smokers who are picky about function but don’t need a crazy novelty piece. If you run a 14mm glass bong or rig as your daily driver and want a bowl that packs easily, pulls smoothly, and doesn’t dump half your grind into the water, this is it. It’s also a nice upgrade if you’re still using the tiny stock bowl that came with your first piece from a big-box smoke shop.

How to Use It

Grind or break up your flower, then gently drop it into the concave bucket until it’s evenly filled. The internal glass pinch acts like a built-in screen, so you don’t need metal screens or paper hacks to keep herb from slipping through. Pack it as loose or as tight as you like, depending on how you prefer your pulls.

Once you’re done, let the bowl cool off before you handle it. Tap out the ash, then use a cotton swab or small brush to clear the pinches so your next pack has good airflow. Setting the bowl down on a heat-safe surface like a dab mat between hits keeps stray ash and resin off your table.

For deeper cleans, soak the bowl in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with warm water, and let it dry completely before putting it back on your piece. A quick wipe every couple of sessions keeps the glass looking sharp and stops resin from building up in the pinches.

Specifications

Category Flower bowl
Material Glass
Joint Size 14mm male
Joint Style Beveled edge
Bowl Shape Concave bucket with internal pinch screen
Handle Thick glass horn
Colors Multiple color options available

Fit & Compatibility

This Beveled Edge Concave Pinch Bucket is designed for any piece with a 14mm female joint. It’ll drop right into most standard glass bongs and rigs that are built for bowls instead of bangers. If you’re running a compact setup or a hybrid piece that pulls double duty as a rig, this bowl is an easy way to swap back to flower without changing anything else in your kit.

If you bounce between flower and concentrates, keep this bowl parked next to your favorite rig and swap it in when you’re not using a banger or carb cap. Just make sure your joint is 14mm and female, and you’re good.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?
    If your piece has a 14mm female joint, this bowl will fit. That covers most modern medium-sized glass tubes and many compact rigs. If you’re not sure, compare your joint to another known 14mm accessory or check what size your current bowl or nectar collector tips use for reference.
  • Do I need a metal screen with this bowl?
    No, you don’t. The concave design and internal pinch act as a built-in glass screen to help keep flower in the bowl and out of your piece. Some people still like to add a metal screen when using very fine grind, but it’s optional.
  • How big is the bowl — is it for solo snaps or party bowls?
    The concave bucket is a nice middle ground: plenty of room for a solid personal pack, but you can also load it heavier if you’re passing it around. If you’re microdosing tiny amounts, just pack less into the concave area instead of filling it all the way.
  • What’s the benefit of the beveled edge?
    The beveled edge helps the joint seat smoothly into your downstem or joint without feeling wobbly. It gives you a more secure fit and makes it less likely to get stuck compared to super-sharp, flat-cut joints. That’s especially nice on thicker glass or custom glass setups.
  • How should I clean it without clogging the pinches?
    Let the bowl cool, tap out loose ash, then rinse or soak in isopropyl alcohol for a bit. After soaking, rinse with warm water and use a cotton swab or soft brush to clear any resin caught at the pinch points. Make sure it’s fully dry before using again.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    Yes, it’s made from sturdy glass and built as a daily driver bowl. Like any glass, it’ll last a long time if you’re not dropping it on tile or knocking it off the table. When you’re done, parking it in a small tray or next to your storage containers keeps accidents to a minimum.
  • Can I pick my color?
    This bowl comes in multiple colors. Availability can vary, so check the options listed on the product page at checkout. If you’re building a matched set with other pieces or accessories, it’s easy to grab a color that ties everything together.

If you’re tired of flimsy stock bowls or losing good flower through oversized holes, the Beveled Edge Concave Pinch Bucket is a simple upgrade that makes every pack easier and every hit a little cleaner.

The 1.5" Ceramic 10mm Nectar Tip – 5-Pack is a compact bundle of replacement tips for nectar-collector fans who care about clean flavor and always having a fresh tip ready. Built from neutral ceramic and sized at 1.5 inches (38mm) with a 10mm connection, these tips slide into most mini and standard straw-style setups that use 10mm joints. With five matching tips in each pack, you've got enough for heavy rotation, travel backups, or swapping out when one gets too gunked.

Why it works

  • Cleaner-tasting dabs — Full ceramic construction keeps metal flavors out of the way so your concentrates taste like they're supposed to.
  • Always have a fresh tip ready — The 5-pack format means you can rotate tips instead of pausing the sesh every time one gets dirty.
  • Made for 10mm nectar setups — Standard 10mm size is designed for most nectar collectors and straw-style rigs that accept 10mm tips.
  • Compact and easy to control — 1.5 inch (38mm) length keeps things nimble without feeling too tiny or awkward in your hand.
  • Smoother heat behavior — Ceramic heats and cools more evenly than cheap metals, which helps your hits feel less harsh when you're going back-to-back.
  • Backup insurance — Drop one, crack one, or lose one in the car? You've still got spares in the pack.

Best for

This 5-pack is made for concentrate fans who already love using nectar collectors and want a cleaner-tasting, easy-to-swap ceramic tip option instead of sticking with cheap metal. It also fits well for anyone who travels with a compact straw rig and wants multiple tips on hand without taking up much space in a case or bag.

How to use it

Seat a ceramic tip into the 10mm joint on your nectar collector or straw-style rig so it feels snug and secure. Let the tip fully cool between uses, then wipe off any residue to keep buildup from stacking up over time. For deeper cleaning, let it cool, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry completely before putting it back on your piece.

Keep your rig and extra tips on a solid dab mat so you're not watching small, sticky parts roll around or fall off the table mid-sesh. Having everything on one clean surface also makes swapping between fresh tips a lot smoother and less messy.

If you keep a little travel kit going, stash a few spare tips alongside your favorite tools from our dab tools collection so they're easy to grab when you want a clean, fresh-tasting hit instead of dealing with a crusty old tip.

Specs

Length 1.5 inches (38mm)
Joint size 10mm
Material Ceramic
Quantity 5 tips per pack

Fit & compatibility

These ceramic tips are sized for setups that accept a 10mm nectar-style tip, so they play best with 10mm straw rigs and mini nectar collectors designed around that standard. If your piece is built with a 14mm or 18mm joint, you'll need the right adapter or a different size tip—this pack won't stretch to fit larger joints.

The short 1.5 inch (38mm) profile is especially nice on compact rigs and small glass or silicone nectar-style pieces, keeping the hot end out front while still feeling controlled in hand.

Why go ceramic?

Ceramic is a favorite for flavor chasers because it stays neutral—no metallic taste, no weird after-flavor when you switch strains, just whatever terps you put in front of it. It also tends to heat more evenly across the surface compared to sketchy thin metal tips, which a lot of people find smoother when they're stacking hits.

Another plus: ceramic handles regular cleaning cycles well as long as you let it cool before wiping or soaking. Paired with a solid stash setup from our storage and packaging options, this 5-pack makes it easy to keep a few fresh, clean tips ready to go at all times.

Care & cleaning

Always let the tip cool completely before you touch or clean it. For light use, a quick wipe with a paper towel or cotton swab will knock most residue off. When things get stubborn, soak the cooled tip in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry thoroughly before reuse. Treat them like glass—ceramic loves heat but doesn't love being dropped on hard floors.

FAQ

  • Will these tips fit my nectar collector?
    They'll fit most setups that use a 10mm nectar-style tip. If your straw or rig has a 14mm or 18mm joint, these will be too small unless you're using an adapter. When in doubt, measure your existing tip or joint size before you grab this pack.
  • Are these male or female tips?
    These are standard nectar-style ceramic tips designed to insert into a matching 10mm joint on your collector or straw. If your current setup takes a typical 10mm tip that slides in, these should work the same way.
  • How durable are ceramic tips?
    Ceramic is tough against heat but, like glass, it doesn't love impact. You can absolutely daily these—just avoid dropping them on concrete, overtightening them, or letting them rattle around loose in a bag. Stashing spares in a small case or even a padded spot next to your glass jars and packaging works well.
  • What's the best way to deal with heavy buildup?
    Let the tip cool all the way, then soak it in isopropyl alcohol to loosen residue. After soaking, rinse with warm water and let it dry before putting it back on your nectar collector. Regular quick wipes between uses will help keep it from ever getting super caked.
  • Can I use these with flower?
    No, these are nectar-style tips meant for concentrates, not for packing dry herb. If you want to build out your flower setup, check the bowls, slides, and other gear in our broader smoke shop products section.
  • How do these compare to metal tips?
    Metal tips are usually more drop-resistant, but ceramic wins for most people when it comes to flavor and smoothness. You're less likely to taste the hardware, and hits often feel a bit softer when you're running multiple dabs in a row.
  • How should I store the extra tips?
    Keep unused tips somewhere padded and secure so they're not banging into hard surfaces—a small case, pouch, or even tucked in with your mylar storage works. Heat is fine; sudden impacts are what you really want to avoid.

If you’re already rocking 14mm glass, this drops right into your lineup as an easy daily driver.

Even though it’s listed under flower bowls, this style of straw really shines for quick, controlled pulls when you don’t want to fuss with a full rig. Think grab-and-go hits, tasting different material, or keeping your setup minimal without sacrificing flavor.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • Quick, low-profile setup — 3.5 inches (89mm) keeps it compact while still giving you comfortable distance from the hot end.
  • Works with the gear you already own — 14mm joint size plays nice with most standard bongs and rigs, so it’s not a “one-off” piece.
  • Clean flavor every time — glass pathway keeps things neutral so you’re actually tasting your material, not the hardware.
  • Solid little workhorse — glass construction is built for regular seshes as long as you don’t treat it like a tank.
  • Easy to stash and travel with — smaller than most bowls or full nectar collectors, it tucks into a case or pocket without drama.

Best For

This piece is made for people who already have a 14mm setup and want a simple, straightforward way to take quick hits without pulling out an entire rig kit. It’s a nice add-on if you’ve already got a main rig in your rotation, maybe a few nectar collectors, and you just want something minimal for solo seshes.

If you’re the type who keeps your coffee table dialed with a good dab mat and a few go-to pieces instead of a giant arsenal, this slides right into that clean, compact vibe.

How to Use It

Using the 3.5" Clear Reclaim Nectar Straw is pretty intuitive if you’ve spent any time around glass. Drop it into any compatible 14mm joint, make sure it’s seated snug, and you’re good to go. The short length gives you easy control, so you can take smaller, more precise pulls instead of clearing a huge chamber every time.

Because it’s glass, you’ll notice the flavor more than with metal or silicone tips, especially if you keep it clean. Between seshes, let it cool, then set it somewhere safe — a corner of your smoking accessories station or a padded case works great so it’s not rolling off the table when you’re not looking.

For cleaning, let it cool completely, then wipe off loose residue. When it needs a reset, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry fully before putting it back into your piece.

Specs

Length 3.5 inches (89mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This nectar straw is built around a standard 14mm joint, so if your bong or rig takes 14mm male or female connections (depending on how you’re using it), you’re in good shape. It’s a nice match for smaller daily drivers and compact pieces, especially if you like to swap between different attachments instead of being locked into one style.

If you’re running multiple setups or like to rotate bowls and attachments, this gives you another option alongside your regular bowls and slides. For anyone building out a mixed tray with jars, bowls, and straws, it pairs nicely with solid glass concentrate jars or flower storage so your material is as dialed in as your hardware.

What You Get

  • 1 × 3.5" Clear Reclaim Nectar Straw (glass, 14mm joint)

Tips for Keeping It in Rotation

  • Designate a safe landing spot — a padded corner of your tray or a silicone pad helps avoid chips when you set it down.
  • Keep the joint clean — a little residue around the 14mm joint can make it harder to seat properly in your piece.
  • Rinse regularly — quick rinses between deep cleans keep flavor from getting muddy.
  • Pair it with proper storage — keeping your material in good storage and packaging makes the clean glass flavor really noticeable.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my 14mm bong or rig?
    Yes, it’s made for standard 14mm setups. As long as your piece uses 14mm joints, this will slot right in without any weird adapters.
  • Is this only for concentrates, or can I use it with flower too?

The PINCH BUCKET BANGER is a compact glass flower bowl built for people who want smoother, cleaner rips without juggling loose screens. Standing about 2 inches (50.8mm) tall with a 14mm male joint, it drops right into most standard water pipes and rigs. The built-in glass screen and thick horn handle make it an easy daily driver bowl that feels solid in the hand and cuts down on ash in your piece.

Key Benefits

  • Cleaner hits, less ash — Integrated glass screen helps keep flower in the bowl and ash out of your piece.
  • Easy to grab and pass — Thick horn handle gives you something solid to hold, even when the bowl’s warm.
  • Drop-in upgrade for 14mm setups — 14mm joint size plays nice with most standard bongs and rigs, no adapters needed.
  • Built to be a daily driver — Sturdy 2-inch (50.8mm) glass body is made to handle regular use without feeling fragile.
  • Less mess in your water pipe — Screened design cuts down on loose bits getting sucked through, so your tube stays cleaner longer.
  • Dial in your vibe — Multiple color options let you match your favorite rig or keep track of different strains.

Best For

This bowl is made for bong smokers and hybrid rig owners who want a simple, glass-on-glass flower setup that just works. It’s especially clutch if you’re tired of dealing with metal screens, clogged holes, or tiny snap bowls that don’t hold enough flower. If you’re building out a versatile station with both flower bowls and smoke shop gear, this is an easy add to your lineup.

How to use it

Slide the 14mm joint of the PINCH BUCKET BANGER into the 14mm female joint on your bong or rig. Pack your flower into the bucket — the built-in glass screen keeps it from falling through while still letting air move. Use the horn to lift, clear, and set it down so you’re not grabbing hot glass with your fingertips.

When you’re done and the bowl has cooled, tap out the ash and wipe any residue from the inside. For a deeper reset, you can soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry fully before your next sesh. Setting it on a nonstick dab mat between uses helps keep your table from collecting stray ash and resin rings.

Specs

Attribute Details
Height 2 inches (50.8mm)
Joint Size 14mm male
Category Glass flower bowl
Material Glass
Screen Type Integrated glass screen
Handle Style Thick horn grip
Color Options Multiple colors available (varies by stock)

Fit & Compatibility

The PINCH BUCKET BANGER is designed specifically for 14mm female joints — that’s the most common size on modern bongs and smaller rigs. It’s ideal if you’ve got a compact water pipe or a dual-use setup and want a dedicated flower bowl that feels more substantial than a tiny snapper. If you’re building a full flower station with storage, it pairs nicely with stash-ready storage and packaging so your bowl is always loaded with fresh material.

Why this style works

Bucket-style bowls give you a deeper pack and more even burn than flat, shallow bowls. With the built-in glass screen, you get that deeper pack without sacrificing airflow, and you don’t have to hunt for tiny metal screens when you’re already mid-sesh. The horn handle is also more than just a look — it’s there so you can pull and clear confidently when things are hot and a little hazy.

Because it’s all glass, there’s no extra flavor from metal or silicone in the bowl itself — just the taste of your flower and the function of your piece. If you like keeping everything glass-on-glass but still need durability, this bowl hits that middle ground really well, especially when paired with tougher pieces like silicone bongs and rigs you don’t have to baby.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong or rig?

    If your piece has a 14mm female joint, yes — this bowl is made for 14mm. If you’re not sure, most 14mm joints are about the width of a sharpie marker at the opening. For anything 10mm or 18mm, you’d need an adapter.

  • Can I use this for concentrates?

    This piece is designed as a flower bowl, not as a banger for concentrates. If you’re into dabs, you’ll want a proper nail or banger plus the right carb cap for better temp control and airflow.

  • How do I keep the glass screen from clogging?

    Tap out the ash after each bowl, give it a quick wipe when it’s cool, and do an iso soak when airflow starts to feel restricted. Regular light maintenance keeps the screen clear so you don’t have to scrub it hard later.

  • Does the horn handle get hot?

    The horn stays cooler than the bowl itself, especially toward the tip, but it can still get warm during longer seshes. Grab it by the end of the horn and let the bowl cool a bit before handling if you’ve been running it hard. Using a simple tool or grabber from our accessories can help if you’re extra cautious about heat.

  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?

    Yes, this bowl is built with a sturdy 2-inch glass profile that feels substantial in the hand. Like any glass, it can break if dropped or knocked against a hard surface, but for normal everyday use it’s solid and reliable.

  • What’s the bowl capacity like?

    As a bucket-style bowl, it’s deeper than a tiny snapper but not an oversized party bowl. It’s a comfortable size for solo rips or small group seshes, especially if you like a consistent pack every time.

  • How should I store it when I’m not using it?

    Let it cool completely, then park it in a safe spot on your tray or in a padded drawer so it’s not rolling around with lighters and tools. If you like keeping everything organized by strain, pairing this with labeled glass jars or containers makes your setup a lot easier to manage.

The CARB CAP – Pack from What You Need is a glass carb cap set built for flower heads running 14mm pieces who want tighter, more flavorful pulls. Designed to sit over 14mm flower bowls, these caps help you control airflow and conserve smoke instead of letting it drift away. At about 2 inches (50.8mm) with a thick horn handle, each cap is easy to grab and spin without getting your fingers cooked.

Instead of just ghosting out the bowl and wasting flavor, these cup-shaped caps trap and redirect airflow so your hits feel denser and more efficient. They’re simple, tough little upgrades that make a big difference on any 14mm flower setup.

Why it works

  • Stronger, thicker hits — Capping the bowl keeps more smoke in the chamber so every pull feels denser and more satisfying.
  • Better flavor from your flower — Controlled airflow lets the bowl roast more evenly, so you actually taste your strain instead of just burning through it.
  • Less wasted bud — The cup-shaped cap helps keep smoke from just floating off the top of the bowl between pulls.
  • Easy to handle hot — The thick horn handle gives you something solid to grab, turn, or lift without getting too close to the heat.
  • Simple glass construction — No moving parts, no gimmicks, just solid glass you can see through and keep clean.
  • Doubles as a little style upgrade — Multiple color options let you match your bowl or piece so your daily driver doesn’t look like everyone else’s.

Best for

This carb cap pack is made for flower smokers who already love their piece but want more control over how it hits. If you’re the type who likes to milk the chamber instead of ripping open-air snaps, this is you.

They’re especially nice on clean glass setups and worked bowls where you actually care what your piece looks like. If you’re building out a full kit with matched flower bowls, these caps help you finish the look and the function at the same time.

How to use it

Once your bowl is packed and ready, you just rest the cap over the top of a 14mm flower bowl and use the horn to lift or angle it as you pull. The cup shape sits over the bowl to restrict airflow and encourage the chamber to fill, instead of letting smoke escape straight into the air.

You can lift the cap slightly to adjust how much air gets in, or leave it more covered to keep the hit thick and milky. On bigger pieces, you’ll notice the chamber fills more consistently, which is great when you’re passing the bong and want everyone to have a similar hit. Setting your rig on a dab mat or pad helps keep hot glass from clinking around the table between pulls.

When you’re done, let the cap cool off and then stash it somewhere safe so it doesn’t roll off and meet the floor. A small tray or organizer with your other smoke accessories keeps everything easy to grab when it’s time for the next sesh.

Specifications

Spec Detail
Product type Carb cap for flower bowls
Material Glass
Joint / bowl size Designed for 14mm flower bowls
Overall length 2 inches (50.8mm)
Design Cup-shaped cap with thick horn handle

Fit & compatibility

This cap pack is built around 14mm flower setups. It’s meant to sit over the top of 14mm flower bowls rather than lock into a joint like a slide or banger would. As long as your bowl has a reasonably open top and isn’t massively oversized or tiny, it should play nice.

If you’re running a hybrid setup with both flower and dabs on the same piece, this lives on the flower side of your kit. For concentrate work, you’ll still want proper dab carb caps that are matched to your banger style.

Care & cleaning

Let the carb cap cool before you touch it for cleaning. Wipe off loose ash or residue first, then for deeper cleans soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry fully before using again.

Because these are glass, treat them like your bowl or slide — don’t toss them into a cluttered drawer where they can chip or crack against heavier gear. Keeping them near your pipes or smoke shop essentials on a shelf or tray makes them last longer and easier to find.

FAQ

  • Will these carb caps fit every 14mm piece?
    They’re designed to work with standard 14mm flower bowls that have a typical open top. As long as your bowl isn’t extremely wide or oddly shaped, the cup cap should sit over it and give you the airflow control you’re looking for.
  • Can I use this with a 10mm or 18mm bowl?
    These caps are sized with 14mm bowls in mind, so they won’t sit as naturally on 10mm or 18mm hardware. You might be able to balance it on some pieces, but for a proper fit, stick with 14mm flower setups.
  • Is this meant for dabs or just flower?
    This pack is aimed at flower use, capping the bowl on your bong or rig to keep smoke from escaping and to tweak airflow. If you’re looking for something to pair with your banger and rig for concentrates, check out more traditional dab tools and dabbers and tools designed for that job.
  • How do I keep it from getting stuck or dirty?
    Try not to push the cap too hard into the bowl; it’s meant to sit over the top, not wedge inside. If ash or resin builds up, just give it a quick wipe after a sesh, and do an alcohol soak once in a while so it doesn’t gum up.
  • Will the glass handle get hot?
    The cup section near the bowl will heat up first, but the thick horn is there to give you a cooler grab point. Still, if you’ve been chain-ripping, give it a few moments before handling or move it gently from the end of the horn.
  • Does this change how much flower I should pack?
    You don’t have to change anything about how you pack bowls. The cap just helps you control the way air moves through the bowl and how smoke stays in the piece, so the same amount of flower can feel like it hits harder. If you like to prep bowls ahead of time, you can keep them nearby in stash-ready storage containers and packaging so they’re ready to go.
  • How many caps are in the pack?
    This listing is for a pack of carb caps, so you’ve got backups or multiple colors to swap depending on what piece you’re running. It’s also nice if you’re sharing — one cap lives on your main bong, another on a backup, or you keep a clean one set aside with your silicone rigs and bongs for travel or outdoor seshes.

The 5" 14M 90° XL Reclaim Catcher is a glass add-on for 14mm rigs and bongs, built for people who hate wasting anything and want their piece to stay cleaner between deep scrubs. It sits between your bowl and your water pipe, catching residue before it ever hits your main chamber. At 5 inches (127mm) long with a 90° joint, it lines up naturally with most 90° 14mm setups, so you get better function without awkward angles.

Why It Works

  • Stretch your stash further — The reclaim chamber catches residue that would normally cake your joint and downstem, so less gets wasted and more stays usable.
  • Keep your main piece way cleaner — By trapping buildup in the catcher instead of your bong or rig, deep cleans take minutes instead of becoming a full-sink project.
  • Plug-and-play with 14mm glass — 14mm male joint and 90° angle are made for standard 14mm, 90° water pipes, so it just drops into most modern setups.
  • XL size for heavier use — The extra length and chamber space mean it can handle longer seshes before you need to dump and clean it.
  • Less risk to your favorite piece — If something gets too gunked up or bumped on the table, it’s the catcher taking the abuse instead of your prized rig.

Best For

This XL reclaim catcher is made for people who put real mileage on their glass—daily driver bong fans, heavy hitters, and anyone who hates seeing reclaim caked in hard-to-reach spots. It’s also a smart move if you run multiple bowls back to back and want to keep your main tube and any matching smoke shop pieces looking fresh longer.

How to Use It

Set the 5" 14M 90° XL Reclaim Catcher between your bowl and your 14mm water pipe: the male joint drops into your piece, and your bowl goes into the top joint on the catcher. The 90° angle keeps everything lined up, so your bowl still sits upright and hits the way you’re used to.

As you sesh, residue and buildup collect in the catcher’s chamber instead of running straight into your downstem and base. When it starts to look dirty or you notice airflow tightening up, pull the catcher off, clear it out, and rinse it. Setting it on a dab mat while it dries keeps sticky spots and drips off your table.

After cleaning, just pop it back onto your 14mm joint and slide your bowl back in. Once it’s part of your setup, it basically becomes a “buffer zone” that takes all the nasty so your actual piece doesn’t have to.

Specifications

Overall Length 5 inches (127mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Joint Angle 90°
Material Glass

Fit & Compatibility

This reclaim catcher is designed for 14mm setups with a 90° joint—basically, most mid-size modern bongs and rigs where the joint comes straight out from the side and the bowl sits vertical. If your piece has a 45° joint, this won’t sit right and will likely lean at an odd angle.

It pairs especially well with standard 14mm flower bowls and smaller 14mm rigs; if you’re already running multiple silicone bongs or rigs with 14mm glass joints, it can swap between them as a universal cleanup upgrade.

Care & Cleaning

Let the glass cool off fully before you mess with it. For quick maintenance, pull the catcher off, empty out any loose residue, and wipe what you can reach. For a deeper clean, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before you put it back on your piece.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my 14mm bong?

    If your bong or rig has a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle, yes—this reclaim catcher is made for that exact setup. If your joint is 14mm but angled at 45°, it will technically connect, but the alignment will be off and the bowl may not sit comfortably.

  • Is this just for flower, or can I use it with dabs too?

    Even though it’s tagged for flower setups, a lot of people run reclaim catchers with bangers as well, as long as everything is 14mm and 90°. If you do that, pair it with proper carb caps and bangers that match your joint size and angle for smooth function.

  • How do I clean it without risking my main piece?

    Pop the catcher off your rig first, then clean it separately so you’re not sloshing anything around inside your main tube. Let it cool, then soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and let it dry fully before reattaching. This way you protect both the catcher and whatever glass or accessories you’ve got around it.

  • Does it change how my piece hits?

    Mostly it just keeps things cleaner. You’re adding a bit of extra pathway, so air has slightly more distance to travel, but on a 5" catcher that change is minor. As long as you keep the catcher reasonably clean, your draw should feel very close to how your piece hits without it.

  • Can I use this on multiple pieces?

    Yes, as long as they all have 14mm female joints at 90°. You can move the catcher between different bongs or rigs and just drop your favorite bowl or nail in the top joint. If you like rotating glass, keeping one catcher in the mix can make your whole lineup stay cleaner and simplifies cleaning when you’re swapping between pieces and nectar collectors.

  • Is this glass thick enough for daily use?

    It’s built as a functional daily accessory, not super fragile gallery glass—but it’s still glass, so treat it like you do your other bowls and adapters. If you’re clumsy or share space with people who bump into things, using a padded tray or storing it with your other storage and packaging gear when not in use is a smart move.

  • Does it come in different colors?

    Yes, the reclaim catcher is available in assorted colors, so you can grab one that matches your favorite bowl, rig, or even your lineup of glass jars and packaging if you like keeping your setup color-coordinated.
