The BOX OF SCREENS – BRASS from What You Need is a simple, workhorse accessory for anyone who’s constantly packing flower bowls and tired of pulling ash. Built for people running glass pieces with 14mm joints, this box keeps you stocked with sturdy brass screens so your hits stay smooth and your bowl doesn’t clog out of nowhere. Brass construction means they hold their shape, and each screen keeps your herb in place while still letting the airflow you actually paid for come through.

Why It Works

  • Less ash in your piece — The brass mesh catches small particles so they don’t rocket down into your downstem or water every hit.
  • Smoother, more consistent pulls — Screens help keep the bowl from clogging, so you’re not ripping on a blocked pack wondering where the airflow went.
  • Protects your bowl — Creates a little buffer between direct heat and the glass bowl, which can help cut down on thermal stress over time.
  • Made for 14mm glass setups — Sized for standard 14mm flower bowls, so they drop in and sit right where they should.
  • Reusable instead of disposable — Brass holds up to multiple cleanings, so you’re not burning through a bag of flimsy screens every week.
  • Easy upgrade with a big impact — One tiny add-on that makes your whole daily driver feel cleaner and less fussy.

Best For

This box is dialed in for people who are always on their flower piece—think nightly bowls, wake-and-bake, or group seshes where the bong is basically in rotation all day. If you’re sick of fishing soggy bits of herb out of your downstem or cleaning after every couple of packs, a stash of brass screens turns that whole routine way more manageable. It also pairs nicely with other simple upgrades from our broader smoke shop products lineup if you’re tuning up your whole setup.

How to Use It

Drop a brass screen into the bottom of your 14mm flower bowl so it’s sitting flat and centered, then pack your herb on top like you normally would. The screen acts like a mesh floor—flower stays put, and only smoke and tiny particles make it through, so your hit stays open and your water doesn’t get nasty as fast.

When things start to look gunked up or airflow feels tighter, knock out the ash, tap the screen clean, or give it a quick soak and you’re back in business. It’s a small step that makes a big difference in how often you’re scrubbing your glass instead of just enjoying it on your dab mat.

Specifications

Product BOX OF SCREENS – BRASS
Category Flower bowl screens
Material Brass
Joint Fit Designed for 14mm glass flower bowls
Use Helps prevent clogs and stops ash from pulling through

Fit & Compatibility

These brass screens are built with standard 14mm glass flower bowls in mind—the classic setup you see on most bongs and water pipes. As long as your bowl has a normal cup-style shape and a 14mm joint, these should sit comfortably at the bottom without a fight.

They also play fine with many bowls on hybrid or silicone rigs, as long as the bowl itself is 14mm and has enough room inside for a small mesh disc to sit flat. If you’re running multiple pieces—like a glass bong plus a backup silicone pipe from our silicone pipes section—keeping one box of screens around covers all of them.

Care & Cleaning

Let the screen cool off before you touch it, then tap or wipe off any loose ash. For a deeper clean, soak the screen in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and let it dry completely before dropping it back into a bowl. Rotating a few screens from the box makes it easy to always have a clean one ready while the others are drying.

FAQ

  • Will these screens fit every 14mm bowl?
    They’re designed for standard 14mm glass flower bowls with a typical cup shape. As long as your bowl isn’t super shallow or oddly shaped, they should drop in and sit nicely at the bottom.
  • Can I use these with bowls that aren’t 14mm?
    They’re optimized for 14mm, but some people do use them in slightly different sizes if the inner bowl is similar and the screen can sit flat. For best performance and less fiddling, stick with true 14mm bowls or grab bowls sized to match from your favorite accessories setup.
  • How often should I replace a brass screen?
    Swap it out when it starts to warp, tear, or stay clogged even after a soak. With normal use and occasional cleaning, each screen can last through multiple seshes before it needs to be retired.
  • What’s the best way to clean them without wrecking my sink?
    Knock off as much ash as you can into an ashtray or trash first, then soak the screens in isopropyl alcohol. After that, rinse and dry thoroughly. If you’re dealing with concentrates too, it’s smart to keep a dedicated container near your concentrate jars so sticky parts aren’t going near your kitchen sink at all.
  • Are brass screens better than glass or stainless?
    Brass hits a nice middle ground: it’s sturdy, shapes well to the bowl, and holds up to repeated use. Some people prefer the feel of glass or stainless, but brass stays popular because it’s durable, easy to work with, and doesn’t shatter if you poke it a little too hard when you’re three bowls deep.
  • Can I use these in a dry pipe or just bongs?
    You can absolutely use them in hand pipes, spoons, and other dry pieces as long as the bowl shape fits a small screen at the bottom. Many people like screens in smaller pipes to stop bits of flower from pulling through and to keep the inside cleaner, just like with their water pieces or nectar collectors stations.
  • Do these come pre-cleaned or should I wash them first?
    It’s always a good habit to give new hardware a quick rinse or soak before first use, just to remove any dust or handling residue from packaging and storage. A fast clean before your first pack sets you up for a fresh-tasting hit right away and keeps the rest of your storage and packaging routine consistent.

This dugout is made for flower smokers who want something discreet, simple, and reliable for quick tokes during the day. Dip the end of the one-hitter into your flower stash to pack the bowl, then use it as your personal mini hitter for quick, controlled pulls. Back at home, you can empty and top off the stash section from whatever you’re storing in larger flower storage and packaging, then the dugout is good to go again for a few rounds before refilling.

FAQ

  • Does this dugout include the one-hitter bat?

  • What kind of material is the dugout made from?

    The body is made from wood with a rainbow stripe design. It’s built to feel solid in the hand and hold up to everyday pocket carry.

  • Can I use this with concentrates?

    This dugout is designed for ground flower and one-hitter use. If you’re working with wax or rosin, you’ll be better served with dedicated tools like rigs, bangers, and proper dab tools.

  • How do I clean the inside without damaging the wood?

    Tap out loose crumbs and use a small brush or cotton swab for the stash area. Avoid soaking the wood or using heavy cleaners inside; keep moisture light and let everything dry fully before closing it up again.

  • Is this better than carrying a small pipe?

    It depends how you like to sesh. A dugout keeps your flower, one-hitter, and poker together in a single block, which is great if you want something pocketable and discreet. If you prefer bigger bowls and longer hits at home, you might still want a spoon or bubbler plus a sturdy silicone pipe for when you’re clumsy or on the go.

  • Will this fit in a standard pocket or small bag?

    Yes. At 4 inches (102mm) tall and a classic dugout shape, it’s made to slide into most pockets, small bags, or even a car cup holder without drawing much attention.

  • How should I store my flower when I’m not filling the dugout?

With a 10mm joint and included glass tip, it’s a clean, straightforward way to run quick concentrate hits without dragging out a full rig.

Why You’ll Actually Use This

  • True grab-and-go dabs — 6.5 inches (165mm) overall length gives you a real nectar collector feel without being bulky in your pocket or bag.
  • Dialed for 10mm setups — 10mm joint keeps things tight and efficient, ideal if you already like smaller, terp-focused gear.
  • Smooth pulls — Glass construction and included tip keep the path clean so you taste your material, not hot metal or mystery coatings.
  • Easy to handle & pass — Straightforward shape and manageable length make it simple to use solo or in a small circle.
  • Zero-fuss cleaning — Full glass build means you can soak, rinse, and be ready for the next sesh without scrubbing tiny parts forever.
  • Color options to match your vibe — Multiple colors available so it doesn’t just hit right, it looks right with the rest of your kit.

Best for

This 6.5” 10MM Nectar Collector Kit is made for dabbers who love the ritual of a nectar collector but don’t want a huge, fragile piece living on the coffee table. If you’re running small amounts of concentrate at a time and want something that fits easily next to your other dab tools, this is your lane.

It’s also a solid backup or travel piece for people who already own bigger rigs or recyclers, but want a lightweight option that still feels like real glass, not disposable gear.

How to use it

Think of this as a slim, direct-path dab straw. You load your concentrates in a heat-safe dish, warm the glass tip, and gently bring it into contact with your material while you pull. The 10mm sizing keeps the airpath tight and efficient, so you’re not wasting vapor or hunting for flavor.

For a cleaner station, park the piece between hits on a nonstick dab mat instead of laying it straight on your table. It helps catch any stray drops and keeps sticky glass from bonding itself to your surface.

When you’re done and it’s cooled down, you can stash it in a small pouch, case, or even alongside your other nectar collectors so it’s always ready for the next quick sesh.

Specifications

Specification Detail
Length 6.5 inches (165mm)
Joint Size 10mm
Material Glass
Type Nectar collector kit
Use Concentrates
Colors Multiple colors available

Fit & Compatibility

This kit is built around a 10mm joint, so it plays best with other 10mm-sized accessories and setups. If most of your glass is 14mm or 18mm, you’ll want the right adapters on hand or plan to use this as a standalone straw-style piece, separate from your larger rigs and smoke shop products.

Because it’s glass-on-glass, keep an eye on fit and don’t force anything—if it doesn’t slide in smoothly, double-check that you’re matching 10mm joints correctly and that there’s no resin buildup on either side.

Care & Cleaning

Let the nectar collector cool completely before you even think about cleaning it. Once it’s at room temp, wipe off any visible residue. For a deeper reset, soak the glass in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry fully before using again.

If you like to keep sticky tools and tips separate from everything else, toss this in a padded pouch or stash box along with your favorite storage and packaging so it’s not rolling around in a drawer.

FAQ

  • Is this actually 10mm? Will it fit my tiny rig?

    Yes, this kit is specifically built around a 10mm joint, which is common on smaller rigs and compact nectar setups. As long as your piece is truly 10mm and not 14mm or 18mm, it should play nice without adapters.

  • Can I use this with flower instead of concentrates?

    No, this style is designed for concentrates only. If you want to run flower through a water pipe or mini rig, grab a dedicated bowl from our other gear instead of trying to make a nectar collector do double-duty. For storing your concentrates between dabs, pair this with heavy-bottom concentrate jars so your material is always ready to go.

  • How fragile is the glass?

    It’s solid glass meant for regular use, but it’s still glass—if it hits tile or concrete, there’s a chance it breaks. Treat it like you would any glass rig: set it down gently, don’t drop it in a backpack loose, and try not to knock it off the table when you’re a few dabs in.

  • What’s the best way to clean out heavy buildup?

    If resin really stacks up, a longer soak in isopropyl alcohol usually does the trick. You can gently shake the alcohol inside the piece to help loosen stubborn spots, then rinse well and let it dry completely before taking another hit.

  • Does this come with everything I need to start dabbing?

    The kit gives you the glass nectar collector setup, but you’ll still need concentrates, a small dish, and a heat source. A lot of people like to pair this with nonstick liners or non-stick PTFE when they’re handling stickier extracts.

  • Is 6.5 inches long enough to keep the heat away from my face?

    For typical nectar collector use, 6.5 inches (165mm) is a comfortable length. You’re not right on top of the tip, but it’s still compact and easy to control. Just give the glass time to cool between hits if you’re doing back-to-back dabs.

  • How does this compare to a full-sized rig setup?

    A full rig with a banger and carb cap will usually give you more water diffusion and a slightly cooler hit, but it’s also more parts to clean and carry. This 6.5” nectar collector is about speed and simplicity—less glass, fewer pieces, and a more direct line from concentrate to flavor. If you already have larger rigs or silicone bongs and rigs, this makes a great fast-hit companion piece.

Silicone and ceramic is a smart combo for a portable nectar straw. Silicone is flexible, tough, and forgiving—ideal for something that’s getting tossed into bags and glove boxes. Ceramic, on the other hand, excels at preserving flavor and handling high heat on the working end.

The 4.5″ Fume Bubbler is a compact glass bubbler made for flower lovers who want smooth, cooled hits without hauling around a big glass piece. At just 4.5 inches (114mm) and built around a 14mm joint, it’s small enough for a backpack but still has enough water volume to take the edge off your smoke.

Fume coloring gives each piece its own swirl of personality, so the one you unbox will be uniquely yours, not just another cookie-cutter bowl off a shelf.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Smoother flower hits — The bubbler chamber adds a layer of water filtration so your smoke feels cooler and less harsh compared to a basic dry hand pipe.
  • Pocketable size — At 4.5 inches (114mm), it’s easy to stash, toss in a bag, or keep in a desk drawer without turning your space into a full-blown glass shelf.
  • Easy pull with a 14mm setup — Standard 14mm joint means it plays nice with other 14mm flower accessories you already own.
  • Unique fume look — Fumed glass changes up in different lighting and over time, so your bubbler develops its own character as you sesh with it.
  • Comfortable in-hand — The compact, rounded profile is easy to cradle and pass without feeling like you’re holding something fragile and awkward.

Best For

This 4.5″ Fume Bubbler is made for flower heads who want water filtration without committing to a full-size water pipe. If your current rotation is mostly dry spoons or one-hitters and you’ve been thinking about leveling up to something smoother, this bridges that gap nicely. It also makes a solid backup or travel-friendly daily driver alongside any bigger pieces or smoke shop accessories you already run.

The Basics: How to Use It

Using this bubbler is as straightforward as it looks. Add a small amount of water into the chamber so the downstream section that sits inside the body is slightly submerged, but not drowning. You want just enough water that you hear a light bubble when you pull.

From there, treat the built-in bowl like any standard flower bowl: grind or break up your herb, pack it gently, and pull through the mouthpiece. The smoke will travel through the water first, cooling and diffusing before it reaches you, which is a noticeable upgrade if you’re used to dry pipes only. Set it down on a stable surface or even on a small dab mat between hits so you’re not worrying about knocking it over.

When you’re done, dump the water instead of letting it sit — that keeps flavor fresher and the piece from getting funky faster.

Specifications

Overall Length 4.5 inches (114mm)
Joint Size 14mm
Material Glass
Category Flower bubbler / flower bowl

Cleaning & Care

Let the glass cool off if you’ve just used it, then pour out the old water. For light maintenance, a quick rinse with warm water and a shake will knock loose most fresh residue. For deeper cleaning, soak the bubbler in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry completely before using again.

If you’re the type who likes to clean everything at once, keep your cleaning supplies and spare bowls together with your other smoking accessories so you’re not hunting around every time you want to freshen your glass.

Fit & Compatibility

This piece is built around a 14mm joint, which is one of the most common sizes in the game. That means it plays well with most standard 14mm flower bowls and attachments designed for 14mm connections. Since it’s a compact bubbler, it’s best used as a self-contained piece rather than a multi-part modular setup, but it still lines up with the rest of your 14mm collection if you like to swap and experiment.

If you ever decide you want to expand your lineup into something you can’t break as easily, this bubbler pairs nicely with unbreakable options from our silicone bongs and rigs so you’ve always got something that can take a hit in a backpack or at the park.

FAQ

Is this bubbler only for flower?

Yes, this 4.5″ Fume Bubbler is set up as a flower piece. The bowl and airflow are designed around dry herb, so that’s where it shines. If you want to run concentrates, you’ll be better off adding a dedicated rig or checking out small nectar collectors instead of forcing this piece into double duty.

Does it come with a 14mm bowl, or do I need to buy one?

This product listing is for the bubbler itself. As long as you have a standard 14mm bowl in your stash, you’re good to go. If your current setup is a different joint size, you’ll want to grab a 14mm-compatible bowl so everything fits correctly.

How much water should I use?

Use just enough water to cover the bottom of the downstem section inside the chamber so you get a clean bubble noise when you pull. Too much water can lead to splashback, too little and you lose the benefit of filtration. It’s easy to dial in after a couple quick test pulls.

How do I keep the flavor fresh?

Dump the water after each sesh instead of leaving it sitting overnight, and give the piece a quick rinse once in a while. Fresh water plus a clean chamber lets your flower actually taste like your flower, not like last week. If you’re storing bigger amounts of herb for a while, pair it with proper glass jars and packaging so your hits stay tasty.

Is this good as a first water piece?

Definitely. If you’re coming from dry pipes only, this is a nice intro to water filtration without committing to a tall bong. The 4.5″ size keeps it simple, easy to clean, and not intimidating, while still giving you a clear difference in smoothness compared to a regular spoon.

Can I travel with this bubbler?

It’s small enough to travel with easily, but it’s still glass, so treat it like any other piece of glassware. Wrap it in something soft, stash it in a padded pocket, and keep it empty and clean when you’re on the move. For more rugged on-the-go use, some people run this at home and use a backup from our silicone pipes lineup for the truly clumsy moments.

How often should I deep clean it?

That depends on how often you’re seshing and how picky you are about flavor. Heavy daily use might call for a deeper isopropyl soak every week or so, while lighter use can get by with less frequent cleaning. If you notice drag getting worse or the glass looking cloudy, that’s your cue it’s time for a reset. Keeping your gear tidy pays off, especially if you also take care of your flower and stash it in proper storage and packaging instead of letting it dry out.

Why You’ll Reach for This First

How to Use It

The basics are simple: this is a straight-shot chillum, so you’re just loading the bowl end, pointing the mouthpiece where it belongs, and taking your pull. The straight airway keeps resistance low, which is nice when you want a fast hit between errands or during a quick walk.

Because it’s compact, a little goes a long way — a small, even pack in the bowl helps it burn more consistently and keeps ash from pulling through. When you’re done, tap out the bowl gently, let everything cool, then give it a quick wipe or periodic soak so the frit and fuming keep shining instead of getting dulled by residue. Setting it down on a small dab mat between hits can help keep ash and resin off your table.

Design Details

The standout here is the fume frit ball section. The fritted glass is speckled with color, and the fuming adds that layered, shifty look that changes a bit as it gets some use and as the light hits it. Over time, as the inside picks up a little resin, the colors usually deepen and pop even more.

Because each frit and fume pattern is done individually, no two chillums are exactly alike. You’re not picking from a basic color chart — you’re getting whatever wild combo came out of the artist’s torch on that run. It’s the kind of piece that looks just as good sitting next to your silicone pipes as it does in your pocket.

Specifications

Material Glass

Joint Feature Tagged 14mm (plays nicely with 14mm-focused setups; intended as a hand pipe)

Care & Cleaning

Let the chillum cool completely before you do anything. Tap out the ash gently — don’t smack it on hard surfaces if you want it to live a long life. For everyday upkeep, a quick wipe or a little warm water swish goes a long way.

When it’s time for a deeper reset, soak the pipe in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with clean water, and let it dry before you put it back in rotation. A clean interior really brings back the clarity and color of that fume frit work, so it’s worth the occasional soak, especially if you’re the “heavy daily driver” type. Keeping your flower in sealed glass jars between uses also helps cut down on sticky buildup and keeps flavor on point.

FAQ

    It’s made from thick glass and built to handle real use, but at the end of the day, glass is glass. Treat it with basic respect: use a padded pouch, keep it separate from heavy items, and you’ll dramatically improve its chances of staying in one piece.

This cap is made for dabbers who want better function than a basic bubble cap, but still like simple, grab-and-go gear. If you’re running a small to medium rig with a 14mm joint and want more consistent vapor without upgrading your whole setup, this is a solid, low-cost move. Once your banger is hot and your dab is in, set the 1.5" Color Top Hat Spinner Carb Cap over the top of your 14mm banger. The cap helps trap heat inside the bucket and focuses airflow so your concentrate keeps moving and vaporizing instead of pooling in one spot.

Rest it on a clean dab mat between pulls so you’re not setting hot glass directly on your table.

Because it’s compact, this carb cap is easy to pocket, travel with, or keep paired with one dedicated rig so you always know where your cap is when you’re three dabs in and not in the mood to search the couch.

Pop the 18mm male joint into your bong’s 18mm female joint and pack your flower into the cup, letting the glass screen at the bottom support your grind. For smoother, cleaner use, keep your concentrates on a nonstick surface so you’re not digging in jars or scraping off glass. Dropping a small dab onto a dedicated dab pad or mat gives you a clean target and keeps sticky messes off your table.

  • Is this actually a flower bowl? Will it fit my 14mm bong?

    Always let it cool completely before handling. Once it’s cool, you can wipe away light buildup, and for heavy residue, soak the tip in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry before you use it again. Avoid soaking the silicone in alcohol — warm soapy water is better for the body.
  • Can I use this as my main dab setup at home?
    You can, especially if you like simple, low-profile gear. A full rig and banger will give you more water filtration and options, but a nectar straw is perfect for quick hits when you don’t feel like setting everything up.     The heat is focused at the titanium tip, so the body stays comfortable to hold under normal use. Just avoid heating too far up the metal section, and always keep your fingers on the silicone grip area, not near the flame or hot end.

  • How should I store this when I’m not using it?
    Let it cool, then stash it somewhere clean and dry — a small pouch, tray, or drawer works great. If you’re keeping a whole little dab kit together, pairing it with proper storage & packaging for your concentrates makes everything easier to grab when it’s time for a sesh.

The beauty of a nectar straw is the simplicity: instead of loading a banger, you bring the hot tip to your concentrate and sip straight from the source. The silicone body acts as your mouthpiece and handle, while the quartz tip is the business end that touches your extract.

Set your concentrate on a clean surface—ideally a nonstick dab mat or pad—so you’re not wasting anything on random tables or plates. How to Use It

Pop the 14mm male joint into any bong or water pipe with a 14mm female joint and you’re basically set. Grind or break up your flower, then pack the bowl so it sits evenly over the integrated glass screen — not jammed in, just a comfortable fill so it still pulls air smoothly.

For cleaning, let everything cool down, then dump any leftover ash. For deeper refreshes, soak the bowl in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it fully dry before tossing it back into your piece.

To keep the glass screen doing its job, don’t let thick resin build up around the holes. Every few bowls, tap out the ash and lightly poke around with a poker or cotton swab to keep airflow open. When things start looking dark and sticky, that’s your sign to give it an alcohol soak.

The 2" Clear Spinner w/ Color Top Carb Cap is a compact glass carb cap built for dabbers who want stronger spins and better flavor without a bulky cap blocking their view. At just 2 inches (51mm) tall with a top-hat profile and spinner-style airflow, it’s made to rip pearls and spread vapor evenly across your banger.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Sesh

  • Better vapor from the same amount of concentrate — spinner-style airflow helps push vapor and heat around the banger instead of letting it pool in one hot spot.
  • Gets your terp pearls moving — the directional spinner design is built to catch air and spin pearls for more even contact.
  • Easy to handle while you’re faded — the color top gives you a good grip and makes it easy to spot on a cluttered tray.
  • Works with most flat-top bangers — the compact 2" (51mm) size and top-hat shape sit nicely over common quartz banger styles.
  • Doesn’t dominate your rig — clear body lets you watch the function instead of hiding the whole bucket under a giant cap.
  • Affordable upgrade — quick way to step up airflow and style without swapping your whole setup.

Best For

This spinner carb cap is made for dabbers who are already running flat-top bangers and want more motion and flavor without going to some huge, awkward cap. It’s a nice match for smaller and mid-size rigs, including many silicone bongs and dab rigs that use standard quartz bangers.

How to Use It

Once your banger is ready, just set the 2" Clear Spinner w/ Color Top Carb Cap on top of your flat-top bucket. The cap’s internal spinner airflow is designed to pull air in and send it across the surface in a circular motion, helping pearls spin and concentrate vaporize more evenly.

You’ll get the best function with a level, flat-top banger and a reasonably smooth draw, so the airflow through the spinner path can actually do its thing. Setting your rig on a stable dab mat also helps keep your cap safe between hits instead of rolling off the table.

Cleaning is simple: let it cool fully first, then wipe off residue. For deeper cleans, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry will keep the glass clear and spinning freely.

It plays nicely with a lot of daily-driver rigs, from simple glass tubes to compact dab setups and nectar collector stations where you keep a traditional rig nearby for full dabs. Just make sure your banger isn’t domed or too angled.

    It’s designed for most standard flat-top quartz bangers. If your banger opening is roughly in the same size range as the cap’s top-hat section and it’s not domed or heavily angled, you should get a good seal and spin.

    “Better” depends on your style, but a spinner cap like this is great if you use pearls and like to see motion in the bucket. A simple directional cap works, but the spinner design adds more swirl and can help cover more of the banger surface when you pull.

The 2.5″ 14MM Color Lip Horn Martini Flower Bowl is a glass slide built for flower lovers who want both easy handling and a little flair. The martini-shaped bowl makes packing and clearing simple, while the side horn keeps your fingers away from the heat. At 2.5 inches (63.5mm) with a 14mm joint, it’s a clean upgrade for most standard water pipes.

Why You’ll Like It

  • Easy, even packs — Martini-style bowl shape helps you mound and level your flower without it spilling over the edge.
  • Less finger-to-heat contact — The glass horn handle gives you a solid grip so you can pull the bowl without getting cooked.
  • Quick clears — Tapered walls let ash drop out cleanly once you tap it, so reloads are fast.
  • Adds color to your setup — Color lip detail stands out against clear glass rigs and makes it easy to spot on a cluttered tray.
  • Drop-in replacement — Standard 14mm joint means it slides right into most daily driver pieces with no adapters.

Best For

This bowl is made for flower smokers who are picky about how their bowls pack and clear, but still want something simple and durable enough for daily use. It’s especially nice if you’re swapping bowls between a couple of pieces or passing around a single smoke shop style daily driver and want a handle that everyone can grab confidently.

How to Use It

Slide the 14mm joint into your water pipe’s female joint with a gentle twist to seat it snugly. Load the martini-shaped cup with ground flower, keeping it below the rim so you’re not knocking herb off every time you move the piece.

When it’s time to clear, grab the horn handle and pull straight up so you’re not twisting the joint or touching the hot glass lip. It’s a small detail, but that horn is clutch when you’re a few bowls in and don’t feel like playing “where do I grab this?” over the downstem and ash.

Between bowls, tap the bowl gently over an ashtray or on a dab mat or pad to knock out ash before your next pack. Let it cool before doing any deep clean so you’re not shocking hot glass with cold liquid.

Cleaning & Care

For quick maintenance, knock out ash while it’s still warm, then give the bowl a dry wipe or cotton swab to keep residue from building up. For deeper cleans, let the piece cool, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and dry fully before dropping it back into your favorite rig.

If you like keeping glass rotation-ready, stash clean bowls in a small tray or in empty storage containers so you always have a fresh one when the current bowl gets caked.

Fit & Compatibility

This bowl is built for any water pipe, bong, or bubbler with a 14mm female joint. If your current piece takes a 14mm male downstem or bowl, this will swap right in with no adapters or weird angles. It’s a solid pick if you tend to break bowls often and just need a dependable, easy-to-grab replacement that doesn’t feel like an afterthought.

If you’re building a full setup from scratch, pairing this with one of our heavy glass pieces and a simple scoop-style dab tool (for loading flower or hash) keeps your whole station feeling dialed instead of mismatched.

    If your bong or water pipe has a 14mm female joint, this bowl will drop right in. If you’re not sure, pull your current bowl and compare: a 14mm joint is smaller than a dime at the very end. For new builds or upgrades, you can always match this with pieces from our broader silicone bongs & rigs lineup if you want something unbreakable.
  • Is the horn handle strong, or is it fragile?
    The horn is fused glass, just like the rest of the bowl, and is meant to be used. It’s sturdy enough for daily grabbing and clearing, but like any glass detail, avoid banging it against hard surfaces or dropping it onto a tray.
  • How big is the bowl – small snaps or big packs?
    The martini shape is a nice middle ground: big enough for a solid personal bowl or a couple of passes, but not a giant party bowl. You can pack lighter snaps or mound it up a bit for longer pulls without it feeling oversized.
  • How do I keep it from clogging?
    Use reasonably ground flower (not dust-fine) and don’t overpack the bottom. After a few bowls, clear ash fully and give the bowl a quick wipe. When draw resistance starts to feel tight, it’s time for a soak in isopropyl, just like you’d do with your other glass and concentrate jars lids.
  • Can I choose my exact color?
    This piece comes with a colored lip in multiple color options. Availability can shift, so check the dropdown or product options on the page for what’s in stock. If you’re matching a specific theme, grabbing a couple of different colors isn’t a bad idea so you always have one that matches your favorite piece.

    It’s designed primarily for flower, but plenty of people layer in hash or other mixes. If you’re working with stickier material, consider keeping a small pad of parchment or nonstick paper nearby so you’re not leaving residue on your table while you prep.

    Let them dry fully after cleaning, then keep them in a padded spot: a lined drawer, a small box, or even wrapped in a soft cloth. If you’re already storing gear like extra glass, tools, and wraps together, folding spare bowls into that same setup with a few protective accessories keeps everything easy to grab for your next sesh.

The 14 M 90° Quartz Enail Banger is a quartz banger built for dabbers running an enail setup who want consistent heat without trashing flavor. With a 14mm male joint and a roomy 19mm bucket, it’s made to handle proper-sized dabs while keeping your temps stable. The dedicated coil peg locks your enail coil in place so you can focus on the sesh, not babysitting your hardware.

Why It Works

  • Locked-in coil, zero slip — Integrated coil peg keeps your enail coil from sagging or spinning mid-sesh, so heat stays where it’s supposed to.
  • Consistent temp, smoother hits — The 90° angle pairs cleanly with most rigs, helping your coil sit flat and deliver even heat across the bucket.
  • Room for real dabs — 19mm bucket diameter gives you plenty of surface area for bigger globs or multiple small pulls without instant flood.
  • Flavor-first material — High-quality quartz lets your terps shine and resists the off-tastes cheaper glass can bring once it’s been cooked a few times.
  • Dialed for daily use — Built for people who keep their rig warmed up for long stretches and want something that can hang every day, not just on special occasions.

Best For

This banger is made for dabbers who live on their enail—people who like a stable temp window for back-to-back pulls instead of reheating with a torch every time. It’s especially handy if you already have a favorite piece and want to turn it into a true daily driver without buying a whole new rig. If you’re building a full workstation, pairing it with a sturdy dab pad or mat keeps your glass and coil safe between hits.

How to Use It

Slide the 14mm male joint into a 14mm female rig, making sure the 90° angle keeps the bucket level and the coil sitting flat. Then seat your enail coil over the bucket so it rests securely against the coil peg—this peg is there to hold the coil in place and prevent it from drifting down the neck during use.

Once everything is stable and your coil is powered, let the banger come up to your preferred temp range, then drop in your concentrate and cap it with your favorite carb cap. When you’re done, let the banger cool down before touching it or moving your rig. If you’re working with premium rosin, consider staging your dabs ahead of time on proper parchment paper so nothing sticks where it shouldn’t.

For cleanup, let the banger cool down, then wipe out any leftover residue. For deeper cleans, a soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and full dry will keep the quartz looking clear and hitting clean.

Fit & Compatibility

This banger is designed to fit any piece with a 14mm female joint at a 90° angle. It’s ideal on compact rigs and recyclers where you want the bucket to sit upright and the coil to hug the side without awkward tilting. If you’re putting together a small but tough travel setup, this plays really well with unbreakable-style pieces from our silicone bongs & rigs lineup.

  • Ready-to-use bucket sized for most standard enail coils

FAQ

  • Will this fit my rig?
    If your rig has a 14mm female joint at 90°, this banger should drop right in. If your joint is 45° or a different size, you’ll want to measure or consider a different banger style.
  • What size coil works with this?
    It’s designed for standard enail coils sized for 19mm buckets. The coil peg helps keep those common coil styles locked in so they don’t slide off the bucket mid-heat.
  • Can I use this with a regular torch instead of an enail?
    You technically can, but this piece really shines with an enail coil since that peg is there specifically to anchor the coil. If you’re mainly torching, you might be happier browsing more traditional banger styles in our general smoke shop products collection.
  • How do I keep it from chazzing or getting cloudy?
    Let the banger cool slightly before cleaning, then wipe out leftover concentrate instead of letting it burn on. When it needs a reset, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well, and dry fully before heating again.

    No, this listing is just for the quartz enail banger. You can match it with any cap that covers a 19mm bucket; if you need an upgrade, check out our selection of carb caps to finish your setup.
  • Is quartz really better than standard glass for enails?
    For most dabbers, yes. Quartz handles repeated heating better, keeps flavor cleaner, and is less likely to crack from typical enail temps compared to basic borosilicate glass.
  • What’s the best way to store my concentrates for enail use?
    Keep them in airtight, non-reactive containers so they stay fresh and easy to scoop when you’re posted up at the rig. Heavy-bottom glass and nonstick options in our concentrate jars section are built exactly for that job.

The 3.5″ Fume Rasta Cane Triple Bulb Chillum is a compact glass one-hitter made for folks who want quick, tasty snaps without hauling around a full-size pipe. At just 3.5 inches (89mm), it’s pocket-friendly but still has enough length and shape to cool things down. The triple bulb body and fumed rasta cane work make it as fun to look at as it is to hit.

This is the kind of chillum you keep in your pocket, backpack, or tray for those “just one real quick” moments—simple, colorful, and surprisingly smooth for its size.

Why You’ll Reach For It

  • Smoother than a basic one-hitter — Triple bulb body adds a bit of airflow and cooling so your hits aren’t scorching.
  • Actually fits real pockets — 3.5 inches (89mm) is short enough for jeans, bags, or a small pouch without feeling fragile.
  • Lively rasta fume work — Inside-out cane design with rasta colors and fuming gives it that trippy, layered look that pops in any light.
  • Great for “just a couple hits” — Perfect when you don’t feel like loading a full bowl or dragging out the big glass.
  • Easy to stash, easy to rinse — Straightforward shape means simple cleaning and low-maintenance use.
  • Fun party piece — That triple bulb silhouette stands out in a pile of clear and plain spoons when you’re passing pieces around.

Best For

This chillum is made for people who like to keep it light and simple—small bowls, quick breaks, and no extra parts to lose. If you already have a big daily driver or a couple smoke shop staples at home and just want something minimal for pockets, hikes, and walks, this is very much in that lane.

It’s also a good fit if you prefer a one-hitter style over traditional spoons but still want a little bit of cooling and style, not a plain metal bat.

How to Use It

Think of this like a dressed-up, glass version of a one-hitter: pack, hit, tap out, done. The open end is your bowl; the other end is the mouthpiece. Smaller loads keep it tasting fresher and make it super easy to clear between hits.

The triple bulb design gives the smoke a bit more room to expand and slow down before it reaches you, which is why it feels less harsh than a straight tube. If you’re posting up at a table, set it on a dab mat or pad so you’re not rolling a hot piece across your coffee table or desk.

When it starts to feel restricted or taste off, a quick clean will bring the color and function right back.

Specs

Category One Hitter / Chillum Hand Pipe
Length 3.5 inches (89mm)
Material Glass
Style Triple bulb chillum
Design Inside-out cane with rasta colors and fuming

Fit & Everyday Use

The 3.5″ length makes this a true pocket piece—you can slip it into a small pouch, stash jar, or any compact carry setup without worrying about a long stem snapping. If you like to keep your kit organized, it pairs well with small storage and packaging options so you can carry a little herb and a little glass in one spot.

The straight-through chillum design means a simple airway with no crazy percs or chambers to clog, which is exactly what you want in something you’re grabbing for quick solo seshes or passing once or twice.

Cleaning & Care

Let the chillum cool fully before cleaning. Wipe off loose residue, and for a deeper refresh, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and let it dry before using again. Avoid dropping it on hard surfaces—this is solid glass, but glass is still glass.

If you’re someone who rotates between multiple small pieces, keeping this one on a tray with your other accessories makes it less likely to roll off or get stepped on.

Pair It With

Because this is a simple glass hand pipe, it plays nicely with almost any setup. Many people like to back it up with a more durable option like silicone pipes for camping, beach days, or anywhere you’re really not trying to risk your glass.

For home use, you can keep this chillum loaded and ready while your main piece lives on the table or near your glass jars and packaging, so you’ve always got a “quick hit” option without digging through everything.

FAQ

  • How big is the bowl on this chillum?
    It’s sized like a classic one-hitter—enough for a quick personal hit or two, not a full group bowl. That’s what keeps it efficient and easy to clear between uses.
  • Is the triple bulb just for looks, or does it actually help?
    It’s both. The bulbs give the smoke a little more travel and space, which helps take the edge off the hit compared to a straight micro one-hitter. They also make the rasta cane and fume work really pop visually.
  • Can I toss this in my pocket or bag?
    Yes, the 3.5 inch (89mm) length is very pocket-friendly—just be mindful it’s still glass. A small padded pouch or even a dedicated pocket in your mylar bag setup can help keep it safe on the move.
  • How do I clean out buildup inside the tube?
    Let it cool, then tap or gently scrape out loose material from the bowl side. For deeper cleaning, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let dry before using again.
  • Is this better than a metal one-hitter?
    It comes down to preference. Glass won’t add any metallic taste, and the triple bulb design gives you a bit of cooling and more visual flair. Metal bats are nearly indestructible, but this piece wins if you care about flavor and style.
  • Does it stand up on its own?
    Most chillums are meant to lay on their side, and this is no different. Set it on a flat surface like a tray or dab tool station so it doesn’t roll, especially when it’s warm.
  • Is every piece identical?
    No, that’s part of the charm. Because of the fume and cane work, each chillum will have its own slight variations in color patterns and intensity, but all follow the same rasta and triple bulb theme.

The 6.5″ Clear One Piece Honeycomb Nectar Straw is a compact, no-nonsense glass dab straw built for people who want quick, flavorful hits without hauling around a whole rig. At 6.5 inches (165mm), it’s long enough to stay comfortable away from the heat, but still small enough to stash easily. The built-in honeycomb disc acts like a splash guard, keeping hot oil where it belongs so you just get clean, tasty vapor.

Why You’ll Actually Use This All the Time

  • Way less splashback — The honeycomb disc acts as a barrier so you’re not catching hot concentrate in your mouth mid-sesh.
  • Grab-and-go dabs — One solid piece of glass means no joints, no clips, no water, just heat the tip and you’re on.
  • Smoother pulls — The flared mouthpiece feels better on your lips and helps you get a solid draw without fighting for airflow.
  • Travel-friendly size — At 6.5 inches (165mm), it fits easily in most cases or smell-proof pouches without feeling tiny in the hand.
  • Simple to keep clean — Straight, one-piece design makes it easy to soak, rinse, and get back to clear glass again.
  • Affordable daily driver — Priced at $13.99, it’s a solid upgrade from cheap throwaway straws without feeling like a museum piece.

Best For

This piece is made for dabbers who like the nectar collector style but don’t want to mess with multiple parts, water chambers, or fragile add-ons. It’s especially clutch if you’re running small to medium dabs straight from your dish, or if you want a dedicated travel straw you’re not scared to toss in a bag. Pair it with a nonstick dab mat and you’ve basically got a full mobile dab station.

How to use it

The beauty of a one-piece nectar straw is how straightforward it is. You heat the tip, touch it to your concentrate, and pull through the mouthpiece — there’s no water to fill, no awkward angles to line up. The honeycomb disc sits between the tip and the mouthpiece, acting as a splash guard so any hot oil that pops stays on the business end instead of shooting toward your face.

For comfort, hold it like a thick pen, keeping your fingers well away from the heated tip. Set your concentrates in a small glass or silicone container so you can gently touch the hot end to the material without scraping or digging. If you like to keep your flavors organized, using separate containers or concentrate jars for different strains makes this style of dabbing feel really clean and intentional.

When you’re done, let the straw cool before handling the tip. Once it’s back to room temp, wipe off any visible residue. For deeper cleaning, soak the straw in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry completely before your next sesh.

The basics

This is a straight, clear glass nectar straw with a honeycomb-style disc built right into the neck. That disc doesn’t just look cool — the multiple small holes break up any splash and help keep your pulls more controlled. Because it’s all one piece, there’s nothing to misplace, and no metal joints or silicone seals to wear out over time.

At 6.5 inches (165mm), it hits a sweet spot between control and comfort. Shorter straws can feel a little too close to the heat, while really long ones get awkward to aim. This length is easy to maneuver over your concentrates without feeling like you’re wielding a wand across the table. If you’re the type who likes to keep things minimal but still functional, it’s exactly that energy.

Specifications

Product Type Nectar collector straw
Length 6.5 inches (165mm)
Material Glass
Design One-piece glass body with integrated honeycomb disc splash guard
Mouthpiece Flared for comfort
Color Clear
Price $13.99

Fit & Compatibility

Because this is a standalone nectar straw, there’s nothing you need to “fit” in terms of joints or adapters — it plays nice with whatever small glass or silicone dish you already use for your concentrates. If you like to keep your dab space tidy and your gear protected, tossing it in with your other travel-ready smoke shop accessories makes it easy to grab in a rush.

Care & Cleaning Tips

To keep flavor clean and glass clear, don’t let residue build up forever. Let the straw cool after use, then wipe the tip and inside edge with a cotton swab or cloth to catch fresh reclaim before it hardens up. When it’s time for a reset, soak the whole straw in isopropyl alcohol, rinse thoroughly with warm water, and let it dry before putting it back into your case or using it again.

If you like to keep sticky messes off the table altogether, parking this straw on a dedicated accessory stand or tray between hits helps avoid rolling, clinking, or surprise tip burns on the coffee table.

FAQ

  • Is 6.5 inches long enough, or will I feel too close to the heat?

    6.5 inches (165mm) is a comfortable length for most dabbers — your hand stays well behind the heated tip, and the flared mouthpiece gives you a good grip point. As long as you’re only heating the very end of the straw, you won’t feel like you’re getting cooked during normal use.

  • Does the honeycomb disc actually make a difference?

    Yes. The honeycomb disc acts as a physical barrier between the hot tip and your mouth, so if your concentrate bubbles or pops, that splash gets broken up and slowed down. You still get direct, flavorful hits, just with less risk of hot oil making it all the way through.

  • Can I use this with any type of concentrate?

    You can run pretty much any standard dab-able concentrate with this style of straw — shatter, wax, crumble, rosin, etc. Just place your material in a heat-safe dish, like a small glass tray or one of your glass concentrate jars, and work from there.

  • How do I travel with it without breaking it?

    Because it’s glass, you’ll want a bit of protection. A padded pouch, hard case, or even wrapping it in a soft cloth and tucking it into a small bag works well. For people who are rough on gear, pairing it with tougher pieces like silicone rigs and bongs can help build a travel kit that can actually survive the trip.

  • How often should I clean it?

    That depends how picky you are about flavor. If you’re dabbing daily, a quick wipe after each sesh and a deeper soak every few days keeps it clear and tasting fresh. If you ever notice airflow getting restricted, that’s your sign to give it a proper soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry.

  • Is this better than using a full dab rig?

    They’re just different tools. A full rig with a banger and carb cap gives you water filtration and more dialing-in options, while this straw wins on speed, simplicity, and portability. A lot of people keep both — a rig at home, and a nectar straw like this for quick hits or travel. If you end up wanting a more traditional setup later, you can always add on a dedicated nectar collector kit or full rig to your lineup.

  • Can I use this on a workbench or press station?

    Definitely. If you’re pressing or handling rosin, it’s an easy way to taste-test small amounts without bringing out your whole glass collection. Just keep it parked on a heat-safe surface or rosin work area and make sure it’s cooled before you set it near any tools or materials.

Pick whichever side feels right for the texture you’re working with: one end can handle bigger globs, while the opposite side is perfect for breaking up pieces or nudging material exactly where you want it. When you’re done, let the hot end cool down before you wipe off residue. For a deeper refresh, you can soak the tips in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry before using again or tossing it back with the rest of your dab tools.

Use Handling and portioning concentrates

Fit & compatibility

This 4.5" Titanium Pitchfork Dab Tool plays nice with pretty much any rig setup you already own. It works with standard quartz bangers, nails, and even portable nectar collectors when you just need something to portion and stage your concentrate. The compact size also fits easily in most storage tubes, cases, or zipper pouches.

FAQ

Is 4.5 inches long enough to keep my fingers away from the heat?

Yes. At 4.5 inches (114mm), you get enough distance so your hand isn’t crowding the hot banger, while still keeping things balanced and easy to control. If you’re used to super long tools, this will feel more compact and precise, not cramped.

What kinds of concentrates does the pitchfork style work best with?

The forked tips are great for wax, budder, crumble, and similar textures that benefit from being scooped, split, or nudged into place. For super runny sauce or very soft live resin, a small scoop-style tool can help too, and you can keep both on your station along with your concentrate jars so everything is within reach.

Will this fit in my usual storage or travel setup?

Most cases and organizers that hold pens, small brushes, or other dabbers will handle a 4.5" tool no problem. If you carry your rig and accessories together, it’ll ride right alongside your banger, carb cap, and other accessories without taking up extra space.

How do I clean this titanium dab tool?

Let the tool cool, then wipe off any leftover residue with a cotton pad or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak the ends in isopropyl alcohol for a bit, rinse with water, and dry fully before using again or setting it back on your smoke shop gear station.

Is titanium really better than cheaper metal dab tools?

Titanium is tougher and holds up to regular heat and cleaning without flaking or bending the way some mystery-metal or coated tools can. If you’re dabbing often and don’t want to keep replacing tools, investing once in a solid titanium dabber like this pitchfork makes a big difference over time.

Does it work with both small and large rigs?

Yep. On smaller dab rigs the 4.5" length feels perfectly sized; on bigger pieces it still gives you good reach. You don’t have to change your tool when you swap from your compact setup to your bigger silicone rig or glass rig.

Is this overkill if I only dab occasionally?

Not at all. It’s simple, durable, and doesn’t require any special care. If you only break it out on the weekends, it’ll just sit there waiting and ready, instead of rusting, peeling, or bending like some bargain-bin dabbers.

If you’re running sticky concentrates and want one tool that can both scoop and scrape without bending or gumming up, this is it. The 4.5 inch (114mm) length keeps your fingers away from the hot zone while still feeling nimble in the hand.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • One tool, two jobs — Double-sided rake design lets you scoop, drag, chop, and scrape without swapping tools mid-sesh.
  • Built for high heat — Solid titanium construction shrugs off the temps your banger sees, so it won’t melt, warp, or flake.
  • Clean release from sticky concentrates — Smooth titanium surface helps concentrates slide where you want them instead of clumping on the tool.
  • Comfortable control — 4.5 inches (114mm) gives you enough reach over the rig while still feeling precise, not awkward or wand-like.
  • Won’t baby out on you — Titanium is tough; toss it in your bag or drop it on the table and it keeps on working.
  • Less residue buildup — The rake-style ends break up and move concentrate cleanly, so you’re not constantly fighting a stuck blob.

Best For

This titanium rake dab tool is made for dabbers who don’t want a whole roll-up of tools just to get through a sesh. If you’re running different consistencies throughout the week—sauce, badder, shatter, all of it—and need something that can handle them without bending or chipping, this is your daily driver. It also plays perfectly with compact silicone rigs and travel setups where space and durability matter.

How to Use It

Think of this as a precision stick built for sticky things. Use one rake end when you need to scoop or lift a chunk, and flip to the other side when you want to scrape the last bit out of a jar or guide concentrate exactly where you want it on the nail or banger.

The shorter 4.5 inch (114mm) length makes it easy to rotate between your fingers and hit the perfect angle, so you’re not awkwardly reaching over the rig and risking a drop. Set it down on your dab mat between pulls to keep your table from getting sticky.

When you’re done, let the tool cool off, then wipe off any residue. For a deeper clean, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse, and dry is all it needs before it’s back in the rotation.

Specifications

Category Dab tool / dabber
Material Titanium
Length 4.5 inches (114mm)
Style Double sided, rake style ends

Fit & Compatibility

This tool works with basically any dab setup you’re already running—bangers, nails, e-rigs, and nectar collectors that benefit from a little help staging your concentrate. The rake-style tips are especially handy for breaking up or moving thicker concentrates that don’t want to cooperate.

Care & Cleaning

Titanium is low maintenance, which is why so many dabbers swear by it. Let the tool cool, wipe off residue with a cloth or cotton swab, and you’re good for next time. For stubborn buildup, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before putting it back with your other storage and packaging gear.

FAQ

  • Is 4.5 inches long enough for my rig?
    Yes. At 4.5 inches (114mm), it’s ideal for small to medium rigs and most tabletop setups. You get enough distance from the heat so your fingers aren’t getting cooked, but it still feels compact and easy to control around the joint and banger.
  • What’s the advantage of the rake-style ends?
    The rake shape gives you little edges and points to grab, pull, and portion concentrates more precisely than a plain flat tip. It’s clutch for scraping jars clean and working with thicker textures. If you’re pairing it with glass or heavy-bottom concentrate jars, it really shines.
  • Will titanium affect the taste of my dabs?
    Proper titanium is neutral and doesn’t add flavor when used correctly. Most people notice cleaner, more consistent hits compared to softer metals or cheap coated tools that can degrade over time.
  • How do I keep it from getting permanently gunked up?
    Don’t clean it while it’s blazing hot—let it cool a bit, then wipe off residue. If you let build-up sit for a while, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse brings it back. Stashing it on a clean surface or dab tool stand or accessory tray between uses also helps keep it cleaner.
  • Is this better than a glass or ceramic dab tool?
    Different materials have different vibes. Glass and ceramic look pretty but can chip or break if they hit the floor. Titanium is much tougher, handles heat easily, and is a great choice if you’re clumsy, travel a lot, or just want a worry-free tool in your kit of smoke shop essentials.
  • Can I use this with all types of concentrates?
    Yes. The rake ends work well with most consistencies—shatter, crumble, badder, wax, sauce, and more. One side can be your general scooper while the other is your dedicated scraper or chopper so you’re not swapping tools all sesh.
  • Does the color or finish ever wear off?
    Because this tool is titanium (not a coated soft metal), it’s built to handle regular use and cleaning without flaking or peeling. As with any metal gear, minor surface marks over time are normal but won’t affect how it works with your other glass and extract packaging setups.

The clear body keeps things clean and classic, while the colored horn gives you something solid to grab so you’re not touching hot glass. At 2 inches (51mm) tall with a standard 14mm joint, it drops right into most daily driver bongs without any drama.

Key Benefits

  • Easy grabs, no cooked fingers — The color horn acts like a built-in handle, so you can pull the bowl without reaching toward the hot end.
  • Fits most 14mm rigs and bongs — Standard 14mm male joint means it plays nice with the majority of modern water pipes using 14mm female joints.
  • Clean look with a pop of color — Clear glass keeps the piece looking crisp while the horn adds personality so you can tell your bowl from everyone else’s on the table.
  • Solid everyday glass — Simple, no-gimmick construction that’s easy to clean and tough enough for regular rotation when you’re swapping between pieces.
  • Quick swap backup — Perfect as a replacement bowl when your original gets too gunked up or takes a tumble.
  • Multiple color options — Pick the horn color that vibes with your favorite setup or keep a couple on hand to color-code different pieces.

Best for

This bowl is made for people who actually use their gear daily — bong smokers who are pulling the slide all the time and want something easy to grip, even mid-sesh. It’s especially handy if you’ve got a favorite glass piece and just need a reliable 14mm bowl to bring it back to life without buying a whole new setup from the broader world of smoke shop products.

How to use it

Pop the 14mm male joint into any water pipe with a 14mm female joint and you’re ready to go — no adapters, no weird fit issues. Load your favorite flower into the bowl, use the horn to pull it when you’re ready to clear, and set it down somewhere stable so you’re not risking a drop when you’re nice and relaxed.

For a smoother, less messy setup, park your piece and this bowl on a nonstick dab mat so any ash or stray plant material is easy to wipe up instead of grinding into your table. After your sesh, let the bowl cool, then tap or dump the ash out and give it a quick wipe so it stays clear and doesn’t build up burnt residue.

The basics

This is a straightforward flower bowl — no percs, no built-in screen, no weird shapes to trap gunk. That simplicity is the point. The horn gives you a reliable handle, so even when you’re a few bowls deep, you’ve got a clean, cool spot to grab. If you like keeping different strains or pieces organized, grab a couple in different horn colors and dedicate each one to a certain flower, then stash extras alongside your jars and other storage & packaging gear.

Let the bowl cool completely before handling or cleaning. Tap out ash and loose material, then wipe off residue.     Don’t overpack, and tap out the ash after each use so it doesn’t harden and cake up. A quick soak in isopropyl alcohol every so often keeps the airflow open and the glass looking fresh, especially if you’re burning stickier or resin-heavy flower stored in good concentrate jars or glass containers.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built as an everyday flower bowl — sturdy enough for regular swapping and pulling. That said, it’s still glass, so try not to knock it off the table or sink it into a hard surface when you’re cleaning.

The Reverse Tweezer is a stainless-steel, self-clamping grabber built for dabbers who are always juggling hot gear and tiny parts. If you’re tired of fighting weak spring tweezers or dropping hot pieces mid-sesh, this reverse-action design does the gripping for you. At $14.99, it’s a small upgrade that makes a big difference in control, especially when you’re working close to a hot banger or delicate glass.

Why It Works

  • Hands that don’t cramp — Reverse action means they stay clamped when you let go, so you’re not white-knuckling a tiny spring while hovering over heat.
  • Dialed-in precision — Pointed tips make it easy to grab carb caps, pearls, inserts, or hardware without blocking your view.
  • Solid around heat — Stainless steel construction handles the warmth of nearby nails and tools without getting soft or sketchy.
  • Fewer “oh no” moments — Stable grip helps prevent slips when you’re moving hot glass or sticky tools, so you’re not explaining broken pieces later.
  • Daily-driver durability — Built to keep its tension and tip shape through regular use instead of bending out on week two.
  • Multi-use in the lab or at home — Just as useful at a home dab station as it is on a processor’s bench for small parts and accessories.

Best For

Ideal for dabbers who run multiple seshes a day and constantly swap bangers, pearls, or inserts, and for anyone with shaky hands or grip fatigue who wants a steadier hold on hot gear. Also a clutch tool for processors who already keep a dab mat on the table and need something precise for handling small, heat-adjacent components.

How to Use It

Reverse tweezers work opposite of normal tweezers: at rest, the tips are closed and clamped. Give them a gentle squeeze to open the tips, position them around what you want to grab, then ease off your grip and let the spring action close them back down for you.

They shine when you’re repositioning hot accessories around your rig, adjusting a cap stand, or moving tools that are too close to a fresh nail for bare fingers. Set them down on a heat-safe accessory station between uses so they’re easy to grab again when you’re in the flow.

For lighter tasks, like picking up inserts, pearls, or non-sticky pieces, just use the very tips for max precision. For bulkier items, slide whatever you’re holding deeper into the jaws so the pressure is spread out and less likely to slip.

Specifications

Category Essentials & Accessories / Dab Tools
Action Style Reverse (stays closed when not squeezed)
Material Stainless steel
Tip Style Pointed
Price $14.99

Fit & Compatibility

This Reverse Tweezer isn’t locked to any one brand or setup — it plays nice with whatever rig and tools you already love. It’s especially handy if your table is already full of small dab tools, pearls, and caps, or if you run compact setups like nectar collectors and need something precise to handle hot tips and accessories without getting too close.

Care & Cleaning

Let the tweezers cool before cleaning, then wipe off any residue with a cloth or paper towel. For a deeper clean, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and full dry keeps the stainless steel looking fresh and helps prevent buildup around the tips.

FAQ

  • Will these tweezers get damaged by heat?
    The stainless steel build is made to live around hot gear and high-temp zones. Just avoid leaving the tips sitting directly in a red-hot surface and let them cool naturally between uses. When they’re not in your hand, parking them near your rig on a dedicated smoke shop station keeps things safe and organized.
  • Are they good for handling sticky concentrates directly?
    You can use them to move tools or accessories that touch concentrates, but most people use them to handle hot or delicate parts, not the extract itself. If you want to keep sticky material contained, pairing your tools with proper storage and packaging usually works better.
  • Will these work with my small inserts and terp pearls?
    Yes, the pointed tips are great for small items as long as you’re gentle with your grip. They give you enough precision to pick up tiny parts without crushing or flinging them, which helps when you’re working over glass or trying not to lose a pearl in the carpet.
  • Do they lock, or do I have to keep squeezing?
    The reverse design means they clamp shut on their own. You squeeze to open, relax to grip. That’s why they’re easier on your hands than standard tweezers when you’re holding something for more than a second or two.
  • Are these only for dabbing, or can I use them for other tasks?
    They’re marketed toward dabbers, but they’re handy for anything that needs a steady hold on small or hot items — think tiny hardware, electronics bits, or craft work. If your setup already includes things like dedicated parchment handling or other fine tools, these slide right into that workflow.
  • Will they rust if I clean them often?
    Stainless steel is naturally resistant to rust and corrosion. As long as you dry them completely after rinsing or soaking, they’ll stay in good shape even with frequent cleaning.
  • Do I need these if I already have regular tweezers?
    If your current tweezers are doing the job and your hands never get tired, you might be fine. But if you’ve ever dropped something hot because your grip slipped or your hand cramped, the reverse action on these is a very real upgrade over standard tweezers.

The 2" Clear Heavywall Ball Carb Cap is a glass carb cap built for dabbers who actually care about airflow and flavor, not just clouds. Its thick, heavywall construction feels solid in the hand and shrugs off regular heat cycles, while the rounded ball design lets you steer airflow across your puddle so you’re not leaving oil stuck on the edges of your banger.

If you’re the type who likes to finish a dab clean with smooth, controlled pulls instead of hot, wasteful blasts, this cap earns its spot as a daily driver. The 2-inch (about 51mm) size gives you enough grip to spin and angle it comfortably without getting your fingers cooked over the bucket.

Key Benefits

  • Get more from every dab — The ball shape lets you direct airflow across your oil for more complete vaporization and less waste stuck on the sides.
  • Solid, heavy feel in the hand — Thick heavywall glass means it doesn’t feel flimsy, and holds up well to normal heat cycles and everyday seshes.
  • Smoother, tastier pulls — Restricting and redirecting airflow helps keep temps in a sweeter spot, so terps pop instead of getting roasted.
  • Easy to spin and control — Rounded body makes it simple to tilt, spin, or park it on top of the banger without awkward fumbling when you’re mid-dab.
  • Simple, clear glass look — Clean, transparent design matches pretty much any rig setup and lets you see exactly what your puddle is doing.
  • Plays nice with common setups — Designed for use with most standard quartz bangers, so you can drop it into your current lineup without redoing your whole rig.

Best For

This ball carb cap is made for dabbers who already have a consistent setup and want to tighten up their airflow game without overcomplicating things. If you’re running a simple rig with a bucket banger and want more control over how your puddle moves, this is a nice upgrade from the random cap that came with your first kit. It also pairs well with unbreakable daily drivers like our silicone bongs & rigs if you like a low-stress, toss-it-in-the-bag type setup.

How to Use It

Once your banger is at the temp you like and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, set the ball carb cap on top of the bucket. From there, you can lightly spin or tilt it to change where the air hits your puddle and how fast it moves. Small angle changes can make a big difference in how evenly the oil spreads out and vaporizes.

If you like to keep your sesh station clean, park your cap on a dab mat when it’s not in use so you’re not gluing it to the table with stray reclaim. The smooth glass surface also makes it easy to wipe between dabs if you get a little splash back.

For people who bounce between different rigs or bangers, this style carb cap is a good "one and done" option that works with a lot of setups. Just make sure your banger has a flat or slightly beveled top so the cap can sit and seal properly.

Specifications

Spec Details
Type Ball-style carb cap
Material Clear heavywall glass
Diameter (overall height) 2 inches (approx. 51mm)
Color Clear

Fit & Compatibility

This 2" Clear Heavywall Ball Carb Cap is built to play nicely with most common quartz bucket bangers. As long as your banger top is flat or beveled and not oversized, you’ll get a solid seal and easy control over airflow. It’s especially at home on standard-sized buckets that you’d typically pair with your go-to dab tools and pearls.

Because it’s clear glass and not an oddly shaped novelty piece, it looks right at home on almost any rig — from small recyclers to chunky daily drivers. Just treat it like any other glass accessory: avoid hard drops and don’t force it against your banger if things are stuck or too hot.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool down fully before you even think about cleaning it. Once it’s at room temp, you can wipe off light residue with a swab. For a deeper reset, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh. If you keep your other glass and glass jars & packaging clean, adding this to the routine is painless.

Why Heavywall Glass Matters

Heavywall glass isn’t just a marketing term here — the extra thickness gives this carb cap more thermal stability and better durability than skinny, cheap caps. That means it’s less likely to feel sketchy when you’re moving it around over a hot banger, and you’re not babying it every time you set it down.

That added mass also helps maintain a more consistent environment over the top of your banger. Instead of air rushing in from all sides and spiking temps up and down, you get a more controlled mix, which is exactly what you want if you’re trying to really taste your concentrates instead of just blasting through them. It’s a small upgrade that you’ll notice after a couple seshes, especially if you’ve been using thin glass caps before.

Pair It With

This ball carb cap plugs right into most dab setups, but it really shines when you build a simple, efficient station around it. Match it with proper storage like heavy-bottom concentrate jars so your extracts stay clean and easy to scoop, and keep your work area dialed so you’re not chasing sticky glass around your coffee table.

If you’re upgrading your whole kit, it also plays well with other smoke shop products from Oil Slick — think tools, rigs, and accessories that are built to survive regular use without turning into a headache after a month.

FAQ

  • Will this carb cap fit my banger?
    It’s designed to work with most standard quartz bucket bangers that have a flat or slightly beveled top. As long as your banger isn’t oversized and the opening isn’t tiny, you should get a solid seal and good airflow control. If you’re grabbing new glass anyway, it’s easy to pair this with rigs from our silicone pipes collection for a durable travel setup.
  • How big is the carb cap exactly?
    The cap measures about 2 inches (51mm) overall. That size gives you enough room to grip and spin it comfortably without hanging your fingers over the hot zone above the banger.
  • Is the glass really that thick?
    Yes, this is a true heavywall glass piece. It’s noticeably thicker than budget caps, which helps with durability and heat handling. That said, it’s still glass — avoid drops onto hard surfaces so you’re not explaining a shattered cap to your roommate.
  • How do I clean off reclaim and residue?
    Let the cap cool completely so you’re not shocking hot glass. Wipe off light buildup with a cotton swab, and for heavy grime, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and dry. Keeping your concentrates in clean, sealed storage & packaging also helps cut down on sticky messes.
  • Does this work with terp pearls or other inserts?
    Yes. The directional-style control you get from a ball cap plays nicely with pearls and similar inserts, since you can adjust airflow to help them spin and move your puddle around the bottom of the banger.
  • Is this better than a flat-style carb cap?
    Different style, different feel. Flat caps mostly just restrict air; this ball cap lets you actually steer and direct airflow. If you like to fine-tune your hits and get more from each dab, the ball shape is usually an upgrade over basic flat caps.
  • Can I use this with every rig I own?
    As long as the rig has a compatible banger on it, you’re good. If you run multiple setups, you might find this becomes your "one cap to rule them all" since it works across a wide range of gear and plays well with most carb caps-style setups you already know.
