The 4″ 14MM Quartz Nectar Straw is a compact, straight-shot dab straw built for concentrate fans who want something simple, clean, and tough. At just 4 inches (102mm) long with a 14mm sandblasted joint, it’s made for quick hits, easy handling, and solid connections without extra parts or bulk. If you like tasting your terps straight from the source without dragging out a whole rig, this little quartz straw is the no-fuss tool that actually gets used.

Key Benefits

  • Pure flavor, no mystery metals — Full quartz construction keeps the path clean so you’re tasting your concentrate, not your gear.
  • Easy to stash and travel with — 4 inches (102mm) is short enough to pocket or toss in a case without taking over your bag.
  • Secure connections — Sandblasted 14mm joint bites just enough to feel snug when paired with compatible glass or adapters.
  • Quick heat-up, quick cooldown — Quartz responds fast, so you’re not waiting forever between dabs or during cleanup.
  • Simple, one-piece design — No extra chambers, clips, or gimmicks to lose when you’re a few dabs deep.
  • Great backup or daily beater — Affordable enough to be your travel straw, sturdy enough for everyday use.

Best For

This 4″ quartz nectar straw is made for dabbers who like to keep things minimal: small desk, small bag, big flavor. It shines if you mostly dab from a stable surface like a silicone tray or dab mat and don’t always want to commit to a full rig setup.

  • People who micro-dose or take quick hits throughout the day
  • Concentrate fans who travel or bounce between spots and need something low-profile
  • Anyone who prefers quartz for flavor and clean-up over metal tips
  • Dabbers looking for a simple, 14mm-friendly straw that plays nice with existing glass

How to use it

The 4″ 14MM Quartz Nectar Straw keeps the whole process straightforward: just your concentrate in a dish, the straw, and a heat source. No water chambers, no extra pieces to assemble every time you want a hit.

Use it with your concentrates laid out in a small dish or nonstick surface, keeping the tip and your material on a steady table so you’re not chasing things around. Between dabs, you can rest it carefully on a heat-safe surface or alongside other dab tools to keep your station organized.

When you’re done for the sesh, let the quartz cool off fully before you touch the tip or clean it. Once it’s back to room temp, you can wipe off residue; for deeper cleans, a quick soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry will keep it clear and tasting fresh.

The basics of quartz nectar straws

Nectar straws (a.k.a. nectar collectors or honey straws) flip the usual dab setup: instead of dropping your concentrate onto a hot surface, you bring the hot tip to the concentrate. That makes them great for people who don’t want to keep a full rig and banger out all the time.

Quartz is the go-to for flavor chasers because it doesn’t add taste and handles heat well. On a short straw like this 4″ version, that also means less distance for vapor to travel, so you get dense, direct hits and can really taste how good (or not) your material is. If you’re already packing your sauce away in tight-sealing concentrate jars, this kind of straw really shows off what you’ve been saving.

Specifications

Length Joint Size Material Joint Finish
4 inches (102mm) 14mm Quartz Sandblasted

Fit & Compatibility

The 4″ 14MM Quartz Nectar Straw uses a 14mm sandblasted joint, which is one of the most common sizes in glass. That means it can work with compatible 14mm accessories and adapters in your existing lineup, so you’re not locked into some weird proprietary size. If you already run 14mm rigs or silicone bongs & rigs, you’ll feel right at home with this straw in the mix.

Care & Cleaning

Quartz is pretty forgiving as long as you don’t thermal shock it. Let the straw cool naturally before you try to clean or rinse it. For light build-up, a quick wipe goes a long way; for heavier residue, soak in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with warm water and let it fully dry before your next sesh.

If you’re the type to clean as you go, keeping a small container or tray with cleaning supplies near the rest of your smoke shop accessories makes it easier to actually stay on top of maintenance instead of letting it get caked.

FAQ

  • Is 4 inches too short for comfortable hits?

    4 inches (102mm) is on the compact side, but that’s the point: it’s made for quick, direct hits and easy portability. As long as you’re mindful of where you hold it and give the tip space to cool between uses, most dabbers find this length very manageable and easy to control.

  • Will this work with my existing 14mm gear?

    It’s built around a 14mm sandblasted joint, so it plays well with most 14mm-compatible glass and adapters. If you’re already running 14mm bowls or similar fittings on your other smoke shop pieces, chances are you’ll be able to integrate this straw into your setup easily.

  • What’s the advantage of quartz over titanium or glass tips?

    Quartz is the sweet spot for flavor and heat handling. Compared to titanium, it usually tastes cleaner and doesn’t have that metallic feel; compared to softer glass, it often stands up better to repeated heating. If you care about tasting your terps and keeping the path clean, quartz is a solid choice.

  • How do I keep it from getting too gunked up?

    The easiest move is to avoid overloading your concentrate surface and to wipe the tip once it’s cooled down after use. If you’re working with especially sticky hashes or sauces, pairing this with proper nonstick storage like good storage & packaging options helps cut down on random buildup.

  • Can I use this as a regular glass piece or bowl?

    No, this is specifically a nectar straw-style tool meant for dabbing concentrates by contacting them with the heated quartz tip. It’s not shaped or designed to be used as a bowl or traditional pipe.

  • Is this a good option for beginners?

    Yes, if you’re new to nectar straws and want something simple, this is a good starting point. There are no moving parts, and the 14mm joint size is common, so you’re not fighting with compatibility. Many beginners like pairing a straw with a small rig or other nectar collectors to figure out what style they prefer.

  • How often should I replace it?

    Quartz doesn’t really “wear out” from normal use, but if you drop it, chip it, or notice cracks, it’s time to swap it out. With reasonable handling and regular cleaning, a quartz nectar straw like this can stay in your lineup for a long time.

It’s sized right for personal snaps or shared bowls, and the 14mm sandblasted joint gives you a snug, reliable fit on standard 14mm female pieces. Clear marble accents double as both grip and style, so you’re not fumbling your bowl when things get a little sticky.

This piece keeps your setup clean and straightforward: small footprint, solid function, and just enough color to stand out without looking loud.

Why you’ll actually use this bowl

  • Easy pulls, no drama — 14mm joint size matches most modern bongs and rigs, so it just slides in and seals up without wiggling.
  • Less slipping, more ripping — Clear marble accents give you a legit grip point for clearing or pulling the bowl without burning your fingers.
  • Dialed for daily use — Simple 2 inch (51mm) profile is small enough for easy cleaning but big enough to pack a proper bowl.
  • Adds color without being cheesy — Colorful glass with clear marbles looks clean on the table and doesn’t scream novelty piece.
  • Won’t fight your setup — Sandblasted joint helps it lock into place smoothly instead of squeaking or spinning.

Best for

This 2" 14MM Color Flower Bowl is made for people running 14mm water pipes as their go-to daily driver, who want a bowl that’s easy to grab, clear, and clean. It’s also a nice upgrade if you snapped your stock bowl or you’re switching between different herbs and want a dedicated head for each, especially if your main piece is a sturdy silicone or glass tube from our broader smoke shop products lineup.

How to use it (and get the most out of it)

Load your favorite flower into the bowl, making sure not to overpack the bottom so airflow stays smooth. Slide the 14mm male sandblasted joint into any 14mm female downstem or joint on your water pipe, and you’re good to go. The marbles make it easy to pull the bowl when it’s time to clear your hit, so you’re not grabbing hot glass directly.

If you like keeping your station tidy, park your piece on a nonstick dab pad or mat so ash and stray herb don’t end up all over the coffee table. It also gives your bowl a soft landing instead of tapping it straight onto glass or a hard surface.

When you’re done, let the bowl cool before dumping ash out or tapping it gently. For people who swap bowls frequently—say you switch between flower and concentrates on the same table—having a couple of different heads sitting near your accessories makes it easy to grab what you need without reloading mid-sesh.

Between uses or when traveling, you can keep your favorite flower strain nearby in proper packaging pulled from our wider storage and packaging collection so what you’re packing into the bowl actually tastes like it should.

Specifications

Category Flower bowl (dry herb slide)
Material Glass
Joint Size 14mm male
Joint Finish Sandblasted
Length 2 inches (51mm)

Fit & compatibility

This bowl is designed for any piece with a 14mm female joint. That includes most modern midsize bongs, rigs, and hybrids—anything that takes a standard 14mm flower bowl will play nice with this one. It’s not meant for 10mm or 18mm setups, and it won’t adapt without a separate reducer or adapter.

If you’ve got a compact rig from our silicone bongs & rigs collection and you want to run flower through it sometimes, this is the kind of simple 14mm bowl that makes the swap painless.

Cleaning & care

Let the bowl cool completely before handling. Dump out ash, then rinse under warm water. For deeper cleans, soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with clean water, and let it dry fully before using again. Avoid dropping it into the sink or banging it against other glass—marbles give you grip, but it’s still glass.

FAQ

  • Will this bowl fit my bong?
    If your bong or rig has a 14mm female joint, this bowl will fit. If your piece is 10mm or 18mm, you’d need an adapter—otherwise it won’t make a proper seal.
  • Is the joint frosted or clear?
    The joint is sandblasted, which gives it a frosted look and helps it seat more securely in your downstem compared to totally smooth glass.
  • How big is the bowl—personal or party size?
    At 2 inches (51mm) overall length, it’s a nice medium personal bowl. You can pack enough for a solid rip or a shared hit or two, but it’s not an oversized party bowl.
  • Are the colors random or can I choose?
    This style comes in multiple colors. Availability may change based on what’s in stock, but every bowl has the same 14mm sandblasted joint and clear marble grips.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from rolling or breaking?
    Use the marbles as set-down points so it rests more securely, and place it on a soft surface like a small dab tool mat or pad instead of hard counters. And as always with glass, avoid sudden drops or heat shock.
  • Can I use this on an oil rig?
    Yes—as long as your rig has a 14mm female joint, this will work as a flower attachment. If you’re swapping between this and a banger, consider keeping your concentrates in dedicated concentrate jars so your flavors don’t mix with flower residue.
  • How often should I clean it?
    If you’re using it as a daily driver, a quick rinse every day or two and a deeper alcohol soak when it starts to look cloudy keeps flavor and airflow on point. Heavy ash buildup will make hits harsher and can clog faster.

The CARB CAP Pack from What You Need is a mixed pack of glass carb caps for dabbers who like to tweak airflow, test different styles, and actually feel a difference in how their rig hits. It’s built for people who are past the “one cap does it all” phase and want options without dropping a ton of cash. At just about $2.50 per cap, you get multiple shapes in heat-resistant glass that can hang with your daily seshes.

Instead of hunting for a single “perfect” carb cap, this pack lets you build a little arsenal, so whether you’re hitting puddles or low-temp sips, you’ve got a cap that makes your concentrates work harder for you.

Why this pack actually helps your dabs

  • Dial in your airflow — Different cap shapes and styles let you adjust restriction, spin, and direction so you can match your cap to your banger and your hit style.
  • Use more of your concentrate — By trapping heat over the banger, each cap helps keep vapor in the dish longer so you’re not watching terps disappear into the air.
  • Experiment without overspending — Multipack pricing means you can try several carb cap designs for less than the cost of one fancy artisanal cap.
  • Survive daily heat cycles — Heat-resistant glass construction is built for real-world use, not just for looking pretty on a shelf.
  • Always have a backup — Drop one or misplace it mid-cleaning? You’ve still got more from the pack ready to go.
  • Match different rigs and bangers — A variety of sizes and styles means you can cover most of the 14mm and 18mm setups in your stash.

Best for

This carb cap pack is made for dabbers who actually notice the difference between a tight, milky pull and a thin, airy hit. If you’re running a couple different rigs or swapping between flat-top and deeper bangers, having a mix of caps just makes life easier. It’s also a good move if you’re building out a dab station with a solid dab pad or mat and want your whole setup feeling intentional instead of random.

If you’re the friend who hosts the sesh, this pack covers you so anyone can find a cap that works with your gear, without you handing over your favorite single cap to the clumsiest person in the room.

How to use these caps

Once your banger or nail is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, set one of the caps over the top of the banger to trap heat and control airflow. From there, the fun part starts: you can tilt, spin, or gently move the cap to change how air moves across the oil and how the vapor feels.

Some caps in the pack will feel more “open,” giving you quicker, airier pulls; others will be more restrictive, which usually means denser clouds and a slower, more controlled hit. Try different caps with the same banger, and you’ll feel how much airflow alone can change a dab. And if you’re already pairing it with a favorite rig or even one of your trusty silicone bongs or rigs, you’ll quickly figure out which cap is the new daily driver.

Between dabs, let the cap cool before you touch or clean it. When you’re three dabs deep and moving fast, having multiple caps in rotation also means you’re not forced to grab hot glass.

Specifications

Product type Mixed carb cap pack
Material Heat-resistant glass
Quantity Multi-pack (approximately $2.50 per cap)
Sizes Variety of sizes to fit most common bangers
Joint compatibility Plays nice with 14mm and 18mm setups (male and female, depending on banger design)

Because this is a mixed pack of styles and shapes, think of it as a toolbox: different caps will shine with different banger shapes and rig styles, especially if you rotate between pieces the way most dabbers do.

Fit & compatibility notes

These caps are designed to work with most standard quartz bangers rather than locking into the joint directly. If you’re using 14mm or 18mm rigs, they’ll typically sit over flat-top or beveled bangers just fine, regardless of whether your joint itself is male or female.

If you’re pairing them with more specialized setups like mini rigs, recyclers, or even compact nectar collector accessories, just make sure the banger or dish opening isn’t drastically oversized. As long as the cap can cover the top and create at least a partial seal, you’ll get the benefits of better heat retention and directed airflow.

Care & cleaning

Cleaning is straightforward: let the carb cap cool fully, then wipe off any fresh residue with a cloth or cotton swab. For deeper cleans, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh.

If you like to keep everything extra clean and organized, it pairs well with proper storage and some dedicated accessories at your dab station so your caps aren’t rolling off the table or getting stuck to random sticky surfaces.

FAQ

Will these carb caps fit my 14mm banger?

Yes, the pack is designed with a variety of caps that fit most standard 14mm bangers. Since they sit on top of the banger rather than locking into the joint, they’ll work with 14mm rigs as long as your banger opening isn’t unusually large or tiny.

What about 18mm setups?

Most of the caps in this pack also play well with common 18mm bangers, again because they cover the top instead of plugging into it. If you’re running a big, wide dish, just check that the cap can cover the opening enough to trap heat and restrict airflow.

Are these directional carb caps or just basic covers?

The pack includes a mix of styles, so some caps will feel more directional or adjustable than others. You’ll have options you can tilt and move to steer airflow and others that act more like simple heat-trapping covers. That’s part of the fun — trying each one and seeing what matches your rig and banger best.

Can I use these with spinner pearls or terp pearls?

Some caps in the mix may help move pearls around depending on their airflow style, but this isn’t sold as a dedicated “spinner cap” kit. If spinning pearls is your thing, you can still test each design and see which one gets the best motion in your setup, especially when paired with clean, evenly heated quartz and a dialed-in dab tool routine.

What should I do if the carb cap gets sticky or cloudy?

Let it cool off first, then wipe away fresh residue with a cotton swab or cloth. For more stubborn buildup, soak the cap in isopropyl alcohol, rinse it well, and dry it before using again. Keeping your caps clean not only looks better, it keeps airflow smooth and your hits tasting fresher.

Is glass a good material for carb caps?

Glass is a classic for a reason: it handles the heat, doesn’t add flavor, and is easy to soak clean. Just treat it like any other glass dab gear — avoid sudden impacts or drops, especially on hard surfaces. If you want caps that can roll around without drama, consider organizing them with your other gear or near your storage and packaging setup so they’re not loose on the table.

How does this compare to buying one premium carb cap?

A single high-end cap can be great if you already know exactly what airflow style you like. This pack is better if you’re still figuring that out, or if you run multiple rigs and banger styles. You get a range of shapes and feels for about the price of one fancy cap, plus you’ve always got backups — which matters when a buddy knocks something off the rig and you don’t want the sesh to be over. And if you’re already stocking up on glass or glass jars and packaging for your concentrates, it’s an easy add-on that upgrades how they actually get used.

The AR15-inspired handle gives you extra grip and personality without getting in the way of actually moving sticky concentrates.

This is the tool you grab when you want clean, controlled dabs and a piece that always gets a second look on the tray. The spoon-style scoop makes it easy to work with saucy, sugary, or crumbly textures without leaving half your dab stuck behind.

Why you’ll actually use this one

  • Controlled, clean dabs — Spoon scoop tip lets you pick up and place concentrates without them rolling off or smearing everywhere.
  • Fingers stay away from the heat — 6-inch (152mm) length keeps your grip comfortably away from hot nails and bangers.
  • Built to survive real use — Solid stainless steel construction handles daily heat, cleaning, and the occasional drop.
  • Grippy, AR15-style body — The rifle-inspired detailing isn’t just for looks; it gives your fingers something to lock onto, even if things get a little sticky.
  • Easy cleanup between strains — Smooth metal surface wipes down quickly so you’re not ghosting old flavors into your next dab.
  • One tool for most textures — Works well with shatter chunks, diamonds in sauce, sugar, badder, and rosin, so you’re not swapping tools every time.

Best for

The AR15 dab tool is made for dabbers who like their gear to have personality but still want it to work flawlessly three dabs deep. It’s a great fit if you’re running a dedicated rig setup and want a "main tool" that lives on your tray instead of constantly disappearing into drawers. If you already rock a durable setup with silicone rigs and bongs, this stainless dabber fits right into that unbreakable, low-maintenance lifestyle.

It also works well for newer dabbers who don’t want to baby glass tools or worry about snapping something delicate on the first drop. Stainless doesn’t care how clumsy your friends are.

How to use it

Using this dabber is pretty intuitive. The spoon-style end is designed to scoop, cradle, and guide your concentrates where they need to go, instead of poking at them and hoping they stick. Just load up what you need and move it cleanly from storage to your banger or nail without losing half on the journey.

Set it down on a nonstick surface or proper dab mat between hits so you’re not smearing sticky residue into the table or your clothes. The length and weight make it feel balanced in the hand, so it doesn’t roll away the second you put it down.

For cleaning, let the tool cool off, then wipe off residue with a cloth or cotton pad. For deeper cleans, soak the metal tip or the whole tool in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with water, and dry fully before your next sesh.

Specs

Material Stainless steel
Length 6 inches (152mm)
Tip style Spoon scoop
Design AR15-style handle

Fit & compatibility

This tool plays nice with pretty much any dab setup — rigs, e-rigs, bangers, and nectar-style setups where you’re loading material onto a hot surface. Pair it with proper concentrate jars to keep your extracts clean and easy to access when you’re scooping. The size feels right at home next to standard rigs without looking oversized or tiny.

Because it’s stainless steel, it’s a solid choice for both home stations and travel kits. Toss it in with your other dab tools and dabbers, and you’ve got a reliable backup if silicone or glass tools ever tap out.

Why stainless over glass or ceramic?

Glass and ceramic dabbers can be nice, but they’re easy to chip, crack, or snap when they hit a hard surface — especially when things get messy around the rig. Stainless steel gives you a heavier, sturdier feel with way less stress about breaking something you actually like.

It also handles repeated cleaning with alcohol and heat without getting cloudy or weird over time. If your setup already leans toward durable gear, like rugged smoke shop accessories, this tool fits right into that “grab it and go” style.

FAQ

  • Is 6 inches too long for a dab tool?
    No — 6 inches (152mm) is a sweet spot. It keeps your hand away from the heat of your nail or banger but still gives you enough control to place dabs exactly where you want them. It won’t feel bulky on a standard dab station.
  • Will this work with my small rig or mini setup?
    Yes, the AR15 dab tool works fine with both full-size and mini rigs. If you’re working with tiny bangers, just use the front edge of the spoon scoop for more precise placement. It’s versatile enough to be your main tool across different rigs.
  • Is stainless steel safe to use with concentrates?
    Stainless steel is commonly used in dab tools because it’s tough, smooth, and easy to keep clean. Just avoid overheating any dab surface and you’re good — keep things in the normal range you’d use with your other tools.
  • How do I clean off thick, baked-on residue?
    Let the tool cool, then soak it in isopropyl alcohol for a bit to loosen tough buildup. Wipe it down, rinse with water, and dry completely. You can keep it on a small pad near your rig accessories so it’s always clean and ready.
  • Is the AR15 design sharp or uncomfortable to hold?
    No, the design is more about texture and style than edges. It has enough detail to give you grip but it’s not sharp or painful in the hand, even during longer seshes.
  • Will it scratch my glass banger?
    Normal, gentle use should be fine — just don’t scrape aggressively against the glass. Think of it as a tool for loading and guiding your concentrates, not for digging or chipping at stuck residue.
  • Can I travel with this in a case or pouch?
    Yes, it’s a solid option for travel kits because it’s metal and not fragile. Just keep it with your other gear or in a small pouch, ideally separate from sticky concentrate containers or storage packaging, so everything stays cleaner.

Key Benefits

  • Clean, controlled scoops — KAR-98 spoon-style tip makes it easy to grab exactly as much concentrate as you want, instead of fighting with flat edges.
  • Less wasted extract — Smooth stainless finish helps concentrates slide off the tool instead of staying glued to it.
  • Fingers stay away from the heat — 6 inches (152mm) of length gives you comfortable reach over hot bangers and nails without feeling clumsy.
  • Built to survive daily use — Stainless steel construction can handle constant heating, cooling, and cleaning without bending or chipping like cheaper tools.

Made for

How to use it

Load up by dipping the spoon-shaped end into your concentrate and scooping or rolling until you’ve got your ideal dab size. The shape gives you enough depth to catch runnier textures without them sliding right off, while still working great for more solid waxes and crumbles.

When you’re ready to drop in, angle the tool over your hot surface and let the concentrate slide off the tip—no need to mash or scrape aggressively. Keeping your grip on the back half of the 6-inch handle helps you stay away from radiant heat, which is especially handy on taller rigs and deeper bangers.

Between dabs, you can rest the tool on a heat-safe surface or a silicone stand with your other dab tools so you’re not laying a sticky utensil straight on the table.

Let the tool cool fully before cleaning. For light use, just wipe off residue with a cloth or paper towel. For deeper cleans, soak the stainless steel in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh.

Why stainless steel for a dab tool?

Stainless steel is a classic choice for dab tools because it’s tough, easy to clean, and doesn’t mind repeated heating and cooling. It won’t chip like glass or deform like cheap mystery metal, so you can throw it in your kit or travel bag without babying it.

The 2" 18mm Clear Martini Screen Flower Bowl is a glass slide built for people who want cleaner flower hits without juggling loose metal screens. If you’re running an 18mm water pipe and are tired of ash pulling through, this compact martini-style bowl with its built‑in glass screen helps keep your piece cleaner and your hits smoother.

Why you’ll like it

  • Less ash in your piece — Integrated glass screen helps stop small bits of flower from getting sucked into your downstem or water.
  • Cool fingers, easy pulls — Side peg handle gives you something solid to grab so you can lift and clear without getting your fingertips toasted.
  • Ready for your 18mm setup — Standard 18mm male joint means it drops right into any 18mm female water pipe or bong.
  • Efficient bowl shape — Martini-style design keeps flower centered over the screen so it burns evenly instead of hugging the walls.
  • Clean look, easy to inspect — Clear glass makes it simple to see airflow, resin buildup, and when it’s really time for a deep clean.
  • Simple upgrade — Swapping this in for a basic funnel slide instantly tightens up your piece’s function without changing the whole setup.

Best for

This bowl is made for people who actually use their glass daily — the ones who don’t want to scrub their water pipe every night just because their last bowl dumped ash through the joint. It’s especially nice if you’re running your favorite piece on a dab mat and want to keep the grime inside the glass, not on the table.

How to use it

Pop the 18mm martini bowl into any 18mm female joint on your water pipe or bong. The built-in glass screen is there to support your flower and reduce pull-through, so you don’t need a separate metal screen unless you like ultra-fine filtration. Load the bowl with ground flower and make sure you’re not packing it so tight that you completely choke airflow through the screen.

Between bowls, you can give it a quick tap or gentle scrape to knock out ash and keep the screen from clogging. When you’re done for the night, just let the glass cool down, then clear out any leftover material before stashing your piece away with the rest of your smoke shop gear.

For cleaning, let the bowl cool, then wipe or lightly scrape off loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse well with water, and let it dry fully before using it again. Regular cleaning keeps the built-in screen open so you’re not fighting for airflow when you’re a few bowls in.

Specs

Product Type Flower bowl (slide)
Total Height 2 inches (about 51mm)
Joint Size 18mm male
Material Clear glass
Bowl Style Martini-style with built-in glass screen

Fit & compatibility

This 2" 18mm Clear Martini Screen Flower Bowl is designed for 18mm female joints only. If your piece uses a 14mm or 10mm joint, this won’t fit without a separate adapter. It works great as an everyday slide on classic straight tubes, beakers, or even some silicone bongs and rigs that use 18mm glass joints.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my bong?
    Yes, as long as your bong or water pipe has an 18mm female joint where the bowl sits. If you’re not sure, compare it to another piece you know is 18mm, or check what your last bowl was labeled as.
  • Do I still need a metal screen with this?
    No, the bowl has a built-in glass screen at the bottom that’s meant to hold your flower. Some people still drop a small metal screen on top if they’re using super fine grind, but it’s optional.
  • Does the built-in screen clog easily?
    Like any screen, it can clog if you run a lot of bowls and never knock the ash out. A quick tap after each bowl and an occasional soak keeps it flowing. Storing your ground flower properly in airtight glass jars can also help keep it from getting too dusty and powdery, which leads to faster clogs.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built for regular use, but it’s still glass — drop it on a hard floor and you’ll probably be shopping for another bowl. Treated with basic care, it holds up well as a daily driver slide.
  • How deep is the bowl?
    It’s a classic martini-style dish, so it’s wide with a nice moderate depth — big enough for a decent group bowl, but not so huge that you’re wasting flower when you’re just taking a quick hit. If you like to pack huge party bowls, you may want a larger slide in your rotation stored with the rest of your glass and accessories.
  • Can I use this on a piece I also dab from?
    Yes. If your rig has an 18mm female joint, you can swap between this flower bowl and a banger or nail. Just make sure everything is cool before swapping and consider setting your hot banger on a heat-safe stand or accessory mat instead of straight on your table.
  • How should I clean it without damaging the glass?
    Let it cool fully before touching, dump or gently scrape out the ash, then soak in isopropyl alcohol if it’s really gunked up. Rinse thoroughly with water and let it dry. For stubborn bits on the built-in screen, a soft tool from your dab tools kit can help loosen residue without scratching.

The 1.5" 10MM Quartz Nectar Tip is a compact quartz tip for nectar collectors, built for dabbers who want clean flavor and a low-profile setup that travels easy. The quartz heats evenly, holds up to repeated use, and keeps your terps tasting the way they should.

Why It Works

  • Terp-forward pulls — Solid quartz construction keeps your vapor clean and neutral, so you’re tasting your rosin or sauce, not your hardware.
  • Pocket-sized profile — The 1.5 inch (38mm) length keeps your straw short, balanced, and easy to tuck into a small case without a long, fragile tip sticking out.
  • Better grip and control — Carved maria rings give your fingers a solid purchase, so you can hover right over your puddle without sliding in too deep.
  • Standard 10mm joint — Built for nectar collectors and dab straws that use a 10mm connection, so upgrading your tip usually means just swapping it in.
  • Easy backup or daily driver — Affordable enough to keep a spare, durable enough to run every day without babying it.
  • Simple to refresh — Quartz releases residue more easily than cheap glass or metal, so a quick soak brings it back to clear when it clouds up.

Best For

This tip is ideal for dabbers who live out of a small kit — the kind of setup that fits in a pocket pouch with a couple dab tools and a jar of their favorite extract. If you like quick, controlled hits off a straw instead of firing up a full rig every time, this size and style just makes life easier.

It’s also clutch for anyone who travels, camps, or just doesn’t want a long, wand-like tip poking around in a backpack. Shorter glass means less leverage if it gets bumped, so it’s less likely to snap when your bag inevitably takes a tumble.

How to use it

Pop the 1.5" 10MM Quartz Nectar Tip into the 10mm joint on your nectar collector or dab straw, making sure it seats straight and snug so you’re not pulling any extra air. Once it’s locked in, you’re ready to warm the end and bring it toward your concentrates, using small, deliberate pulls so you’re just kissing the puddle instead of dunking the whole tip.

For less mess, stage your concentrate on a dish or nonstick surface set on a dab mat so any drips or misses land somewhere easy to wipe, not on your table or lap. That setup also gives you a defined "target" when you’re a few dabs deep and just want it to be simple.

When you’re wrapped up, let the quartz cool down completely before you pull it out of the collector. Once it’s at room temp, remove it carefully and stash it in a padded pocket, small tin, or tube so it’s not clinking around with keys, lighters, or whatever else is rattling in your bag.

The Basics

Nectar tips are about direct, controlled contact with your concentrates. Instead of loading a banger and capping it, you bring the heated quartz straight to the material and sip through the straw. That gives you fine control over how much you vaporize at a time, which is perfect if you prefer smaller, dialed-in hits instead of lung-busting clouds.

The short 1.5" length is intentional: it keeps your collector compact and maneuverable so you can reach the last bit of sauce at the bottom of a jar without smacking the edges. Pair it with solid concentrate storage — heavy-bottom glass concentrate jars are perfect — and you’ll notice smoother access to your material and less sticky chaos on your table.

Quartz is the standard for a reason. It handles repeated heating better than basic glass, doesn’t dump weird flavors into your vapor, and cleans up well when it starts to haze from use. As long as you avoid hard drops and keep it reasonably clean, this tip can stay in your rotation for a long time.

Length 1.5 inches (38mm)
Joint Size 10mm

Fit & Compatibility

The 1.5" 10MM Quartz Nectar Tip is made for nectar collectors and dab straws that use a 10mm joint. If your current piece already takes a 10mm tip, this should slot in and feel familiar right away, especially on smaller, pocket-sized straws where a long tip would throw off the balance and feel front-heavy.

If your straw uses a different joint size (like 14mm or 18mm), this tip won’t fit without an adapter, so give your gear a quick check before you add it to the cart. It also pairs nicely as a "quick-hit" option if your main setup is something like a rugged rig from the silicone bongs & rigs side of your collection, giving you a lighter, more portable way to dab the same concentrates.

Care & Cleaning

Always wait for the quartz to cool completely before handling or cleaning. For routine maintenance, wipe light residue with a dry cotton swab or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak the tip in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and let it dry fully before you pop it back into your collector.

If you’re pressing or handling your own rosin, keeping your prep area lined with proper sheets from the parchment papers collection helps keep random debris and buildup from ever reaching your tip in the first place.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my nectar collector?

    If your collector has a 10mm joint for the tip, you’re good — this quartz tip is made for that size and should slide in and seat like your current one. If you’re unsure, compare it to another known 10mm joint in your stash or look up your piece’s specs. If you’re shopping for a new straw to go with it, our nectar collectors & straws include options that play nice with 10mm tips.

  • Is 1.5 inches long enough for comfortable hits?

    For most compact handheld collectors, yes. The 1.5 inch (38mm) length keeps the hot end safely away from your face while keeping the whole setup short, less fragile, and easier to stash. If you really like a long, wand-style feel, you might prefer a bigger tip, but for travel, quick dabs, and small rigs this size hits a sweet spot.

  • How tough is the quartz?

    Quartz is built for heat, but it’s still glass — it doesn’t like meeting tile floors, concrete, or getting bounced around loose in a backpack. Treat it like any other glass accessory and store it with your padded or protected smoke shop accessories, and it’ll hold up just fine for regular use.

  • What should I do if there’s heavy buildup inside?

    Let the tip cool completely, then soak it in isopropyl alcohol until the residue loosens. Rinse with warm water and allow it to dry fully before using it again. Keeping your concentrates on clean nonstick surfaces, like liners from our non-stick paper & PTFE collection, also helps cut down on how much gunk ends up getting scorched onto the quartz.

  • Is quartz really better than titanium or cheap glass tips?

    If flavor matters to you, quartz is usually the move. It’s more neutral than titanium, so you’re tasting more of the actual terpenes and less of the hardware. Compared to basic soda-lime glass, quartz tends to handle repeated heating cycles better and feels more solid and reliable during a sesh.

  • What kinds of concentrates work best with this tip?

    It works with most consistencies you’d normally hit from a nectar straw — shatter, sugar, crumble, sauce, rosin, and similar textures all pair well. Just be mindful not to dunk the tip too deep into very runny material or flood the joint. Keeping everything organized in proper storage & packaging also makes it easier to work cleanly and avoid sticky surprises.

  • Is this a good first tip if I’m new to nectar collectors?

    Yes. The common 10mm size, compact length, and quartz material make it a great starter: it’s easy to handle, gives you clean flavor, and doesn’t feel huge or awkward. Once you’re comfortable with straw-style dabbing, you can branch out into bigger pieces or full smoke shop products like rigs and bangers, but this tip is more than enough to learn on and keep in your regular kit.

The 6″ CRUSH GLASS HANDLE W/ METAL TIP DAB TOOL is a glass-handled dabber built for concentrate fans who want accuracy, reach, and a little flex on the tray. At 6.0 inches (15.2 cm), it keeps your fingers comfortably back from the heat while the metal tip gives you solid control over sticky concentrates. The crushed-glass handle doesn’t just look wild under the light—it also adds real grip so you’re not fumbling your dab three seshes in.

Why You’ll Actually Use This Every Day

  • Confident reach over hot glass — 6.0 inches (15.2 cm) of length means you can work over your nail without feeling the heat on your knuckles.
  • Better grip, fewer drops — crushed-glass handle texture gives your fingers something to hold, even if they’re a little sticky.
  • Clean, accurate scoops — shaped metal tip makes it easy to pick up and place your dab exactly where you want it.
  • Looks as good as it hits — the encased crushed glass and iridescent-style metal tip add some personality to your kit.
  • Built for repeat seshes — glass handle and metal tip combo stands up to normal dabbing heat and regular cleaning.

Best For

This tool is made for dabbers who are past the “paperclip and pocketknife” phase and want something solid, cleanable, and nice to look at on the table. It’s a great daily driver if you’re already running a dedicated rig and like your station organized with a proper dab mat and tools that actually match the rest of your setup.

How to Use It

Think of this as your precision brush for concentrates. The metal tip is firm enough to scoop thicker material and controlled enough to nudge smaller dabs exactly where you want them on your nail or banger. The longer body gives you leverage and keeps your hand farther from the hot zone so you can work comfortably without feeling rushed.

Between dabs, you can rest the tool across the edge of your rig, lay it on a heat-safe accessory, or park it on a mat so you’re not getting residue on the table. The glass handle also makes it easy to spot in a cluttered sesh—way harder to lose than a tiny metal pick.

When you’re done for the night, let the tip fully cool before wiping it down. For a deeper reset, a quick soak and rinse keeps it ready for the next sesh without building up burn-on gunk.

Specifications

Length 6.0 inches (152 mm)
Handle Material Crushed glass (encased)
Tip Material Metal
Category Dab tool / dabber

Fit & Use Notes

This dabber plays nice with just about any rig setup—quartz, titanium, ceramic, or electronic surfaces—since you’re only using the metal tip to move concentrates around. If you like to bounce between rigs and even on-the-go options like nectar collectors, it’s an easy tool to keep in your kit without taking up much space.

Care & Cleaning

Let the metal tip cool completely before you touch or clean it. Once it’s cool, wipe off any residue with a cotton pad or cloth. For deeper cleans, soak just the tip in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse with water and dry before reuse. Try not to bang the glass handle into hard surfaces—treat it like any other glass piece and it’ll stay looking sharp.

FAQ

  • Will this work with my current dab setup?
    Yes. This tool works with pretty much any style of rig, banger, or nail—it’s just used to move concentrate from your stash to your hot surface. Whether you’re running a big home rig or something smaller from our silicone bongs & rigs collection, it’ll fit right into the routine.
  • Is the crushed-glass handle actually durable?
    The crushed glass is fully encased, so you’re not touching loose shards—just a textured glass handle. It’s sturdy for normal use, but like any glass, if you drop it on a hard floor or slam it against something, it can break, so try to keep it on a mat or padded tray.
  • How do I keep the metal tip from getting gunked up?
    Let the tool cool, then wipe off leftover concentrate after your sesh instead of letting it sit. If buildup happens over time, a short soak in isopropyl alcohol followed by a rinse and dry will bring it back. Storing it near your concentrate jars or stash spot makes it easy to keep clean and ready.
  • Can I travel with this dab tool?
    You can, but remember it has a glass handle, so pack it carefully. A padded case, a small protective tube, or tucking it inside a pouch with other soft gear from our general smoke shop products will help keep it from getting cracked in a bag.
  • Is this better than a full-metal dab tool?
    It comes down to feel and style. The glass handle gives you more grip and a lighter, more balanced feel in the hand compared to solid metal picks, and the metal tip still gives you the strength and precision you want on sticky or crumbly concentrates.
  • Can I use this with really soft concentrates?
    Yes. The shaped metal tip can scoop softer material, then you can gently tap or roll it onto your hot surface. If you’re dealing with especially messy textures, working over a sheet of parchment paper or a nonstick pad can help catch any drips.
  • How should I store it when not in use?
    Keep it somewhere it won’t roll off or get stepped on—a tool stand, a padded tray, or even a drawer works. If you’re storing it with other glass or metal, separating it with a soft cloth or case, like you might with other storage and packaging items, will help avoid accidental chips or scratches.

The 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is a glass carb cap built for dabbers who want smoother, more efficient dabs from their flat-top bangers. It’s ideal if you’re already into pearls or pills and want real spin, not just a glorified plug. At about 2 inches (51mm) across with a top-hat profile, it gives you easy grip and responsive airflow so you can keep temps low and flavor high.

Why It Works

  • Better use of your concentrates — Spinner-style airflow channels push air around the dish so your oil doesn’t just sit and burn in one hot spot.
  • Real terp pearl spin — When paired with pearls, the directional airflow helps them whirl, spreading heat and oil more evenly across the banger floor.
  • Low-temp friendly — By capping the banger and controlling airflow, you can ride those lower temps longer instead of feeling rushed.
  • Easy to handle when you’re cooked — The top-hat shape gives you a solid grip so you’re not fumbling around a hot banger during a heavy sesh.
  • See everything that’s happening — Clear glass lets you monitor melt, puddles, and pearl action instead of guessing.
  • Simple, no-gimmick design — One solid piece of glass that just works with most flat-top bangers in a daily driver setup.

Best For

This cap is made for dabbers who are running flat-top bangers as their main daily driver and want more control over airflow without overcomplicating their setup. It’s especially nice if you’re already using a small rig or compact setup and want tighter, more flavorful pulls without upgrading your whole piece — just add this and a clean banger and you’re in business. If you’re building out a full dab station, pair it with a solid dab mat so sticky tools and caps stay where they’re supposed to.

How to Use It

Once your banger is hot and you’ve dropped in your concentrate, set the 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap over the top of your flat-top banger. As you draw, the angled airflow in the cap pulls air in a way that makes your puddle move and, if you’re using pearls, gets them spinning.

You don’t have to overthink it — just keep the cap centered and let the airflow do the work. If your pearls aren’t moving, a slightly stronger pull or a small adjustment in how you’re holding the cap usually gets them going. A good dab tool helps you load neatly so the puddle sits right where the airflow can hit it best.

After your sesh, let the cap cool on a safe surface (not on the hot banger) so you’re not dealing with super-heated glass. A quick wipe while it’s still slightly warm will help keep reclaim from building up.

Specifications

Product Type Spinner carb cap
Material Glass
Diameter 2 inches (51mm)
Color Clear
Design Top-hat style with spinner airflow

Fit & Compatibility

This 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is designed for flat-top bangers — that wide, even top gives the cap room to sit comfortably and seal well. Most medium-sized flat-top quartz bangers will work, as long as the diameter isn’t way smaller than the cap. If your setup leans more compact or you run micro bangers, just double-check that the 2-inch (51mm) size won’t completely dwarf the top of your banger.

It plays especially nice with directional-friendly bangers and setups where you’re already running pearls or small inserts. If you’re still putting your kit together, you can round things out with some simple dab accessories like stands or holders to keep hot caps off your table.

Care & Cleaning

Let the carb cap cool fully before cleaning. Once it’s safe to touch, wipe off any loose residue. For a deeper clean, soak it in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with warm water, and dry completely before your next sesh. Regular quick wipes will keep it from getting cloudy with reclaim buildup.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my banger?
    It’s made for flat-top bangers and works best with standard medium sizes. If your banger has a flat rim and isn’t tiny, you’re likely good. Just make sure the 2" (51mm) cap won’t completely cover way past the edges of a very small banger.
  • Does it actually spin terp pearls?
    Yes — that’s the whole point of the spinner-style airflow. With a proper flat-top banger, normal draw, and pearls that aren’t oversized, you’ll see them start to spin around the dish instead of just sitting there.
  • Can I use this on angled (45°) rigs?
    You can, as long as the banger itself is a flat-top style. The angle of the joint doesn’t really matter; what matters is that the top of the banger is flat and the cap can sit on it without sliding off. If you prefer more compact setups, a small rig from our silicone bongs & rigs section can be a good, durable match.
  • Is the glass thick enough for daily use?
    It’s built as a daily-driver style carb cap — solid enough for regular seshes if you treat it like glass. It’ll handle normal heat from a banger, but like any glass piece, drops to a hard floor are another story.
  • How do I clean off heavy reclaim buildup?
    If it’s really crusted, let it soak in isopropyl alcohol until the reclaim loosens, then rinse and dry. Doing a quick wipe after each sesh keeps it from ever getting to that "why is this so sticky?" stage. Stash it on a clean surface or even next to your storage and packaging setup so it’s not picking up extra dust and grime.
  • Is this better than a basic bubble cap?
    They do different jobs. A basic bubble cap is great for simple directional control, but a spinner cap like this is purpose-built to move air in a way that spins pearls and keeps your puddle moving. If you’re into low-temp dabs and want to squeeze more performance out of your banger, upgrading to a spinner is a noticeable step up.
  • Can I travel with this or toss it in my kit?
    You can, just remember it’s glass. Keeping it in a padded pouch or alongside your other protected gear — like jars or containers from our concentrate jars lineup — goes a long way toward not opening your bag to find a pile of broken glass.

Dial In Your Dab Setup

The 2" Clear Spinner Carb Cap is a small upgrade that makes a big difference if you’re chasing flavor and efficiency from your concentrates. Pair it with a clean flat-top banger, some pearls if you like the spin, and a solid rig from our broader smoke shop products collection, and you’ve got a reliable daily setup that just works when you’re a few dabs deep and don’t want to think about it.

The 1″ Quartz Control Tower Hollow Insert is a quartz dab insert built for flavor chasers who love dialed-in, low-temp hits. Drop it into a compatible banger or slurper and the hollow tower design helps spread and hold heat more evenly, so your concentrates melt smoothly instead of flash-frying. At 1 inch (25mm), it’s sized to play nicely with typical 25mm-style setups while staying easy to handle and clean.

Why It Works

  • Stretches out your terp window — The hollow tower shape helps stabilize heat, so flavors stay rich instead of getting scorched in the first pull.
  • Smoother, more controlled vapor — Even heat distribution means concentrates melt consistently, which translates into fewer harsh, surprise rips.
  • Lets your rig do more with less — By managing how heat moves in the banger, you get more out of each dab without needing to change your whole setup.
  • Daily-driver durability — Solid quartz construction handles regular heating and cooling cycles when you’re running multiple seshes a day.
  • Easy in, easy out — The compact 1″ size and shaped profile make it simple to place, adjust, and pull for cleaning without chasing it around a hot bucket.

Best For

This insert is made for dabbers who already have a solid rig but want more control over flavor and consistency. If you’re the type who actually notices when terps fall off halfway through a dab, or you’ve been experimenting with different inserts and want something simple that just helps your setup function better, this piece belongs in your rotation. It’s also a nice upgrade if you’re building out a dedicated low-temp station alongside a reliable dab pad or mat to keep things clean.

How to Use It

Using the 1″ Quartz Control Tower Hollow Insert is straightforward: it sits inside your compatible banger or slurper and acts as a heat management piece. You heat your setup as you normally would, and the insert works in the background to smooth out how heat moves through the bucket.

Once it’s up to temp and cooled to your preferred range, load your concentrate so it contacts the heated surfaces and lets the insert do its thing, helping your material melt and vaporize steadily instead of in one aggressive burst. When you’re done, let everything cool fully before handling the insert for cleaning or storage, just like you would with your other quartz accessories or dab tools.

Specs

Material Quartz
Type Control tower hollow insert
Size 1 inch (25mm)

Fit & Compatibility

The 1″ (25mm) size is intended for use with properly sized bangers or slurpers that can physically accommodate a 25mm insert. In practice, that usually means 25mm buckets, but always double-check your gear so you’re not forcing glass-on-quartz or creating pressure points. If your setup is on the smaller side, or has a unique internal shape, this insert may not seat correctly.

Because it’s quartz, it plays well with most standard carb caps, especially styles that are designed for directional airflow or slurper-style function. Pair it with a cap that gives you good control over airflow and you’ll notice how much more consistent your pulls are. For rigs that see a lot of action, keeping everything staged near your favorite smoke shop essentials makes switching inserts in and out feel seamless.

Care & Cleaning

Let the insert cool completely before you mess with it—hot quartz and cold tools never mix well. For light cleanup, a quick wipe or swab after each sesh helps keep buildup under control.

For deeper cleans, soak the cooled insert in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry fully before tossing it back into your banger. If you’re rotating multiple inserts or storing flavor-specific pieces, keeping them in clean, sealed concentrate jars or similar containers can help keep dust and residue off between uses.

FAQ

  • Will this fit my 25mm banger?

    In most cases, yes—this insert is 1 inch (25mm), which is what many people refer to as a 25mm setup. As long as your banger or slurper is actually a 25mm internal style and not tighter or heavily shaped inside, it should sit and function properly. If your bucket is smaller, it may not fit or could feel cramped.

  • Can I use it in any quartz banger or only slurpers?

    This control tower insert can be used in compatible bangers or slurper-style nails that have room for a 25mm insert. The key is having enough internal space for the insert to sit without wedging or scraping. If you’re building out a full dab station, it pairs nicely with other nonstick gear and dab accessories that keep your setup organized.

  • Does this change how hot I need to run my dabs?

    It doesn’t force a specific temperature, but it does change how heat moves and holds inside your banger. Most people notice that the heat feels more stable and forgiving, which is why these are popular for flavor-focused, lower-temp style dabs. You can experiment within your usual comfort range and see where it tastes best.

  • How should I clean it without cracking or clouding the quartz?

    Always let it cool before cleaning. For everyday upkeep, a quick wipe after use is plenty. For deeper cleaning, soak the fully cooled insert in isopropyl alcohol, then rinse and dry before your next sesh. Avoid sudden temperature shocks—no dunking hot quartz into cold liquid.

  • Will it work with my directional or spinner carb cap?

    Yes, most directional and spinner-style caps will still function well with this insert as long as they’re sized for your banger. The insert helps manage heat while your cap manages airflow, so together they give you tighter control over how your concentrates move and vaporize. If you’re comparing options, check out different carb caps to match your style of rig and airflow.

  • Is quartz better than glass for this kind of insert?

    For dabbing applications, quartz is generally preferred over standard glass because it handles repeated heating and cooling much better. With this insert, the quartz construction lets you run regular seshes without worrying as much about heat stress, as long as you still treat it with care and avoid drops or extreme temp swings.

  • Can I use this with other concentrates or just one type?

    You can use it with whatever concentrates you normally dab. Some people like to keep separate inserts for different textures or strains to keep flavors cleaner over time. If you’re working with multiple types, backing them up with proper storage—like mylar or other compliant options from the storage and packaging section—helps keep everything fresh until it’s time to hit the rig.

At 1 inch (25.4mm) long, it’s sized to work with most control tower/slurper designs while still leaving room for proper airflow and motion.

Why it works

  • Smoother, more even vapor — The solid quartz body helps spread heat more evenly inside your banger so you’re not dealing with random hot and cold spots.
  • Longer flavor window — Extra thermal mass means your banger doesn’t crash in temp as fast, giving you more time to enjoy terps instead of rushing every dab.
  • Better use of your material — As it moves with airflow, the insert keeps oil in motion over more hot surface area, helping you pull more out of every drop.
  • Built to take the heat — Solid quartz construction is made for repeated heating and cooling, so it’s ready to be a true daily driver insert.
  • Easy maintenance — Non-porous quartz cleans back up quickly, so you’re not stuck scrubbing between every sesh.
  • Cleans up the look of your setup — The polished pattern design adds a subtle visual upgrade inside your tower or slurper without being over-the-top.

Best for

This insert is made for dabbers who already love their control tower or slurper-style banger but want more consistency and control from it. If you’re the type who tweaks timing, airflow, and cap technique to chase perfect flavor, this little chunk of quartz will fit right into your ritual. It’s also a solid upgrade if you’re dialing in a new rig and want a reliable insert to pair with your favorite dab mat and tools.

How to use it

Drop the insert into your compatible control tower or slurper-style banger before you start your heat cycle so the quartz can warm up along with the rest of the piece. Once it’s up to temp, load your material into the banger as usual and let airflow and your carb cap do the work of moving the insert and oil around. You’ll notice the hit feels more controlled and the heat curve is easier to predict, especially when you’re three dabs deep and just want things to behave the same way every time.

Between pulls, give the insert a quick visual check so it’s not overrun with residue; keeping it reasonably clean helps it move and function properly. When you’re done for the day, let everything cool, then pop the insert out for a simple wipe-down so it’s ready to go next time you crack open your favorite concentrates from one of your go-to concentrate jars.

Quick cleaning guide

Always let the insert cool fully before you touch or clean it. For light cleanup, a quick wipe with a cotton swab or cloth while there’s still a little warmth (but not hot) can keep buildup under control. For deeper cleans, soak the quartz insert in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and let it dry completely before putting it back in your banger.

Specifications

Spec Detail
Material Solid quartz
Length 1 inch (25.4mm)
Style Solid insert for control tower and slurper-style quartz bangers
Design Patterned quartz detail for visual appeal

Fit & compatibility notes

This insert is designed specifically for control tower and slurper-style quartz bangers. Because every brand’s dimensions are a little different, you’ll want to make sure your banger has enough internal height and diameter for a 1 inch (25.4mm) solid insert to move freely without getting jammed. If you’re piecing together a full setup from scratch, this pairs nicely with sturdy glass or unbreakable silicone bongs and rigs that can keep up with heavy dab use.

FAQ

  • Will this insert fit my current banger?
    It’s made for control tower and slurper-style quartz bangers, but exact fit depends on your brand’s internal dimensions. As long as your banger is tall enough and wide enough for a 1 inch (25.4mm) solid insert to sit and move without binding, you’ll be good. If your tower is especially narrow or shallow, double-check measurements before you grab one.
  • Can I use this with a regular flat-bottom banger?
    This insert is really tuned for control tower and slurper-style designs where airflow moves the insert and oil together. It may physically fit some other bangers, but you won’t get the same function it’s designed for. If you’re experimenting with different setups, start with the right style of banger and build your kit out from there with the right dab tools and caps.
  • Do I heat the insert separately?
    Most people just keep the insert in the banger during the heat cycle so everything comes up to temp together. That way, the solid quartz mass helps stabilize the heat curve. Just avoid handling or moving the insert while it’s hot so you don’t crack it or burn yourself.
  • How durable is the quartz?
    Quartz is built for repeated heating and cooling, which is why it’s the go-to for quality dab gear. That said, like any quartz accessory, it can still crack if it’s dropped on a hard surface or hit with extreme temp shock. Let it cool naturally and don’t move it straight from very hot to cold water or alcohol.
  • What’s the best way to keep it from getting gunked up?
    Staying on top of light cleaning goes a long way. After your sesh, once the insert has cooled down a bit, wipe away visible residue so it doesn’t bake into a thick layer. If it does get crusty, a soak in isopropyl alcohol and a quick rinse will bring it back. Keeping your workspace tidy with a reliable dab accessory setup also helps you stay on top of maintenance.
  • Is this better than a hollow or pill-style insert?
    It’s just different. A solid control tower insert focuses on thermal mass and consistent heat, which a lot of flavor chasers and low-temp fans prefer. Hollow, pill, or marble-style inserts may spin or move differently and change how your oil travels. If you’re dialing in your perfect setup, this solid insert is a great baseline to compare other insert styles against, especially if you’re already picky about your parchment and handling workflow from our parchment papers or similar products.
  • Can I use this with terp pearls or other inserts at the same time?
    In most control tower and slurper setups, this insert is meant to be the main moving mass, so stacking lots of extra pearls or marbles can crowd the space and hurt airflow. If you experiment with combos, make sure everything can still move freely and you’re not blocking intake slits or channels in your tower. Less is usually more with this type of insert.

Why it hits different

  • More consistent hits — The hollow tower design helps move heat through your puddle instead of letting it pool and fry in one corner of the banger.
  • Flavor stays clean — Solid quartz construction keeps the taste neutral, so you’re actually getting your strain’s terps, not hardware funk.
  • Better puddle control — The vertical profile keeps oil from slamming into one wall and sizzling out, helping your dab vaporize more evenly.
  • Sized for 30mm buckets — Built around a 1.25 inch (31.8mm) diameter to play right with standard 30mm banger setups.
  • Quick to maintain — Simple wipe-downs between dabs and occasional soaks keep it crystal clear and ready for the next sesh.
  • Big upgrade, tiny footprint — You keep the same rig and banger, but the insert makes everything feel more controlled and less random.

Best for

This insert is made for dabbers who already know their favorite banger and just want it to behave more predictably. If you’re running a 30mm quartz bucket as your daily driver and find yourself chasing the “perfect first pull” every time, this helps smooth out the whole dab from start to finish. It’s especially clutch for folks who keep a tidy station with a proper dab mat and like their setup to feel more like a dialed tool than a guessing game.

How to use it

Set the 1.25″ 30MM Quartz Control Tower Hollow Insert gently into your clean 30mm banger before you bring anything up to temp, so the tower heats along with the bucket. Once your hardware is where you like it, introduce your concentrate to the banger and let the insert manage how the puddle moves and warms inside the dish. Think of this tower as a little bit of heat management tech inside your banger. Instead of your puddle sitting in one super-hot zone, the hollow design gives heat more surface to travel through and evens out how your oil cooks. That helps reduce those surprise scorched pulls that pop up mid-dab and wreck the flavor for the rest of the hit.

For people who are serious about taste and consistency, combining this insert with clean glass and good storage — like heavy-bottom glass concentrate jars that protect terps between seshes — turns your rig into a more reliable, repeatable setup.

Specifications

Material Quartz
Outer Diameter 1.25 inches (31.8mm)
Intended Banger Size 30mm setups
Design Style Hollow control tower insert

Fit & compatibility

Once it’s cool, wipe out leftover residue with a cotton swab, and when you want it looking brand new again, soak briefly in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and let it dry fully. FAQs

  • Will this fit my 30mm banger?

    Yes, as long as the insert is fully cooled first. Let it come back to room temp, then soak in isopropyl alcohol, rinse with clean water, and dry before reuse.
